秋七月，以夫人卞氏為王后。遣于禁助曹仁擊關羽。八月，漢水溢，灌禁軍，軍沒，羽獲禁，遂圍仁。使徐晃救之。




Ninth Moon [219 Sep 27 – Oct 25], Chancellor of State Zhōng Yáo in connection to West Department Official Wèi Fěng’s rebellion was dismissed. [115]



九月，相國鍾繇坐西曹掾魏諷反免。〔一〕










[115] Shìyǔ states: [Wèi] Fěng appellation Zǐjīng was a Pèi man, had talent in captivating the masses, admired and active in Yè capital, Zhōng Yáo because of this recruited him. The main army had not yet returned, [Wèi] Fěng secretly joined with followers and faction, and also with Chánglè Minister of the Guard Chén Yī planned to attack Yè. Before the planned time, [Chén] Yī was afraid and reported it to the Heir-Apparent [Cáo Pī]. Executed [Wèi] Fěng, those connected that died were several tens of men.
Wáng Chǎng’s Jiājiè states: “Jǐyīn’s Wèi Fěng,” but this says “Pèi man.” It is uncertain.



〔一〕　世語曰：諷字子京，沛人，有惑眾才，傾動鄴都，鍾繇由是辟焉。大軍未反，諷潛結徒黨，又與長樂衛尉陳禕謀襲鄴。未及期，禕懼，告之太子，誅諷，坐死者數十人。王昶家誡曰「濟陰魏諷」，而此云沛人，未詳。







Winter, Tenth Moon [219 Oct 26 – Nov 24], the army returned to Luòyáng. [116] Sūn Quán sent envoy to send up letter to request to suppress Guān Yǔ to prove himself. The King from Luòyáng campaigned south against [Guān] Yǔ, had not yet arrived, [Xú] Huǎng attacked [Guān] Yǔ, defeated him, [Guān] Yǔ fled, [Cáo] Rén’s besiegement was resolved. The King’s army at Móbēi. [117]



冬十月，軍還洛陽。〔一〕孫權遣使上書，以討關羽自效。王自洛陽南征羽，未至，晃攻羽，破之，羽走，仁圍解。王軍摩陂。〔二〕










[116] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The King rebuilt the North Division Commandant Office, ordering it surpass its former state.



〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：王更脩治北部尉廨，令過于舊。













[117] Wèi lüè states: Sūn Quán sent up letter declaring himself subject, declaring and explaining Heaven’s Mandate. The King had [Sūn] Quán’s letter shown to the exterior, saying: “This boy wishes to put me above the stove fire!” Attendant Central Chén Qún and Secretariat Writer Huán Jiē memorialized stating: “Hàn from since Emperor Ān onward had governance leave the ruling house, the state’s succession was repeatedly severed. Reaching to the present, there is only the name and title. A chǐ of land or a single civilian, all are not Hàn’s possession. Its allotted fate for a long time has already been exhausted, the calendar calculations for a long time have already ended. It is not only on today. Therefore, during Huán and Líng, those that observed and understood the Tú and Wĕi all said: ‘Hàn’s transition aura is exhausted, the Yellow House shall rise.’ Your Highness answers this allotment, of the ten divisions of Heaven’s Under then possessing nine, to submit and serve Hàn, the crowds take note and watch, far and near complain and sigh, and therefore Sūn Quán from afar declares himself subject, this is the answering of Heaven and Man, different auras together in chorus. Your Servants humbly believe Yú and Xià did not modestly decline, Yīn and Zhōu did not begrudge executing and exiling. Fearing Heaven and understanding the Mandate, there is no reason to decline.”
Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Xiàhóu Dūn said to the King: “Heaven’s Under all knows Hàn’s blessings are already exhausted, a different dynasty is about to rise. Since antiquity onward, the one able to remove the people’s sufferings and to which the Hundred Surnames submit to, is exactly the ruler of the people. Now Your Highness has fought in war for over thirty years, achievements and virtues known to the numerous masses, the one Heaven’s Under depends on and submits to. In answering Heaven and obeying the people, what further is there to doubt?” The King said: “‘Displaying it in government, is also to be government.’ If Heaven’s Mandate is with me, I am Zhōu Wén-wáng.”
Cáo Mán zhuàn and Shìyǔ both say Huán Jiē urged the King to correct his rank, Xiàhóu Dūn believed: “It is appropriate to first exterminate Shǔ, if Shǔ is destroyed then Wú will submit, two regions then settled, and only afterward follow the path of Shùn and Yǔ.” The King followed this. When the King died, [Xiàhóu] Dūn regretted his previous words, fell ill and died.
Sūn Shèng’s Appraisal states: Xiàhóu Dūn was ashamed to be a Hàn official and requested to receive a Wèi seal. Huán Jiē was proper and honest, having righteous and upright integrity. Investigating their biography records, Shìyǔ is absurd.



〔二〕　魏略曰：孫權上書稱臣，稱說天命。王以權書示外曰：「是兒欲踞吾著爐火上邪！」侍中陳群、尚書桓階奏曰：「漢自安帝已來，政去公室，國統數絕，至於今者，唯有名號，尺土一民，皆非漢有，期運久已盡，曆數久已終，非適今日也。是以桓、靈之間，諸明圖緯者，皆言『漢行氣盡，黃家當興』。殿下應期，十分天下而有其九，以服事漢，群生注望，，遐邇怨歎，是故孫權在遠稱臣，此天人之應，異氣齊聲。臣愚以為虞、夏不以謙辭，殷、周不吝誅放，畏天知命，無所與讓也。」魏氏春秋曰：夏侯惇謂王曰：「天下咸知漢祚已盡，異代方起。自古已來，能除民害為百姓所歸者，即民主也。今殿下即戎三十餘年，功德著於黎庶，為天下所依歸，應天順民，復何疑哉！」王曰：「『施于有政，是亦為政』。若天命在吾，吾為周文王矣。」曹瞞傳及世語並云桓階勸王正位，夏侯惇以為宜先滅蜀，蜀亡則吳服，二方既定，然後遵舜、禹之軌，王從之。及至王薨，惇追恨前言，發病卒。孫盛評曰：夏侯惇恥為漢官，求受魏印，桓階方惇，有義直之節；考其傳記，世語為妄矣。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 25 (220)


Twenty-Fifth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [220 Feb 22 – Mar 21], reached Luòyáng. [Sūn] Quán struck and beheaded [Guān] Yǔ, sent his head.



二十五年春正月，至洛陽。權擊斬羽，傳其首。




Gēngzǐ [220 Mar 15], the King passed away at Luòyáng, his years sixty-six. [118] Legacy Order said: “Heaven’s Under is not yet secure and settled, and cannot follow the old ways. When the burial is complete, all are to remove mourning clothes. Those commanding troops in garrison camps are all to not leave their garrison departments. Relevant managers are to each continue in their offices. Dress in seasonal clothes, without storage of gold or jade treasures.” Posthumous name Wǔ-wáng. Second Moon [220 Mar 22 – Apr 20] Dīngmǎo [220 Apr 11], buried at Gāolíng. [119]



庚子，王崩于洛陽，年六十六。〔一〕遺令曰：「天下尚未安定，未得遵古也。葬畢，皆除服。其將兵屯戍者，皆不得離屯部。有司各率乃職。斂以時服，無藏金玉珍寶。」諡曰武王。二月丁卯，葬高陵。〔二〕










[118] Shìyǔ states: Tàizǔ from Hànzhōng reached Luòyáng, raised Jiànshǐ Hall, cut down Zhuólóng shrine, but from the trees blood came out.
Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The King sent laborer Sū Yuè to move a pear tree. Digging it, a root was damaged and out came blood. [Sū] Yuè reported the situation. The King personally went to see and hated it, believing it inauspicious, returned and therefore fell ill.



〔一〕　世語曰：太祖自漢中至洛陽，起建始殿，伐濯龍祠而樹血出。曹瞞傳曰：王使工蘇越徙美梨，掘之，根傷盡出血。越白狀，王躬自視而惡之，以為不祥，還遂寢疾。













[119] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ personally took the reins of Within the Seas, weeded and razed the crowds of the evil, his deploying of armies and employing of brigades overall followed the methods of Sūn [Wǔ] and Wú [Qǐ], but in taking advantage of situations and setting surprises, outwitting the enemy to secure victory, the transformations were like a deity. He personally composed military books of over a hundred thousand words, the various officers on campaign all consulted his Xīn shū in managing affairs. Overseeing matters he also hand wrote dispatch directions, those that followed orders achieved victory, those that violated instructions suffered defeats. Facing the enemy lines, his thoughts were tranquil and at ease, as if not wishing to battle, however reaching the decisive opportunity to seize victory, his energy was overflowing, therefore every battle was certain to succeed, the army never only by fortune victorious. He understood men and excelled in observation, difficult to beguile with falseness, selected out Yú Jīn and Yuè Jìn from among the battle lines, obtained Zhāng Liáo and Xú Huǎng from within defeated enemies, all assisted the mandate and established achievements, ranked as famed officers. The rest that he selected out from the small and obscure, raised to be governors and administrators, cannot even be counted. Therefore he created a great enterprise, civil and martial together enacted, led the army for over thirty years, his hand did not set aside books, in daytime then discussing martial strategy, in the night then pondering the classics, when climbing up high certain to compose an ode, and when he made a new poem, he set it to pipes and strings, all becoming musical songs. His talent and strength surpassed men, hand shooting flying birds, personally capturing fierce beasts, once at Nánpí in one day shooting pheasants and obtaining sixty-three heads. Reaching to the building of Palace Residences, repairing of machines and weapons, none were not by his methods and models, all completely by his intentions. Elegant in nature and frugal, he did not enjoy flowery decoration, the Rear Palace clothes were not embroidered, his attendants’ shoes were not of two colors, his curtains and screens when damaged were patched, his bedding was for warmth, with no fringe decorations. In attacking cities and capturing towns, when obtaining beautiful things, then bestowed them all on those with achievements. For accomplished labors that should be rewarded, he did not begrudge a thousand gold. For those without achievements hoping for bestowment, the smallest fraction was not given. The Four Quarters sent tribute, he shared it together with his subordinates. He always believed the systems of ending arrangements and the numbers of burial shrouds were complicated and without benefit, vulgar and also excessive, and therefore in advance on his own regulated his final arrangements to clothes of four packages and nothing more.
Fù-zǐ states: Tàizǔ regretted that marriages had become extravagant and presumptuous. When his daughters were matched to someone, all had black curtains, the accompanying maid servants did not exceed ten people.
Zhāng Huá’s Bówùzhì states: In Hàn’s era, Ānpíng’s Cuī Yuàn, [Cuī] Yuàn’s son [Cuī] Shí, Hóngnóng’s Zhāng Zhī, [Zhāng] Zhī’s younger brother [Zhāng] Chǎng all excelled in cursive script, and Tàizǔ was second to them. Huán Tán and Cài Yōng excelled in music, Píngyì’s Shān Zǐdào, Wáng Jiǔzhēn, Guō Kǎi, and others excelled in wéiqí, Tàizǔ all matched them in ability. Also he enjoyed cultivation methods, also understood medicine and pharmacology, attracted and gathered masters of technical arts, Lújiāng’s Zuǒ Cí, Qiáo Prefecture’s Huà Tuó, Gānlíng’s Gān Shǐ, Yángchéng’s Xì Jiǎn, none did not all come. Also he regularly ate yěgé of one chǐ, and also sometimes drank poisoned alcohol.
Fù-zǐ states: At Hàn’s end of the kings and dukes many cast aside royal clothes, wore headscarves as fashion, and therefore the sorts as Yuán Shào and Cuī Jūn, although they were military commanders, all wore silk headscarves. Wèi Tàizǔ because Heaven’s Under was in desolation, resources and wealth lacking and exhausted, imitated ancient leather caps, cut silk to make the cap, in accordance with intentions for simplicity and ease and adapting to the times, using color to distinguish noble and lowly. To the present it is in use, and can be said to be a military appearance, not a stately appearance.
Cáo Mán zhuàn states: Tàizǔ as a man was frivolous and impulsive, without weighty prestige, enjoyed music, singers and performers at his side, always from day to night. He wore clothes of light raw silk, his body wearing girdle of small belt and purse, to hold hand scarf and small items, at times wearing cap to meet guests. Every time he conversed with someone, he would tease and joke, completely without holding back, and when pleased he would greatly laugh, to the extent that his head would be drenched in his cups on the table, dishes and food all dirtying his headscarf, his recklessness was like this. However in wielding law he was severe and oppressive, if among the various officers there was one with a strategy that surpassed his own, then he would use the law to execute them, reaching to past friends and old enemies, also all had none remaining. Those he condemned to death, then he would face them and shed tears and sigh in pain, but to the end none were spared. Previously, Yuán Zhōng was Pèi Chancellor, once wished to use the law to punish Tàizǔ, and Pèi State’s Huán Shào also disparaged him. Reaching to when he was at Yǎn Province, Chénliú’s Biān Ràng in speaking comments often offended Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ killed him and clan exterminated his family. [Yuán] Zhōng and [Huán] Shào both fled the troubles to Jiāo Province. Tàizǔ sent an envoy to meet Administrator Shì Xiè to completely clan exterminate them. Huán Shào was able to surrender himself, bowed and apologized in the courtyards, Tàizǔ said: “Can kneeling pardon death?” Therefore killed him. Once he set out the army, traveled through wheat, ordered: “Soldiers are not to damage wheat, violators die.” Cavalry servicemen all dismounted horse, parting the wheat to support one another. Then Tàizǔ’s horse galloped into the wheat. Ordered the Registrar to discuss punishment. The Registrar replied believing: “By the principles of the Chūnqiū, punishments are not applied on the honored.” Tàizǔ said: “To systemize a law but myself violate it, how can I command subordinates? However I am the army commander, and cannot kill myself, and request to punish myself.” Therefore he drew sword and cut his hair to set on the ground. Also he had a favored concubine that once accompanied when he napped during the day, pillowed on her lap, instructed her stating: “In a short while wake me.” The concubine saw Tàizǔ was resting peacefully, and did not at once wake him. When he woke up himself, had her beaten to death. Once while suppressing bandits, the government grain was not enough, and he privately said to the manager: “What can be done?” The manager said: “We can use smaller measuring cups to satisfy it.” Tàizǔ said: “Excellent.” Later those in the army said Tàizǔ was cheating the masses. Tàizǔ said to the manager: “I must specially rely on your death to appease the masses, if not the matter cannot be resolved.” Thus beheaded him, taking the head with an announcement sign stating: “For using smaller measuring cups, stealing government grain, beheaded him at the army gates.” His ruthless brutality and accommodating deceptions were all of this sort.



〔二〕　魏書曰：太祖自統御海內，芟夷群醜，其行軍用師，大較依孫、吳之法，而因事設奇，譎敵制勝，變化如神。自作兵書十萬餘言，諸將征伐，皆以新書從事。臨事又手為節度，從令者克捷，違教者負敗。與虜對陳，意思安閒，如不欲戰，然及至決機乘勝，氣勢盈溢，故每戰必克，軍無幸勝。知人善察，難眩以偽，拔于禁、樂進於行陳之間，取張遼、徐晃於亡虜之內，皆佐命立功，列為名將；其餘拔出細微，登為牧守者，不可勝數。是以創造大業，文武並施，御軍三十餘年，手不捨書，晝則講武策，夜則思經傳，登高必賦，及造新詩，被之管絃，皆成樂章。才力絕人，手射飛鳥，躬禽猛獸，嘗于南皮一日射雉獲六十三頭。及造作宮室，繕治器械，無不為之法則，皆盡其意。雅性節儉，不好華麗，後宮衣不錦繡，侍御履不二采，帷帳屏風，壞則補納，茵蓐取溫，無有緣飾。攻城拔邑，得美麗之物，則悉以賜有功，勳勞宜賞，不吝千金，無功望施，分毫不與，四方獻御，與群下共之。常以送終之制，襲稱之數，繁而無益，俗又過之，故預自制終亡衣服，四篋而已。傅子曰：太祖愍嫁取之奢僭，公女適人，皆以皁帳，從婢不過十人。張華博物志曰：漢世，安平崔瑗、瑗子寔、弘農張芝、芝弟昶並善草書，而太祖亞之。桓譚、蔡邕善音樂，馮翊山子道、王九真、郭凱等善圍棋，太祖皆與埒能。又好養性法，亦解方藥，招引方術之士，廬江左慈、譙郡華佗、甘陵甘始、陽城郄儉無不畢至，又習啖野葛至一尺，亦得少多飲鴆酒。傅子曰：漢末王公，多委王服，以幅巾為雅，是以袁紹、（崔豹）〔崔鈞〕之徒，雖為將帥，皆著縑巾。魏太祖以天下凶荒，資財乏匱，擬古皮弁，裁縑帛以為帢，合于簡易隨時之義，以色別其貴賤，于今施行，可謂軍容，非國容也。曹瞞傳曰：太祖為人佻易無威重，好音樂，倡優在側，常以日達夕。被服輕綃，身自佩小鞶囊，以盛手巾細物，時或冠帢帽以見賓客。每與人談論，戲弄言誦，盡無所隱，及歡悅大笑，至以頭沒杯案中，肴膳皆沾汙巾幘，其輕易如此。然持法峻刻，諸將有計畫勝出己者，隨以法誅之，及故人舊怨，亦皆無餘。其所刑殺，輒對之垂涕嗟痛之，終無所活。初，袁忠為沛相，嘗欲以法治太祖，沛國桓邵亦輕之，及在兗州，陳留邊讓言議頗侵太祖，太祖殺讓，族其家，忠、邵俱避難交州，太祖遣使就太守士燮盡族之。桓邵得出首，拜謝於庭中，太祖謂曰：「跪可解死邪！」遂殺之。常出軍，行經麥中，令「士卒無敗麥，犯者死」。騎士皆下馬，付麥以相持，於是太祖馬騰入麥中，敕主簿議罪；主簿對以春秋之義，罰不加於尊。太祖曰：「制法而自犯之，何以帥下？然孤為軍帥，不可自殺，請自刑。」因援劍割髮以置地。又有幸姬常從晝寢，枕之臥，告之曰：「須臾覺我。」姬見太祖臥安，未即寤，及自覺，棒殺之。常討賊，廩穀不足，私謂主者曰：「如何？」主者曰：「可以小斛以足之。」太祖曰：「善。」後軍中言太祖欺眾，太祖謂主者曰：「特當借君死以厭眾，不然事不解。」乃斬之，取首題徇曰：「行小斛，盜官穀，斬之軍門。」其酷虐變詐，皆此類也。







Appraisal states: At Hàn’s end, Heaven’s Under was in great chaos, the stalwart and powerful all rising, and Yuán Shào like a tiger oversaw four provinces, his strength flourishing without match. Tàizǔ formulated strategies and enacted plans, thrashing within the world, wielding the legalist techniques of Shēn [Bùhài] and Shāng [Yāng], encompassing the exceptional strategies of Hán [Xìn] and Bái [Qǐ], government office conferred by talents, each according to their abilities, discarding feelings in appointment and calculation, not caring for old grievances, that in the end he was able to wield Imperial power, succeeded and achieved the vast enterprise, was only because his enlightened strategy was the most exceptional. It could be said that he was no ordinary man, a hero who transcended the era.



評曰：漢末，天下大亂，雄豪並起，而袁紹虎視四州，彊盛莫敵。太祖運籌演謀，鞭撻宇內，攬申、商之法術，該韓、白之奇策，官方授材，各因其器，矯情任算，不念舊惡，終能總御皇機，克成洪業者，惟其明略最優也。抑可謂非常之人，超世之傑矣。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text: Yuān county was in Nányáng prefecture. The character is also commonly read as Wǎn, but the old reading Yuān is favored here to disambiguate with the Wǎn county in Lújiāng prefecture.↩︎

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text: Yánkāng (220)

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text:
Wén Huángdì forbidden name Pī appellation Zǐhuán, was Wǔ-dì’s Heir-Apparent. Zhōngpíng Fourth Year [187] Winter, born at Qiáo. [1] Jiàn’ān Sixteenth Year [211], became Five Office Central Cadet General, aide to the Assistant Chancellor. Twenty-Second Year [217], established as Wèi Heir-Apparent. [2] When Tàizǔ passed away, succeeded the positions of Assistant Chancellor, King of Wèi. [3] Honored the Royal Queen as Royal Dowager Queen. Changed Jiàn’ān Twenty-Fifth Year to Yánkāng Inaugural Year.



文皇帝諱丕，字子桓，武帝太子也。中平四年冬，生于譙。〔一〕建安十六年，為五官中郎將、副丞相。二十二年，立為魏太子〔二〕。太祖崩，嗣位為丞相、魏王。〔三〕尊王后曰王太后。改建安二十五年為延康元年。










[1] Wèi shū states: At the time when the Emperor was born, there was a mist cyan and round like a chariot’s canopy above him, to the end of day. An interpreter of mist believed that it was a confirmation of utmost nobility, not the mist of a servant of men. Aged eight years, he was able to compose prose. He had outstanding talent, and therefore widely worked through the books of the classics and hundred schools of thought from antiquity to the present. He excelled in riding and shooting, and enjoyed sword fencing. Nominated as Abundant Talent, not enacted.
Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Jiàn’ān Thirteenth Year [208], he was by Excellency over the Masses Zhào Wēn recruited. Tàizǔ memorialized: “[Zhào] Wēn has recruited from Your Servant’s junior relatives, the selection and nomination therefore cannot be genuine.” Sent Attendant Central observing Minister of Staff Chī Lǜ Holding Stave to present the certificate dismissing [Zhào] Wēn from office.



〔一〕　魏書曰：帝生時，有雲氣青色而圜如車蓋當其上，終日，望氣者以為至貴之證，非人臣之氣。年八歲，能屬文。有逸才，遂博貫古今經傳諸子百家之書。善騎射，好擊劍。舉茂才，不行。獻帝起居注曰：建安十（五）〔三〕年，為司徒趙溫所辟。太祖表「溫辟臣子弟，選舉故不以實」。使侍中守光祿勳郗慮持節奉策免溫官。













[2] Wèi lüè states: Tàizǔ did not timely establish the Heir-Apparent, the Heir-Apparent doubted himself. At the time there was a Gāo Yuánlǚ, excelled in physiognomy, thus called and asked him, and he replied saying: “Your nobility cannot be spoken of.” Asked: “How long is my lifespan?” Yuánlǚ said: “As for lifespan, reaching forty there will be a small hardship, passing that there will be no worries.” Later very soon he was established as the Royal Heir-Apparent, reaching years of forty then he died.



〔二〕　魏略曰：太祖不時立太子，太子自疑。是時有高元呂者，善相人，乃呼問之，對曰：「其貴乃不可言。」問：「壽幾何？」元呂曰：「其壽，至四十當有小苦，過是無憂也。」後無幾而立為王太子，至年四十而薨。













[3] Yuán Hóng’s Hàn jì records the Hàn Emperor’s Edict stating: “Wèi Heir-Apparent [Cáo] Pī: in the past August Heaven provided your illustrious father to assist Our Imperial family, therefore forcefully he eliminated the crowds of evils, expanded and settled the Nine Provinces, vast achievements and abundant accomplishments, radiant through the cosmos. We employed folded hands and back against the screen for over twenty years. Heaven could not leave me one elder, to forever protect my one person, early departed and concealed as a spirit, I mourn and lament in deep pain. [Cáo] Pī, you accumulated generations of renown and enlightenment, and should grasp the civil and the martial, to carry on and expand the previous legacy. Now send Envoy Holding Stave Censorate Grandee Huà Xīn to present the conferment Edict to grant [Cáo] Pī the Assistant Chancellor’s Seal and Ribbon, the King of Wèi’s Ruler’s Seal and Cord, designate Jì Province Governor. Right now the exterior has remnant caitiffs, distant Yí not yet guests, flags and drums are still at the frontier borders, shields and spears cannot be cased and sheathed. This then is the season for spreading and raising vast exploits, establishing achievement and passing down name. How can you cultivate the rituals of the mourning rooms and seek the ambitions of Zēng and Mǐn? Thus respectfully obey Our command: restrain and stop your mourning and sorrow, follow and revere this legacy, in time shine with numerous achievements, to fulfill Our intention. Oh alas, you cannot but exhort yourself!”



〔三〕　袁宏漢紀載漢帝詔曰：「魏太子丕：昔皇天授乃顯考以翼我皇家，遂攘除群凶，拓定九州，弘功茂績，光於宇宙，朕用垂拱負扆二十有餘載。天不憖遺一老，永保余一人，早世潛神，哀悼傷切。丕奕世宣明，宜秉文武，紹熙前緒。今使使持節御史大夫華歆奉策詔授丕丞相印綬、魏王璽紱，領冀州牧。方今外有遺虜，遐夷未賓，旗鼓猶在邊境，干戈不得韜刃，斯乃播揚洪烈，立功垂名之秋也。豈得脩諒闇之禮，究曾、閔之志哉？其敬服朕命，抑弭憂懷，旁祗厥緒，時亮庶功，以稱朕意。於戲，可不勉與！」

[13] Wèi lüè states: The King was about to set out on campaign. Limiting Expenses Central Cadet General Xīnpíng’s Huò Xìng sent up memorial remonstrating that said: “Your Servant has heard that in the matter of King Wén and Zhòu, at the time Heaven’s Under ‘closed sacks to avoid blame,’ altogether hundreds of noble men, none willing to give counsel. Now you Great King embody the model of Qián and Kūn, widely opening to listen in four [directions], allowing the worthy and the foolish to each establish their judgments. In prostration considering that the Former King [Cáo Cāo] in achievements is without compare, but now of what can be said, he was not praised for virtue. Therefore the sagely man states: ‘Obtain the pleased hearts of the Hundred Surnames,’ the military books states: ‘Battle is a dangerous affair.’ Therefore, the six states fiercely battled and powerful Qín took advantage of their exhaustion, the King of Bīn did not fight and Zhōu’s ways thus prospered. I humbly say that you Great King for the time being should entrust the heavy [responsibilities] to the current Court and ‘maintain the feminine,’ restrain power as a tiger crouching, and your achievements and enterprise can be completed. But now at the initiation of the foundations, you yet again raise troops. Troops are a violent tool, certainly there will be violent disturbances, disturbances then lead to thoughts of chaos, chaos appears without expecting it. Your Servant says this precariousness is the precariousness of stacked eggs. In the past Xià Qǐ was in seclusion for three years, the Yì has ‘do not go far and so return,’ the Lún has ‘do not fear change.’ Sincerely may you the Great King consider the past and investigate the present, deeply plan and distantly consider, with the three serving grandees calculate the strengths and shortcomings. Your Servant was immersed in the Former King’s treatment, and also at the first change in government further received heavy responsibility, and though I know that speaking will disturb dragon scales and that flattery is near to fortune, I humbly am emotionally moved of having read of ‘precarious and yet not supported.’” The memorial was sent, the Emperor was furious, sent inspectors of treason to interrogate, in the end killing him. Shortly after he regretted it, pursued to pardon but was too late.



〔二〕　魏略曰：王將出征，度支中郎將新平霍性上疏諫曰：「臣聞文王與紂之事，是時天下括囊無咎，凡百君子，莫肯用訊。今大王體則乾坤，廣開四聰，使賢愚各建所規。伏惟先王功無與比，而今能言之類，不稱為德。故聖人曰『得百姓之歡心』。兵書曰『戰，危事也』是以六國力戰，彊秦承弊，豳王不爭，周道用興。愚謂大王且當委重本朝而守其雌，抗威虎臥，功業可成。而今創基，便復起兵，兵者凶器，必有凶擾，擾則思亂，亂出不意。臣謂此危，危于累卵。昔夏啟隱神三年，易有『不遠而復』，論有『不憚改』。誠願大王揆古察今，深謀遠慮，與三事大夫算其長短。臣沐浴先王之遇，又初改政，復受重任，雖知言觸龍鱗，阿諛近福，竊感所誦，危而不持。」奏通，帝怒，遣刺奸就考，竟殺之。既而悔之，追原不及。

〔一〕　管子曰：黃帝立明臺之議者，上觀於兵也；堯有衢室之問者，下聽於民也；舜有告善之旌，而主不蔽也；禹立建鼓於朝，而備訴訟也；湯有總街之廷，以觀民非也；武王有靈臺之囿，而賢者進也：此古聖帝明王所以有而勿失，得而勿忘也。

Sūn Shèng states: In the past the Former Kings used filial piety to govern Heaven’s Under, inside restraining natural instincts, outside extending to the Four Seas, to the surviving thorough in their respect, to the departed utmost in their mourning, pondering and remembering in the mourning rooms, entrusting government to the senior ministers, and therefore it is said: “The Three Years of Mourning applies from Heaven’s Son to the common people.” That being so, therefore the relationships of the three will be genuine, the affection of servants and subjects sincere, the transformation of harmony and prosperity expand, the ways of managing the state firm, how the sagely man is able to connect to Heaven and Earth, thicken human relationships, spread utmost teachings, esteem social customs. This is a standard that for ten thousand generations did not change, a system that the Hundred Kings submitted to and embraced. Therefore in mourning rituals of white cap, the Kuài people wrote the ridicule of “if only seeing,” Zǎi Yú shortened the mourning period and Zhòngní sighed that it was not benevolent, Zǐtuí forgot his grief and the noble man believed it delighting in disaster, the Marquess of Lǔ changed clothes and the Chūnqiū knew he would not last to the end. How were these not the decline of the sincere heart of utmost pain, the disappointment of the great principles of mourning dirges? Therefore even at the end of the three finalities or at the destitution of the seven powers, yet there never was an abandonment of mourning clothes between ten days and a moon, or a releasing of coarse cane on the day of weeping. Reaching to Hàn Wén, there was a change from the ancient systems, generations of human principles abandoned in one morning, mourning clothes seized away by the Utmost Honored, the Four Seas dispersed the restrictions of silence, righteous feelings lost by the various lords, great cultivation fallen from the lord’s kin. Although the intention was to reduce and economize, the thoughts on weaving threads, as for cultivating virtue and bequeathing reputation, honoring influence and transforming customs, assuredly the morality was less than in past years, customs degenerated over a hundred generations. Moreover King Wǔ conveyed tablet and Mǔyè did not have battle lines, Jìn Xiāng wore black mourning hemp and three commanders became captives. In responding to duties and accomplishing achievements, mourning clothes have what harm? The King of Wèi both imitated Hàn’s systems and discarded the Great Rituals, during the heaviest of mourning yet set feasting music, at the beginning of the succession yet discarded the foundations of the ruler’s influence, and reaching to the acceptance of the abdication, he prominently accepted the two daughters, forgetting his utmost sorrow to falsely imitate the ancient sages. Heaven’s heart was lost, so how could he last to the end? Therefore one can know that the King’s life would not be long, and divine that the period of [his state’s] reign would be short.



〔一〕　魏書曰：設伎樂百戲，令曰：「先王皆樂其所生，禮不忘其本。譙，霸王之邦，真人本出，其復譙租稅二年。」三老吏民上壽，日夕而罷。丙申，親祠譙陵。孫盛曰：昔者先王之以孝治天下也，內節天性，外施四海，存盡其敬，亡極其哀，思慕諒闇，寄政冢宰，故曰「三年之喪，自天子達於庶人」；夫然，故在三之義惇，臣子之恩篤，雍熙之化隆，經國之道固，聖人之所以通天地，厚人倫，顯至教，敦風俗，斯萬世不易之典，百王服膺之制也。是故喪禮素冠，鄶人著庶見之譏，宰予降期，仲尼發不仁之歎，子頹忘戚，君子以為樂禍，魯侯易服，春秋知其不終，豈不以墜至痛之誠心，喪哀樂之大節者哉？故雖三季之末，七雄之弊，猶未有廢縗斬於旬朔之間，釋麻杖於反哭之日者也。逮於漢文，變易古制，人道之紀，一旦而廢，縗素奪於至尊，四海散其遏密，義感闕於群后，大化墜於君親；雖心存貶約，慮在經綸，至於樹德垂聲，崇化變俗，固以道薄於當年，風頹於百代矣。且武王載主而牧野不陳，晉襄墨縗而三帥為俘，應務濟功，服其焉害？魏王既追漢制，替其大禮，處莫重之哀而設饗宴之樂，居貽厥之始而墜王化之基，及至受禪，顯納二女，忘其至恤以誣先聖之典，天心喪矣，將何以終！是以知王齡之不遐，卜世之期促也。







Winter, Tenth Moon, Guǐmǎo [220 Nov 13], Order said: “The various officers go on campaign, of the soldiers that died some are not yet collected, I extremely mourn this. Thus announce to the prefectures and states to provide caskets and cases for their burials, [17] send them to their homes, government offices set sacrifices for them. [18] Bǐngwǔ [220 Nov 19], traveled and reached Qǔlí.



冬十（一）月癸卯，令曰：「諸將征伐，士卒死亡者或未收斂，吾甚哀之；其告郡國給槥櫝殯斂，〔一〕送致其家，官為設祭。」〔二〕丙午，行至曲蠡。










[17] Huì (“casket”) pronounced Wèi.



〔一〕槥音衛。













[18] Hàn shū: Gāozǔ’s Eighth Moon Order states: “For the soldiers in the army that died, make caskets.”
Yīng Shào states: “Caskets are small coffins, now called as cases.”
Yīng Qú’s Bǎi Yī Shī states: “Casket carriages on the road, campaign soldiers cannot rest.”
Lù Jī’s Dà Mù Fù states: “Seeing narrow wood and feeling despondent, observing immense cases and remembering caskets.”



〔二〕　漢書高祖八月令曰：「士卒從軍死，為槥。」應劭曰：「槥，小棺也，今謂之櫝。」應璩百一詩曰：「槥車在道路，征夫不得休。」陸機大墓賦曰：「觀細木而悶遲，睹洪櫝而念槥。」

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text:
The Abdication


The Hàn Emperor, because the expectations of the masses were on Wèi, thus summoned the various Excellencies and Ministers and servicemen, [19] announced and sacrificed at Gāo Temple. Sent concurrent Censorate Grandee Zhāng Yīn Holding Stave to present the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon to abdicate the throne, the conferment said: “Oh you the King of Wèi: In the past the Emperor Yáo abdicated the throne to Yú Shùn, and Shùn also passed the Mandate to Yǔ. Heaven’s Mandate is not constant, and only goes to those with virtue. Hàn’s Way has fallen and declined, its generations losing their order, declining to reach Our person, great chaos and growing confusion, crowds of vicious unrestrained in rebellion, the cosmos overturned. Relying on King Wǔ’s [Cáo Cāo’s] divine martial power, rescuing the Four Quarters from the growing disasters, purifying the regions of Xià, to protect and pacify our Ancestral Temples. How was it only my one person who obtained peace? It enabled the Nine Regions to truly receive this bestowment. Now you the King respectfully continue the former threads, radiate the virtues, expand the great enterprise of the civil and martial, shining your late father’s vast exploits. The August Spirits give down the signs, men and deities report the omens, oh pondering shining qualities, multitudes informing Our mandate, all say your capability accords with Yú Shùn; employing our Táng standards, I respectfully abdicate to you the throne. Alas! ‘Heaven’s calendar calculations are upon your person, justly maintain the correct, [or else] Heaven’s blessings forever end.’ You must respectfully follow the great rituals, provide for all states, to solemnly carry on Heaven’s Mandate.” [20] Thus made a platform at Fányáng. Gēngwǔ [220 Dec 10], the King ascended the platform and accepted the throne, the Hundred Offices in accompanying seats. The matter finished, descended the platform, oversaw the burnings to complete the ritual and returned. Changed Yánkāng to Huángchū. Great Amnesty.[21]



漢帝以眾望在魏，乃召群公卿士，〔一〕告祠高廟。使兼御史大夫張音持節奉璽綬禪位，冊曰：「咨爾魏王：昔者帝堯禪位於虞舜，舜亦以命禹，天命不于常，惟歸有德。漢道陵遲，世失其序，降及朕躬，大亂茲昏，群兇肆逆，宇內顛覆。賴武王神武，拯茲難於四方，惟清區夏，以保綏我宗廟，豈予一人獲乂，俾九服實受其賜。今王欽承前緒，光于乃德，恢文武之大業，昭爾考之弘烈。皇靈降瑞，人神告徵，誕惟亮采，師錫朕命，僉曰爾度克協于虞舜，用率我唐典，敬遜爾位。於戲！天之曆數在爾躬，允執其中，天祿永終；君其祗順大禮，饗茲萬國，以肅承天命。」〔二〕乃為壇於繁陽。庚午，王升壇即阼，百官陪位。事訖，降壇，視燎成禮而反。改延康為黃初，大赦。〔三〕










[19] Yuán Hóng’s Hàn jì records the Hàn Emperor’s Edict saying: “We have been on the throne for thirty and two years, encountered Heaven’s Under shaken and overturned, by fortune relied on the spirits of my ancestors, was endangered but yet survived. However looking up to gaze on Heaven’s signs, looking down to examine the people’s hearts, the calculations of flame’s essence is already finished, the transitioning fate is on the Cáo clan. Therefore the previous King had cultivated divine martial accomplishments, the present King also radiates brilliant virtue to answer this phase, and so the calendar calculations are shining clear, and truly can be known. ‘In the enactment of the great way, Heaven’s Under is public, select the worthy and give to the able.’ Therefore Táng Yáo did not selfishly give to his own son, and so his fame spread without bound. We admire and desire this, now thus follow the legacy of Yáo’s standards, and abdicate the throne to the King of Wèi.”



〔一〕　袁宏漢紀載漢帝詔曰：「朕在位三十有二載，遭天下蕩覆，幸賴祖宗之靈，危而復存。然仰瞻天文，俯察民心，炎精之數既終，行運在乎曹氏。是以前王既樹神武之績，今王又光曜明德以應其期，是曆數昭明，信可知矣。夫大道之行，天下為公，選賢與能，故唐堯不私於厥子，而名播於無窮。朕羨而慕焉，今其追踵堯典，禪位于魏王。」













[20] Xiàn-dì zhuàn records the abdication succession’s many matters stating: Left Central Cadet General Lǐ Fú memorialized the King of Wèi stating: “In the past when the Former King first established Wèi state, those beyond the borders heard of it but did not investigate the details, and all believed he was appointed a King. Wǔdū’s Lǐ Shù and Jiāng Hé were traveling and lodging in Hànzhōng, and said to Your Servant: ‘It certainly is as Duke (gōng) of Wèi, not yet as a King. The one to settle Heaven’s Under is “Wèi Gōng Zǐ Huán.” What the deities have mandated will accord with signs and omens, to answer the positions of Heaven and Man.’ Your Servant reported [Jiāng] Hé’s words to Defending South General Zhāng Lǔ. [Zhāng] Lǔ also asked [Jiāng] Hé: ‘What book produced this?’ [Jiāng] Hé said: ‘It is Kǒng-zǐ Yùbăn. The calendar calculations of Heaven’s Son even for a hundred generations can be known.’ From then after over a moon, there was a deserter who came, wrote down the conferment text, and indeed it was as [Jiāng] Hé had said. [Jiāng] Hé excels in Inner Studies, reputation known west of the passes. Though [Zhāng] Lǔ had a heart devoted to the state, he was immersed in heterodox teachings and changes, and was not fully awakened by [Jiāng] Hé’s words. Later he secretly with Your Servant discussed a plan to send hostages [to surrender], the state’s people did not agree, some wished to go west [to join Liú Bèi]. [Zhāng] Lǔ immediately was furious and said: “Better to be the Duke of Wèi’s slave than Liú Bèi’s most honored guest!” His words came from sorrow and pain, truly instinctual. [Jiāng] Hé first welcomed the King’s brigades, and in past years fell ill and died at Yè. From since Your Servant was at Court, every time I discussed this intention with my intimates, the time was not yet appropriate, and I did not dare publicly speak of it. In this first year of Your Highness succeeding the throne, the auspicious portents are numerous, every day and every moon arriving; there is a mandate from Heaven, shining clear and obviously seen. Thus your sagely virtue penetrates and pervades, the signs in advance are clear, truly Qián and Kūn extend congratulations, all states give pledge. Your Servant every time in offering congratulations wished to speak of [Jiāng] Hé’s verification, but in serving lord with thorough ritual, people believe it flattery. Moreover Your Servant’s reputation and conduct are base and lowly, my days since entering Court are few, speaking of it would be an incredible crime, and I restrained myself and nothing more. Now your vast grace covers the four borders, your spiritual mercy reaches Heaven and Earth, Within the Seas in close harmony, foreign quarters come to submit, foretelling and fulfillments both accumulate, to raise up the glorious mandate, beginning to end completely good. Your Servant cannot contain my happiness, and solemnly present memorial to inform.” The King’s Order said: “Show this to the exterior. How can a man of meager virtue [like myself] have attracted this? I do not dare presume. This assuredly is the Former King’s utmost virtue communicating with the divine intelligence, assuredly not the work of man.”



〔二〕　獻帝傳載禪代眾事曰：左中郎將李伏表魏王曰：「昔先王初建魏國，在境外者聞之未審，皆以為拜王。武都李庶、姜合羈旅漢中，謂臣曰：『必為魏公，未便王也。定天下者，魏公子桓，神之所命，當合符讖，以應天人之位。』臣以合辭語鎮南將軍張魯，魯亦問合知書所出？合曰：『孔子玉版也。天子曆數，雖百世可知。』是後月餘，有亡人來，寫得冊文，卒如合辭。合長于內學，關右知名。魯雖有懷國之心，沈溺異道變化，不果寤合之言。後密與臣議策質，國人不協，或欲西通，魯即怒曰：『寧為魏公奴，不為劉備上客也。』言發惻痛，誠有由然。合先迎王師，往歲病亡於鄴。自臣在朝，每為所親宣說此意，時未有宜，弗敢顯言。殿下即位初年，禎祥眾瑞，日月而至，有命自天，昭然著見。然聖德洞達，符表豫明，實乾坤挺慶，萬國作孚。臣每慶賀，欲言合驗；事君盡禮，人以為諂。況臣名行穢賤，入朝日淺，言為罪尤，自抑而已。今洪澤被四表，靈恩格天地，海內翕習，殊方歸服，兆應並集，以揚休命，始終允臧。臣不勝喜舞，謹具表通。」王令曰：「以示外。薄德之人，何能致此，未敢當也；斯誠先王至德通於神明，固非人力也。」




The King of Wèi’s Attendant Centrals Liú Yì, Xīn Pí, Liú Yè, Secretariat Writers Director Huán Jiē, Secretariat Writers Chén Jiǎo, Chén Qún, Dispensing Affairs Yellow Gate Attendant Cadets Wáng Bì, Dǒng Yù, and others said: “Your Servants in prostration read Left Central Cadet General Lǐ Fú’s sent up matter, investigated the reports of the Tú and Wěi, and in their effectiveness in answering the divine intelligence, examining to ancient times, there has never been any incorrect. Therefore when Yáo said the calendar calculations were on his person, Xuánjī illuminated Heaven’s way; Zhōu Wǔ had not yet battled and yet the red crow carried the message; Hàn [Gāo]Zǔ was not yet prominent and yet the divine mother reported the signs; Xiào-Xuān was lowly and humble but words appeared on tree leaves; Guāng-Wǔ was in plain clothes and his name was already engraved in the Chén. These were what Heaven mandated in order to prove the sagely, not what the sound of speech or the smell of fragrance can obtain and understand, it only hangs signs to show to people and trifling objects to express intentions. From since the waning of Hàn’s virtue, gradually it contaminated several generations, to the end of Huán and Líng, the Imperial standards were not established, and to now from the great chaos it has been over twenty years. Heaven does not obliterate, but creates enlightened sages to resolve these disasters, and therefore signs and prophecies are in advance written, to make clear their utmost virtue. Your Highness’s succession to the throne has not yet been a year, and yet the spiritual signs change above, crowds of omens answer below. The uninhibited people of the Four Quarters submit their hearts toward righteousness, only fearing to be too late. Even of what is recorded by the ancient records, there are none that compare to the flourishing of the present. Of Your Servants far and near, none are not ducks in the grasses.”
The King’s Order said: “The stripes of plowing oxen resemble tigers. The sprouts of weeds resemble grains. Situations have those that resemble the true but which are actually false. The present day is only that. Seeing these reported matters, they actually emphasize my lack of virtue.” Therefore the Secretariat Writers Deputy Director announced report to the bureaucracy offices, for all to hear of and know.



魏王侍中劉廙、辛毗、劉曄、尚書令桓階、尚書陳矯、陳群、給事黃門侍郎王毖、董遇等言：「臣伏讀左中郎將李伏上事，考圖緯之言，以效神明之應，稽之古代，未有不然者也。故堯稱曆數在躬，璇璣以明天道；周武未戰而赤烏銜書；漢祖未兆而神母告符；孝宣仄微，字成木葉；光武布衣，名已勒讖。是天之所命以著聖哲，非有言語之聲，芬芳之臭，可得而知也，徒縣象以示人，微物以效意耳。自漢德之衰，漸染數世，桓、靈之末，皇極不建，暨於大亂，二十餘年。天之不泯，誕生明聖，以濟其難，是以符讖先著，以彰至德。殿下踐阼未期，而靈象變於上，群瑞應於下，四方不羈之民，歸心向義，唯懼在後，雖典籍所傳，未若今之盛也。臣妾遠近，莫不鳧藻。」王令曰：「犁牛之駮似虎，莠之幼似禾，事有似是而非者，今日是已。睹斯言事，良重吾不德。」於是尚書僕射宣告官寮，咸使聞知。




Xīnhài [Nov 21], Grand Scribe Deputy Xǔ Zhī catalogued the observed prophecies of Wèi’s succession to Hàn for the King of Wèi stating: Yì Zhuàn states: “The sagely man receives the Mandate and rules as King, Yellow Dragon on a Wù or Jǐ day is seen.” Seventh Moon Fourth Day Wùyín [220 Aug 20], Yellow Dragon sighted. This is the most obvious and clear of the corresponding omens of Emperors and Kings receiving the Mandate. It also states: “First Six: Treading Frost” is “Yīn begins to condense.” Also there was an accumulation of vermin in a large hole in the Palace of Heaven’s Son, its calamity verified. Now the locust sightings are its answer. It also states: “The sagely man by virtue is close with Heaven’s Under, benevolence and grace applied everywhere, its answer is the qílín in a Wù or Jǐ day arriving, its answer is the sagely man receiving the Mandate.” It also states: “The sagely man pure and clean, conduct correct and upright, the worthy man’s fortunes arrive, the people follow the mandate, its answer is the qílín coming.” Chūnqiū Hàn Hán Zī states: “Hàn by Wèi, Wèi by portents.” Chūnqiū Yùbǎn Chèn states: “The successor of the Red is Wèi Gōngzǐ.” Chūnqiū Zuǒzhùqī states: “Hàn by Promising [xǔ] Prosperity [chāng] loses Heaven’s Under.” Former Báimǎ Magistrate Lǐ Yún’s sent up matter said: “Xǔ prosperous aura seen at ‘on the road high.’ The ‘on the road high’ will prosper at Xǔ.” ‘On the road high’ is Wèi. The symbol Wèi is the two-watchtower gate. What is on a street and high is Wèi. Wèi will succeed Hàn. Now Wèi’s foundations prospered at Xǔ, Hàn’s portents are severed at Xǔ, thus now the verifications are seen, like Lǐ Yún’s words, Xǔ and Chāng answer one another. Zuǒzhùqī also states: “Hàn by ignorant descendant perishes.” Those explaining it believe the ‘ignorant descendant’ is Hàn’s twenty-fourth Emperor, young and ignorant, foolish and confused, by feebleness perishes. Others believe in variant writings to make ignorant one’s descendant is to lose Heaven’s Under, believing the Hàn Emperor was not the proper successor, as a youth was called Marquess Dǒng, his name not correct, making ignorant and chaotic, leading to confusion, and his descendants by feebleness perish. Xiàojīng Zhōnghuáng Chèn states: “Sun rides east, extinguishing fire’s light. Not across one, sagely intelligent brilliance. Beyond four hundred, change surname and rule, Heaven’s Under submits to achievement, reaching Grand Peace, occupying eight shells, sharing ritual and music, correcting myriad peoples, commendable music families harmonized and mixed.” This is the King of Wèi’s surname and forbidden name written in chart prophecies. Yì Yùnqī Chèn states: “Speech resides east, west has noon, two suns together shine, sun resides below. That which was ruler instead becomes supporter. Five eight forty, yellow aura received, True Man appears.” Speech and noon form the Xǔ character. Two suns form the Chāng [“prosper”] character. Hàn will by Xǔ perish, Wèi will by Xǔ prosper. Now the phase of conjunction is at Xǔ [city], this is its great verification. Yì Yùnqī also states: “Ghost at mountain, grain and woman joined, rules Heaven’s Under.” Your Servant has heard that Emperors and Kings are the essence of the Five Transitions, the signs of changing surnames, the meetings of succession and rising, take seven hundred twenty years as one course. Those with virtue exceed it, reaching to eight hundred, those without virtue do not reach it, arriving at four hundred years. Therefore the Zhōu House was eight hundred sixty-seven years, the Xià House four hundred and several tens of years, Hàn enacted the Xià Standard [calendar], reaching to the present is four hundred twenty-six years. Also when Gāozǔ received the Mandate, although the numbering began at Yǐwèi, however the omen portents began at the capture of the Lín. From the capture of the Lín onward has been over seven hundred years, Heaven’s calendar calculations will be exhausted and completed. The risings of Emperors and Kings are not constantly one surname. Within Tàiwēi [asterism], Huángdìzuò [“Yellow Emperor’s Seat” star] was constantly bright, but Chìdìzuò [“Red Emperor’s Seat” star] was constantly unseen, meaning the Yellow House would rise and the Red House decline, the omen of the inauspicious and perishing. From then onward by over forty years, also Yínghuò [Mars] lost color and was not bright for ten and some years. Jiàn’ān Tenth Year [205], a comet first passed through Zǐwēi. Twenty-Third Year [218], it further swept through Tàiwēi. From since a New Heaven’s Son aura was seen in the southeast, in twenty-three years, a white rainbow crossed the sun, the moon eclipsed Yínghuò, in recent years on a Jǐhài, Rénzǐ, Bǐngwǔ the sun was eclipsed; all are signs of water extinguishing fire. Your Highness succeeded the throne, first ascending the steps, virtue matching Heaven and Earth, conduct according with the divine intelligence, favor and grace overflowing, widely covering the four borders, reaching to the highest and lowest. Therefore yellow dragons were repeatedly seen, fènghuáng frequently soared, qílín all arrived, white tigers effected benevolence, beginning to end offering sightings in the suburb outskirts. Sweet dew and sweet springs, fantastic beasts and divine objects, multitudes of signs together appear. These all are the correspondences to Emperors and Kings receiving the Mandate and the changing of surnames. In the past Huáng-dì received the Mandate, Fēnghòu received the Hé tú; Shùn and Yǔ possessed Heaven’s Under, Fènghuáng soared and the Luò produced documents; Tāng became King, the white bird was the correspondence; Wén-wáng became Xībó, the red bird carried the cinnabar text; Wǔ-wáng attacked Yīn, the white fish jumped into the boat; Gāozǔ first rose, the white snake was the portent. Tremendous signs and omen verifications all are by the rise of sagely men. Observing Hàn’s beginning to end great calamities and the present time’s corresponding omens, investigating the allotted fates of the Tú and Chèn, judging what the Hé and Luò have discerned, nothing compares to the present Great Wèi’s greatest magnificence. The one who obtains the Suìxīng [Jupiter], their way begins to rise. In the past when Wǔ-wáng attacked Yīn, Suì was at Chúnhuǒ, which is Zhōu’s Field Allocation. Gāozǔ entered Qín, the Five Planets assembled at Dōngjīng, which is in Hàn’s Field Allocation. Now presently Suìxīng is at Dàliáng, which is Wèi’s Field Allocation. And Heaven’s omen verifications all gather together and come, the Four Quarters submit and attach, carrying their children on their back and arriving, the millions of people happy and supportive, all joyous and celebrating. Chūnqiū Dàzhuàn states: “Why did Zhōu-gōng not go to Lǔ? Probably he believed that though there was a lord to continue the succession and maintain culture, it did not hinder a sage in accepting the Mandate and ruling.” Zhōu-gōng returned governance, the Shī-zǐ believes that Kǒng-zǐ criticized this, believing Zhōu-gōng was not a sage as he did not serve the millions of people. Jīng Fáng’s Yì Zhuàn states: “For those who are King, if evil remove them, if feeble replace them. In changing surnames and transferring dynasties, Heaven’s Mandate answers constantly, men plan or ghosts plan, the Hundred Surnames go with the capable.” In prostration considering that Your Highness embodies the flourishing enlightenment of Yáo and Shùn, receives a seven hundred abdication of dynasties, meets the allotted fates of Tāng and Wǔ, encounters the shifting and receiving of Heaven’s Mandate, what the Hé and Luò reveal, what the charts and prophecies convey, are clear and obvious, what the scholars of Heaven’s Under all see. Your Servant’s duties are in the Scribal Office, examining signs and investigating portents, the charts and prophecies verifications seen, the phase of the conjunction, I solemnly send up report.”
The King’s Order said: “In the past, Zhōu Wén possessed two thirds of Heaven’s Under, by this served Yīn, and Zhòngní sighed in admiration of his utmost virtue; Gōng Dàn assumed the responsibilities of Heaven’s Son, judged the cases of Heaven’s Under, in the end then ‘returned to the son the glorious power,’ the Shū praised his person. Although my virtue does not reach those two sages, dare I forget the meanings of high mountains and scenic journeys? As for the deeds of Táng Yáo, Shùn, Yǔ, they all by sagely character and abundant virtue accomplished them, and therefore were able to above harmonize with spirits and deities, below pacify the myriad surnames, leaving legacies to the present day. Now my virtue is utmostly meager, my person utmostly low, encountered a coincidence, by chance succeeded to the Former King’s [Cáo Cāo’s] unfinished enterprise, my grace does not yet cover the Four Seas, my favor not yet reached Heaven’s Under, and though I pour out the granaries and empty the treasuries to rouse Wèi state’s Hundred Surnames, yet those who are cold are not yet all warmed, those who are hungry are not yet all fed. Morning to night apprehensive, not daring to have leisure, I only wish to preserve my hair and teeth, long maintain the present situation, to go into the ground, to preserve Wèi state, going down to meet the Former King, to fulfill the responsibilities of my burden. My expectations are limited and ambitions narrow, maintaining these and nothing more. Although repeatedly immersed in auspicious omens, I meet them with violent fear, my expressions without control. Words like those of [Xǔ] Zhī, how can I listen to them? My heart trembles and hands shake, when writing cannot form words, when speaking cannot express heart. During leisure I composed a poem that states: > Death and chaos lasting beyond ages > White bones crisscrossing myriad leagues > Sorrowful, sorrowful people below with none to rely on > I will assist the times and set order > ‘Return to the son the glorious power’ and retire from service I only wish to maintain these words to my own end, to death without false words. Appropriately announce and show to the far and near, to make clear my red heart.”
Thereupon Attendant Centrals Xīn Pí and Liú Yè, Cavalier Regular Attendants Fù Xùn and Wèi Zhēn, Secretariat Writers Director Huán Jiē, Secretariat Writers Chén Jiǎo, Chén Qún, Dispensing Affairs Central Academic Scholar Cavalry Commandant Sū Lín, Dǒng Bā, and others memorialized stating: “In prostration observing Grand Scribe Deputy Xǔ Zhī’s sent up signs of Wèi state receiving the mandate: the Order letter is earnest and sincere, genuinely insisting on modestly declining; even of Shùn, Yǔ, Tāng, Wén, in righteousness none would surpass it. However, that the ancient former worthy kings received Heaven’s Mandate without declining, was truly that they urgently complied with the intentions of August Heaven, served the expectations of the millions of people, and could not but do so. Moreover, the Yì states: ‘Observe Heaven’s patterns to investigate time’s changes, observe Human patterns to influence and complete Heaven’s Under.’ It also states: ‘Heaven bequeaths signs, showing good and bad fortunes, the sages modeled after it. The Hé produced charts, the Luò produced documents, the sages imitated it.’ This means that Heaven’s patterns because of men change. As for the writings of the Hé and Luò, they were written in the Hóngfàn, and so Yīn and Zhōu imitated and employed them. These reports truly are the enlightened signs of Emperors and Kings, the great essentials of Heaven’s Way. Therefore, those that by virtue answer fate will successively rise to the front, those that lose the way and whose calculations are exhausted will repeatedly fall to the rear. The Zhuàn ridicules Cháng Hóng’s desire to raise what Heaven had destroyed, and speaks of Cài Mò’s explanation of ‘Léi riding Qián,’ making clear that the survival or destruction of the Divine Vessels is not what the strength of Man is able to establish. Now the Hàn House has declined and been replaced, the Emperor’s network degenerated and fallen, the Edicts of Heaven’s Son are extinguished and not listened to, the August Heavens about to abandon the old and mandate the new, the Hundred Surnames have left Hàn and joined Wèi, manifest and obvious, and so can be known. The Former King dispelled the chaos and pacified the world, about to establish a vast foundation; as for Your Highness, by utmost virtue you meet the fate of the calendar calculations, from since your succession to the throne, Heaven’s verifications and human affairs are clearly greatly provided, the divinities and spirits, charts and registers, all continuing from past antiquity, the glorious portents and auspicious omens surpass over previous eras. Thus the prophecies of your surname and forbidden name that [Xǔ] Zhī selected from Zhōnghuáng and Yùnqī, these writings then were written in previous ages, with Hàn coexisting. By this speaking of it, Heaven’s Mandate has already long been settled, not what Your Highness is able to obtain but then refuse. The intentions of the divine intelligence wait and expect sacrificial offerings, the millions of people reverently watch all concentrated on auspicious wishes. May Your Highness read the obvious writings of the charts and registers, urgently value the just righteousness of Heaven’s Under, at once announce Order to the interior and exterior, widely inform the provinces and prefectures, to have them know that the signs of the mandate are obvious and clear, but Your Highness intends to modestly decline.”
The Order said: “Sending down to the Four Quarters to explain my sincere heart, that is correct. As for reading the remaining statements, how was that what I said? How can it be endured? You sirs in your directions and opinions are not as careful as my own self-examination. This empty talk and mistaken praise are what my lowly self cannot bear. Moreover it is heard that in the recent eastern campaign, weaving through the prefectures and counties, passing through the Garrison Farms, the faces of the Hundred Surnames had expressions of hunger, of the clothes some are short and worn and incomplete, the fault is all on me. Therefore above I am humiliated by the multitudes of omens, below ashamed for the servicemen and people. By this speaking of it, my virtue is not worthy to be a regional King, so why speak of Emperor? It is appropriate to stop this discussion, to not increase my lack of virtue, so that after my passing, I will not be shameful to the noble men of posterity.”



辛亥，太史丞許芝條魏代漢見讖緯于魏王曰：「易傳曰：『聖人受命而王，黃龍以戊己日見。』七月四日戊寅，黃龍見，此帝王受命之符瑞最著明者也。又曰：『初六，履霜，陰始凝也。』又有積蟲大穴天子之宮，厥咎然，今蝗蟲見，應之也。又曰：『聖人以德親比天下，仁恩洽普，厥應麒麟以戊己日至，厥應聖人受命。』又曰：『聖人清淨行中正，賢人福至民從命，厥應麒麟來。』春秋漢含孳曰：『漢以魏，魏以徵。』春秋玉版讖曰：『代赤者魏公子。』春秋佐助期曰：『漢以許昌失天下。』故白馬令李雲上事曰：『許昌氣見于當塗高，當塗高者當昌於許。』當塗高者，魏也；象魏者，兩觀闕是也；當道而高大者魏。魏當代漢。今魏基昌于許，漢徵絕于許，乃今效見，如李雲之言，許昌相應也。佐助期又曰：『漢以蒙孫亡。』說者以蒙孫漢二十四帝，童蒙愚昏，以弱亡。或以雜文為蒙其孫當失天下，以為漢帝非正嗣，少時為董侯，名不正，蒙亂之荒惑，其子孫以弱亡。孝經中黃讖曰：『日載東，絕火光。不橫一，聖聰明。四百之外，易姓而王。天下歸功，致太平，居八甲；共禮樂，正萬民，嘉樂家和雜。』此魏王之姓諱，著見圖讖。易運期讖曰：『言居東，西有午，兩日並光日居下。其為主，反為輔。五八四十，黃氣受，真人出。』言午，許字。兩日，昌字。漢當以許亡，魏當以許昌。今際會之期在許，是其大效也。易運期又曰：『鬼在山，禾女連，王天下。』臣聞帝王者，五行之精；易姓之符，代興之會，以七百二十年為一軌。有德者過之，至于八百，無德者不及，至四百載。是以周家八百六十七年，夏家四百數十年，漢行夏正，迄今四百二十六歲。又高祖受命，數雖起乙未，然其兆徵始于獲麟。獲麟以來七百餘年，天之曆數將以盡終。帝王之興，不常一姓。太微中，黃帝坐常明，而赤帝坐常不見，以為黃家興而赤家衰，凶亡之漸。自是以來四十餘年，又熒惑失色不明十有餘年。建安十年，彗星先除紫微，二十三年，復掃太微。新天子氣見東南以來，二十三年，白虹貫日，月蝕熒惑，比年己亥、壬子、丙午日蝕，皆水滅火之象也。殿下即位，初踐阼，德配天地，行合神明，恩澤盈溢，廣被四表，格于上下。是以黃龍數見，鳳皇仍翔，麒麟皆臻，白虎效仁，前後獻見于郊甸；甘露醴泉，奇獸神物，眾瑞並出。斯皆帝王受命易姓之符也。昔黃帝受命，風后受河圖；舜、禹有天下，鳳皇翔，洛出書；湯之王，白鳥為符；文王為西伯，赤鳥銜丹書；武王伐殷，白魚升舟；高祖始起，白蛇為徵。巨跡瑞應，皆為聖人興。觀漢前後之大災，今茲之符瑞，察圖讖之期運，揆河洛之所甄，未若今大魏之最美也。夫得歲星者，道始興。昔武王伐殷，歲在鶉火，有周之分野也。高祖入秦，五星聚東井，有漢之分野也。今茲歲星在大梁，有魏之分野也。而天之瑞應，並集來臻，四方歸附，襁負而至，兆民欣戴，咸樂嘉慶。春秋大傳曰：『周公何以不之魯？蓋以為雖有繼體守文之君，不害聖人受命而王。』周公反政，尸子以為孔子非之，以為周公不聖，不為兆民也。京房作易傳曰：『凡為王者，惡者去之，弱者奪之。易姓改代，天命應常，人謀鬼謀，百姓與能。』伏惟殿下體堯舜之盛明，膺七百之禪代，當湯武之期運，值天命之移受，河洛所表，圖讖所載，昭然明白，天下學士所共見也。臣職在史官，考符察徵，圖讖效見，際會之期，謹以上聞。」王令曰：「昔周文三分天下有其二，以服事殷，仲尼歎其至德；公旦履天子之籍，聽天下之斷，終然復子明辟，書美其人。吾雖德不及二聖，敢忘高山景行之義哉？若夫唐堯、舜、禹之蹟，皆以聖質茂德處之，故能上和靈祇，下寧萬姓，流稱今日。今吾德至薄也，人至鄙也，遭遇際會，幸承先王餘業，恩未被四海，澤未及天下，雖傾倉竭府以振魏國百姓，猶寒者未盡煖，飢者未盡飽。夙夜憂懼，弗敢遑寧，庶欲保全髮齒，長守今日，以沒於地，以全魏國，下見先王，以塞負荷之責。望狹志局，守此而已；雖屢蒙祥瑞，當之戰惶，五色無主。若芝之言，豈所聞乎？心慄手悼，書不成字，辭不宣心。吾閒作詩曰：『喪亂悠悠過紀，白骨縱橫萬里，哀哀下民靡恃，吾將佐時整理，復子明辟致仕。』庶欲守此辭以自終，卒不虛言也。宜宣示遠近，使昭赤心。」於是侍中辛毗、劉曄、散騎常侍傅巽、衛臻、尚書令桓階、尚書陳矯、陳群、給事中博士騎都尉蘇林、董巴等奏曰：「伏見太史丞許芝上魏國受命之符；令書懇切，允執謙讓，雖舜、禹、湯、文，義無以過。然古先哲王所以受天命而不辭者，誠急遵皇天之意，副兆民之望，弗得已也。且易曰：『觀乎天文以察時變，觀乎人文以化成天下。』又曰：『天垂象，見吉凶，聖人則之；河出圖，洛出書，聖人效之。』以為天文因人而變，至于河洛之書，著于洪範，則殷、周效而用之矣。斯言，誠帝王之明符，天道之大要也。是以由德應錄者代興于前，失道數盡者迭廢于後，傳譏萇弘欲支天之所壞，而說蔡墨『雷乘乾』之說，明神器之存亡，非人力所能建也。今漢室衰替，帝綱墮墜，天子之詔，歇滅無聞，皇天將捨舊而命新，百姓既去漢而為魏，昭然著明，是可知也。先王撥亂平世，將建洪基；至於殿下，以至德當曆數之運，即位以來，天應人事，粲然大備，神靈圖籍，兼仍往古，休徵嘉兆，跨越前代；是芝所取中黃、運期姓緯之讖，斯文乃著於前世，與漢並見。由是言之，天命久矣，非殿下所得而拒之也。神明之意，候望禋享，兆民顒顒，咸注嘉願，惟殿下覽圖籍之明文，急天下之公義，輒宣令外內，布告州郡，使知符命著明，而殿下謙虛之意。」令曰：「下四方以明孤款心，是也。至于覽餘辭，豈余所謂哉？寧所堪哉？諸卿指論，未若孤自料之審也。夫虛談謬稱，鄙薄所弗當也。且聞比來東征，經郡縣，歷屯田，百姓面有飢色，衣或短褐不完，罪皆在孤；是以上慚眾瑞，下愧士民。由斯言之，德尚未堪偏王，何言帝者也！宜止息此議，無重吾不德，使逝之後，不愧後之君子。」




Guǐchǒu [Nov 23], announced and informed the various offices. Commanding Army Censorate Central Deputy Sīmǎ Yì, Attendant Censors Zhèng Hún, Yáng Mì, Bào Xūn, Wǔ Zhōu and others said: “The Order is to the left. In prostration reading Grand Scribe Deputy Xǔ Zhī’s sent up matters of the signs of the mandate, Your Servants have heard that when Yǒu Táng’s reign declined, Heaven’s Mandate was on Yú, and when the Yú clan’s reign declined, Heaven’s Mandate was on Xià. That being the case the vitality of Heaven and Earth, the fates of the calendar calculations, the signs of leaving and arriving, are only by where there is virtue. Therefore Kǒng-zǐ said: ‘The fèng bird does not arrive, the Hé does not produce charts, I am finished!’ Now the Hàn House has declined, from Ān, Hé, Chōng, Zhì, the state’s succession was repeatedly severed, Huán and Líng were dissolute and licentious, fortunes left the ruling house. This then was Heaven’s Mandate departing and arriving, ‘not [the result of] one morning or one evening,’ its origins were from long ago. Your Highness ascended the throne, utmost virtue spread and covered, reaching above and below, Heaven and Man emotionally moved and answer, signs and omens all arrive, and investigating the ancient histories, there were none as flourishing as the present day. For a great man, ‘when acting before Heaven then Heaven does not oppose him, when acting after Heaven then complies with Heaven’s timing.’ For Heaven’s timing to have already arrived and yet modestly decline, Shùn and Yǔ would not do, and therefore the living people were immersed in the kindness of rescue and relief, all sorts received the bestowal of nurturing and growth. Now the Eight Directions reverently watch, large and small focus gaze, the August Heavens gives favor, Divinities and Humanity together plan, nine out of ten have pledged submission, the situation surpassing Zhōu Wén, what is called excessive deference. Your Servants above and below in prostration are not at ease.”
The Order said: “What the world is lacking in is morality and righteousness, what it has in excess is negligence and presumptuousness. The nature of an ordinary man is to disparage what they lack and value what they have in excess. Therefore it was said: ‘Do not worry of lacking position, worry of reason to be appointed.’ Though I am scant in virtue, I would avoid an ordinary man’s values. Thus ‘a stone can be broken but cannot be robbed of its hardness, cinnabar can be pulverized but cannot be robbed of its red.’ Cinnabar and stone are trifling objects and yet can protect their qualities, so all the more when I am at the end of a line of servicemen, having received teachings from noble men. Moreover, Wūlíng Zhòngzǐ took benevolence as wealth, Bǎichéng Zǐgāo took righteousness as nobility, Bào Jiāo was emotionally moved by Zǐgòng’s words and discarded his vegetables and withered to death, the firewood-collector ridiculed Jì Zhá for wrongly speaking; all discarded treasures without a glance. I alone am what sort of man? In the past Zhōu Wǔ was a great sage, sent Shū Dàn to swear alliance with Jiāo Gé at Sìnèi, sent Shào-gōng to make covenant with Wēi-zǐ at Gòngtóu, and therefore Bó Yí and Shū Qí together laughed at them saying: ‘In the past Shénnóng-shì’s possession of Heaven’s Under did not ruin others for one’s own accomplishments and did not make others lowly to make oneself high,’ believing that Zhōu’s attack on Yīn was cruelty. My virtue is not of Zhōu Wǔ, my righteousness shameful to [Bó] Yí and [Shū] Qí. I wish to distance from losing morality by negligence and presumptuousness, establish the unstealable of cinnabar and stone, stride what Wūlíng [Zhòngzǐ] held as wealth, tread what Bǎichéng [Zǐgāo] took as nobility, grasp Bào Jiāo’s chaste cultivation, follow the firewood-collector’s pure integrity. Therefore it is said: ‘The Three Armies can be robbed of their commander; a common fellow cannot be robbed of his will.’ This will of mine, who can rob me of it?”



癸丑，宣告群寮。督軍御史中丞司馬懿、侍御史鄭渾、羊祕、鮑勛、武周等言：「令如左。伏讀太史丞許芝上符命事，臣等聞有唐世衰，天命在虞，虞氏世衰，天命在夏；然則天地之靈，曆數之運，去就之符，惟德所在。故孔子曰：『鳳鳥不至，河不出圖，吾已矣夫！』今漢室衰，自安、和、沖、質以來，國統屢絕，桓、靈荒淫，祿去公室，此乃天命去就，非一朝一夕，其所由來久矣。殿下踐阼，至德廣被，格于上下，天人感應，符瑞並臻，考之舊史，未有若今日之盛。夫大人者，先天而天弗違，後天而奉天時，天時已至而猶謙讓者，舜、禹所不為也，故生民蒙救濟之惠，群類受育長之施。今八方顒顒，大小注望，皇天乃眷，神人同謀，十分而九以委質，義過周文，所謂過恭也。臣妾上下，伏所不安。」令曰：「世之所不足者道義也，所有餘者苟妄也；常人之性，賤所不足，貴所有餘，故曰『不患無位，患所以立』。孤雖寡德，庶自免于常人之貴。夫『石可破而不可奪堅，丹可磨而不可奪赤』。丹石微物，尚保斯質，況吾託士人之末列，曾受教于君子哉？且於陵仲子以仁為富，柏成子高以義為貴，鮑焦感子貢之言，棄其蔬而槁死，薪者譏季札失辭，皆委重而弗視。吾獨何人？昔周武，大聖也，使叔旦盟膠鬲于四內，使召公約微子於共頭，故伯夷、叔齊相與笑之曰：『昔神農氏之有天下，不以人之壞自成，不以人之卑自高。』以為周之伐殷以暴也。吾德非周武而義慚夷、齊，庶欲遠苟妄之失道，立丹石之不奪，邁於陵之所富，蹈柏成之所貴，執鮑焦之貞至，遵薪者之清節。故曰：『三軍可奪帥，匹夫不可奪志。』吾之斯志，豈可奪哉？」




Yǐmǎo [220 Nov 25], the conferment Edict on the King of Wèi to abdicate and transfer Heaven’s Under said: “On Yánkāng Inaugural Year Tenth Moon Yǐmǎo, the Imperial Emperor states: Oh you King of Wèi, fate transfers between Pǐ and Tài, in accordance to virtue rises and falls. The Three Dynasties’ divination of years is written in the Chūnqiū, and therefore that Heaven’s Mandate is not constant, Emperors and Kings not of one surname, has been so from since long ago. Hàn’s way is fallen and declined, and has been for a long time. From Ān and Shùn on down, the generations lost their sequence, Chōng and Zhì had short blessings, three generations without successors, the Imperial network began to fail, the Emperor’s standards collapsing and destroyed. Reaching to Our person, Heaven sent down calamities, I encountered the convergence of undeserved misfortunes, happened upon the phase of flame’s essence imprisoned and concealed. Rebellion rose at the carriage spokes, the disasters by the castrate eunuchs. Dǒng Zhuó took advantage of the rifts, his evil as extreme as Jiāo and Yì, he stole away the government reins, burned away the Palaces and Temples, and therefore caused the Nine Provinces to be split apart, strong enemies fighting like tigers, the Huáxià a boiling cauldron, venomous snakes blocking the roads. At that time, not a chǐ of land remained as Hàn’s possession, could a single person remain as Our people? By good fortune relying on King Wǔ’s [Cáo Cāo’s] virtue receiving the signs and fates, he exerted and raised his divine warfare, cut down the vicious and cruel, purified and settled the regions of Xià, protected and ordered the Imperial House. Now you the King inherit and continue these former threads, utmost virtue radiant and shining, driving the reins without wavering, spreading virtue to the distant, the sounds of your teachings cover the Four Seas, benevolence air through to desolate regions, and therefore the Four Quarters present treasures, Man and Divinity resonate in answer, Heaven’s calendar calculations truly are upon your person. In the past Yú Shùn had great achievements of twenty and so Fàngxūn abdicated to him Heaven’s Under; Dà Yǔ had the accomplishment of dredging and channeling and so Chónghuá abdicated to him the Emperor’s throne. Hàn inherits Yáo’s fate, has the righteousness of passing to the sagely, adds obedience to the spirits and deities, continues Heaven’s brilliant Mandate, and so grants two daughters to be consorts of Wèi. Send Envoy Holding Stave Enacting Censorate Grandee affairs the Minister of Ceremonies [Zhāng] Yīn, to present the Imperial Emperor’s Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon. The King is thus to forever be lord over the myriad states, to respectfully enact Heaven’s authority, to justly maintain the correct, [or else] Heaven’s blessings forever end. Would you respect it?”
Therefore Secretariat Writers Director Huán Jiē and others memorialized stating: “The Hàn dynasty abdicates the throne of Heaven’s Son to Your Majesty, Your Majesty by the virtue of sagely enlightenment, the sequence of the calendar calculations, receives the abdication of Hàn, indeed matching Heaven’s intention. Heaven’s Mandate cannot be declined, the expectations of the millions of people cannot be opposed. Your Servants request to convene the Ranked Marquesses, the various officers, the various ministers and accompanying scribes, to open the Ruler’s Seal marked letter, obey Heaven’s Mandate, and prepare the ceremony and successive memorials.”
The Order said: “You should discuss my intention to refuse to the end, and nothing more. I am yet hunting, and when I return I will have an Order.”



乙卯，冊詔魏王禪代天下曰：「惟延康元年十月乙卯，皇帝曰，咨爾魏王：夫命運否泰，依德升降，三代卜年，著于春秋，是以天命不于常，帝王不一姓，由來尚矣。漢道陵遲，為日已久，安、順已降，世失其序，沖、質短祚，三世無嗣，皇綱肇虧，帝典頹沮。暨于朕躬，天降之災，遭無妄厄運之會，值炎精幽昧之期。變興輦轂，禍由閹宦。董卓乘釁，惡甚澆、豷，劫遷省御，（太僕）〔火撲〕宮廟，遂使九州幅裂，彊敵虎爭，華夏鼎沸，蝮蛇塞路。當斯之時，尺土非復漢有，一夫豈復朕民？幸賴武王德膺符運，奮揚神武，芟夷兇暴，清定區夏，保乂皇家。今王纘承前緒，至德光昭，御衡不迷，布德優遠，聲教被四海，仁風扇鬼區，是以四方效珍，人神響應，天之曆數實在爾躬。昔虞舜有大功二十，而放勳禪以天下；大禹有疏導之績，而重華禪以帝位。漢承堯運，有傳聖之義，加順靈祇，紹天明命，釐降二女，以嬪于魏。使使持節行御史大夫事太常音，奉皇帝璽綬，王其永君萬國，敬御天威，允執其中，天祿永終，敬之哉？」於是尚書令桓階等奏曰：「漢氏以天子位禪之陛下，陛下以聖明之德，曆數之序，承漢之禪，允當天心。夫天命弗可得辭，兆民之望弗可得違，臣請會列侯諸將、群臣陪隸，發璽書，順天命，具禮儀列奏。」令曰：「當議孤終不當承之意而已。猶獵，還方有令。」




The Secretariat Writers Director and the rest again memorialized stating: “In the past Yáo and Shùn abdicated at Wénzǔ. Reaching to the Hàn dynasty by military campaign receiving the Mandate, in fear of Heaven’s authority they did not dare be negligent or idle, and so succeeded the throne in the land of wherever they were traveling. Now in receiving the mandate of the abdicating dynasty, it is appropriate to convene the hundred offices and various managers, the servicemen of the Six Armies, for all to go to their seats, to have all witness Heaven’s Mandate. Inside the camps is compact and narrow, we can on a flat and spacious location establish a platform stage, to receive and answer the glorious mandate. Your Servants at once with the Attendant Centrals and Regular Attendants meet to discuss the ceremonies, the Grand Scribe offices to select an auspicious date, and when finished will again memorialize.”
The Order said: “I absolutely do not dare to accept this, why does the exterior presume on the matter?”



尚書令等又奏曰：「昔堯、舜禪於文祖，至漢氏，以師征受命，畏天之威，不敢怠遑，便即位行在所之地。今當受禪代之命，宜會百寮群司，六軍之士，皆在行位，使咸睹天命。營中促狹，可於平敞之處設壇場，奉答休命。臣輒與侍中常侍會議禮儀，太史官擇吉日訖，復奏。」令曰：「吾殊不敢當之，外亦何豫事也！」




Attendant Central Liú Yì, Regular Attendant Wèi Zhēn and others memorialized comments stating: “The Hàn dynasty complies with the discussions of Táng Yáo sharing Heaven’s Under, Your Majesty by sagely virtue receives the cycles of the calendar calculations, Heaven and Humanity together joyous, nothing is not in its place, it is appropriate to obey the spiritual signs, and quickly ascend the Imperial steps. Asking the Grand Scribe Deputy Xǔ Zhī, the present moon’s seventeenth day Jǐwèi [220 Nov 29], Zhí Chéng, can accept the abdication mandate, and so at once we prepare the location of the platform stage, and what should be put into effect will be in separate memorials.”
The Order said: “Happening to go out and see the exterior, there is the building of a platform stage. What is the meaning of this? Now I will decline and not accept the Edict. Only outside the tents open the Ruler’s Seal marked letter, with the authoritative ceremonies as usual. Moreover the weather is cold, dismiss the servicemen building the platform and send them home.”
At the opening of the Ruler’s Seal marked letter, the King’s Order said: “I will respectfully return the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon with a Response of declining. How can I accept this Edict and receive this bestowal? In the past Yáo yielded Heaven’s Under to Xǔ Yóu and Zǐzhōu Zhīfǔ, Shùn also yielded to Shàn Juǎn, Shíhù zhī Nóng, Běirén Wúzé. One withdrew and plowed the Yǐng’s sunny bank, one declined and claimed depression illness, one went far into the mountains and forest so none knew where he was, one took his children to the sea and to the end would not return, one believed it a disgrace and threw himself into the abyss. Moreover Yán Zhú feared that Grand Simplicity would not be preserved and maintained the wisdom of knowing contentment, Wángzǐ Sōu was happy to live in seclusion in the cinnabar caves and when smoked did not come out, Liǔxià Huì would not for the nobility of the Three Excellencies exchange his integrity, Zēng Shēn would not for the wealth of Jìn and Chǔ exchange his benevolence. These nine servicemen all had high integrity and esteemed righteousness, contemptuous of wealth and disdainful of nobility, and therefore their names were written for a thousand years and praised to the present. Seeking benevolence obtains benevolence, how is benevolence far away? How can I alone not compare? Righteousness is to walk into the eastern sea and die, and not accept the Hàn Court’s Edict. Urgently send up Response returning the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, announce it to Heaven’s Under, to have all hear of it.”
Jǐwèi [220 Nov 29], announced and reported to the various offices, sent down to Wèi [fief state], also sent down to Heaven’s Under.



侍中劉廙、常侍衛臻等奏議曰：「漢氏遵唐堯公天下之議，陛下以聖德膺曆數之運，天人同歡，靡不得所，宜順靈符，速踐皇阼。問太史丞許芝，今月十七日己未直成，可受禪命，輒治壇場之處，所當施行別奏。」令曰；「屬出見外，便設壇場，斯何謂乎？今當辭讓不受詔也。但於帳前發璽書，威儀如常，且天寒，罷作壇士使歸。」既發璽書，王令曰：「當奉還璽綬為讓章。吾豈奉此詔承此貺邪？昔堯讓天下於許由、子州支甫，舜亦讓于善卷、石戶之農、北人無擇，或退而耕潁之陽，或辭以幽憂之疾，或遠入山林，莫知其處，或攜子入海，終身不反，或以為辱，自投深淵；且顏燭懼太樸之不完，守知足之明分，王子搜樂丹穴之潛處，被熏而不出，柳下惠不以三公之貴易其介，曾參不以晉、楚之富易其仁：斯九士者，咸高節而尚義，輕富而賤貴，故書名千載，于今稱焉。求仁得仁，仁豈在遠？孤獨何為不如哉？義有蹈東海而逝，不奉漢朝之詔也。亟為上章還璽綬，宣之天下，使咸聞焉。」己未，宣告群僚，下魏，又下天下。




Supporting the State General and Marquess of Qīngyuàn Liú Ruò and others of one hundred twenty people sent up letter that said: “In prostration reading the Order letter, deeply insisting on restraint and refusal, your sagely intentions are earnest and sorrowful, utmost sincerity outwardly revealed, We Your Servants are thus not at ease. Why is this? Shíhù and Běirén were ordinary fellows of deranged extremism, their conduct not in accordance with righteousness, their matters not seen in the classics, and therefore the Scribe [Sīmǎ] Qiān said it was not so, truly not what sagely enlightenment should admire. Moreover, Yǒu Yú did not oppose Fàngxūn’s abdication, Xià Yǔ also had no speech of declining the throne, therefore the Zhuàn states: ‘Shùn ascended the Emperor’s Throne, as if he inherently possessed it.’ This truly was a sagely man understanding that Heaven’s Mandate cannot be opposed, the calendar calculations cannot be declined. In prostration considering that Your Majesty answers Heaven’s signs and cycles, utmost virtue spread and heard, ascending to shine the heavens, thus the Three Spirits send down omens, Man and Divinity thus harmonize, magnificent portents mingle together, myriad states resonate in answer, and even if you wish to not be employed, how can you escape it? And yet you stubbornly maintain modesty, disobeying Heaven and opposing the masses, admiring the trifling fame of ordinary fellows, turning back on where the highest sages have tread, disobeying the explicit writings of the classics and prophecies, trusting in the digging of the hundred schools. This is not how to serve and answer Heaven’s Mandate, glorify and comfort the expectations of the masses. We Your Servants risk death to plead: at once organize the platform stage, on reaching the auspicious day accept the mandate, as in previous memorials, and separately write Orders to announce down.”
The King’s Order said: “In the past Bǎichéng Zǐgāo declined Xià Yǔ and hid in the wilderness, Yán Hé declined Lǔ’s gifts and went far away; the heavy importance of rulers, the nobility of vassal lords, yet these two sirs thought little of it. Why was this? Because their integrity was high. Therefore ardent martyrs seek glory and fame, righteous men esteem resolute integrity, and even if they eat vegetables and ladle water, they are happy in it. Therefore Zhòngní took as teacher Wáng Tái, and Zǐ Chǎn praised Shēntú. Now you ministers all are my legs and arms and belly and heart, able to understand me, but that now you all are like this, then it is that you ministers are roaming inside form and structure, while I seek to be beyond form and structure: that we do not understand one another is not enough to be a great surprise. Urgently send up Response to return the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, and do not again clamor about it.”



輔國將軍清苑侯劉若等百二十人上書曰：「伏讀令書，深執克讓，聖意懇惻，至誠外昭，臣等有所不安。何者？石戶、北人，匹夫狂狷，行不合義，事不經見者，是以史遷謂之不然，誠非聖明所當希慕。且有虞不逆放勛之禪，夏禹亦無辭位之語，故傳曰：『舜陟帝位，若固有之。』斯誠聖人知天命不可逆，曆數弗可辭也。伏惟陛下應乾符運，至德發聞，升昭于天，是三靈降瑞，人神以和，休徵雜沓，萬國響應，雖欲勿用，將焉避之？而固執謙虛，違天逆眾，慕匹夫之微分，背上聖之所蹈，違經讖之明文，信百氏之穿鑿，非所以奉答天命，光慰眾望也。臣等昧死以請，輒整頓壇場，至吉日受命，如前奏，分別寫令宣下。」王令曰：「昔柏成子高辭夏禹而匿野，顏闔辭魯幣而遠跡，夫以王者之重，諸侯之貴，而二子忽之，何則？其節高也。故烈士徇榮名，義夫高貞介，雖蔬食瓢飲，樂在其中。是以仲尼師王駘，而子產嘉申徒。今諸卿皆孤股肱腹心，足以明孤，而今咸若斯，則諸卿遊于形骸之內，而孤求為形骸之外，其不相知，未足多怪。亟為上章還璽綬，勿復紛紛也。」




The Supporting the State General and others of one hundred twenty men again memorialized stating: “Your Servant has heard that signs of the mandate do not appear without reason, the hearts of the masses cannot be disobeyed, and therefore Kǒng-zǐ said: ‘Was Zhōu-gōng thus not a sage? To decline Heaven’s Under is like Heaven and Earth and the Sun and Moon thoughtlessly abandoning all things.’ Therefore Shùn oversaw Heaven’s Under, not bowing and accepting the Mandate. Now Fire’s Virtue and aura are exhausted, Flame sends up calculations of completion, Emperor title shifts to enlightened virtue, the blessings pass to Great Wèi. The signs and omens are obvious and clear, receiving the mandate already assured, glorifying under the Heavens, Divinities and Humanity together answer, even Yǒu Yú’s ceremonious fèng and Chéng Zhōu’s leaping fish, when compared to the present situation, are not enough to compare. Yet Your Majesty disobeys Heaven’s Mandate to embellish petty conduct, opposes the hearts of the people to uphold selfish ambitions, above disobeying the intentions of the caring mandate of the august firmament, in the middle forgetting the calculations of the comprehensive understandings of the sages, below abandoning your subjects looking up in hope; this is not the way to raise up the high road of the way of sages and carry on boundless exemplary merits. Your Servants have heard that serving lord has ways of proffering the appropriate and replacing the unsuitable, that serving superiors has the righteousness of firmly contesting inverted scales, Your Servants dare to risk death to plead.”
The Order said: “In the government of the ancient sage kings, utmost virtue accorded with Qián and Kūn, kindness and beneficence equaled natural change, ritual and education improved even the insects, benevolence and favor penetrated even the grasses and trees, all that the sun and moon shined upon, all the sorts of breathing living things supporting the heavens and treading the earth, none were not covered and enveloped in the pure aura, bathed and immersed in profound virtue. Therefore metal and leather did not rise, oppression and evil were not created, wind and rain complied with the seasons, auspicious omens of all sorts appeared. Now of the Hundred Surnames, those cold are not yet warmed, those hungry not yet fed, the widowers not yet married, the widows not yet wed, [Sūn] Quán and [Liú] Bèi still survive, cannot be subdued by dancing with shield and battle-ax, and must be set right with the sharp ax. Military campaigns have not yet ceased on the exterior, servicemen and civilians are not yet safe in the interior, ears do not yet hear songs of Kāngzāi, eyes do not yet see games of hitting soil, infants cannot yet be entrusted to high nests, surplus grain cannot yet be left in the fields overnight. Human affairs are not yet provided for to this extent. The night has not yet been illuminated by the Jǐng star, governance has not yet connected with the True Man, the Hé has not produced a dragon horse, the mountains have not produced an elephant chariot, míngjía have not yet been planted in the courtyard steps, shàpú have not grown in the kitchens, the Wángmǔ has not yet presented a white jade ring, the Qúsōu have not yet revealed precious furs. Auspicious signs are not yet verified, also to that degree. In the past Dōnghù Jìzǐ, Róngchéng, Dàtíng, Xuānyuán, Hèxū, these lords all by obtaining these accomplished their achievements and engraved their names. Now you ministers alone, cannot you lend me a little leave to be thorough in heart and exhaustive in consideration, to harmonize with Heaven and Humanity, to reach utmost reason, to allow those multitudes of affairs to be prepared, the various auspicious signs to be verified, and only afterward then discuss this? Why so hurriedly and shamefully pressure like this? Hurriedly make the decline Response, send up and return the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, to not increase my lack of virtue.”



輔國將軍等一百二十人又奏曰：「臣聞符命不虛見，眾心不可違，故孔子曰：『周公其為不聖乎？以天下讓。是天地日月輕去萬物也。』是以舜嚮天下，不拜而受命。今火德氣盡，炎上數終，帝遷明德，祚隆大魏。符瑞昭晳，受命既固，光天之下，神人同應，雖有虞儀鳳，成周躍魚，方今之事，未足以喻。而陛下違天命以飾小行，逆人心以守私志，上忤皇穹眷命之旨，中忘聖人達節之數，下孤人臣翹首之望，非所以揚聖道之高衢，乘無窮之懿勳也。臣等聞事君有獻可替否之道，奉上有逆鱗固爭之義，臣等敢以死請。」令曰：「夫古聖王之治也，至德合乾坤，惠澤均造化，禮教優乎昆蟲，仁恩洽乎草木，日月所照，戴天履地含氣有生之類，靡不被服清風，沐浴玄德；是以金革不起，苛慝不作，風雨應節，禎祥觸類而見。今百姓寒者未煖，飢者未飽，鰥者未室，寡者未嫁；權、備尚存，未可舞以干戚，方將整以齊斧；戎役未息於外，士民未安於內，耳未聞康哉之歌，目未睹擊壤之戲，嬰兒未可託於高巢，餘糧未可以宿於田畝：人事未備，至於此也。夜未曜景星，治未通真人，河未出龍馬，山未出象車，蓂莢未植階庭，萐莆未生庖廚，王母未獻白環，渠搜未見珍裘：靈瑞未效，又如彼也。昔東戶季子、容成、大庭、軒轅、赫胥之君，咸得以此就功勒名。今諸卿獨不可少假孤精心竭慮，以和天人，以格至理，使彼眾事備，群瑞效，然後安乃議此乎，何遽相愧相迫之如是也？速為讓章，上還璽綬，無重吾不德也。」




Attendant Central Liú Yì and others memorialized stating: “In prostration considering that Your Majesty by the pure virtue of a great sage bears the calendar calculations of Heaven’s Mandate, in observing Heaven’s Images then the auspicious signs are proven and clear, in investigating the charts and prophecies then the written meanings are shining and luminous, in inspecting human affairs then the Four Seas are unified in heart, in examining the previous dynasties then different eras have the same results, but yet you firmly refuse the abdication mandate, have not yet ascended to the honored throne, your sagely intentions earnest and sorrowful, do We Your Servants dare not accept your Edict? At once we prepare Response and send the envoy.”
Presented Order said: “Tàibó thrice declined Heaven’s Under, the people had no ability to praise him, Zhòngní sighed at this utmost virtue. I alone am what sort of man?”



侍中劉廙等奏曰：「伏惟陛下以大聖之純懿，當天命之曆數，觀天象則符瑞著明，考圖緯則文義煥炳，察人事則四海齊心，稽前代則異世同歸；而固拒禪命，未踐尊位，聖意懇惻，臣等敢不奉詔？輒具章遣使者。」奉令曰：「泰伯三以天下讓，人無得而稱焉，仲尼歎其至德，孤獨何人？」




Gēngshēn [220 Nov 30], the King of Wèi sent up letter that said: “Imperial Emperor, Your Majesty: Receiving this Moon’s Yǐmǎo [220 Nov 25] Ruler’s Seal marked letter, in prostration listening to the conferment mandate, my five internal organs were startled and shaken, my vitality scattered about, not knowing what to do. Your Servant previously sent up and returned my Chancellor’s position, withdrawing to maintain my vassal state, and your sagely grace permitted it. Although Your Servant is without the will of the ancients to self-determine position by measuring virtue and judging myself, protecting myself and preserving my nature truly is my selfish hope. Unexpectedly Your Majesty condescended to transmit excessively mistaken mandate, issue an irregular Edict, to apply on a servant without virtue. Moreover I have heard that Yáo abdicated to Chónghuá to elevate his virtue of ability to harmonize, and Shùn conferred to Wénmìng to select his beauty of overwhelming sagacity, yet still below consulted the Sìyuè and above observed the Xuánjī. Now Your Servant’s virtue is not that of Yú or Xià, conduct not of those two lords, and yet receive consultation on the calendar calculations, answer mandate of selection and conferment, inside considering and estimating myself, I have no virtue to be praised. Moreover Xǔ Yóu was an ordinary fellow and yet refused the Emperor’s throne, Shàn Juàn was in plain clothes but yet opposed Yú’s [Shùn’s] Edict. Although Your Servant is lowly and ignorant, dare I forget integrity to accept this great mandate? I cannot bear your utmost wishes. I sincerely bow to present this Response to explain my feelings, sending Acting as Chancellor of State the Yǒngshòu Minister Treasurer Your Dirtied Servant Máo Zōng to memorialize, and also send up the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon.”



庚申，魏王上書曰：「皇帝陛下：奉被今月乙卯璽書，伏聽冊命，五內驚震，精爽散越，不知所處。臣前上還相位，退守藩國，聖恩聽許。臣雖無古人量德度身自定之志，保己存性，實其私願。不寤陛下猥損過謬之命，發不世之詔，以加無德之臣。且聞堯禪重華，舉其克諧之德，舜授文命，采其齊聖之美，猶下咨四嶽，上觀璿璣。今臣德非虞、夏，行非二君，而承曆數之諮，應選授之命，內自揆撫，無德以稱。且許由匹夫，猶拒帝位，善卷布衣，而逆虞詔。臣雖鄙蔽，敢忘守節以當大命，不勝至願。謹拜章陳情，使行相國永壽少府糞土臣毛宗奏，并上璽綬。」




Xīnyǒu [220 Dec 1], Dispensing Affairs Central Academic Scholars Sū Lín and Dǒng Bā sent up memorial that said: “Heaven has Twelve Stations forming the Field Allocations, the states of kings and dukes each have their affiliation. Zhōu is at Chúnhuǒ, Wèi is at Dàliáng. Suìxīng travels through the Twelve Stations and states, Heaven’s Son receives the Mandate, the vassal lords are enfeoffed. When Zhōu King Wén first received the Mandate, Suì was at Chúnhuǒ, reaching King Wǔ attacking Zhòu in the thirteenth year, Suìxīng again was at Chúnhuǒ, and therefore the Chūnqiū Zhuàn states: ‘King Wǔ attacked Zhòu, Suì was at Chúnhuǒ. Where Suì is located, is our Yǒu Zhōu’s field allocation.’ In the past in Guānghé Seventh Year [184], Suì was at Dàliáng, King Wǔ [Cáo Cāo] first received a mandate at the time to command the suppression of Huángjīn. That year was changed to Zhōngpíng Inaugural Year. Jiàn’ān Inaugural Year [196], Suì again was at Dàliáng, he was first appointed General-in-Chief. Thirteenth Year [208] again at Dàliáng, first appointed Assistant Chancellor. Now it is the Twenty-Fifth Year [220], Suì again is at Dàliáng, Your Majesty receives the Mandate. This is Wèi obtaining Suì in correspondence to Zhōu King Wén receiving the Mandate.
