[Dǒng] Zhuó sent decoy troops as if about to cross at Píngyīn, secretly sent elite multitudes to from Xiǎopíng’s north cross, turning to strike their rear, greatly defeated them at the ford’s north, the dead were almost all of them. [Dǒng] Zhuó because powerful figures east of the mountains were rising together was fearful and not at ease. Chūpíng Inaugural Year Second Moon [190 Mar 24 - Apr 22], thus relocated Heaven’s Son to set capital at Cháng’ān, burned the Luòyáng Palace Residences, entirely excavated the tombs, seizing the treasures. [12] [Dǒng] Zhuó reached the western capital, became Grand Preceptor, called as Shàngfù.17 He rode Blue Canopy Gold Decorated chariot, claw paintings on the two wheel-guards, at the time people called it the Pole-Scraping Chariot. [13] [Dǒng] Zhuó’s younger brother [Dǒng] Mín became Left General, enfeoffed Marquess of Hù, elder brother’s son [Dǒng] Huáng became Attendant Central Central Mary Colonel managing troops, his clansmen paternal and maternal all were lined up in Court. [14] The Excellencies and Ministers on meeting [Dǒng] Zhuó bowed below the carriage, [Dǒng] Zhuó was not courteous in return. Summoned and called on the Three Terraces Secretariat Writers on down to personally visit [Dǒng] Zhuó’s office to report on affairs. [15] Built Méi Fortress, its height equal to Cháng’ān city walls, amassed grain for thirty years of reserves, [16] saying if his affairs were successful he would dominate Heaven’s Under, and if not successful, maintaining this was enough to last through old age. Once on reaching Méi to travel the fortress, the Excellencies and Ministers on down saw him off outside Héng Gate. [17] [Dǒng] Zhuó in advance laid out curtains to drink, invited surrendered Běidì rebels of several hundred people, among the seats first cut off their tongues, some cut off hands and feet, some dug out eyes, some in cauldrons boiled them, not yet died, writhing and turning among the cups and tables, those gathered all trembled and dropped their spoons and chopsticks, but [Dǒng] Zhuó drank and ate at ease. The Grand Scribe observed auras and reported there would be a great minister killed.18 Former Grand Commandant Zhāng Wēn at the time was Minister of the Guard, previously was not friendly with [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó in his heart resented him, taking advantage of the Heavens having an omen and wishing to obstruct calamity,19 sent someone to report that [Zhāng] Wēn was communicating with Yuán Shù, and therefore whipped him to death. [18] Laws and ordinances were severe and harsh, by loves and hates excessively punished, so that people falsely accused one another, those that died junjustly were in the thousands. The Hundred Surnames wailed, on the road glancing.20 [19] He completely smashed and destroyed the Bronze Men and the Bell Stands, reaching to destroying Wǔzhū coins, to recast into small coins, size five fēn, without inscriptions, the material and hole without inner or outer rims,21 not trimmed or polished. Therefore money was cheap and goods expensive, grain of one hú reached several hundred thousand. From then afterward money was not circulated.



河內太守王匡，遣泰山兵屯河陽津，將以圖卓。卓遣疑兵若將於平陰渡者，潛遣銳眾從小平北渡，繞擊其後，大破之津北，死者略盡。卓以山東豪傑並起，恐懼不寧。初平元年二月，乃徙天子都長安。焚燒洛陽宮室，悉發掘陵墓，取寶物。〔一〕卓至西京，為太師，號曰尚父。乘青蓋金華車，爪畫兩轓，時人號曰竿摩車。〔二〕卓弟旻為左將軍，封鄠侯；兄子璜為侍中中軍校尉典兵；宗族內外並列朝廷。〔三〕公卿見卓，謁拜車下，卓不為禮。召呼三臺尚書以下自詣卓府啟事。〔四〕築郿塢，高與長安城埒，積穀為三十年儲，〔五〕云事成，雄據天下，不成，守此足以畢老。嘗至郿行塢，公卿已下祖道於橫門外。〔六〕卓豫施帳幔飲，誘降北地反者數百人，於坐中先斷其舌，或斬手足，或鑿眼，或鑊煮之，未死，偃轉杯案閒，會者皆戰慄亡失匕箸，而卓飲食自若。太史望氣，言當有大臣戮死者。故太尉張溫時為衛尉，素不善卓，卓心怨之，因天有變，欲以塞咎，使人言溫與袁術交關，遂笞殺之。〔七〕法令苛酷，愛憎淫刑，更相被誣，冤死者千數。百姓嗷嗷，道路以目。〔八〕悉椎破銅人、鐘虡，及壞五銖錢。更鑄為小錢，大五分，無文章，肉好無輪郭，不磨鑢。于是貨輕而物貴，穀一斛至數十萬。自是後錢貨不行。










[12] Huà Qiáo’s Hàn shū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó wished to move to Cháng’ān, summoned the Excellencies and Ministers on down for a great discussion. Excellency over the Masses Yáng Biāo said: “In the past Pán Gēng five times moved, Yīn’s peoples were all resentful, and therefore he composed three chapters to inform the people of Heaven’s Under.22 Now Within the Seas is calm and stable, to without reason move the capital, one fears the Hundred Surnames will be alarmed and disturbed, boiling up and ants swarming into chaos.” [Dǒng] Zhuó said: “Guānzhōng is fertile and rich, therefore Qín was able to absorb and swallow Six States.23 Now to relocate to the western capital, even if the powerful and strong east of the passes dare have any move, I will use strong troops to trample them, and can drive them into the blue sea.” [Yáng] Biāo said: “Within the Seas, disturbing it is extremely easy, calming it is extremely difficult. Also the Cháng’ān Palace Residences are in ruins, and cannot be quickly rebuilt.” [Dǒng] Zhuó said: “At the time Emperor Wǔ resided at Dùlíng south mountain’s bottom, there were ceramics kilns of several thousand locations, drawing from Liáng Province timber and wood east downstream to build the Palace Residences, the achievement is not difficult.” [Dǒng] Zhuó’s could not obtain his intentions, and so changed color and said: “Does Your Excellency wish to ruin my plans? Biān Zhāng and Hán Yuē24 had letters come, wishing to have the Court certainly relocate the capital. If large armies go east downstream, I would no longer be able to rescue you, Your Excellency might as wel join the Yuán clan to march west.” [Yáng] Biāo said: “The west is naturally [my, Yáng] Biāo’s road to take, I only look back not knowing what will become of Heaven’s Under.” The discussion ended. [Dǒng] Zhuó ordered the Director of Retainers Colonel Xuān Fán to use disaster omens to impeach and memorialize, and therefore certificate dismissed [Yáng] Biāo.
Xù Hàn shū states: Grand Commandant Huáng Wǎn, Excellency over the Masses Yáng Biāo, Excellency of Works Xún Shuǎng together visited [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó said: “In the past Gāozǔ set capital in Guānzhōng, after eleven reigns was the Internal Restoration, changing the capital to Luòyáng. From Guāng-Wǔ to the present again is eleven reigns,25 Citing Shí Bāo Shì Chén,26 it is appropriate to again return the capital to Cháng’ān.” Those seated were all alarmed and startled, none dared to answer. [Yáng] Biāo said: “Moving the capital and changing systems is Heaven’s Under’s great affair, all should follow the hearts of the people and what is appropriate to the times. In the past Pán Gēng five times moved, Yīn’s peoples all were resentful, therefore he composed three chapters to inform them. In the past Wáng Mǎng usurped and rebelled, changing and disordering the Five Constants, in the time of Gēngshǐ and the Chìméi,27 Cháng’ān was burned, the Hundred Surnames devastated and harmed, the people wandering in exile, out of a hundred not one remained. Guāng-Wǔ received the Mandate, changed the capital to Luò city, this was appropriate. Now when about to establish a sagely Ruler, to glorify and expand Han’s blessings, to yet without reason abandon the Palaces and Temples, discard the Parks and Tombs, one fears the Hundred Surnames will be alarmed and startled, not understand this reasoning, and certainly boil over and ants swarm to result in disturbance and chaos. The Shí Bāo Shì Chèn is a book of witchcraft, how can it be trusted in and employed?” [Dǒng] Zhuó changed color and said: “Does Your Excellency Yáng wish to ruin the country’s plans? East of the passes is about to be in chaos, where the rebels are rising. The Xiáo and Hán are rugged and firm, the state’s weighty defense. Also from Lǒngyòu fetching timber,28 the labors are not difficult. Dùlíng south mountain’s bottom has Xiào-Wǔ’s former pottery locations, to make bricks and tiles, in one morning it can be done. The Palace Residences and Government Offices, overall how are they worth discussing? The Hundred Surnames and petty civilians, how are they worth consulting? If there is hesitation, I will use large armies to drive them, how can they do as they please?” The Hundred Bureaus was terrified and lost color. [Huáng] Wǎn spoke to [Dǒng] Zhuó stating: “This is a great affair. Excellency Yáng’s speech, is it not worth more consideration?” [Dǒng] Zhuó dismissed the seated, that day ordered the Director of Retainers to memorialize against [Yáng] Biāo and [Huáng] Wǎn, and both were dismissed from office. When the Great Carriage29 went west, [Dǒng] Zhuó’s division troops burned Luòyáng city walls’ exterior to within a hundred lǐ. Also he personally commanded troops to burn the South and North Palaces and the Ancestral Temple, the Office Treasury, civilian homes, within the city walls was razed to the ground and completely destroyed. Also he arrested all the wealthy households, claiming to punish evils to confiscate their property, the dead without crimes were uncountable.
Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó captured troops east of the mountains, with pig fat smeared cloth of over ten pǐ, used to wrap their bodies, and afterward burned them, first from the feet rising up. Captured Yuán Shào’s Yù Province Following Official Lǐ Yán, boiled him to death. [Dǒng] Zhuó had a favored Hú, who relied on the favor to act unrestrained, was by the Director of Retainers Colonel Zhào Qiān killed. [Dǒng] Zhuó was greatly furious and said: “Even my favorite dog yet I would not wish to have others shout at, so all the more for a man!” Thus summoned the Director of Retainers to the capital office and beat him to death.



〔一〕　華嶠漢書曰：卓欲遷長安，召公卿以下大議。司徒楊彪曰：「昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉天下之民。（而）〔今〕海內安穩，無故移都，恐百姓驚動，麋沸蟻聚為亂。」卓曰：「關中肥饒，故秦得并吞六國。今徙西京，設令關東豪彊敢有動者，以我彊兵踧之，可使詣滄海。」彪曰：「海內動之甚易，安之甚難。又長安宮室壞敗，不可卒復。」卓曰：「武帝時居杜陵南山下，有成瓦窑數千處，引涼州材木東下以作宮室，為功不難。」卓意不得，便作色曰：「公欲沮我計邪？邊章、韓約有書來，欲令朝廷必徙都。若大兵（來）〔東〕下，我不能復相救，公便可與袁氏西行。」彪曰：「西方自彪道徑也，顧未知天下何如耳！」議罷。卓敕司隸校尉宣璠以災異劾奏，因策免彪。續漢書曰：太尉黃琬、司徒楊彪、司空荀爽俱詣卓，卓言：「昔高祖都關中，十一世後中興，更都洛陽。從光武至今復十一世，案石苞室讖，宜復還都長安。」坐中皆驚愕，無敢應者。彪曰：「遷都改制，天下大事，皆當因民之心，隨時之宜。昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉之。往者王莽篡逆，變亂五常，更始赤眉之時，焚燒長安，殘害百姓，民人流亡，百無一在。光武受命，更都洛邑，此其宜也。今方建立聖主，光隆漢祚，而無故捐宮廟，棄園陵，恐百姓驚愕，不解此意，必麋沸蟻聚以致擾亂。石苞室讖，妖邪之書，豈可信用？」卓作色曰：「楊公欲沮國家計邪？關東方亂，所在賊起。崤函險固，國之重防。又隴右取材，功夫不難。杜陵南山下有孝武故陶處，作塼瓦，一朝可辦。宮室官府，蓋何足言！百姓小民，何足與議。若有前卻，我以大兵驅之，豈得自在。」百寮恐怖失色。琬謂卓曰：「此大事。楊公之語，得無重思！」卓罷坐，即日令司隸奏彪及琬，皆免官。大駕即西。卓部兵燒洛陽城外面百里。又自將兵燒南北宮及宗廟、府庫、民家，城內掃地殄盡。又收諸富室，以罪惡沒入其財物；無辜而死者，不可勝計。獻帝紀曰：卓獲山東兵，以豬膏塗布十餘匹，用纏其身，然後燒之，先從足起。獲袁紹豫州從事李延，煮殺之。卓所愛胡，恃寵放縱，為司隸校尉趙謙所殺。卓大怒曰：「我愛狗，尚不欲令人呵之，而況人乎！」乃召司隸都官撾殺之。













[13] Wèi shū states: Saying it infringed on Heaven’s Son.
Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó had become Grand Preceptor, further wished to be called Shàngfù, and about it asked Cài Yōng. [Cài] Yōng said: “In the past King Wǔ received the Mandate, Tàigōng was Preceptor, assisting and aiding the Zhōu House, to attack those without morality, and therefore Heaven’s Under honored him, calling him as Shàngfù. Now Your Excellency’s achievements and virtue truly are towering and imposing, but it is appropriate to wait for the east of the passes to all be settled, the Chariot Carriage to return east, and only afterward discuss it.” Thus he stopped. The capital region had an earthquake, [Dǒng] Zhuó also asked [Cài] Yōng. [Cài] Yōng replied stating: “Earthquakes are Yīn flourishing,30 caused by a great minister overstepping regulations. Your Excellency rides a Blue Canopy chariot, far and near believe it inappropriate.” [Dǒng] Zhuó followed this, and changed to riding a Gold Drecorated Black Canopy chariot.



〔二〕　魏書曰：言其逼天子也。獻帝紀曰；卓既為太師，復欲稱尚父，以問蔡邕。邕曰：「昔武王受命，太公為師，輔佐周室，以伐無道，是以天下尊之，稱為尚父。今公之功德誠為巍巍，宜須關東悉定，車駕東還，然後議之。」乃止。京師地震，卓又問邕。邕對曰：「地動陰盛，大臣踰制之所致也。公乘青蓋車，遠近以為非宜。」卓從之，更乘金華皂蓋車也。













[14] Yīngxióng jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó’s sons carried in the bosoms of concubines all were enfeoffed Marquesses, playing with gold [seals] and purple [ribbons]. His son’s daughter named [Dǒng] Bái, at the time not yet of age [under fifteen], was enfeoffed as Lady of Wèiyáng. At Méi city’s east raised a platform, depth and width over two zhàng, height five to six chǐ, had [Dǒng] Bái ride a curtained Gold Decorated Blue Canopy Chariot, Commandants and Central Cadet Generals and Inspectors of a thousand dàn rank that were at Méi, each were made to ride curtained carriage with hairpin pens,31 to be [Dǒng] Bái’s guides and escorts, to the top of the platform, having his elder brother’s son [Dǒng] Huáng as Envoy Conferring the Seal and Ribbon.



〔三〕　英雄記曰：卓侍妾懷抱中子，皆封侯，弄以金紫。孫女名白，時尚未笄，封為渭陽君。於郿城東起壇，從廣二丈餘，高五六尺，使白乘軒金華青蓋車，都尉、中郎將、刺史千石在郿者，各令乘軒簪筆，為白導從，之壇上，使兄子璜為使者授印綬。













[15] Shānyáng-gōng Zǎijì states: Previously [Dǒng] Zhuó was Front General, Huángfǔ Sōng was Left General, both on campaign against Hán Suì, each would not defer to the other. Later [Dǒng] Zhuó was summoned to be Minister Treasurer and Bìng Province Governor, his troops to be subordinated to [Huángfǔ] Sōng, [Dǒng] Zhuó was greatly furious. Reaching to becoming Grand Preceptor, [Huángfǔ] Sōng was Censorate Central Deputy, bowed below the chariot. [Dǒng] Zhuó asked [Huángfǔ] Sōng: “Yìzhēn32 are you submitting now?” [Huángfǔ] Sōng said: “How could I have know Your Enlightened Excellency was then reach to this?” [Dǒng] Zhuó said: “The swan inherently has far-reaching ambition, but the sparrows naturally do not understand.” [Huángfǔ] Sōng said: “In I with Your Enlightened Excellency both were swans, but unexpectedly now you have changed into a Fènghuáng.33 [Dǒng] Zhuó laughed and said:”If you had earlier submitted, today you could not bow.”
Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó clapped his hands and said to Huángfǔ Sōng stating: “Yìzhēn are you afraid or not?” [Huángfǔ] Sōng replied stating: “Your Enlightened Excellency by virtue assists the Court, great celebrations are about to arrive, what fear is to be had? If excessive punishments are flaunted, then Heaven’s Under would all be afraid, how would it only be [me, Huángfǔ] Sōng?” [Dǒng] Zhuó was silent, and therefore with [Huángfǔ] Sōng made peace.



〔四〕　山陽公載記曰：初卓為前將軍，皇甫嵩為左將軍，俱征韓遂，各不相下。後卓徵為少府并州牧，兵當屬嵩，卓大怒。及為太師，嵩為御史中丞，拜於車下。卓問嵩：「義真服未乎？」嵩曰：「安知明公乃至於是！」卓曰：「鴻鵠固有遠志，但燕雀自不知耳。」嵩曰：「昔與明公俱為鴻鵠，不意今日變為鳳皇耳。」卓笑曰：「卿早服，今日可不拜也。」張璠漢紀曰：卓抵其手謂皇甫嵩曰：「義真怖未乎？」嵩對曰：「明公以德輔朝廷，大慶方至，何怖之有？若淫刑以逞，將天下皆懼，豈獨嵩乎？」卓默然，遂與嵩和解。













[16] Yīngxióng jì states: Méi from Cháng’ān is two hundred sixty lǐ.34



〔五〕　英雄記曰：郿去長安二百六十里。













[17] Héng pronounced Guāng.



〔六〕橫音光。













[18] Fú-zǐ states: In Emperor Líng’s time postings at the gates sold government offices, thereupon Grand Commandant Duàn Jiǒng, Excellency over the Masses Cuī Liè, Grand Commmandant Fán Líng, Excellency of Works Zhāng Wēn and their sorts, all donated cash up to ten million and down to five million to buy the Three Excellencies. [Duàn] Jiǒng repeatedly on campaign had great achievements, [Cuī] Liè had weighty reputation in the northern provinces, [Zhāng] Wēn had outstanding talent, [Fán] Líng was able to accomodate the times, all were prominent servicemen of their time, yet they used money to obtain position, so all the more for Liú Xiāo, Táng Zhēn, Zhāng Hào and their factions.
Fēngsú Tōng states: Director of Retainers Liú Xiāo due to the faction of the various Regular Attendants reached position in the Excellency assistants.
Xù Hàn shū states: Táng Zhēn was Central Regular Attendant Táng Héng’s younger brother. Zhāng Hào was Central Regular Attendant Zhāng Fèng’s younger brother.



〔七〕　傅子曰：靈帝時牓門賣官，於是太尉段熲、司徒崔烈、太尉樊陵、司空張溫之徒，皆入錢上千萬下五百萬以買三公。熲數征伐有大功，烈有北州重名，溫有傑才，陵能偶時，皆一時顯士，猶以貨取位，而況于劉囂、唐珍、張顥之黨乎！風俗通曰：司隸劉囂，以黨諸常侍，致位公輔。續漢書曰：唐珍，中常侍唐衡弟。張顥，中常侍張奉弟。













[19] Wèi shū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó sent Director of Retainers Colonel Liú Xiāo to register the clerks and civilians that as sons were not filial, as servants were not loyal, as clerks were not pure, as younger brothers were not obedient, and those in answer to this were all executed and their property confusciated by the government. Thereupon loves and hates mutually rose, of the people many died unjustly.



〔八〕　魏書曰：卓使司隸校尉劉囂籍吏民有為子不孝，為臣不忠，為吏不清，為弟不順，有應此者皆身誅，財物沒官。於是愛憎互起，民多冤死。







Third Year Fourth Moon [192 Apr 30 - May 28], Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn, Secretariat Writers Deputy-Director Shìsūn Ruì, [Dǒng] Zhuó’s officer Lǚ Bù together planned to executed [Dǒng] Zhuó. At the time, Heaven’s Son had an illness and was newly recovered, great assembly at Wèiyāng Hall. [Lǚ] Bù sent his same prefecture Cavalry Commandant Lǐ Sù and others to lead personal troops of over ten people, falsely dressed in guard uniforms defending the Side Gate. [Lǚ] Bù kept in his bosom an Edict letter. [Dǒng] Zhuó arrived, [Lǐ] Sù and the rest blocked [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó in alarm shouted where [Lǚ] Bù was. [Lǚ] Bù said: “There is an Edict.” Therefore killed [Dǒng] Zhuó, exterminated Three Clans. Registrar Tián Jǐng ran ahead to [Dǒng] Zhuó’s corpse, [Lǚ] Bù also killed him. Altogether the killed were three people, of the rest none dared move. [20] Cháng’ān servicemen and civilians all congratulated one another, those that had flattered [Dǒng] Zhuó were all sent down to prison and died. [21]



三年四月，司徒王允、尚書僕射士孫瑞、卓將呂布共謀誅卓。是時，天子有疾新愈，大會未央殿。布使同郡騎都尉李肅等，將親兵十餘人，偽著衛士服守掖門。布懷詔書。卓至，肅等格卓。卓驚呼布所在。布曰「有詔」，遂殺卓，夷三族。主簿田景前趨卓尸，布又殺之；凡所殺三人，餘莫敢動。〔一〕長安士庶咸相慶賀，諸阿附卓者皆下獄死。〔二〕










[20] Yīngxióng jì states: At the time there was a folk song that said: “Thousand lǐ grass, how green green, ten days divination, yet not surviving.”35 Also thre was a composed “Dǒng Flees” song. Also there was a Dào priest that wrote on a cloth (bù) with the “Lǚ” character to show to [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó did not understand it referred to Lǚ Bù. [Dǒng] Zhuó was about to enter the assembly, lined up infantry and cavalry, from the camp to the Palace, in Court Dress escorted to go through the middle. His horse stumbled and would not advance, [Dǒng] Zhuó in his heart was bewildered and wished to stop, [Lǚ] Bù encouraged to have him go, so he wore armor inside and entered. When [Dǒng] Zhuó died, at the time the sun and moon were pure and quite, the slightest breeze did not rise. [Dǒng] Mín, [Dǒng] Huáng and the rest with their clan old and young were all at Méi, all returned, and were by their various subordianates chopped down or shot. [Dǒng] Zhuó’s mother was aged ninety, fled to the fortress gate stating: “I beg to be spared from death.” At once cut off her head. The Yuán clan’s disciples and former clerks replaced the coffins of the various Yuán killed at Méi, collected and gathered the Dǒng clan corpses to their side and burned them. Exposed [Dǒng] Zhuó’s corpse in the market. [Dǒng] Zhuó was fat, the grease flowed to soak the ground, the grass turning red. The clerks guarding the corpse in the dark made a large wick, stuck it in [Dǒng] Zhuó’s navel to make a lamp, bright reaching to dawn, and was like this for several days. Later [Dǒng] Zhuó’s former division retainers collected the ashes of the burned, combining it into one coffin, buried at Méi. Inside [Dǒng] Zhuó’s fortress the gold was twenty to thirty thousand jīn, silver eighty to ninety thousand jīn, pearls and jade and brocade and silk and unusual trinkets and various things all were piled into a tall mountain, it could not be counted.



〔一〕　英雄記曰：時有謠言曰：「千里艸，何青青，十日卜，猶不生。」又作董逃之歌。又有道士書布為「呂」字以示卓，卓不知其為呂布也。卓當入會，陳列步騎，自營至宮，朝服導引行其中。馬躓不前，卓心怪欲止，布勸使行，乃衷甲而入。卓既死，當時日月清淨，微風不起。旻、璜等及宗族老弱悉在郿，皆還，為其群下所斫射。卓母年九十，走至塢門曰「乞脫我死」，即斬首。袁氏門生故吏，改殯諸袁死于郿者，斂聚董氏尸于其側而焚之。暴卓尸于市。卓素肥，膏流浸地，草為之丹。守尸吏暝以為大炷，置卓臍中以為燈，光明達旦，如是積日。後卓故部曲收所燒者灰，并以一棺棺之，葬于郿。卓塢中金有二三萬斤，銀八九萬斤，珠玉錦綺奇玩雜物皆山崇阜積，不可知數。













[21] Xiè Chéng’s Hòu Hàn shū states: Cài Yōng was with Wáng Yǔn seated, heard [Dǒng] Zhuó had died, and had a sound of sighing in pity. [Wáng] Yǔn reproached [Cài] Yōng stating: “[Dǒng] Zhuó was the state’s great rebel, killed Ruler and slaughtered Ministers, what Heaven and Earth would not bless, what Humanity and Divinity alike abhored. You are the King’s servant, for generations received the Hàn’s grace, the State’s Ruler was endangered, you never once turned spear, [Dǒng] Zhuó received Heaven’s punishment, yet instead you sigh in sorrow?” Then ordered to arrest and send to the Minister of Justice. [Cài] Yōng apologized to [Wáng] Yǔn stating: “Though I am not loyal, yet I know great righteousness. Safety or danger of antiquity to the present, my ears are full of hearing, my mouth always discusses, how could I turn back on the state and so turn to [Dǒng] Zhuó? Words of insane blindness came out in error and brings in misfortune, I hope for tattooing head as punishment to continue writing Hàn history. The Excellencies and Ministers cherished [Cài] Yōng’s talent, all together remonstrated [Wáng] Yǔn. [Wáng] Yǔn said:”In the past Emperor Wǔ did not kill Sīmǎ Qiān, letting him compose a book of slander, passed to later generations. Right now the state’s blessings are in the middle of decline, war horses in the suburbs, we cannot allow a flattering minister to use pen in a Young Ruler’s Left and Right, later it will cause our group to all receive slanderous comments.” Therefore killed [Cài] Yōng.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Cài Yōng though was by [Dǒng] Zhuó closely appointed, his feelings certainly were not of his faction. How could he not know of [Dǒng] Zhuó’s treachery and viciousness, that he was by Heaven’s Under loathed? On hearing of his death, logically there would be no sigh of pity. Even supposing if it was so, he would not have answered such words in Wáng Yǔn’s seating. This probably is Xiè Chéng’s absurd record. Scribe [Sīmǎ] Qiān’s Annals and Biographies widely had unique achievements to the world, but yet to say that Wáng Yǔn said that Xiào-Wǔ should have earlier killed [Sīmǎ] Qiān, this is not the words of the knowledgable. [Sīmǎ] Qiān merely did not conceal Xiào-Wǔ’s failings, only directly writing his affairs, what slander was there? Wáng Yǔn’s loyal uprightness could be said to reflect on oneself without guilt, without fear of slander, if he wished to kill [Cài] Yōng, he would have discussed why [Cài] Yōng should die or not, how could he worry of being slandered himself and so unjustly kill a good man? This all is the extreme of false accusations and nonsense.
Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: Previously, Cài Yōng for speaking out on affairs met with exile, his reputation heard in Heaven’s Under, his righteousness moving servicemen of will. When he returned, the inner favorites hated him. [Cài] Yōng was afraid, and so fled to the sea shore, dealing with and relying on Tàishān’s Yáng clan, accumulating to ten years. When [Dǒng] Zhuó became Grand Commandant, recruited him as an Assistant, for high performance became Attendant Censor Managing Documents, within three days then reached Secretariat Writer. Later promoted to Bādōng Administrator, [Dǒng] Zhuó sent up to have him stay and appointed Attendant Central, reaching Cháng’ān became Left Central Cadet General. [Dǒng] Zhuó valued his talent, generously treated him, every time there was a Court affair, always had [Cài] Yōng provide the drafts. Reaching to when [Wáng] Yǔn was about to kill [Cài] Yōng, at the time of the famed servicemen many spoke up for him, [Wáng] Yǔn repented and wished to stop, but [Cài] Yōng was already dead.



〔二〕　謝承後漢書曰：蔡邕在王允坐，聞卓死，有歎惜之音。允責邕曰：「卓，國之大賊，殺主殘臣，天地所不祐，人神所同疾。君為王臣，世受漢恩，國主危難，曾不倒戈，卓受天誅，而更嗟痛乎？」便使收付廷尉。邕謝允曰：「雖以不忠，猶識大義，古今安危，耳所厭聞，口所常玩，豈當背國而向卓也？狂瞽之詞，謬出患入，願黥首為刑以繼漢史。」公卿惜邕才，咸共諫允。允曰：「昔武帝不殺司馬遷，使作謗書，流於後世。方今國祚中衰，戎馬在郊，不可令佞臣執筆在幼主左右，後令吾徒並受謗議。」遂殺邕。臣松之以為蔡邕雖為卓所親任，情必不黨。寧不知卓之姦凶，為天下所毒，聞其死亡，理無歎惜。縱復令然，不應反言于王允之坐。斯殆謝承之妄記也。史遷紀傳，博有奇功于世，而云王允謂孝武應早殺遷，此非識者之言。但遷為不隱孝武之失，直書其事耳，何謗之有乎？王允之忠正，可謂內省不疚者矣，既無懼于謗，且欲殺邕，當論邕應死與不，豈可慮其謗己而枉戮善人哉！此皆誣罔不通之甚者。張璠漢紀曰：初，蔡邕以言事見徙，名聞天下，義動志士。及還，內寵惡之。邕恐，乃亡命海濱，往來依太山羊氏，積十年。卓為太尉，辟為掾，以高第為侍御史治書，三日中遂至尚書。後遷巴東太守，卓上留拜侍中，至長安為左中郎將。卓重其才，厚遇之。每有朝廷事，常令邕具草。及允將殺邕，時名士多為之言，允悔欲止，而邕已死。






Lǐ Jué, Guō Sì


Previously, [Dǒng] Zhuó’s daughter’s husband Central Cadet General Niú Fǔ managed troops in a separate garrison at Shǎn, divided and sent Colonels Lǐ Jué, Guō Sì, Zhāng Jì to plunder Chénliú’s and Yǐngchuān’s various counties. When [Dǒng] Zhuó died, Lǚ Bù sent Lǐ Sù to arrive at Shǎn, wishing to with Edict mandate execute [Niú] Fǔ. [Niú] Fǔ and the rest opposed [Lǐ] Sù in battle, [Lǐ] Sù was defeated and fled to Hóngnóng, [Lǚ] Bù executed [Lǐ] Sù. [22] After that in [Niú] Fǔ’s camp soldiers there were some in the night that rebelled and exited, inside the camp was alarmed, [Niú] Fǔ believed all were rebelling, and so took gold and treasures, alone with those he had previously generously treated, Pūhú Chì’ér and others of five to six people accompanying, went over the city wall north to cross the Hé, Chì’ér and the rest were greedy for his gold and treasures, cut off his head and sent it to Cháng’ān.



初，卓女婿中郎將牛輔典兵別屯陝，分遣校尉李傕、郭汜、張濟略陳留、潁川諸縣。卓死，呂布使李肅至陝，欲以詔命誅輔。輔等逆與肅戰，肅敗走弘農，布誅肅。〔一〕其後輔營兵有夜叛出者，營中驚，輔以為皆叛，乃取金寶，獨與素所厚（友）〔攴〕胡赤兒等五六人相隨，踰城北渡河，赤兒等利其金寶，斬首送長安。










[22] Wèi shū states: [Niú] Fǔ was afraid and timid and lost his composure, could not be at ease with himself. Always he held a talismen for warding off weapons,36 had an axe and block37 delivered to his side, wishing to strengthen himself. When meeting guests, he first had a physiognomist appraise them, to know if they had a rebellious aura or not, and also stalk divined to know good or bad fortune,38 and only afterward then met them. Central Cadet General Dǒng Yuè came to meet [Niú] Fǔ, [Niú] Fǔ had a stalk divination for him, obtained Duì bottom Lí top, the stalk diviner said: “Fire overcoming metal, is the hexagram of outside plotting against inside.”39 Immediately killed [Dǒng] Yuè.
Xiàn-dì jì says: The stalk divining person always was whipped by [Dǒng] Yué therefore he took advantage of this to take revenge on him.



〔一〕　魏書曰：輔恇怯失守，不能自安。常把辟兵符，以鈇鑕致其旁，欲以自彊。見客，先使相者相之，知有反氣與不，又筮知吉凶，然後乃見之。中郎將董越來就輔，輔使筮之，得兌下離上，筮者曰：「火勝金，外謀內之卦也。」即時殺越。獻帝紀云：筮人常為越所鞭，故因此以報之。







By the time [Lǐ] Jué and the rest returned, [Niú] Fǔ was already destroyed, the multitudes had none ot rely on, wishing to each scatter and go home. There had been no pardon letter, and it was heard that those in Cháng’ān wished to completely execute all the Liáng Province men, they were anxious and afraid and did not know what to do. Used Jiǎ Xǔ’s strategy, therefore led the multitudes and went west, wherever they were collecting troops, by the time they reached Cháng’ān, the multitudes were over a hundred thousand, [23] with [Dǒng] Zhuó’s former division retainer Fán Chóu, Lǐ Méng, Wáng Fāng and others surrounding and besieging Cháng’ān city. In ten days the city fell, with [Lǚ] Bù battled inside the city, [Lǚ] Bù was defeated and fled. [Lǐ] Jué and the rest released the troops to plunder Cháng’ān’s old and young, killing them completely, the dead like a wolf’s mat.40 Executed the ones who killed [Dǒng] Zhuó, exposed the corpse of Wáng Yǔn in the market. [24] Buried [Dǒng] Zhuó at Méi, large gale and torrential rain shook [Dǒng] Zhuó’s grave, water flowed into the storage, drifitng away his coffins. [Lǐ] Jué became Chariots and Cavalry General, Marquess of Chíyáng,41 designate Director of Retainers Colonel, Lent Stave. [Guō] Sì became Rear General, Marquess of Měiyáng.42 [Fán] Chóu became Right General, Marquess of Wànnián.43 [Lǐ] Jué, [Guō] Sì, [Fán] Chóu usurped control of the Court and government. [25] [Zhāng] Jì became Agile Cavalry General, Marquess of Píngyáng,44 garrisoned Hóngnóng.



比傕等還，輔已敗，眾無所依，欲各散歸。既無赦書，而聞長安中欲盡誅涼州人，憂恐不知所為。用賈詡策，遂將其眾而西，所在收兵，比至長安，眾十餘萬，〔一〕與卓故部曲樊稠、李蒙、王方等合圍長安城。十日城陷，與布戰城中，布敗走。傕等放兵略長安老少，殺之悉盡，死者狼籍。誅殺卓者，尸王允于市。〔二〕葬卓于郿，大風暴雨震卓墓，水流入藏，漂其棺槨。傕為車騎將軍、池陽侯，領司隸校尉、假節。汜為後將軍、美陽侯。稠為右將軍、萬年侯。傕、汜、稠擅朝政。〔三〕濟為驃騎將軍、平陽侯，屯弘農。










[23] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Lǐ] Jué and the rest were at Shǎn, all were afraid, urgently gathered troops to defend themselves. Hú Wéncái, Yáng Zhěngxiū all were Liáng Province’s great figures, but Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn previously was not friendly with them. Reaching to Lǐ Jué’s rebellion, [Wáng] Yǔn then called [Hú] Wéncái and [Yáng] Zhěngxiū to have them go east to explain to them, did not borrow a warm expression, and spoke stating: “What do the rats east of the passes wish to do? You go shout at them.” Thereupon the two men went, in fact summoned troops and returned [as part of the besiegers].



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：傕等在陝，皆恐怖，急擁兵自守。胡文才、楊整脩皆涼州大人，而司徒王允素所不善也。及李傕之叛，允乃呼文才、整脩使東解釋之，不假借以溫顏，謂曰：「關東鼠子欲何為邪？卿往呼之。」於是二人往，實召兵而還。













[24] Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: [Lǚ] Bù’s troops were dfeated, he halted horse at Qīngsuǒ Gate’s exterior, spoke to [Wáng] Yǔn stating: “Your Excellency can leave.” [Wáng] Yǔn said: “Calming the country is my highest hope. If it cannot be obtained, then I will offer my body to death. The Court’s Young Ruler depends on us and no other, on facing danger to cowardly escape, I will not do. Strive hard and apologize to the various Excellencies east of the passes, to remember the country.” [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì entered Cháng’ān city, garrisoned the South Palace Side Gate, killed Minister Charioteer Lǔ Kuí, Minister Herald Zhōu Huàn, City Gate Colonel Cuī Liè, Surpassing Cavalry Colonel Wáng Qí. The clerks and civilians dead could not be counted. Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn grasped Heaven’s Son to go up Xuānpíng City Gate to avoid the troops, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest at the City Gate’s bottom bowed, prostrate on the ground and knocking head [on the ground]. The Emperor spoke to [Lǐ] Jué and the rest stating: “You cannot create power or fortune,45 but yet then release troops without restraint, what do you wish to do?” [Lǐ] Jué and the rest said: “Dǒng Zhuó was loyal to Your Majesty, but without reason was by Lǚ​ Bù killed. We Your Servants are avenging [Dǒng] Zhuó, we do not dare to rebel. We request that when the affair is finished, to go to the Minister of Justice to receive punishment.” [Wáng] Yǔn was thoroughly forced out to go meet [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué executed [Wáng] Yǔn and his wife and children and clansmen of over ten people. Inside Cháng’ān city of the male and female and large and small none did not shed tears. [Wáng] Yǔn appellation Zǐshī was a Tàiyuán Qí man. In youth he had great integrity, Guō Tài met and was amazed with him, stating: “Student Wáng in one day crosses a thousand lǐ, a talent to be a King’s aide.” Though [Guō] Tài was his senior, then they established a relationship. The Three Excellencies all recruited him, he served as Yù Province Inspector, recruited Xún Shuǎng, Kǒng Róng as Following Officials, promoted to Hénán Intendant, Secretariat Writers Director. Reaching to becoming Excellency over the Masses, his way in assisting the Ruling House, extremely had the integrity of a great minister. From Heaven’s Son on down, all depended on him. [Dǒng] Zhuó also relied on and trusted him, entrusting him with the Court.
Huà Qiáo states: The servicemen by uprightness establishes, by strategy relieves, by righteousness succeeds. Like Wáng Yǔn’s accomodating Dǒng Zhuó and sharing in his power, watching for his opening and then trapping his crimes. At this time, Heaven’s Under was difficult to resolve, the root of it was all controlled by loyalty and righteousness, therefore accomodating [Dǒng] Zhuó did not lose uprighteness, sharing in power was not to be unrighteous, watching for opening was not to be deceitful, therefore by strategy relieving and righteousness succeeding, yet it was the result of uprightness.



〔二〕　張璠漢紀曰：布兵敗，駐馬青瑣門外，謂允曰：「公可以去。」允曰：「安國家，吾之上願也，若不獲，則奉身以死。朝廷幼主恃我而已，臨難苟免，吾不為也。努力謝關東諸公，以國家為念。」傕、汜入長安城，屯南宮掖門，殺太僕魯馗、大鴻臚周奐、城門校尉崔烈、越騎校尉王頎。吏民死者不可勝數。司徒王允挾天子上宣平城門避兵，傕等於城門下拜，伏地叩頭。帝謂傕等曰：「卿無作威福，而乃放兵縱橫，欲何為乎？」傕等曰：「董卓忠于陛下，而無故為呂布所殺。臣等為卓報讎，弗敢為逆也。請事竟，詣廷尉受罪。」允窮逼出見傕，傕誅允及妻子宗族十餘人。長安城中男女大小莫不流涕。允字子師，太原祁人也。少有大節，郭泰見而奇之，曰：「王生一日千里，王佐之才也。」泰雖先達，遂與定交。三公並辟，歷豫州刺史，辟荀爽、孔融為從事，遷河南尹、尚書令。及為司徒，其所以扶持王室，甚得大臣之節，自天子以下，皆倚賴焉。卓亦推信之，委以朝廷。華嶠曰：夫士以正立，以謀濟，以義成，若王允之推董卓而分其權，伺其間而弊其罪。當此之時，天下之難解矣，本之皆主於忠義也，故推卓不為失正，分權不為不義，伺閒不為狙詐，是以謀濟義成，而歸於正也。













[25] Yīngxióng jì states: [Lǐ] Jué was a Běidì man. [Guō] Sì was a Zhāngyè man, another name [Guō] Duō.



〔三〕　英雄記曰：傕，北地人。汜，張掖人，一名多。







Hán Suì, Mǎ Téng


That Year, Hán Suì, Mǎ Téng, and others surrendered, led their multitudes to visit Cháng’ān. Appointed [Hán] Suì as Defending West General, sent to return to Liáng Province, [Mǎ] Téng as Campaigning West General, garrisoning Méi. Attendant Central Mǎ Yǔ with Remonstration Consultant Grandee Zhǒng Shào, Left Central Cadet General Liú Fàn and others planned, wishing to have [Mǎ] Téng attack Cháng’ān, themselves as inside support, to execute [Lǐ] Jué and the rest. [Mǎ] Téng led troops to reach Chángpíng Watchtower, [Mǎ] Yǔ and the rest’s plan leaked, fled out to Huáilǐ. [Fán] Chóu struck [Mǎ] Téng, [Mǎ] Téng was defeated and fled, returned to Liáng Province; also attacked Huáilǐ, [Mǎ] Yǔ and the rest all died. At the time the Three Adjuncts’ people were still several hundred thousand households, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest released troops to pillage and plunder, attack and rob cities and towns, the people were starving and destitute, within two years they were eating each other and completely wiped out. [26]



是歲，韓遂、馬騰等降，率眾詣長安。以遂為鎮西將軍，遣還涼州，騰征西將軍，屯郿。侍中馬宇與諫議大夫种邵、左中郎將劉範等謀，欲使騰襲長安，己為內應，以誅傕等。騰引兵至長平觀，宇等謀泄，出奔槐里。稠擊騰，騰敗走，還涼州；　又攻槐里，宇等皆死。時三輔民尚數十萬戶，傕等放兵劫略，攻剽城邑，人民飢困，二年閒相啖食略盡。〔一〕










[26] Xiàn-dì jì states: At that time of newly moving the capital, of the Palace women many lost clothes, the Emperor wished to issue the Management Office’s46 silk to give to them, Lǐ Jué did not wish it, stating: “Inside the Palace there is clothing, why make more?” Edict sold stable horses of over a hundred, the Management Office and Minister of Agriculture produced various silks of twenty thousand pǐ, with the revenue of the sold stable horses, bestowed on the Excellencies and Ministers on down reaching to the poor people that could not support themselves. Lǐ Jué said: “My residence stores are few,” and so had all conveyed and placed in his camp. Jiǎ Xǔ said: “This is the Superior’s intentions, it cannot be refused.” [Lǐ] Jué did not follow this.



〔一〕　獻帝紀曰：是時新遷都，宮人多亡衣服，帝欲發御府繒以與之，李傕弗欲，曰：「宮中有衣，胡為復作邪？」詔賣廄馬百餘匹，御府大司農出雜繒二萬匹，與所賣廄馬直，賜公卿以下及貧民不能自存者。李傕曰「我邸閣儲偫少」，乃悉載置其營。賈詡曰「此上意，不可拒」，傕不從之。







The various officers fought over power, therefore killed [Fán] Chóu, absorbed his multitudes. [27] [Guō] Sì with [Lǐ] Jué turned to mutual suspicion, battled and fought within Cháng’ān. [28] [Lǐ] Jué held hostage Heaven’s Son in his camp, burned the Palace Halls and City Gates, plundered the Government Offices, completely collecting the [imperial] chariots and carriages and uniforms and imperial objects to be placed in his house. [29] [Lǐ] Jué sent the Excellencies and Ministers to visit [Guō] Sì to ask for peace, [Guō] Sì seized the mall. [30] Attached and struck one another for successive moons, the dead were in the tens of thousands. [31]



諸將爭權，遂殺稠，并其眾。〔一〕汜與傕轉相疑，戰鬥長安中。〔二〕傕質天子於營，燒宮殿城門，略官寺，盡收乘輿服御物置其家。〔三〕傕使公卿詣汜請和，汜皆執之。〔四〕相攻擊連月，死者萬數。〔五〕










[27] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: At Mǎ Téng’s and Hán Suì’s defeat, Fán Chóu pursued reaching Chéncāng. [Hán] Suì spoke with [Fán] Chóu stating: “Heaven and Earth turn around, it cannot be predicted. The root of the fighting is not private grudges, it is merely an affair of the Ruling House. You and I are of the same region, although now there is a small opposition, there will be large agreement. I wish to with good words take leave of you. If by chance ten thousand to one it is not as wished, later can we meet one another again?” Both withdrew cavalry and went ahead to meet horses, crossed arms to meet one another, together spoke for a long time and then separated. [Lǐ] Jué’s elder brother’s son [Lǐ] Lì accompanied [Fán] Chóu, [Lǐ] Lì returned and reported to [Lǐ] Jué: “Hán and Fán met on horse and talked, it is not known what was discussed, their affection was extremely close.” [Lǐ] Jué because of this suspected [Fán] Chóu of privately making peace with [Hán] Suì and having ulterior intentions. [Fán] Chóu wished to lead troops east to set out the passes, from [Lǐ] Jué requested additional troops. Took advantage to invite [Fán] Chóu to a meeting to discuss, and then at the seating killed [Fán] Chóu.



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：馬騰、韓遂之敗，樊稠追至陳倉。遂語稠曰：「天地反覆，未可知也。本所爭者非私怨，王家事耳。與足下州里人，今雖小違，要當大同，欲相與善語以別。邂逅萬一不如意，後可復相見乎！」俱卻騎前接馬，交臂相加，共語良久而別。傕兄子利隨稠，利還告傕，韓、樊交馬語，不知所道，意愛甚密。傕以是疑稠與韓遂私和而有異意。稠欲將兵東出關，從傕索益兵。因請稠會議，便於坐殺稠。













[28] Diǎnlüè states: [Lǐ] Jué repeatedly set alcohol and invited [Guō] Sì, sometimes keeping [Guō] Sì to stay overnight. [Guō] Sì’s wife feared [Lǐ] Jué would give [Guō] Sì maids and concubines that would steal his affection from her, and thought to alienate them. It happened that [Lǐ] Jué sent gifted food, the wife thus used fermented beans to resemble a poison, [Guō] Sì was about to eat, the wife said: “The food from the outside came, suppose if there is a problem?” Therefore she plucked out the poison to show him, stating: “One perch does not have two males, I firmly doubt, General, your trust in Excellency Lǐ.” On another day [Lǐ] Jué again invited [Guō] Sì, greatly intoxicated. [Guō] Sì suspected [Lǐ] Jué of poisoning him, strained manure juice and drank it to then vomit. Thereupon it then grew into hostility, and so they drilled troops to attack one another.



〔二〕　典略曰：傕數設酒請汜，或留汜止宿。汜妻懼傕與汜婢妾而奪己愛，思有以離閒之。會傕送饋，妻乃以豉為藥，汜將食，妻曰：「食從外來，倘或有故！」遂摘藥示之，曰：「一栖不二雄，我固疑將軍之信李公也。」他日傕復請汜，大醉。汜疑傕藥之，絞糞汁飲之乃解。於是遂生嫌隙，而治兵相攻。













[29] Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Previously, [Guō] Sì planned to welcome Heaven’s Son to visit his camp, in the night there was a deserter who informed [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué sent his elder brother’s son [Lǐ] Xiān to lead several thousand troops to encircle the Palace, with chariots of three carriages to welcome Heaven’s Son. Yáng Biāo said: “Since antiquity of Emperors and Kings none have been in the houses of servants of men. Actions must accord with the hearts of Heaven’s Under, you sirs in doing this, it is not right.” [Lǐ] Xiān said: “The General’s plan is settled.” Thereupon Heaven’s Son rode one carriage, Noble Lady Fú-shì one carriage, Jiǎ Xǔ and Zuǒ Líng one carriage, the remainder all walked to follow. That day, [Lǐ] Jué further moved the carriages to visit the north fortress, sending a Colonel to supervise the fortress gates, inside and outside cut off. The various attendant ministers all had expressions of hunger, at the time it was the peak of summer heat, the people were completely cold in heart. The Emperor requested rice of five hú, ox bones of five sets to bestow on the Left and Right, [Lǐ] Jué said: “Morning and evening I send up food, What use is rice for?” Thus gave rotten ox bones, all of foul odor and could not be eaten. The Emperor was greatly furious, wished to question and reprimand him. Attendant Central Yáng Qí sent up a sealed message that said: “[Lǐ] Jué is a man of the frontiers, accustomed to Yí manners, now he also himself knows his violations are perverse and rebellious, always having expressions of discontentment, wishing to escort the Chariot Carriage to visit Huángbáichéng to relieve his anger. Your Servant wishes for Your Majesty to endure this, one cannot yet expose his crimes.” The Emperor accepted this. Previously, [Lǐ] Jué garrisoned Huángbáichéng, and therefore planned wishing to relocate there. [Lǐ] Jué, as Excellency over the Masses Zhào Wēn did not agree with him, thus detained [Zhào] Wēn inside the fortress. [Zhào] Wēn heard that [Lǐ] Jué wished to move the carriages, his letter to [Lǐ] Jué said: “Your Excellency formerly claimed to avenge Excellency Dǒng, however in fact slaughtered and sacked the Ruler’s city, massacred the chief ministers, what Heaven’s Under cannot understand house by house or be explained to door by door. Now to contend over the discord of angry glances, to create an enmity of a thousand jūn, the people are [suffering] in mud and ash, each unable to make a living, but not once do you change to waking, and therefore achieve disaster and chaos. The Court repeatedly sends down enlightened Edicts, wishing to order peace and reconciliation, the Edict mandates are not enacted, favor and grace daily damaged, yet you further wish to escort the carriage to Huángbáichéng, this truly is what [I, this] old man cannot understand. According to the Yì, ‘one overstep is an overstep, twice is trespass, thrice and yet not changing, exterminates the head, ominous.’ It is not as good as early making peace together, leading troops back to garrison, above coming the Ten Thousand Carriages, below preserving the living people, would it not be extreme fortune?” [Lǐ] Jué was greatly furious, wished to send someone to murder [Zhào] Wēn. His younger cousin [Lǐ] Yīng was [Zhào] Wēn’s former Assistant, remonstrated him for several days and so he stopped. The Emperor heard of [Zhào] Wēn’s letter to [Lǐ] Jué, and asked Attendant Central Cháng Qià stating: “[Lǐ] Jué does not know good from evil, [Zhào] Wēn’s words were too cutting, it can make one cold in heart.” Replied stating: “Lǐ Yīng already resolved it.” The Emperor then was pleased.



〔三〕　獻帝起居注曰：初，汜謀迎天子幸其營，夜有亡告傕者，傕使兄子暹將數千兵圍宮，以車三乘迎天子。楊彪曰：「自古帝王無在人臣家者。舉事當合天下心，諸君作此，非是也。」暹曰：「將軍計定矣。」於是天子一乘，貴人伏氏一乘，賈詡、左靈一乘，其餘皆步從。是日，傕復移乘輿幸北塢，使校尉監塢門，內外隔絕。諸侍臣皆有飢色，時盛暑熱，人盡寒心。帝求米五斛、牛骨五具以賜左右，傕曰：「朝餔上飯，何用米為？」乃與腐牛骨，皆臭不可食。帝大怒，欲詰責之。侍中楊琦上封事曰：「傕，邊鄙之人，習于夷風，今又自知所犯悖逆，常有怏怏之色，欲輔車駕幸黃白城以紓其憤。臣願陛下忍之，未可顯其罪也。」帝納之。初，傕屯黃白城，故謀欲徙之。傕以司徒趙溫不與己同，乃內溫塢中。溫聞傕欲移乘輿，與傕書曰：「公前託為董公報讎，然實屠陷王城，殺戮大臣，天下不可家見而戶釋也。今爭睚眥之隙，以成千鈞之讎，民在塗炭，各不聊生，曾不改寤，遂成禍亂。朝廷仍下明詔，欲令和解，詔命不行，恩澤日損，而復欲輔乘輿于黃白城，此誠老夫所不解也。於易，一過為過，再為涉，三而弗改，滅其頂，凶。不如早共和解，引兵還屯，上安萬乘，下全生民，豈不幸甚！」傕大怒，欲遣人害溫。其從弟應，溫故掾也，諫之數日乃止。帝聞溫與傕書，問侍中常洽曰：「傕弗知臧否，溫言太切，可為寒心。」對曰：「李應已解之矣。」帝乃悅。













[30] Huà Qiáo’s Hàn shū states: [Guō] Sì feasted the Excellencies and Ministers, discussed a wish to attack [Lǐ] Jué. Yáng Biāo said: “The various ministers together fighting, one man seizes Heaven’s Son, one man takes hostage the Excellencies and Ministers, how can this be done?” [Guō] Sì was angry, wished to use his own hand and blade on him, Central Cadet General Yáng Mì with the Left and Right had many remonstrations, [Guō] Sì thus returned them.



〔四〕　華嶠漢書曰：汜饗公卿，議欲攻傕。楊彪曰：「群臣共鬥，一人劫天子，一人質公卿，此可行乎？」汜怒，欲手刃之，中郎將楊密及左右多諫，汜乃歸之。













[31] Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: [Lǐ] Jué by nature enjoyed the arts of ghosts and spirits and heterodox ways, always having Dào priests and witch women sing songs and beat drums to call down divinities, offered sacrifices to the Six Dīng,47 objects of talismens and amulets,48 none he did not use. Also at the outside of the Court secretariat gates, for Dǒng Zhuó he made a Spirit Seat, repeatedly using oxen and sheep to sacrifice to it, when finishing passed the secretariat side doors to inquire on [the Emperor’s] rising and activities, requesting to enter to meet. [Lǐ] Jué wore three knives, his hand further carried a whip joined to hold one knife. The Attendant Central and Attendant Cadets saw [Lǐ] Jué wearing weapons, all were terrified, and also wore swords and held knives, ahead entering to stand to the Emperor’s side. [Lǐ] Jué faced the Emperor, sometimes saying “Enlightened Majesty,” sometimes saying “Enlightened Emperor,” to the Emperor saying that Guō Sì was insolent, the Emperor also complied with his thinking when answering him. [Lǐ] Jué was pleased, went out and said: “The Enlightened Majesty is truly a worthy and sagely Ruler,” his thoughts therefore were self-confident, himself saying he had thoroughly won over Heaven’s Son’s pleased heart. However, he yet did not wish to let the close ministers wear swords at the Emperor’s side, and spoke to someone saying: “Does this group of boys wish to plot against me? Why do they all hold knives?” Attendant Central Lǐ Zhēn was of [Lǐ] Jué’s home region, formerly with [Lǐ] Jué was friendly, and said to [Lǐ] Jué: “The reason they hold knives, is that in the military one cannot not do so, this is the country’s precedent.” [Lǐ] Jué’s thoughts then were resolved. Heaven’s Son because Visitors Deputy Director Huángfǔ Lì was of an old family of Liáng Province, had talent in diplomatic response, sent him to make peace between [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì. [Huángfǔ] Lì first visited [Guō] Sì, [Guō] Sì accepted the Edict mandate. Visited [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué would not agree, saying: “I have the achievement of suppressing Lǚ Bù, assisted the government, the Three Adjuncts purified and quiet, Heaven’s Under knows this. Guō Duō is merely a horse stealing caitiff, how dare he then wish to share my level? I certainly will execute him. You are a Liáng Province man, observe my overall strategies and multitudes of servicemen, are they sufficient to deal with [Guō] Duō or not? [Guō] Duō also seized as hostages the Excellencies and Ministers, behaving like this, yet you carelessly wish to profit Guō Duō, [I,] Lǐ Jué have the guts to myself understand this.” [Huángfǔ] Lì answered stating: “In the past Yǒuqióng Hòuyì relied on his skill in shooting, not thinking of sufferings or troubles, so that it brought about his death. More recently the strength of Excellency Dǒng [Zhuó], you Enlightened General with your own eyes witnessed, inside he had Excellency Wáng [Yǔn] as his interior controller, outside he had Dǒng Mín, [Dǒng] Chéng, [Dǒng] Huáng as his ruthless enforcers,49 Lǚ Bù received favor and yet rebelled and plotted against him, and within an instant, his head was hanging from the end of a pole. This is to have valor but lack planning. Now you General personally act as the highest officer, grasping Battle-Ax and wielding Stave, sons and grandsons holding power, clansmen carrying favor, the country’s best positions50 are all occupied by them. Now Guō Duō siezes as hostages the Excellencies and Ministers, you General coerce the Utmost Honored, which is lighter and heavier? Zhāng Jì with Guō Duō and Yáng Dìng have plans, and also are joined by the capped and girdled.51 Yáng Fèng is only a Báibō leader,52 yet understands that what you General are doing is not right, though you General may honor and favor him, yet he will not agree to exhaust his strength [for you].” [Lǐ] Jué would not accept [Huángfǔ] Lì’s advice, and so shouted at him to send him out. [Huángfǔ] Lì went out, visited the secretariat gates, reported that [Lǐ] Jué would not agree to obey the Edict, statements and speach insubordinate. Attendant Central Hú Miǎo, who was favored by [Lǐ] Jué, called the Edict carrier to have him embellish the statements, and also spoke to [Huángfǔ] Lì stating: “Geneeral Lǐ’s treatment of you is not meager, and also Excellency Huángfǔ [Sōng] becoming Grand Commandant was by General Lǐ’s strength.” [Huángfǔ] Lì answered stating: “Hú Jìngcái, you are the country’s attendant minister,53 a servant of assisting support, your language and words are like this, how can you be employed?” [Hú] Miǎo said: “I merely worry that if you lose General Lǐ’s goodwill, I fear it will not be easy [for you]. What do I have to do with you?” [Huángfǔ] Lì said: “My family for generations received favor, and I personally also always have been in the curtains,54 for a Lord’s dishonor the Servant dies, if I am connected to the country, by Lǐ Jué killed, then it is Heaven’s Will.” Heaven’s Son heard that [Huángfǔ] Lì’s answer speech was cutting, feared [Lǐ] Jué would hear of it, and immediately ordered to send away [Huángfǔ] Lì. [Huángfǔ] Lì had just gone out the camp gates, [Lǐ] Jué sent Tiger Elite Wáng Chāng to call him. [Wáng] Chāng knew [Huángfǔ] Lì was loyal and upright, let him go, returned to answer to [Lǐ] Jué, saying that in pursuing him he did not catch him. Heaven’s Son sent Left Central Cadet General Lǐ Gù Holding Stave to appoint [Lǐ] Jué as Marshal-in-Chief,55 to the right of the Three Excellencies.56 [Lǐ] Jué hinmself believed he had obtained the strength of ghosts and divinities, and so generously reward the various witches.



〔五〕　獻帝起居注曰：傕性喜鬼怪左道之術，常有道人及女巫歌謳擊鼓下神，祠祭六丁，符劾厭勝之具，無所不為。又於朝廷省門外，為董卓作神坐，數以牛羊祠之，訖，過省閤問起居，求入見。傕帶三刀，手復與鞭合持一刃。侍中、侍郎見傕帶仗，皆惶恐，亦帶劍持刀，先入在帝側。傕對帝，或言「明陛下」，或言「明帝」，為帝說郭汜無狀，帝亦隨其意答應之。傕喜，出言「明陛下真賢聖主」，意遂自信，自謂良得天子歡心也。雖然，猶不欲令近臣帶劍在帝邊，謂人言「此曹子將欲圖我邪？而皆持刀也」。侍中李禎，傕州里，素與傕通，語傕「所以持刀者，軍中不可不爾，此國家故事」。傕意乃解。天子以謁者僕射皇甫酈涼州舊姓，有專對之才，遣令和傕、汜。酈先詣汜，汜受詔命。詣傕，傕不肯，曰：「我有〔討〕呂布之功，輔政四年，三輔清靜，天下所知也。郭多，盜馬虜耳，何敢乃欲與吾等邪？必欲誅之。君為涼州人，觀吾方略士眾，足辦多不？多又劫質公卿，所為如是，而君苟欲利郭多，李傕有膽自知之。」酈答曰：「昔有窮后羿恃其善射，不思患難，以至于斃。近董公之強，明將軍目所見，內有王公以為內主，外有董旻、承、璜以為鯁毒，呂布受恩而反圖之，斯須之間，頭縣竿端，此有勇而無謀也。今將軍身為上將，把鉞仗節，子孫握權，宗族荷寵，國家好爵而皆據之。今郭多劫質公卿，將軍脅至尊，誰為輕重邪？張濟與郭多、楊定有謀，又為冠帶所附。楊奉，白波帥耳，猶知將軍所為非是，將軍雖拜寵之，猶不肯盡力也。」傕不納酈言，而呵之令出。酈出，詣省門，白傕不肯從詔，辭語不順。侍中胡邈為傕所幸，呼傳詔者令飾其辭。又謂酈曰：「李將軍於卿不薄，又皇甫公為太尉，李將軍力也。」酈答曰：「胡敬才，卿為國家常伯，輔弼之臣也，語言如此，寧可用邪？」邈曰：「念卿失李將軍意，恐不易耳！我與卿何事者？」酈言：「我累世受恩，身又常在幃幄，君辱臣死，當坐國家，為李傕所殺，則天命也。」天子聞酈答語切，恐傕聞之，便敕遣酈。酈裁出營門，傕遣虎賁王昌呼之。昌知酈忠直，縱令去，還答傕，言追之不及。天子使左中郎將李固持節拜傕為大司馬，在三公之右。傕自以為得鬼神之力，乃厚賜諸巫。







[Lǐ] Jué’s officer Yáng Fèng with [Lǐ] Jué’s army scribe Sòng Guǒ and others planned to kill [Lǐ] Juè, the matter leaked, therefore they led troops to rebel against [Lǐ] Jué. [Lǐ] Jué’s multitudes rebelled, he gradually weakened. Zhāng Jì from Shǎn reconciliated them, Heaven’s Son thus was able to get out, reached to between Xīnfēng and Bàlíng. [32] Guō Sì again wished to coerce Heaven’s Son to return and set capital at Méi. Heaven’s Son fled to [Yáng] Fèng’s camp, [Yáng] Fèng struck [Guō] Sì and defeated him. [Guō] Sì fled to Nánshān, [Yáng] Fèng with General Dǒng Chéng with Heaven’s Son returned to Luòyáng. [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì regretted letting go Heaven’s Son, restored peace between themselves, pursued and reached Heaven’s Son at Hóngnóng’s Cáoyáng. [Yáng] Fèng urgently recruited Hédōng’s former Báibō leaders Hán Xiān, Hú Cái, Lǐ Lè and others to unite, with [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì greatly battled. [Yáng] Fèng’s troops were defeated, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest unleashed troops to kill the Excellencies and Ministers and Hundred Officials, plundering the Palace women and entering Hóngnóng. [33] Heaven’s Son fled to Shǎn, crossed the Hé north, lost the supply wagons, on foot travelled, only the Imperial Empress and Noble Ladies following, reached Dàyáng, stopped inside a person’s house. [34] [Yáng] Fèng and [Hán] Xiān and others therefore with Heaven’s Son set capital at Ānyì, driving and riding an ox cart. Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo, Minister Charioteer Hán Róng, and the close ministers that were following were over ten people. Appointed [Hán] Xiān as Campaigning East,[Hú] Cái as Campaigning West, [Lǐ] Lè as Campaigning North Generals, all with [Yáng] Fèng and [Dǒng] Chéng maintaining the government. Sent [Hán] Róng to reach Hóngnóng, with [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì and the rest making peace, returned the plundered Palace women and Excellencies and Ministers and Hundred Officials, with carriages and chariots and horses of several carriages. At the time locusts rose, that year was a drought and no grain, the following officials ate jujubes and greens. [35] The various officers could not lead one another, above and below in chaos, grain provisions exhausted. [Yáng] Fèng, [Hán] Xiān, [Dǒng] Chéng thus had Heaven’s Son return to Luòyáng. Set out Jī Pass, down Zhǐ Road, Zhāng Yáng with food welcomed on the road, appointed Marshal-in-Chief. The story is in [Zhāng] Yáng’s biography. Heaven’s Son entered Luòyáng, the Palace Residences were completely burned down, the roads and streets overgrown in weeds, the Hundred Officials draped in thistles and thorns, sheltered between mounds and walls. The provinces and prefectures each gathered troops to guard themselves, none had any come [to help]. The hunger and destitution gradually became extreme, the Secretariat Writers Cadets on down personally went out to collect firewood, some starved to death between the walls.



傕將楊奉與傕軍吏宋果等謀殺傕，事泄，遂將兵叛傕。傕眾叛，稍衰弱。張濟自陝和解之，天子乃得出，至新豐、霸陵閒。〔一〕郭汜復欲脅天子還都郿。天子奔奉營，奉擊汜破之。汜走南山，奉及將軍董承以天子還洛陽。傕、汜悔遣天子，復相與和，追及天子於弘農之曹陽。奉急招河東故白波帥韓暹、胡才、李樂等合，與傕、汜大戰。奉兵敗，傕等縱兵殺公卿百官，略宮人入弘農。〔二〕天子走陝，北渡河，失輜重，步行，唯皇后貴人從，至大陽，止人家屋中。〔三〕奉、暹等遂以天子都安邑，御乘牛車。太尉楊彪、太僕韓融近臣從者十餘人。以暹為征東、才為征西、樂征北將軍，並與奉、承持政。遣融至弘農，與傕、汜等連和，還所略宮人公卿百官，及乘輿車馬數乘。是時蝗蟲起，歲旱無穀，從官食棗菜。〔四〕諸將不能相率，上下亂，糧食盡。奉、暹、承乃以天子還洛陽。出箕關，下軹道，張楊以食迎道路，拜大司馬。語在楊傳。天子入洛陽，宮室燒盡，街陌荒蕪，百官披荊棘，依丘牆閒。州郡各擁兵自衛，莫有至者。飢窮稍甚，尚書郎以下，自出樵采，或飢死牆壁閒。










[32] Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Previously, Heaven’s Son went out and arrived at Xuānpíng Gate, about to cross the bridge, [Guō] Sì’s troops of several hundred men screened the bridge and asked: “Is it Heaven’s Son?” The chariot could not advance. [Lǐ] Jué’s troops of several hundred men all held large halberds to the carriage chariots left and right, Attendant Central Liú Ài greatly shouted saying: “It is Heaven’s Son.” Had Attendant Central Yáng Qí highly raise the chariot curtain. The Emperor spoke to the various soldiers: “You do not withdraw? How dare you press close to the Utmost Honored?” [Guō] Sì and the rest’s soldiers then withdrew. They had crossed the bridge, the servicemen multitudes all shouted Ten Thousand Years.



〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：初，天子出到宣平門，當度橋，汜兵數百人遮橋問「是天子邪」？車不得前。傕兵數百人皆持大戟在乘輿車左右，侍中劉艾大呼云：「是天子也。」使侍中楊琦高舉車帷。帝言諸兵：「汝不卻，何敢迫近至尊邪？」汜等兵乃卻。既度橋，士眾咸呼萬歲。













[33] Xiàn-dì jì states: At the time Secretariat Writers Directory Shìsūn Ruì was by the chaotic troops murdered.
Sānfǔ Juélù zhù states: [Shìsūn] Ruì appellation Jūnróng was a Fúfēng man, for generations a scholar family. [Shìsūn] Ruì in his youth continued the family enterprise, widely learned with nothing not understood, served successively in prominent positions. When [Dǒng] Zhuó had been executed, promoted to Minister of Agriculture, for the state became Three-Elder. Every time the Three Excellencies had an opening, [Shìsūn] Ruì always was among the selected candidates. When Grand Commandants Zhōu Zhōng and Huángfǔ Sōng, Excellencies over the Masses Chúnyú Jiā and Zhào Wēn, Excellencies of Works Yáng Biāo and Zhāng Xǐ and others became Excellencies, all had declined and deferred to [Shìsūn] Ruì.57 When Heaven’s Son set capital at Xǔ, recalled and discussed [Shìsūn] Ruì’s achievements, enfeoffed his son [Shìsūn] Mńg as Marquess of Tánjīn precinct. [Shìsūn] Méng appellation Wénshǐ, also had talent and learning, with Wáng Càn was friendly. When about to accept the fief, [Wáng] Càn composed a poem to gift to [Shìsūn] Méng, [Shìsūn] Méng had a reply, [both] in [Wáng] Càn’s Collected Works.



〔二〕　獻帝紀曰：時尚書令士孫瑞為亂兵所害。三輔決錄注曰：瑞字君榮，扶風人，世為學門。瑞少傳家業，博達無所不通，仕歷顯位。卓既誅，遷大司農，為國三老。每三公缺，瑞常在選中。太尉周忠、皇甫嵩，司徒淳于嘉、趙溫，司空楊彪、張喜等為公，皆辭拜讓瑞。天子都許，追論瑞功，封子萌澹津亭侯。萌字文始，亦有才學，與王粲善。臨當就國，粲作詩以贈萌，萌有答，在粲集中。













[34] Xiàn-dì jì states: Previously, commentators wished ot have Heaven’s Son sail the Hé east downstream, Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo said: “Your Servant is a Hóngnóng man, from here on east, there are thirty-six rapids, not what the Ten Thousand Carriages should follow.” Liú Ài said: “Your Servant formerly was Shǎn Magistrate, know its dangerous terrain, even with [boat] pilots yet there there are capsizes, all the more now with no pilots. The Grand Commandant’s plan is correct.” Thus stopped. Reaching to when about to cross north, sent Lǐ Lè to prepare boats. Heaven’s Son on foot walked hurriedly to the river bank, the bank was high and could not be descended, Dǒng Chéng and the rest planned and wished to use horse bridles to tie together to fasten to the Emperor’s waist. At the time the Central Palace’s servant Fú Dé supported the Central Palace,58 one hand holding ten pǐ of fabric, thus took [Fú] Dé’s silk to tie together into a seat. Marching Army Colonel Shàng Hóng had much strength, had [Shàng] Hóng occupy the front carrying the Emperor on his back, then able to descend to board the boat. The rest that could not cross were extremely many, further sent boats to collect those that could not cross, all fought to climb onto the boats, the people on the boats with blades cut off their fingers, the fingers inside the boats could be scooped.



〔三〕　獻帝紀曰：初，議者欲令天子浮河東下，太尉楊彪曰：「臣弘農人，從此已東，有三十六灘，非萬乘所當從也。」劉艾曰：「臣前為陝令，知其危險，有師猶有傾覆，況今無師，太尉謀是也。」乃止。及當北渡，使李樂具船。天子步行趨河岸，岸高不得下，董承等謀欲以馬羈相續以繫帝腰。時中宮僕伏德扶中宮，一手持十匹絹，乃取德絹連續為輦。行軍校尉尚弘多力，令弘居前負帝，乃得下登船。其餘不得渡者甚眾，復遣船收諸不得渡者，皆爭攀船，船上人以刃櫟斷其指，舟中之指可掬。













[35] Wèi shū states: The carriage [the Emperor] at the time resided within thorn hedges, the gates and doors could not be closed. When Heaven’s Son with the various ministers gathered, soldiers leaned on the hedge top to watch, jostling one another to laugh. The various officers concentrated power, some without authority whipping and killing Secretariat Writers. When the Director of Retainers Colonel went out and in, civilians and soldiers threw stones at him. Of the various officers some sent maids to visit the secretariat side doors, some personally with gifts of alcohol and food went to drink with Heaven’s Son, the Attendant Centrals would not let them pass, they shouted curses, and therefore could not be stopped. Also they competed to memorialize to appoint civilians from the various cmaps and walls to be their division retainers, seeking from them gifts and bribes. Physicians and running lackeys all became Colonels, the Censorate in carving seals could not provide for them, and so used awls to draw and show there was an inscription, some did not have time for that.



〔四〕　魏書曰：乘輿時居棘籬中，門戶無關閉。天子與群臣會，兵士伏籬上觀，互相鎮壓以為笑。諸將專權，或擅笞殺尚書。司隸校尉出入，民兵抵擲之。諸將或遣婢詣省閤，或自齎酒啖，過天子飲，侍中不通，喧呼罵詈，遂不能止。又競表拜諸營壁民為部曲，求其禮遺。醫師、走卒，皆為校尉，御史刻印不供，乃以錐畫，示有文字，或不時得也。







Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] then welcomed Heaven’s Son to set capital at Xǔ. [Hán] Xiān and [Yáng] Fèng were not able to uphold Ruling Law, each went out and fled, plundering between Xú and Yáng [Provinces], killed by Liú Bèi. [36] Dǒng Chéng followed Tàizǔ for over a year, executed. Jiàn’ān Second Year [197], sent Visitors Deputy Director Péi Mào to lead various officers west of the passes to execute [Lǐ] Jué, exterminated Three Clans. [37] [Guō] Sì was by his officer Wǔ Xí attacked, died at Méi. [Zhāng] Jì in hunger arrived at Nányáng to plunder, was by Ráng men killed, his cousin’s son [Zhāng] Xiù took over his multitudes. [Hú] Cái, [Lǐ] Lè remained in Hédōng, [Hú] Cái for a family grudge was killed, [Lǐ] Lè of illness died. [Hán] Suì and [Mǎ] Téng personally returned to Liáng Province, again raided one another, later [Mǎ] Téng entered [Court] to be Minister of the Guard, his son [Mǎ] Chāo managed his division retainers. Sixteenth Year [211], [Mǎ] Chāo with the Guānzhōng’s various officers with [Hán] Suì and others rebelled, Tàizǔ campaigned against and defeated them. The story is in the Wǔ Annals. [Hán] Suì fled to Jīnchéng, was by his officers killed. [Mǎ] Chāo occupied Hànyáng, [Mǎ] Téng in connection was exterminated three clans. Zhào Qú and others raised righteous troops to suppress [Mǎ] Chāo, [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Hànzhōng and followed Zhāng Lǔ, later fled to Liú Bèi, died in Shǔ.



太祖乃迎天子都許。暹、奉不能奉王法，各出奔，寇徐、揚間，為劉備所殺。〔一〕董承從太祖歲餘，誅。建安二年，遣謁者僕射裴茂率關西諸將誅傕，夷三族。〔二〕汜為其將五習所襲，死于郿。濟飢餓，至南陽寇略，為穰人所殺，從子繡攝其眾。才、樂留河東，才為怨家所殺，樂病死。遂、騰自還涼州，更相寇，後騰入為衛尉，子超領其部曲。十六年，超與關中諸將及遂等反，太祖征破之。語在武紀。遂奔金城，為其將所殺。超據漢陽，騰坐夷三族。趙衢等舉義兵討超，超走漢中從張魯，後奔劉備，死于蜀。










[36] Yīngxióng jì states: [Liú] Bèi enticed [Yáng] Fèng to a mutual meeting, took advantage to at the seated assembly seize him. [Hán] Xiān having lost [Yáng] Fèng was isolated, at the time wished to flee back to Bìng Province, was by Zhùqiū garrison leader Zhāng Xuān intercepted and killed.



〔一〕　英雄記曰：備誘奉與相見，因於坐上執之。暹失奉勢孤，時欲走還并州，為杼秋屯帥張宣所邀殺。













[37] Diǎnlüè states: [Lǐ] Jué’s head arrived, there was Edict to hang it high.



〔二〕　典略曰：傕頭至，有詔高縣。
crumbs: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú

title: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú
text:
Yuán Shào


Yuán Shào appellation Běnchū was Rǔnán Rǔyáng man.59 His great-great-grandfather [Yuán] Ān was a Hàn Excellency over the Masses. From [Yuán] Ān on down four generations occupied Three Excellencies positions, from this their influence covered Heaven’s Under. [38] [Yuán] Shào had handsome appearance and imposing presence, able to humble himself to subordinate servicemen, of servicemen many attached to him. Tàizǔ in youth associated with him. As a General-in-Chief’s Assistant he became Attendant Censor, [39] gradually promoted to Central Army Colonel, reached Director of Retainers.



袁紹字本初，汝南汝陽人也。高祖父安，為漢司徒。自安以下四世居三公位，由是勢傾天下。〔一〕紹有姿貌威容，能折節下士，士多附之，太祖少與交焉。以大將軍掾為侍御史，〔二〕稍遷中軍校尉，至司隸。










[38] Huà Qiáo’s Hàn shū states: [Yuán] Ān appellation Shàogōng enjoyed study and had imposing gravitas. In Emperor Míng’s time60 he became Chǔ prefecture Adminsitrator, governed the prison cases of the King of Chǔ, those with redressed grievances were over four hundred families, all received preservation and rescue, [Yuán] Ān therefore became a famed minister.61 In Emperor Zhāng’s time62 reached Excellency over the Masses, begat Shǔ prefecture Administrator [Yuán] Jīng. [Yuán] Jīng’s younger brother [Yuán] Chǎng became Excellency of Works. [Yuán] Jīng’s son [Yuán] Tāng was Grand Commandant. [Yuán] Tāng’s four sons: eldest son [Yuán] Píng, [Yuán] Píng’s younger brother Chéng was Left Central Cadet General, both early died; [Yuán] Chéng’s younger brother [Yuán] Féng, [Yuán] Féng’s younger brother [Yuán] Wěi, both became Excellencies.
Wèi shū states: From [Yuán] Ān on down, all broadly favored and embraced the masses, with no selectiveness. Guests that entered their gates whether worthy or foolish all obtained their desires, Heaven’s Under submitted to them. [Yuán] Shào in fact was [Yuán] Féng’s concubine-born son, [Yuán] Shù’s elder brother of a different mother, sent out to be posterity for [Yuán] Chéng as a son.63
Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Chéng appellation Wénkāi was strong and vigorous and had good proportions, the noble [Imperial in-law] relations powerful and dominant from General-in-Chief Liáng Jì on down all joined in friendship with him, of his advice none was not followed. Therefore the capital region made a proverb stating: “For a matter not resolved, asked Wénkāi.”64



〔一〕　華嶠漢書曰：安字邵公，好學有威重。明帝時為楚郡太守，治楚王獄，所申理者四百餘家，皆蒙全濟，安遂為名臣。章帝時至司徒，生蜀郡太守京。京弟敞為司空。京子湯，太尉。湯四子：長子平，平弟成，左中郎將，並早卒；成弟逢，逢弟隗，皆為公。魏書曰：自安以下，皆博愛容眾，無所揀擇；賓客入其門，無賢愚皆得所欲，為天下所歸。紹即逢之庶子，術異母兄也，出後成為子。英雄記曰：成字文開，壯健有部分，貴戚權豪自大將軍梁冀以下皆與結好，言無不從。故京師為作諺曰：「事不諧，問文開。」













[39] Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Shào was born and then his father [Yuán Chéng] died, the two Excellencies [Yuán Féng, Yuán Wěi] favored him. In youth he became a Cadet, when capped was sent out as Púyáng Chief,65 had pure reputation. Encountering his mother’s passing, he observed mourning to completion, and also posthumously enacted mourning for his father, altogther at the burial mound hut for six years.66 The ritual completed, he lived privately in Luòyáng, not rashly connecting with guests. Those that were not famed Within the Seas were not able to meet him. Also he enjoyed roaming as a vigilante, with Zhāng [Miǎo] Mèngzhuó, Hé [Yóng] Bóqiú, Wú Zǐqīng, Xǔ [Yōu] Zǐyuǎn, Wǔ [Qióng] Déyú and others all becoming friends that would run [to help each other].67 Did not answer recruitment mandates. Central Regular Attendant Zhào Zhōng spoke with the various Yellow Gates stating: “Yuán Běnchū sits and creates reputation, not answering calls of summons but yet raising Death Squad, one does not know what this boy wishes to do.” [Yuán] Shào’s father’s younger brother [Yuán] Wěi heard of this, and repeatedly reproached [Yuán] Shào stating: “You will ruin our family!” [Yuán] Shào thereupon then rose to answer the General-in-Chief’s recruitment.68
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wèi shū says [Yuán] Shào was [Yuán] Féng’s concubine-born son, sent out as posterity to his father’s elder brother [Yuán] Chéng. By what this record says, then it would appear that he truly was born from [Yuán] Chéng. A man posthumously mourning their birth parent, Ritual is without this writing, so all the more to be [adoptive] posterity and yet able to enact it. The two books are uncertain as to which is correct.69



〔二〕　英雄記曰：紹生而父死，二公愛之。幼使為郎，弱冠除濮陽長，有清名。遭母喪，服竟，又追行父服，凡在冢廬六年。禮畢，隱居洛陽，不妄通賓客，非海內知名，不得相見。又好游俠，與張孟卓、何伯求、吳子卿、許子遠、伍德瑜等皆為奔走之友。不應辟命。中常侍趙忠謂諸黃門曰：「袁本初坐作聲價，不應呼召而養死士，不知此兒欲何所為乎？」紹叔父隗聞之，責數紹曰：「汝且破我家！」紹於是乃起應大將軍之命。臣松之案：魏書云「紹，逢之庶子，出後伯父成」。如此記所言，則似實成所生。夫人追服所生，禮無其文，況於所後而可以行之！二書未詳孰是。







When Emperor Líng passed away, the Dowager Empress’s elder brother General-in-Chief Hé Jìn with [Yuán] Shào planned to execute the various castrate officials, [40] the Dowager Empress would not agree. Thus summoned Dǒng Zhuó, wishing to coerce the Dowager Empress. The Regular Attendants and Yellow Gates heard of this, all visited [Hé] Jìn to apologize, entirely to be at his disposal. At the time [Yuán] Shào urged [Hé] Jìn that they could then at this eliminate them, reaching to twice and thrice, but [Hé] Jìn did not permit it. Ordered [Yuán] Shào to send Luòyáng’s general strategy military clerks to investigate and manage the various eunuchs. Also ordered [Yuán] Shào’s younger brother Tiger Elite Central Cadet General [Yuán] Shù to select mild and generous Tiger Elites of two hundred men, to enter the Restricted Center, to replace the Yellow Gates that held weapons at the gates and ramps to guard the gates and doors. Central Regular Attendant Duàn Guī and others feigned a Dowager Empress mandate to summon [Hé] Jìn to enter to discuss, and therefore killed him, inside the Palace was in chaos. [41] [Yuán] Shù led the Tiger Elite to burn the South Palace’s Jiādé Hall’s Qīngsuǒ Gate, wishing to by this force out [Duàn] Guī and the rest. [Duàn] Guī and the rest did not go out, seized the Emperor and the Emperor’s younger brother the King of Chénliú to flee to Xiǎopíng Ford. [Yuán] Shào had beheaded the eunuch appointed Director of Retainers Colonel Xǔ Xiāng, and therefore reined in troops to capture the various castrates, without regard to young or old killed them all. Some without beards were mistakenly killed, to the point of some exposing their bodies to then obtain escape. Of the eunuchs some had good conduct and maintained themselves but yet met with this. The excessiveness was like this. The dead were over two thousand people. Urgently pursued [Duàn] Guī and the rest, [Duàn] Guī and the rest all threw themselves into the Hé and died. The Emperor was able to return to the Palace.



靈帝崩，太后兄大將軍何進與紹謀誅諸閹官，〔一〕太后不從。乃召董卓，欲以脅太后。常侍、黃門聞之，皆詣進謝，唯所錯置。時紹勸進便可於此決之，至于再三，而進不許。令紹使洛陽方略武吏檢司諸宦者。又令紹弟虎賁中郎將術選溫厚虎賁二百人，當入禁中，代持兵黃門陛守門戶。中常侍段珪等矯太后命，召進入議，遂殺之，宮中亂。〔二〕術將虎賁燒南宮嘉德殿青瑣門，欲以迫出珪等。珪等不出，劫帝及帝弟陳留王走小平津。紹既斬宦者所署司隸校尉許相，遂勒兵捕諸閹人，無少長皆殺之。或有無鬚而誤死者，至自發露形體而後得免。宦者或有行善自守而猶見及。其濫如此。死者二千餘人。急追珪等，珪等悉赴河死。帝得還宮。










[40] Xù Hàn shū states: [Yuán] Shào sent his retainer Zhāng Jīn to explain to [Hé] Jìn stating: “The Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants have held power for a long time, also the Yǒnglè Dowager Empress70 with the various Regular Attendants exclusively colluded in wealth and profit, General you should organize Heaven’s Under, and for Within the Seas remove the troubles.” [Hé] Jìn believed it correct, and therefore with [Yuán] Shào joined plans.



〔一〕　續漢書曰：紹使客張津說進曰：「黃門、常侍秉權日久，又永樂太后與諸常侍專通財利，將軍宜整頓天下，為海內除患。」進以為然，遂與紹結謀。













[41] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: Previously [Yuán] Shào explained to [Hé] Jìn stating: “The Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants for accumualted reigns have been excessively powerful, their authority subduing Within the Seas, formerly Dòu Wǔ wished to execute them but instead was murdered by them,71 merely because his seated speech leaked, and he had the Five Camps servicemen as troops.72 The Five Camps servicemen grew up in the capital region, submitted in fear to the central people,73 but the Dòu clan instead employed them as the front line, and therefore they indeed rebelled and fled over to the Yellow Gates, this was bringing on oneself defeat and extermination. Now you General have the honor of the Foremost Maternal Uncle,74 Two Offices both managing strong troops,75 the division retainers and officers and clerks, all are outstanding heroes and famed servicemen, happy to exhaustively devote strength to the death, the task is in your hand, Heaven’s is supporting in the timing. Now to for Heaven’s Under execute and eliminate the greedy and corrupt, the achievements will be prominent, bequeath reputation to later generations, even Zhōu’s Shēn Bó, how would he be worth discussing?76 Now the Greatly Departed is in the Front Hall,77 you General use Edict letter to manage the troops to guard and defend, and need not enter the Palace.” [Hé] Jìn accepted this advice, later instead became doubtful. [Yuán] Shào feared [Hé] Jìn would change [his mind], and coerced [Hé] Jìn stating: “Now the preparations are already complete, the situation already exposed, General how can you not quickly settle it? When matters are detained changes appear, when missing the opportunity disaster arrives.” [Hé] Jìn did not listen, and therefore was destroyed.



〔二〕　九州春秋曰：初紹說進曰：「黃門、常侍累世太盛，威服海內，前竇武欲誅之而反為所害，但坐言語漏泄，以五營士為兵故耳。五營士生長京師，服畏中人，而竇氏反用其鋒，遂果叛走歸黃門，是以自取破滅。今將軍以元舅之尊，二府並領勁兵，其部曲將吏，皆英雄名士，樂盡死力，事在掌握，天贊其時也。今為天下誅除貪穢，功勳顯著，垂名後世，雖周之申伯，何足道哉？今大行在前殿，將軍以詔書領兵衛守，可勿入宮。」進納其言，後更狐疑。紹懼進之改變，脅進曰：「今交搆已成，形勢已露，將軍何為不早決之？事留變生，後機禍至。」進不從，遂敗。







Dǒng Zhuó called [Yuán] Shào, discussed a wish to depose the Emperor and establish the King of Chénliú. At the time Yuán Shào’s father’s younger brother [Yuán] Wěi was Grand Tutor, [Yuán] Shào falsely agreed to it, stating: “This is a great affair, I will go out and with the Grand Tutor discuss.” [Dǒng] Zhuó said: “The Liú clan’s lineage is not worth restoring.” [Yuán] Shào did not answer, with horizontal saber deep salute and then left.78 [42] [Yuán] Shào had gone out, and therefore deserted and fled to Jì Province. Attendant Central Zhōu Bì, City Gate Colonel Wǔ Qióng, Consultant Cadet Hé Yóng and others all were famed servicemen, [Dǒng] Zhuó trusted them, but they secretly supported [Yuán] Shào, thus they persuaded [Dǒng] Zhuó stating: “Deposing and establishing are great affairs, not what ordinary men can reach. [Yuán] Shào does not understand the overall picture, was frightened and therefore went out and fled, not having ulterior ambitions. Now to urgently offer bounty for him, the situation certainly will change [badly]. The Yuán clan has cultivated kindness for four generations, their family lineage and former clerks are everywhere Under Heaven, if he collects towering figures to gather masses and multitudes, outstanding heroes will take advantage of this and rise, then the east of the mountains will not be Your Excellency’s possession. It is not as good as pardoning him, appointing him a prefecture administrator, then [Yuán] Shào will be pleased to escape punishment, and certainly there will be no worries.” [Dǒng] Zhuó believed it correct, and so appointed [Yuán] Shào as Bóhǎi Administrator, enfeoffed Marquess of Kàng village.79



董卓呼紹，議欲廢帝，立陳留王。是時紹叔父隗為太傅，紹偽許之，曰：「此大事，出當與太傅議。」卓曰：「劉氏種不足復遺。」紹不應，橫刀長揖而去。〔一〕紹既出，遂亡奔冀州。侍中周毖、城門校尉伍瓊、議郎何顒等，皆名士也，卓信之，而陰為紹，乃說卓曰：「夫廢立大事，非常人所及。紹不達大體，恐懼故出奔，非有他志也。今購之急，勢必為變。袁氏樹恩四世，門世故吏遍於天下，若收豪傑以聚徒眾，英雄因之而起，則山東非公之有也。不如赦之，拜一郡守，則紹喜于免罪，必無患矣。」卓以為然，乃拜紹勃海太守，封邟鄉侯。










[42] Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó wished to depose the Emperor, said to [Yuán] Shào stating: “The Imperial Emperor is immature and ignorant, not a Ruler of Ten Thousand Chariots. The King of Chénliú is yet superior, now I wish to establish him. That a person may have youthful intelligence but when grown may be stupid, I also know; what can be done? It should for the time being be so. Did you not see Emperor Líng? Remembering that makes a man indignant and bitter.” [Yuán] Shào said: “The Hàn House has ruled Heaven’s Under for four hundred and some years, grace and favor deep and rich, the numerous people have revered it for a long time. Now though the Emperor is young and immature, he has not had evils announced and heard Under Heaven, Your Excellency wishes to depose the legitimate to establish the concubine-born,80 I fear the masses will not follow Your Excellency’s suggestion.” [Dǒng] Zhuó said to [Yuán] Shào stating: “Impudent boy! How are Heaven’s Under’s affairs not decided by me? I now will do it, who dares not follow? Do you say that Dǒng Zhuó’s saber is not sharp?” [Yuán] Shào said: “The strong Under Heaven, how are they only Your Excellency Dǒng?” He drew his girdle saber horizontal and saluted and then left.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: [Yuán] Shào at this time with [Dǒng] Zhuó did not yet reach to hostility, therefore [Dǒng] Zhuó with him consulted on plans. If only for speaking disagreement in discussion, to at once curse him as an ‘impudent boy’ and have a heart to use blade, and then [Yuán] Shào’s reply answer was all the more stubbornly defiant,81 also how could [Dǒng] Zhuó tolerate and not apply harm? Moreover regarding [Yuán] Shào in this speech, advancing it was not clear and upright, withdrawing it violated tact and humility, but instead made obvious his intention to compete vigorously, to charge the spearpoint of a roaring beast, for one with ambition for achievement and enterprise, logically how could it be so? This story, the absurdity is extreme.



〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：卓欲廢帝，謂紹曰：「皇帝沖闇，非萬乘之主。陳留王猶勝，今欲立之。人有少智，大或癡，亦知復何如，為當且爾；卿不見靈帝乎？念此令人憤毒！」紹曰；「漢家君天下四百許年，恩澤深渥，兆民戴之來久。今帝雖幼沖，未有不善宣聞天下，公欲廢適立庶，恐眾不從公議也。」卓謂紹曰：「豎子！天下事豈不決我？我今為之，誰敢不從？爾謂董卓刀為不利乎！」紹曰：「天下健者，豈唯董公？」引佩刀橫揖而出。臣松之以為紹於時與卓未搆嫌隙，故卓與之諮謀。若但以言議不同，便罵為豎子，而有推刃之心，及紹復答，屈疆為甚，卓又安能容忍而不加害乎？且如紹此言，進非亮正，退違詭遜，而顯其競爽之旨，以觸哮闞之鋒，有志功業者，理豈然哉！此語，妄之甚矣。







[Yuán] Shào therefore in Bóhǎi raised troops, intending to execute [Dǒng] Zhuó. The story is in the Wǔ Annals. [Yuán] Shào declared himself Chariots and Cavalry General, leading the alliance, with Jì Province Governor Hán Fù establishing Yōu Province Governor Liú Yú as Emperor, sent envoy to present petition to visit [Liú] Yú, [Liú] Yú did not dare accept. Later [Hán] Fù’s army at Ānpíng was by Gōngsūn Zàn defeated. [Gōngsūn] Zàn therefore led troops to enter Jì Province, with suppressing [Dǒng] Zhuó as pretext, inside wishing to surprise attack [Hán] Fù. [Hán] Fù was filled with unease. [43] It happened that [Dǒng] Zhuó to the west entered the passes, [Yuán] Shào returned his army to Yánjīn, took advantage of [Hán] Fù being frightened and anxious, sent Chénliú’s Gāo Gàn, Yǐngchuān’s Xún Chén and others to persuade [Hán] Fù stating: “Gōngsūn Zàn rides on victory to come heading south, while various prefectures are complying with him. Yuán Chēqí82 leads an army heading east, this is his intentions cannot be known, I humbly believe you General to be endangered by it.” [Hán] Fù said: “What is to be done about it?” [Xún] Chén said: “Gōngsūn leads the soldiers of Yān and Dài, his advance cannot be faced. Yuán-shì83 is a hero of the time, and certainly will not be your subordinate, General. Jì Province is the heavy resource of Heaven’s Under, if the two stalwarts join forces, troops meeting below the city walls, danger and destruction can immediately be waited for. Yuán-shì is your old friend, General, and moreover of the alliance. Right now in the plans for you General, none compare to leading Jì Province to yield to Yuán-shì. When Yuán-shì obtains Jì Province, then [Gōngsūn] Zàn will be unable to contest it, and he will certainly generously favor you, General. Jì Province going to a close friend, is you General having the reputation of yielding to worthiness, and you body will be as secure as Tài Mountain. May you General not doubt!” [Hán] Fù by nature was fearful and timid, and therefore agreed with this plan. [Hán] Fù’s Chief Clerk Gěng Wǔ, Separate Carriage Mǐn Chún, Manager Central Lǐ Lì84 remonstrated [Hán] Fù stating: “Although Jì Province is rustic, those wearing armor are a million, the grain lasts ten years. Yuán Shào is an isolated guest with exhausted armor, relying on us for breath, like an infant atop the palm of the hand, cut off its milk, and immediately it can be starved ot death. Why then wish to have the province given to him?” [Hán] Fù said: “I am the Yuán clan’s former clerk, moreover my talent does not compare to Běnchū. Measuring virtue and so yielding, is what the ancients valued, why do you sirs alone complain?” Following Officials Zhào Fú, Chéng Huàn requested to with troops resist them, [Hán] Fù also did not listen. Thus yielded to [Yuán] Shào, [44] [Yuán] Shào therefore was designated Jì Province Governor.



紹遂以勃海起兵，將以誅卓。語在武紀。紹自號車騎將軍，主盟，與冀州牧韓馥立幽州牧劉虞為帝，遣使奉章詣虞，虞不敢受。後馥軍安平，為公孫瓚所敗。瓚遂引兵入冀州，以討卓為名，內欲襲馥。馥懷不自安。〔一〕會卓西入關，紹還軍延津，因馥惶遽，使陳留高幹、潁川荀諶等說馥曰：「公孫瓚乘勝來向南，而諸郡應之，袁車騎引軍東向，此其意不可知，竊為將軍危之。」馥曰：「為之奈何？」諶曰：「公孫提燕、代之卒，其鋒不可當。袁氏一時之傑，必不為將軍下。夫冀州，天下之重資也，若兩雄并力，兵交於城下，危亡可立而待也。夫袁氏，將軍之舊，且同盟也，當今為將軍計，莫若舉冀州以讓袁氏。袁氏得冀州，則瓚不能與之爭，必厚德將軍。冀州入於親交，是將軍有讓賢之名，而身安於泰山也。願將軍勿疑！」馥素恇怯，因然其計。馥長史耿武、別駕閔純、治中李歷諫馥曰：「冀州雖鄙，帶甲百萬，穀支十年。袁紹孤客窮軍，仰我鼻息，譬如嬰兒在股掌之上，絕其哺乳，立可餓殺。奈何乃欲以州與之？」馥曰：「吾，袁氏故吏，且才不如本初，度德而讓，古人所貴，諸君獨何病焉！」從事趙浮、程奐請以兵拒之，馥又不聽。乃讓紹，〔二〕紹遂領冀州牧。










[43] Yīngxióng jì states: Páng Jì persuaded [Yuán] Shào stating: “General you have raised a great affair but yet rely on another for supplies, to not occupy a province, is to have no way to preserve oneself.” [Yuán] Shào answered saying: “Jì Province’s troops are strong, my servicemen are hungry and tired, supposing if it cannot be done, there will be nowhere left to stand.” [Páng] Jì said: “You can with Gōngsūn Zàn exchange news, guiding him to come south, to strike and take Jì Province. Gōngsūn [Zàn] certainlly will arrive and then [Hàn] Fù will be afraid, take advantage to send an explanation of the benefits and harms, for him lay out the disasters and fortunes, [Hán] Fù certainly will abdicate and yield. At that interval, you can occupy his position.” [Yuán] Shào followed this advice and [Gōngsūn] Zàn indeed came.



〔一〕　英雄記曰：逢紀說紹曰：「將軍舉大事而仰人資給，不據一州，無以自全。」紹答云：「冀州兵彊，吾士飢乏，設不能辦，無所容立。」紀曰：「可與公孫瓚相聞，導使來南，擊取冀州。公孫必至而馥懼矣，因使說利害，為陳禍福，馥必遜讓。於此之際，可據其位。」紹從其言而瓚果來。













[44] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Hán] Fù sent Overall Supervisor Following Officials Zhào Fú and Chéng Huàn with strong crossbows of ten thousand to garrison Héyáng. [Zhào] Fú and the rest heard that [Hán] Fù wished to have Jì Province given to [Yuán] Shào, from Mèngjīn galloped east downstream. At the time [Yuán] Shào was still at Zhāogē’s Qīng river’s mouth, [Zhào] Fú and the rest from the rear came, the boats several hundred ships, multitudes over ten thousand men, organized troops drumming and in the night passing [Yuán] Shào’s camp, [Yuán] Shào extremely hated it. [Zhào] Fú and the rest arrived, spoke to [Hán] Fù stating: “Yuán Běnchū’s army is without a dǒu of provisions, each are already scattering. Although he has Zhāng Yáng and Yūfúluó newly attached, they will not yet agree to be employed, and are not sufficient to be opposition. We your minor Following Officials request to personally with our present troops resist them. Within ten days, they will certainly collapse apart. Enlightened General you only should open doors and highly rest. What is to worry about, what is to fear?” [Hán] Fù did not listen, and so left his position, going out to reside in Zhào Zhōng’s former residence. Sent his son to present Jì Province’s Seal and Ribbon at Líyáng to give to [Yuán] Shào.



〔二〕　九州春秋曰：馥遣都督從事趙浮、程奐將彊弩萬張屯河陽。浮等聞馥欲以冀州與紹，自孟津馳東下。時紹尚在朝歌清水口，浮等從後來，船數百艘，眾萬餘人，整兵鼓夜過紹營，紹甚惡之。浮等到，謂馥曰：「袁本初軍無斗糧，各己離散，雖有張楊、於扶羅新附，未肯為用，不足敵也。小從事等請自以見兵拒之，旬日之間，必土崩瓦解；明將軍但當開閤高枕，何憂何懼！」馥不從，乃避位，出居趙忠故舍。遣子齎冀州印綬於黎陽與紹。







Following Official Jū Shòu [45] persuaded [Yuán] Shào stating: “General when you were capped you ascended to Court, then spread fame Within the Seas. On happening on an interval of deposing and establishing, then your loyalty and righteousness roused to action. Alone on horseback going out to flee, then Dǒng Zhuó was filled with terror. Crossing the Hé and going north, then Bóhǎi bowed head. Rousing the soldiers of one prefecture, gathering the multitudes of Jì Province, your power shakes the Hé’s north, your name heavy Under Heaven. Although the Huángjīn are crafty and chaotic, the Hēishān trampling and insolent, on raising an army and heading east, then Qīng Province can be settled; returning to suppress the Hēishān, then Zhāng Yān can be exterminated; turning the multitudes to head north, then Gōngsūn will certainly be destroyed; shaking and coercing the Róng and Dí, then the Xiōngnú will certainly follow. Crossing the Great Hé’s north, uniting the lands of Four Provinces, collecting the talents of outstanding heroes, gahtering multitudes of a million, welcoming the Great Chariot from the western capital, restoruing the Ancestral Temple at Luò city, declaring orders Under Heaven, to suppress the not yet submitted, in this way contending advance, who is able to withstand it? Within a few years, this achievement will not be difficult.” [Yuán] Shào was pleased and said: “This is my heart.” At once memorialized [Jū] Shòu as Overseer of the Army, Exerting Authority General.
