[46] [Dǒng] Zhuó sent Metal Mace Bearer Húmǔ Bǎn, General Architect Wú Xiū to present Edict letter to explain to [Yuán] Shào, [Yuán] Shào sent Hénèi Administrator Wáng Kuāng to kill them. [47] [Dǒng] Zhuó heard that [Yuán] Shào had obtained the east of the passes, and so entirely executed [Yuán] Shào’s clansmen Grand Tutor [Yuán] Wěi and the rest. At that time, of the powerful vigilantes many attached to [Yuán] Shào all thinking to avenge him, the provinces and prefectures swarmed and rose, none not borrowing his name [as justification]. [Hán] Fù was full of fear, from [Yuán] Shào requested to leave, and went to depend on Zhāng Miǎo. [48] Later [Yuán] Shào sent an envoy to visit [Zhāng] Miǎo, having a discussion on plans, with [Zhāng] Miǎo whispering in ears. [Hán] Fù was seated above, believed he was being met with plotting and framing, very soon rose and went to the privy and killed himself. [49]



從事沮授〔一〕說紹曰：「將軍弱冠登朝，則播名海內；值廢立之際，則忠義奮發；單騎出奔，則董卓懷怖；濟河而北，則勃海稽首。振一郡之卒，撮冀州之眾，威震河朔，名重天下。雖黃巾猾亂，黑山跋扈，舉軍東向，則青州可定；還討黑山，則張燕可滅；回眾北首，則公孫必喪；震脅戎狄，則匈奴必從。橫大河之北，合四州之地，收英雄之才，擁百萬之眾，迎大駕於西京，復宗廟於洛邑，號令天下，以討未復，以此爭鋒，誰能敵之？比及數年，此功不難。」紹喜曰：「此吾心也。」即表授為監軍、奮威將軍。〔二〕卓遣執金吾胡母班、將作大匠吳脩齎詔書喻紹，紹使河內太守王匡殺之。〔三〕卓聞紹得關東、乃悉誅紹宗族太傅隗等。當是時，豪俠多附紹，皆思為之報，州郡蜂起，莫不假其名。馥懷懼，從紹索去，往依張邈。〔四〕後紹遣使詣邈，有所計議，與邈耳語。馥在坐上，謂見圖構，無何起至溷自殺。〔五〕










[45] Jǔ pronounced Jū.



〔一〕沮音葅。













[46] Xiàn-dì jì states: Jū Shòu was a Guǎngpíng man, in youth had great ambition, many expedient strategies. Served in the province as a Separate Carriage, nominated Abundant Talent, successively Magistrate in two counties, also became Hán Fù’s Separate Carriage, memorialized and appointed a Cavalry Commandant. Yuán Shào obtained Jì Province, also recruited him.
Yīngxióng jì states: At the time the Year Name was Chūpíng, [Yuán] Shào’s appellation was Běnchū, he himself believed that the Year with his appellation corresponded, and he certainly would be able to subdue and pacify the disaster and chaos.85



〔二〕　獻帝紀曰：沮授，廣平人，少有大志，多權略。仕州別駕，舉茂才，歷二縣令，又為韓馥別駕，表拜騎都尉。袁紹得冀州，又辟焉。英雄記曰：是時年號初平，紹字本初，自以為年與字合，必能克平禍亂。













[47] Hàn Mò Míngshì lù states: [Húmǔ] Bān appellation Jìpí was a Tàishān man, in youth with Shānyáng’s Dù Shàng, Dōngpíng’s Zhāng Miǎo and others of eight men all disparaged wealth and attended to righteousness, rousing and relieving people and servicemen, the era called them the Eight Kitchens.86
Xiè Chéng’s Hòu Hàn shū states: [Húmǔ] Bān was Wáng Kuāng’s younger sister’s husband, Dǒng Zhuó sent [Húmǔ] Bān carrying Edict to arrive at Hénèi to explain to and dismiss the Righteous Troops. [Wáng] Kuāng accepted Yuán Shào’s directions, arrested [Húmǔ] Bān and bound him in prison, wishing to kill him to show to the army. [Húmǔ] Bān’s letter to [Wáng] Kuāng said: “Since antiquity onward, there has never been subordinate land vassal lords raising troops to head toward the capital region. Liú Xiàng’s Zhuàn states: ‘In throwing a rat, fear for the vessel.’87 Even for a vessel yet fear for it, all the more when [Dǒng] Zhuó now is situated inside the Palace towers, with Heaven’s Son as his screen, the Young Ruler is in the Palace, how can he be suppressed? I with Grand Tutor His Excellency Mǎ, Minister Charioteer Zhào Qí, Minister Treasurer Yīn Xiū all accepted Edict mandate. The various prefectures east of the passes, although they truly loathe [Dǒng] Zhuó, yet they accept and serve the Ruling Mandate, not daring to disgrace it. But you sir alone confine me in prison, wishing to have my blood smear the drums,88 this is the most extreme of perverse cruelty without morality. I and Dǒng Zhuó have what kinship, in righteousness how am I alike in evil? Yet you sir spread the mouth of tigers and wolves, spit the venom of long serpents, your rage at [Dǒng] Zhuó transferred onto another, what extreme ruthlessness! Death is what any person finds difficult, however it is a humiliation to be murdered by a mandman. If the deceased have awareness, I will complain of you sir to the August Heavens. That marriage is the pivot of disaster or fortune, today it is proven. Formerly we were of one body, now we are blood enemies. [I, this] dead man’s sons of two men, then are your sister’s sons, after my body is destroyed, be careful to not let them see my skeleton.” [Wáng] Kuāng obtained the letter, hugged [Húmǔ] Bān’s two sons and sobbed. [Húmǔ] Bān therefore died in prison.
[Húmǔ] Bān once saw Tàishān Fǔjūn and Hébó,89 the matter is in Sōushén jì, the words many and not recorded here.



〔三〕　漢末名士錄曰：班字季皮，太山人，少與山陽度尚、東平張邈等八人並輕財赴義，振濟人士，世謂之八廚。謝承後漢書曰：班，王匡之妹夫，董卓使班奉詔到河內，解釋義兵。匡受袁紹旨。收班繫獄，欲殺之以徇軍。班與匡書云：「自古以來，未有下土諸侯舉兵向京師者。劉向傳曰『擲鼠忌器』，器猶忌之，況卓今處宮闕之內，以天子為藩屏，幼主在宮，如何可討？僕與太傅馬公、太僕趙岐、少府陰脩俱受詔命。關東諸郡，雖實嫉卓，猶以銜奉王命，不敢玷辱。而足下獨囚僕于獄，欲以釁鼓，此悖暴無道之甚者也。僕與董卓有何親戚，義豈同惡？而足下張虎狼之口，吐長蛇之毒，恚卓遷怒，何甚酷哉！死，人之所難，然恥為狂夫所害。若亡者有靈，當訴足下於皇天。夫婚姻者禍福之機，今日著矣。曩為一體，今為血讎。亡人子二人，則君之甥，身沒之後，慎勿令臨僕尸骸也。」匡得書，抱班二子而泣。班遂死於獄。班嘗見太山府君及河伯，事在搜神記，語多不載。













[48] Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Shào appointed Hénèi’s Zhū Hàn as Overall Office Following Official. [Zhū] Hàn in previous times was disrespected by [Hán] Fù, inside held resentment, and moreover wished to cater to [Yuán] Shào’s intentions, without authority mobilized the city wall troops to besiege [Hán] Fù’s mansion, drawing blade and ascending into the rooms. [Hán] Fù fled upstairs. Captured [Hán] Fù’s eldest son, hammered and broke both his legs. [Yuán] Shào at once arrested [Zhū] Hàn, killed him. [Hán] Fù yet was anxious and afraid, and therefore reported to [Yuán] Shào to request to leave.



〔四〕　英雄記曰：紹以河內朱漢為都官從事。漢先時為馥所不禮，內懷怨恨，且欲邀迎紹意，擅發城郭兵圍守馥第，拔刃登屋。馥走上樓，收得馥大兒，槌折兩腳。紹亦立收漢，殺之。馥猶憂怖，故報紹索去。













[49] Yīngxióng jì states: Gōngsūn Zàn struck the Qīng Province Huángjīn rebels, greatly defeated them, returned to garrison Guǎngzōng,90 replacing the administrators and magistrates, of Jì Province’s Chief Clerks none did not watch the winds and comply in answer, opening the gates to receive him. [Yuán] Shào personally went to campaign against [Gōngsūn] Zàn, meeting in battle at Jiè Bridge’s south by twenty lǐ. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s infantry of over thirty thousand emn formed a square formation, cavalry as two wings, left and right each over five thousand, the White Force Righteous Followers forming the center core, also divided to form two regiments, left shooting right, right shooting left, the banners and armor shined Heaven and Earth. [Yuán] Shào ordered Qū Yì with eight hundrd troops as the first to ascend, strong crossbows of a thousand sets flanking and continuing after them, [Yuán] Shào personally with infantry of several tens of thousands joined in formation to the rear. [Qū] Yì for a long time had been at Liáng Province, aware of and trained in Qiāng warfare, his troops all valiant and keen. [Gōngsūn] Zàn saw their troops were few, immediately unleashed the cavalry wishing to overrun and trample them. [Qū] Yì’s troops all lay below shields and did not move, until they reached within several tens of bù, then at the same time all rose, scattering dust and greatly shouting, directly forward charging, the strong crossbows thundered and fired, all that was hit was certain to topple, right on the battle lines cut off [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s appointed Jì Province Inspector Yán Gāng’s armored head, obtained over a thousand heads. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s army was defeated utterly, infantry and cavalry fled and ran, no longer returning to camp. [Qū] Yì pursued eaching Jiè Bridge, [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s rearguard troops returned to battle atop the bridge, [Qū] Yì further defeated them, therefore arrived at [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s camp, pulled out his Ivory Gates,91 the remaining multitudes inside the camp all further scattered and fled. [Yuán] Shào was at the rear, had not yet arrived at the bridge by ten and several lǐ, dismounted horse and released saddle, saw [Gōngsūn] Zàn was already defeated, did not set preparations, below his tent only strong crossbows of several tens of sets and large halberd servicemen of over a hundred men accompanied his person. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s division’s fleeing cavalry of over two thousand suddenly arrived, immediately encircled [Yuán] Shào in several layers, bow shot arrows like rain falling. Separate Carriage Following Official Tián Fēng supported [Yuán] Shào wishing to retreat into an empty wall, [Yuán] Shào threw his helmet to the ground stating: “A great man should forward fight to the death, but to instead enter within a wall, how could one live?” The strong crossbows then chaotically fired, many were by them killed and wounded. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s cavalry did not know it was [Yuán] Shào, and also somewhat drew back. It happened Qū Yì came to welcome, and so they scattered and left. Every time [Gōngsūn] Zàn with caitiffs battled, he always rode a white horse, in pursuit never shot in vain, repeatedly winning military victories, the caitiffs informed one another saying: “You should avoid the white horse.” Taking advantage of what the caitiffs feared, he selected out his white horses of several thousand, chose out servicemen of mounted archery, called as the White Horse Righteous Followers. Another account states: the strong of the Hú and Yí always rode white horses, [Gōngsūn] Zàn had strong cavalry of several thousand, many rode white horses, therefore they were called by that. [Yuán] Shào had defeated [Gōngsūn] Zàn, led his army south arriving at Bóluò Ford, right when he with his guest retainers and various offers together gathered, he heard Wèi prefecture’s troops had rebelled, with the Hēishān bandit Yú Dú together overturned Yè city, therefore killing Administrator Lì Chéng. The bandits were over ten divisions, multitudes several tens of thousands of people, gathered inside Yè. The seated various guests that had families in Yè all were anxious and afraid and lost color, some rising to cry and sob. [Yuán] Shào’s expression did not change, at ease. The bandit Táo Shēng was a former Nèihuáng minor clerk, had a good heart, alone commanded a division multitude to go over the west city wall to enter, shut and defended the provincial gates, not letting in other bandits, with carts conveyed [Yuán] Shào’s family and various robed and capped within the provincial seat, personally defending and guarding, escorting to arrive at Chìqiū92 and then returning. [Yuán] Shào arrived, therefore garrisoned Chìqiū, appointed Táo Shēng as Establishing Righteousness Central Cadet General. Then led the army to enter Zhāogē’s Lùcháng mountain’s Cāngyán valley to suppress Yú Dú, besieged and attacked for five days, defeated them, beheaded [Yú] Dú with Cháng’ān’s appointed Jì Province Governor Hú Shòu. Therefore along the mountains northward travelled, approached and strike the various bandits Zuǒ Zīzhàngbā and others, beheaded them all. Also struck Liú Shí, Qīng Niújiǎo, Huánglóng, Zuǒ Xiào, Guō Dàxián, Lǐ Dàmù, Yú Dīgēn and others,93 slaughtering all their garrison camps, those that fled obtained escape, the beheaded were several tens of thousands of heads. [Yuán] Shào again returned to garrison Yè. Chūpíng Fourth Year [193], Heaven’s Son sent Grand Tutor Mǎ Mìdī and Minister Charioteer Zhào Qí to make peace with the east of the passes. [Zhào] Qí separately visited the Hé’s north, [Yuán] Shào went out to welcome at over a hundred lǐ, bowing to receive the Emperor’s command. [Zhào] Qí stayed in [Yuán] Shào’s camp, dispatch letter to inform [Gōngsūn] Zàn. [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent envoy to provide a letter to [Yuán] Shào that stated: “Minister Charioteer Zhào by the virtue of Zhōu and Shào carried mandate to come on campaign, to announce and spread the Court’s grace, demonstrate peace and harmony, vast as parting the clouds to see the sun, what joy compares to this? In the past Jiǎ Fù and Kòu Xún also quarreled over soldiers and wished to endanger and harm one another, encountered the magnamity of Guāng-Wǔ, personally met both at the Throne, in the same carriage together went out, at the time people believed it glorious.94 Examining myself on the borders, to be able to with you General together share this fortune, this truly is affection for you General, and good fortune for [me, Gōngsūn] Zàn.” Qū Yì later relied on his achievements and so was arrogant and presumptuous, [Yuán] Shào thus killed him.



〔五〕　英雄記曰：公孫瓚擊青州黃巾賊，大破之，還屯廣宗，改易守令，冀州長吏無不望風響應，開門受之。紹自往征瓚，合戰于界橋南二十里。瓚步兵三萬餘人為方陳，騎為兩翼，左右各五千餘匹，白馬義從為中堅，亦分作兩校，左射右，右射左，旌旗鎧甲，光照天地。紹令麴義以八百兵為先登，彊弩千張夾承之，紹自以步兵數萬結陳于後。義久在涼州，曉習羌鬥，兵皆驍銳。瓚見其兵少，便放騎欲陵蹈之。義兵皆伏楯下不動，未至數十步，乃同時俱起，揚塵大叫，直前衝突，彊弩雷發，所中必倒，臨陳斬瓚所署冀州刺史嚴綱甲首，獲千餘級。瓚軍敗績，步騎奔走，不復還營。義追至界橋；瓚殿兵還戰橋上，義復破之，遂到瓚營，拔其牙門，營中餘眾皆復散走。紹在後，未到橋十數里，下馬發鞍，見瓚已破，不為設備，惟帳下彊弩數十張，大戟士百餘人自隨。瓚部迸騎二千餘匹卒至，便圍紹數重，弓矢雨下。別駕從事田豐扶紹欲卻入空垣，紹以兜鍪撲地曰：「大丈夫當前鬥死，而入牆閒，豈可得活乎？」彊弩乃亂發，多所殺傷。瓚騎不知是紹，亦稍引卻；會麴義來迎，乃散去。瓚每與虜戰，常乘白馬，追不虛發，數獲戎捷，虜相告云「當避白馬」。因虜所忌，簡其白馬數千匹，選騎射之士，號為白馬義從；一曰胡夷健者常乘白馬，瓚有健騎數千，多乘白馬，故以號焉，紹既破瓚，引軍南到薄落津，方與賓客諸將共會，聞魏郡兵反，與黑山賊于毒共覆鄴城，遂殺太守栗成。賊十餘部，眾數萬人，聚會鄴中。坐上諸客有家在鄴者，皆憂怖失色，或起啼泣，紹容貌不變，自若也。賊陶升者，故內黃小吏也，有善心，獨將部眾踰西城入，閉守州門，不內他賊，以車載紹家及諸衣冠在州內者，身自扞衛，送到斥丘乃還。紹到，遂屯斥丘，以陶升為建義中郎將。乃引軍入朝歌鹿場山蒼巖谷討于毒，圍攻五日，破之，斬毒及長安所署冀州牧壺壽。遂尋山北行，薄擊諸賊（左髮丈八）〔左髭丈八〕等，皆斬之。又擊劉石、青牛角、黃龍、左校、郭大賢、李大目、于氐根等，皆屠其屯壁，奔走得脫，斬首數萬級。紹復還屯鄴。初平四年，天子使太傅馬日磾、太僕趙岐和解關東。岐別詣河北，紹出迎於百里上，拜奉帝命。岐住紹營，移書告瓚。瓚遣使具與紹書曰：「趙太僕以周召之德，銜命來征，宣揚朝恩，示以和睦，曠若開雲見日，何喜如之？昔賈復、寇恂亦爭士卒，欲相危害，遇光武之寬，親俱陛見，同輿共出，時人以為榮。自省邊鄙，得與將軍共同此福，此誠將軍之眷，而瓚之幸也。」麴義後恃功而驕恣，紹乃殺之。







Previously, Heaven’s Son’s establishment was not [Yuán] Shào’s intention,95 and when at Hédōng, [Yuán] Shào sent Yǐngchuān’s Guō Tú as envoy. [Guō] Tú returned and advised [Yuán] Shào to welcome Heaven’s Son to set capital at Yè, [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. [50] It happened that Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] welcomed Heaven’s Son to set capital at Xǔ, collected the lands south of the Hé, Guānzhōng all attached. [Yuán] Shào was regretful, and wished to order Tàizǔ to relocate Heaven’s Son’s capital to Juànchéng to be closer to himself, Tàizǔ refused him. Heaven’s Son had [Yuán] Shào become Grand Commandant, transferred to General-in-Chief, enfeoffed Marquess of Yè, [51] [Yuán] Shào declined the Marquessate and did not accept. Shortly after this, struck and defeated [Gōngsūn] Zàn at Yìjīng, absorbed his multitudes. [52] Sent out his eldest son [Yuán] Tán as Qīng Province, Jū Shòu remonstrated [Yuán] Shào: “Certainly this will be the beginning of disaster.” [Yuán] Shào did not listen, stating: “I96 wish to have my various sons each occupy one province.” [53] Also had his middle son [Yuán] Xī as Yōu Province, sister’s son Gāo Gàn as Bìng Province. His multitudes were several hundred thousand, with Shěn Pèi, Páng Jì presiding military affairs, Tián Fēng, Xún Chén, Xǔ Yōu as strategy masters, Yán Liáng, Wén Chǒu as commanding leaders, selected elite soldiers of a hundred thousand, cavalry of ten thousand, about to attack Xǔ. [54]



初，天子之立非紹意，及在河東，紹遣潁川郭圖使焉。圖還說紹迎天子都鄴，紹不從。〔一〕會太祖迎天子都許，收河南地，關中皆附。紹悔，欲令太祖徙天子都鄄城以自密近，太祖拒之。天子以紹為太尉，轉為大將軍，封鄴侯，〔二〕紹讓侯不受。頃之。擊破瓚于易京，井其眾。〔三〕出長子譚為青州，沮授諫紹：「必為禍始。」紹不聽，曰：「孤欲令諸兒各據一州也。」〔四〕又以中子熙為幽州，甥高幹為并州。眾數十萬，以審配、逢紀統軍事，田豐、荀諶、許攸為謀主，顏良、文醜為將率，簡精卒十萬，騎萬匹，將攻許。〔五〕










[50] Xiàn-dì zhuàn states: Jū Shòu advised [Yuán] Shào saying: “General [your family] for accumulated generations assisted and aided [the Emperor], for generations perpetuating loyalty and righteousness. Now the Court is scattered and wandering, the Ancestral Temple destroyed and ruined, observing the various provinces and prefectures, outside they claim righteous troops, inside they plot to exterminate one another, none preserving the Ruler and relieving the people. Moreover now the provincial city is roughly settled, it is appropriate to welcome the Great Chariot, secure the Palace in Yè capital, grasp Heaven’s Son and so command the vassal lords, raise servicemen and horses to suppress those not submitted, who would be able to withstand it?” [Yuán] Shào was pleased and about to follow this. Guō Tú and Chúnyú Qióng said: “The Hàn House has declined for a long time, now to wish to restore it, is it not very difficult? Moreover now outstanding heroes occupy and possess provinces and prefectures, multitudes mobilized in the count of tens of thousands, what is called ‘Qín lost its deer, the first to capture it is King.’ If you welcome Heaven’s Son to be near yourself, actions then must be memorialized and heard, following him then is authority lightened, opposing him then is to defy commands, it is not a good plan.” [Jū] Shòu said: “Now to welcome the Court is utmost righteousness, also the grand strategy appropriate for the times, if it is not early planned, certainly there will be someone who pre-empts us. Power is in not losing opportunity, achievement is in fast speed, General may you consider this!” [Yuán Shào was not able to employ this.
Note: This book claims it was Jū Shòu’s plan, then it is with the base biography in opposition.



〔一〕　獻帝傳曰：沮授說紹云：「將軍累葉輔弼，世濟忠義。今朝廷播越，宗廟毀壞，觀諸州郡外託義兵，內圖相滅，未有存主恤民者。且今州城粗定，宜迎大駕，安宮鄴都，挾天子而令諸侯，畜士馬以討不庭，誰能禦之！」紹悅，將從之。郭圖、淳于瓊曰：「漢室陵遲，為日久矣，今欲興之，不亦難乎！且今英雄據有州郡，眾動萬計，所謂秦失其鹿，先得者王。若迎天子以自近，動輒表聞，從之則權輕，違之則拒命，非計之善者也。」授曰：「今迎朝廷，至義也，又於時宜大計也，若不早圖，必有先人者也。夫權不失機，功在速捷，將軍其圖之！」紹弗能用。案此書稱（郭圖）〔沮授〕之計，則與本傳違也。













[51] Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shào was ashamed to be ranked below Tàizǔ, and angrily said: “Cáo Cāo was about to die several times, I at once rescued and preserved him, now he then turns back on kindness, grasps haven’s Son to command me!” Tàizǔ heard, and so had the General-in-Chief [position] yielded to [Yuán] Shào.



〔二〕　獻帝春秋曰：紹恥班在太祖下，怒曰；「曹操當死數矣，我輒救存之，今乃背恩，挾天子以令我乎！」太祖聞，而以大將軍讓于紹。













[52] Diǎnlüè states: From this, [Yuán] Shào’s tribute became rare and slow, and he privately sent his Registrar Gěng Bāo to secretly report stating: “The Red Virtue has decayed completely, Yuán is the Yellow heir, and should obey Heaven’s intentions.” [Yuán] Shào had [Gěng] Bāo’s secretly reported affair shown to the Army Office commanders and clerks. The discussions all believed [Gěng] Bāo was deceptive and absurd and should be executed, [Yuán] Shào thus killed [Gěng] Bāo to disassociate himself.
Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shào extended summons for Běihǎi’s Zhèng Xuán but was not respectful, Zhào Róng heard this and said: “A worthy man is the hope of the noble men. To disrespect the worthy is to lose the hopes of the noble men. A lord of action does not dare to lose the pleased hearts of the myriad people, all the more the noble men. To lose the hopes of the noble men, is difficulty to have action.”
Yīngxióng jì records Tàizǔ’s Song of Dǒng Zhuó, the lyrics say: “Virtue and Conduct are not lacking, yet misfortunes are difficult to endure. Zhèng Kāngchéng was passing the liquor, fell to the ground and his breath severed, Guō Jǐngtú’s fate ended in the garden mulberries.” By this writing, then [Zhèng] Xuán without illness yet died, this is not seen in other books, therefore it is recorded here.



〔三〕　典略曰：自此紹貢御希慢，私使主薄耿苞密白曰：「赤德衰盡，袁為黃胤，宜順天意。」紹以苞密白事示軍府將吏。議者咸以苞為妖妄宜誅，紹乃殺苞以自解。九州春秋曰：紹延徵北海鄭玄而不禮，趙融聞之曰：「賢人者，君子之望也。不禮賢，是失君子之望也。夫有為之君，不敢失萬民之歡心，況於君子乎？失君子之望，難乎以有為矣。」英雄記載太祖作董卓歌，辭云：「德行不虧缺，變故自難常。鄭康成行酒，伏地氣絕，郭景圖命盡于園桑。」如此之文，則玄無病而卒。餘書不見，故載錄之。













[53] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū records Jū Shòu’s remonstration statement stating: “The world says when one rabbit flees through the intersection, ten thousand people chase it, when one person catches it, the greedy all stop, because the allocation is settled. Moreover, when age is equal use worthiness, when virtue is equal then use divination, is the system of antiquity. May you above ponder the admonishments of successes and failures of the former dynasties, below consider the meaning of chasing rabbits and allocation settlement.” [Yuán] Shào said: “I wish to have my four sons each occupy one province, to observe their abilities.” [Jū] Shòu went out and said: “Diaster will begin from this!” [Yuán] Tán first reached Qīng Province, became Overall Supervisor, not yet Inspector, later Tàizǔ appointed him Inspector.97 His territory from the Hé on west overall did not exceed Píngyuán and nothing more, therefore he to the north expelled Tián Kǎi, to the east attacked Kǒng Róng, shining troops to the sea shore, at the time the Hundred Surnames were without master, and happily supported him. However he trusted and employed the petty, enjoyed receiving gossip, unrestained in will and extravagant in debauchery, not understanding the hardships of sowing and reaping. Huà Yàn and Kŏng Shùn both were treacherous flatterers and petty men, he trusted them as belly and heart. Wáng Xiū and others filled offices and nothing more. However he was able to receive guest retainers, admire reputation and respect servicemen. He had his wife’s younger brother manage troops in the interior, to the extent it caused banditry in the markets and outside caitiffs plundered the fields and wilds. Separately sent two officers to recruit troops in subordinate counties, those that paid bribes met with exemption, those without met with capture, the poor and weak were many, so it reached to fleeing and hiding inside the hills and wilds, released troops to capture and search, like hunting birds and beasts. In towns that had ten thousand households, the registered did not reach several hundred. In collecting levies and taxes, out of three parts the income did not reach one. In recruiting and appointing worthy servicemen, they did not accept. Those that did not hasten to attend military service but resided peacefully with clan and associates, also could not be punished.



〔四〕　九州春秋載授諫辭曰：「世稱一兔走衢，萬人逐之，一人獲之，貪者悉止，分定故也。且年均以賢，德均則卜，古之制也。願上惟先代成敗之戒，下思逐兔分定之義。」紹曰：「孤欲令四兒各據一州，以觀其能。」授出曰：「禍其始此乎！」譚始至青州，為都督，未為刺史，後太祖拜為刺史。其土自河而西，蓋不過平原而已。遂北排田楷，東攻孔融，曜兵海隅，是時百姓無主，欣戴之矣。然信用群小，好受近言，肆志奢淫，不知稼穡之艱難。華彥、孔順皆姦佞小人也，信以為腹心；王脩等備官而已。然能接待賓客，慕名敬士。使婦弟領兵在內，至令草竊，巿井而外，虜掠田野；別使兩將募兵下縣，有賂者見免，無者見取，貧弱者多，乃至於竄伏丘野之中，放兵捕索，如獵鳥獸。邑有萬戶者，著籍不盈數百，收賦納稅，參分不入一。招命賢士，不就；不趨赴軍期，安居族黨，亦不能罪也。













[54] Shìyǔ states: [Yuán] Shào’s infantry was fifty thousand, cavalry eight thousand.
Sūn Shèng’s Appraisal states: Note that Wèi Wǔ [Cáo Cāo] spoke to Cuī Yǎn stating: “Yesterday consulting your esteemed province’s household registries, I can obtain three hundred thousand in multitudes.” By this considering it, if just Jì Province had numerous troops already like this, all the more when combined with Yōu, Bìng, and Qīng provinces! [Yuán] Shào in his great mobilization certainly with all his brigades rose up, a hundred thousand is closer to it.
Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to southward send brigades, Jū Shòu and Tián Fēng remonstrated stating: “The brigades have been sent out for successive years, the Hundred Surnames weary and distressed, the granaries without reserves, the taxes and conscription currently abundant, this is the state’s deep distress. It is appropriate to first send envoy proffer report of the triumphs to Heaven’s Son, attend to agriculture and rest the people. If [the envoy] cannot be connected, then memorialize that Cáo-shì is cutting off our ruler’s road, and then afterward advance to garrison Líyáng, gradually fortify the Hé’s south, increasingly build boats and ships, mend and repair equipment and weapons, divide and send elite cavalry, plunder their borders, to cause them to be unable to be at ease, while we obtain rest. Within three years, the matter can be settled while sitting.” Shěn Pèi and Guō Tú said: “In the methods of military books, if ten [times the enemy in size] besiege, if five attack, if matched then able to battle. Now with Your Enlightened Excellency’s divine warfare, striding the Hé’s north’s strong multitudes to cut down Cáo-shì, is [as easy] as turning a hand. Now to not timely take him, is to later have trouble in planning.” [Jū] Shòu said: “Overall rescuing from chaos and executing the cruel is called as Righteous Troops, relying on numbers and depending on strength is called as Arrogant Troops. Troops that are righteous are without match, the arrogant are the first exterminated. Cáo-shì welcomed Heaven’s Son and secured Palace at Xǔ capital, now to raise troops to head south, in righteousness then is violation. Moreover strategies of a Temple Victory is not in strength or weakness.98 Cáo-shì’s laws and orders are enacted, his soldiers elite and trained, not the situation of Gōngsūn Zàn sitting and waiting to be surrounded. Now to abandon the techniques of total security, and instead raise troops without justification, I humbly on behalf of Your Excellency fear this!” [Guō] Tú and others said: “King Wǔ attacking Zhòu was not called not righteous, all the more when troops are used against Cáo-shì and yet said to be without justification! Moreover Your Excellency’s brigades and martial ministers are strong, the officers and servicemen indignant and wrathful, the people think to exert themselves, but yet to not follow the timing and early settle the great enterprise, is a failure in thinking. If what Heaven gives is not taken, it is instead to receive its blame, this is how Yuè became the hegemon and how Wú was destroyed. The plan of the Overseer of the Army [Jū] Shòu is a plan to hold firm, but yet not to see the timing and understand the transformations of opportunity.” [Yuán] Shào followed this. [Guō] Tú and the rest took advantage of this to slander [Jū] Shòu: “The Overseer presides interior and exterior, authority shakes the Three Armies, if he gradually flourishes further, how will you control him? For the servant and master to not be the same is prosperity, the master and servant to be the same is destruction, this is what Huángshí dreaded.99 Moreover the one managing the multitudes in the exterior, is not appropriate to know the interior.” [Yuán] Shào became suspicious, and so divided the Overseer of the Army office into Three Overall Supervisors, having [Jū] Shòu with Guō Tú and Chúnyú Qióng each managing one army, therefore gathered and went south.



〔五〕　世語曰：紹步卒五萬，騎八千。孫盛評曰：案魏武謂崔琰曰「昨案貴州戶籍，可得三十萬眾」。由此推之，但冀州勝兵已如此，況兼幽、并及青州乎？紹之大舉，必悉師而起，十萬近之矣。獻帝傳曰：紹將南師，沮授、田豐諫曰：「師出歷年，百姓疲弊，倉庾無積，賦役方殷，此國之深憂也。宜先遣使獻捷天子，務農逸民；若不得通，乃表曹氏隔我王路，然後進屯黎陽，漸營河南，益作舟船，繕治器械，分遣精騎，鈔其邊鄙，令彼不得安，我取其逸。三年之中，事可坐定也。」審配、郭圖曰：「兵書之法，十圍五攻，敵則能戰。今以明公之神武，跨河朔之彊眾，以伐曹氏。譬若覆手，今不時取，後難圖也。」授曰：「蓋救亂誅暴，謂之義兵；恃眾憑彊，謂之驕兵。兵義無敵，驕者先滅。曹氏迎天子安宮許都，今舉兵南向，於義則違。且廟勝之策，不在彊弱。曹氏法令既行，士卒精練，非公孫瓚坐受圍者也。今棄萬安之術，而興無名之兵，竊為公懼之！」圖等曰：「武王伐紂，不曰不義，況兵加曹氏而云無名！且公師武臣（竭）力，將士憤怒，人思自騁，而不及時早定大業，慮之失也。夫天與弗取，反受其咎，此越之所以霸，吳之所以亡也。監軍之計，計在持牢，而非見時知機之變也。」紹從之。圖等因是譖授「監統內外，威震三軍，若其浸盛，何以制之？夫臣與主不同者昌，主與臣同者亡，此黃石之所忌也。且御眾于外，不宜知內。」紹疑焉。乃分監軍為三都督，使授及郭圖、淳于瓊各典一軍，遂合而南。







Before this, Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] sent Liú Bèi to visit Xú Province to resist Yuán Shù. [Yuán] Shù died, [Liú] Bèi killed Inspector Chē Zhòu and led his army to garrison Pèi. [Yuán] Shào sent cavalry to assist him. Tàizǔ sent Liú Dài and Wáng Zhōng to strike him, not successful. Jiàn’ān Fifth Year [200], Tàizǔ personally campaigned east against [Liú] Bèi. Tián Fēng advised [Yuán] Shào to attack Tàizǔ’s rear, [Yuán] Shào refused due to his child’s illness and did not permit it. [Tián] Fēng raised his cane and struck the ground stating: “To encounter a difficult to find opportunity, but yet for an infant’s illness lose the chance, a pity!” Tàizǔ arrived, struck and defeated [Liú] Bèi, [Liú] Bèi fled to [Yuán] Shào. [55]



先是，太祖遣劉備詣徐州拒袁術。術死，備殺刺史車冑，引軍屯沛。紹遣騎佐之。太祖遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克。建安五年，太祖自東征備。田豐說紹襲太祖後，紹辭以子疾，不許，豐舉杖擊地曰：「夫遭難遇之機，而以嬰兒之病失其會，惜哉！」太祖至，擊破備；備奔紹。〔一〕










[55] Wèi-shì Chūnqiū records [Yuán] Shào’s Dispatch to the Provinces and Prefectures Writing stating: “Overall it is heard that the Enlightened Ruler plans for danger to control for changes, the Loyal Minister considers difficulties to establish expedience. Formerly strong Qín had a weak Ruler, Zhào Gāo seized the handles [of power], concentrating control over Court commands, authority and fortune coming from himself, in the end there was the disaster of Wàngyí, the filth and disgrace reaching the present.100 Reaching to arrive at Empress Lǚ, [Lǚ] Lù and [Lǚ] Chǎn controlled the government, usurped authority to decide the myriad affairs,101 determining affairs in the Restricted Ministries,102 the below rising to replace the above,103 Within the Seas was cold in heart. Thereupon the Marquess of Jiàng and Zhūxū raised authority and exerted fury, executed and exterminated the rebellious and chaotic, honored and established Tàizōng,104 therefore able to make moral cultivation rise and expand, radiance and brilliance clear and harmonizing, this then is a clear example of chief ministers establishing expedience. The Excellency of Works Cáo Cāo’s grandfather [Cáo] Téng was a former Central Regular Attendant, with Zuǒ Guàn, Xú Huáng together created evils, gluttony and greed unleased unrestrained, injuring cultivation and oppressing the people. His father [Cáo] Sōng was a beggar taken in for adoption, took advantage of illicit wealth to buy position, carts of gold and carriages of jade, to donate money to powerful gates, to steal rank in the Three Excellencies105, overturning the Heaviest Vessels. [Cáo] Cāo is a castrate’s lingering disgrace, originally without good virtue, a frivolous cunning reckless vigilante, enjoys chaos and delights in disaster. Our Tent Office106 in the past commanded falcons rising,107” to sweep away and exterminated vicious rebels. Continuing to encounter Dǒng Zhuó invading the government and terrorizing the state, thereupon I raised sword and beat the drums, issuing commands on the eastern Xià, then collecting and gathering outstanding heroes, ignoring blemishes to employ, and therefore then with [Cáo] Cāo consulted on strategies, believing him a talent of hawks and hounds, claws and teeth that could be appointed.108 It led then to his foolish and frivolous short-sighted plans, recklessly advancing and easily retreating, wounded and razed and broken and bleeding, repeatedly losing brigades and followers. Our Tent Office then again divided troops to command the keen, to repair and reinforce him, memorialized him as Acting Dōng Prefecture Administrator, Yǎn Province Inspector, covering him in tiger stripes, conferring him with auxiliary brigades, encouraging and pressing authority and control, hoping to obtain the repayment of the Qín brigade’s single success.109 But [Cáo] Cāo then took advantage of the resources to be insolent, recklessly enacting cruel fierceness, cutting apart the common people, ruining the worthy and harming the good. Former Jiǔjiāng Administrator Biān Ràng was an outstanding talent eminent and transcendant, Heaven’s Under knew his name, for his blunt speech and stern expression, in discussion not fawning or flattering, his body and head suffered the massacre of cutting off and hanging, his wife and offspring received the calamity of ash and extermination. From this the forest of servicemen were indignant and pained, the people’s grievances increasingly heavy, one man exerted arm, the entire province was alike in sound, and therefore his person was defeated in Xú region, his land seized away by Lǚ Bù, wavering about the eastern frontiers, nowhere to walk or stand. Our Tent Office pondered the meaning of strong trunks and weak branches, and moreover would not support a faction of rebels, and therefore again raised banners and wore armor, rolling up to go on campaign, metal drums sounded and shook, [Lǚ] Bù’s multitudes were broken and destroyed, rescuing him [Cáo Cāo] from the misfortune of death and destruction, restoring his appointment as a regional governor, this then was Our Tent Office being without virtue to the people of Yǎn’s lands, but having great benefit to [Cáo] Cāo. Later it happened the Belled Chariot returned east, crowds of caitiffs disordered the government. At the time Jì Province just had alarms on the northern border, without the leisure to leave its station, therefore I sent Following Official Central Cadet Xú Xūn to meet and send [Cáo] Cāo to have him mend and repair the Suburbs and Temple, support and defend the Young Ruler. But yet he then unleashed his ambitions to arbitrarily act, coercing the relocation of the Restricted Ministries, humiliating and insulting the Ruler’s Officials, destroying law and disordering discipline, seated summoned the Three Terraces, usurping control over Court and government, noble ranks and rewards from his heart, punishment and executions by his mouth, those he favored were glorified to the Five Clans, those he hated were exterminated to Three Clans, the crowds that spoke out suffered prominent execution, those that discussed privately suffered secret killings, on the roads [people communicated only] by eyes, the hundred bureaus clamped their mouths, the Secretariat Writers recorded Court meetings, the Excellencies and Ministers filled personnel quotas and nothing more. Former Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo successively managed the Three Departments, reached the state’s utmost positions,110 [Cáo] Cāo because of an angry look, subjected him to wrongful punishment, beatings and canings both at once, the five tortures all arrived, indulging his passions and unleashing his malice, without regard to statute charters. Also Consultant Cadet Zhào Yàn loyally remonstrated with blunt speech, his suggestions had those that could be accepted, therefore the Sagely Court attentively listened, changed expression and applied bestowments, [Cáo] Cāo wished to seize away the authority of that time, block and sever the roads of speech, without authority arrested and immediately killed, not waiting to report and seek approval. Also King Xiào of Liáng was a Former Emperor’s younger brother of the same mother,111 his grave tomb honored and prominent, pines and cypress and mulberry and catalpa, and yet should have been respectfully maintained, but yet [Cáo] Cāo led commanders and officers and clerks and servicemen to personally oversee an excavation, breaking the coffin and stripping the corpse, plundering and taking the gold and treasures, so that it caused the Sagely Court to shed tears, servicemen and people wounded and grieved. Also he installed an Excavating Mounds Central Cadet General and Retrieving Gold Colonel, wherever they passed they desecrated, no skeletons not exposed. His body occupies the office of the Three Excellencies, but his conduct is the attitude of cruel caitiffs, destroying the state and oppressing the people, his toxicity flowing to people and ghosts. Additionally his trifling government is oppressive and cruel, rules and prohibitions set everywhere, silk snares fill the paths, pitfall traps block the roads, raise a hand and get caught in a net, move a foot and step on a mechanical trap, and therefore Yǎn and Yù [Provinces] have people with nothing they can do, the Emperor’s capital has hushed sighs in resentment. Reading through the books and registers from antiquity to the present, of the recorded ministers of ruinous greed and intense cruelty and immorality, [Cáo] Cāo is the most extreme. Our Tent Office was busy investigating outer treacheries, not able to organize and train, gave attention to tolerance and covering, hoping it could be completely mended, but yet [Cáo] Cāo has a ravenous wolf’s wild heart, secretly harbors disastrous plans, and so wishes to disturb and break the supporting pillars, isolate and weaken the Hàn House, eliminate and exterminate the correct and upright, usurp power as a ruthless warlord.112 In former years I beat the drums on northern campaign to suppress Gōngsūn Zàn, a strongly defended cruel rebel who resisted a siege for one year. [Cáo] Cāo took advantage that he was not yet defeated, secretly exchanged letters and commands, wishing to claim to assist with the Ruling Brigades, to coordinate a surprise attack, and therefore led troops to the Hé, preparing boats to cross north. It happened that his messenger was exposed, [Gōngsūn] Zàn also was beheaded and exterminated, therefore causing his spear point to be blocked and withdrawn, his plots could not bear fruit. He garrisons and occupies Áo Granary, obstructs the Hé as defense, and so wishes to with the claw of a mantis block a massive chariot’s path. Our Tent Office serves Hàn’s authoritative spirit, breaks and charges through the cosmos, long halberds of a million, Hú cavalry of a thousand crowds, exerting the capabilities of Zhōnghuáng, [Xià] Yù, [Wū] Huò,113 unleashing the power of fine bows and strong crossbows, Bìng Province crosses the Tàiháng [mountains], Qīng Province wades the Jǐ and Tà [rivers], the main army sails the Yellow Hé to horn his front, Jīng Province goes down Yuān and Shè to drag his rear,114 thunder shaking and tiger pouncing, together gathering at the caitiff’s hall, like raising a flaming fire to burn through a flying tumbleweed, overturning the azure sea to flood a burning coal, how can it not be annihilated? Right now Hàn’s Way is declined, network slackened and cords severed. [Cáo] Cāo with elite troops of seven hundred encircles and guards the Palace watchtowers, outside claiming to assist the defense, inside to maintain detainment, fearing that the disaster of usurpation and rebellion will take advantage of this to be created, thus it is the autumn for loyal ministers to stain their livers and brains on the ground, the opportunity for ardent martyrs to establish achievement, can you not exhort yourselves!” This was Chén Lín’s writing.115



〔一〕　魏氏春秋載紹檄州郡文曰：「蓋聞明主圖危以制變，忠臣慮難以立權。曩者彊秦弱主，趙高執柄，專制朝命，威福由己，終有望夷之禍，汙辱至今。及臻呂后，祿、產專政，擅斷萬機，決事省禁，下陵上替，海內寒心。於是絳侯、朱虛興威奮怒，誅夷逆亂，尊立太宗，故能道化興隆，光明顯融，此則大臣立權之明表也。司空曹操，祖父騰，故中常侍，與左悺、徐璜並作妖孽，饕餮放橫，傷化虐民。父嵩，乞匄攜養，因贓假位，輿金輦璧，輸貨權門，竊盜鼎司，傾覆重器。操贅閹遺醜，本無令德，僄狡鋒俠，好亂樂禍。幕府昔統鷹揚，掃夷凶逆。續遇董卓侵官暴國，於是提劍揮鼓，發命東夏，方收羅英雄，棄瑕錄用，故遂與操參咨策略，謂其鷹犬之才，爪牙可任。至乃愚佻短慮，輕進易退，傷夷折衄，數喪師徒。幕府輒復分兵命銳，修完補輯，表行東郡太守、兗州刺史，被以虎文，授以偏師，獎蹙威柄，冀獲秦師一克之報。而操遂乘資跋扈，肆行酷烈，割剝元元，殘賢害善。故九江太守邊讓，英才俊逸，天下知名，以直言正色，論不阿諂，身〔首〕被梟縣之戮，妻孥受灰滅之咎。自是士林憤痛，民怨彌重，一夫奮臂，舉州同聲，故躬破於徐方，地奪於呂布，彷徨東裔，蹈據無所。幕府唯彊幹弱枝之義，且不登叛人之黨，故復援旌擐甲，席卷赴征，金鼓響震，布眾破沮，拯其死亡之患，復其方伯之任，是則幕府無德於兗土之民，而有大造於操也。後會鑾駕東反，群虜亂政。時冀州方有北鄙之警，匪遑離局，故使從事中郎徐勛就發遣操，使繕修郊廟，翼衛幼主。而便放志專行，脅遷省禁，卑侮王官，敗法亂紀，坐召三臺，專制朝政，爵賞由心，刑戮在口，所愛光五宗，所惡滅三族，群談者蒙顯誅，腹議者蒙隱戮，道路以目，百寮鉗口，尚書記朝會，公卿充員品而已。故太尉楊彪，歷典三司，享國極位，操因睚眥，被以非罪，榜楚并兼，五毒俱至，觸情放慝，不顧憲章。又議郎趙彥，忠諫直言，議有可納，故聖朝含聽，改容加錫，操欲迷奪時權，杜絕言路，擅收立殺，不俟報聞。又梁孝王，先帝母弟，墳陵尊顯，松柏桑梓，猶宜恭肅，而操率將校吏士親臨發掘，破棺裸尸，略取金寶，至令聖朝流涕，士民傷懷。又署發丘中郎將、摸金校尉，所過墮突，無骸不露。身處三公之官，而行桀虜之態，殄國虐民，毒流人鬼。加其細政苛慘，科防互設，繒繳充蹊，坑阱塞路，舉手挂網羅，動足蹈機陷，是以兗、豫有無聊之民，帝都有吁嗟之怨。歷觀古今書籍，所載貪殘虐烈無道之臣，於操為甚。幕府方詰外姦，未及整訓，加意含覆，冀可彌縫。而操豺狼野心，潛苞禍謀，乃欲撓折棟梁，孤弱漢室，除滅中正，專為梟雄。往歲伐鼓北征，討公孫瓚，彊禦桀逆，拒圍一年。操因其未破，陰交書命，欲託助王師，以相掩襲，故引兵造河，方舟北濟。會其行人發露，瓚亦梟夷，故使鋒芒挫縮，厥圖不果。屯據敖倉，阻河為固，乃欲以螳螂之斧，禦隆車之隧。幕府奉漢威靈，折衝宇宙，長戟百萬，胡騎千群，奮中黃、育、獲之材，騁良弓勁弩之勢，并州越太行，青州涉濟、漯，大軍汎黃河以角其前，荊州下宛、葉而掎其後，雷震虎步，並集虜庭，若舉炎火以概飛蓬，覆滄海而沃熛炭，有何不消滅者哉？當今漢道陵遲，綱弛紀絕。操以精兵七百，圍守宮闕，外稱陪衛，內以拘執，懼其篡逆之禍，因斯而作。乃忠臣肝腦塗地之秋，烈士立功之會也，可不勖哉！」此陳琳之辭。







[Yuán] Shào advanced army to Líyáng, sent Yán Liáng to attack Liú Yán at Báimǎ. Jū Shòu again remonstrated [Yuán] Shào: “[Yán] Liáng by nature is impatient and narrow-minded, though he is valiant and brave he cannot be appointed alone.” [Yuán] Shào did not listen. Tàizǔ rescued [Liú] Yán, with [Yán] Liáng battled, defeated and beheaded [Yán] Liáng. [55] [Yuán] Shào crossed the Hé, fortified Yán Ford’s south, sent Liú Bèi and Wén Chǒu to challenge battle. Tàizǔ struck and defeated them, beheaded [Wń] Chǒu. In two battles took [Yuán] Shào’s chief officers, [Yuán] Shào’s army was greatly shaken. [56] Tàizǔ returned to Guāndù. Jū Shòu again said: “The northern troops more are numerous but their determination and spirit does not reach the south’s, the south’s grain is lacking and scarce and money and wealth does not reach the north’s, the south’s advantage is in quick battle, the north’s advantage is in protracted combat. It is appropriate to slowly maintain for a long time, draw out by days and moons.” [Yuán] Shào did not follow this, linked camps to gradually advance, pressured Guāndù, engaged in battle, Tàizǔ’s army was not successful, returned to the ramparts. [Yuán] Shào made high towers, raised earthen mountains, shot into the camps, inside the camps all covered with shields, the multitudes greatly afraid. Tàizǔ thus made shooting stone carts, struck [Yuán] Shào’s towers, all were broken, [Yuán] Shào’s multitudes called them Thunderbolt Carts. [57] [Yuán] Shào made earthen tunnels, wishing to surprise attack Tàizǔ’s camp. Tàizǔ at once in the interior made a long moat to resist this. Also sent surprise troops to raid and strike [Yuán] Shào’s transport carts, greatly defeated them, completely burned his grain. Tàizǔ with [Yuán] Shào were locked together for a long time, the Hundred Surnames exhausted, and many rebelled in support of [Yuán] Shào, the army’s provisions were exhuasted. It happened that [Yuán] Shào sent Chúnyú Qióng and others to command troops of over ten thousand men to welcome transport carts, Jū Shòu advised [Yuán] Shào: “You can send officer Jiǎng Qí separately as a branch army on the exterior, to cut off Cáo-gōng’s raids.” [Yuán] Shào again did not follow this. [Chúnyú] Qióng lodged at Wūcháo, from [Yuán] Shào’s army by forty lǐ. Tàizǔ then left Cáo Hóng to defend, personally commanded infantry and cavalry of five thousand in the cover of night to secretly go attack [Chúnyú] Qióng. [Yuán] Shào sent cavalry to rescue him, they were defeated and fled. Defeatd [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest, beheaded them all. Tàizǔ returned, had not yet reached his camp, [Yuán] Shào’s officers Gāo Lǎn and Zhāng Hé and others led their multitudes to surrender. [Yuán] Shào’s multitudes greatly collapsed, [Yuán] Shào with [Yuán] Tán on single horseback retreatd to cross the Hé. The remaining multitudes falsely surrendered, completely massacred them.116 [58] Jū Shòu did not reach [Yuán] Shào to cross, was by someone captured, sent to Tàizǔ. [59] Tàizǔ generously treated him. Later he plotted to return to the Yuán clan, was put to death.



紹進軍黎陽，遣顏良攻劉延于白馬。沮授又諫紹：「良性促狹，雖驍勇不可獨任。」紹不聽。太祖救延，與良戰，破斬良。〔一〕紹渡河，壁延津南，使劉備、文醜挑戰。太祖擊破之，斬醜，再戰，禽紹大將。紹軍大震。〔二〕太祖還官渡。沮授又曰：「北兵數眾而果勁不及南，南穀虛少而貨財不及北；南利在於急戰，北利在於緩搏。宜徐持久，曠以日月。」紹不從。連營稍前，逼官渡，合戰，太祖軍不利，復壁。紹為高櫓，起土山，射營中，營中皆蒙楯，眾大懼。太祖乃為發石車，擊紹樓，皆破，紹眾號曰霹靂車。〔三〕紹為地道，欲襲太祖營。太祖輒於內為長塹以拒之，又遣奇兵襲擊紹運車，大破之，盡焚其穀。太祖與紹相持日久，百姓疲乏，多叛應紹，軍食乏。會紹遣淳于瓊等將兵萬餘人北迎運車，沮授說紹：「可遣將蔣奇別為支軍於表，以斷曹公之鈔。」紹復不從。瓊宿烏巢，去紹軍四十里。太祖乃留曹洪守，自將步騎五千候夜潛往攻瓊。紹遣騎救之，敗走。破瓊等，悉斬之。太祖還，未至營，紹將高覽、張郃等率其眾降。紹眾大潰，紹與譚單騎退渡河。餘眾偽降，盡坑之。〔四〕沮授不及紹渡，為人所執，詣太祖，〔五〕太祖厚待之。後謀還袁氏，見殺。










[56] Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to set out, Jū Shòu met with his clansmen, scattered his wealth to give to them stating: “When momentum is present then one’s power has nowhere it cannot be applied, when momentum is lost then one cannot protect one’s own body, a sorrow!” His younger brother [Jū] Zōng said: “Cáo-gōng’s servicemen and horses are no match, why are you afraid?” [Jū] Shòu said: “With Cáo Yǎnzhōu’s enlightened strategy,117 and also holding Heaven’s Son as his resource, although we overcame Gōngsūn [Zàn], the multitudes in fact are weary and worn, but the officers arrogant and the ruler complacent, the defeat of the army will be in this action. Yáng Xióng had a saying: ‘Six States of ignorant worms, for the Yíng weakend the Jī.’118 This speaks of the present.”



〔一〕　獻帝傳曰：紹臨發，沮授會其宗族，散資財以與之曰：「夫勢在則威無不加，勢亡則不保一身，哀哉！」其弟宗曰：「曹公士馬不敵，君何懼焉！」授曰：「以曹兗州之明略，又挾天子以為資，我雖克公孫，眾實疲弊，而將驕主泰，軍之破敗，在此舉也。揚雄有言，『六國蚩蚩，為嬴弱姬』，今之謂也。」













[57] Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to cross the Hé, Jū Shòu remonstrated stating: “The transformations of victory or defeat cannot be not scrutinized. Now it is appropriate to remain to garrison Yán Ford, divide troops to Guāndù. If they overcome and capture, returning to welcome will not be too late, but supposing if there are difficulties, the multitudes would not be able to return.” [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. [Jū] Shòu oversaw the crossing and sighed stating: “The above overflows in ambition, the below attend to their achievements. Vast vast Yellow Hé, will I not return?” Therefore he claimed illness to resign. [Yuán] Shào resented this, and so reduced his division’s troops to be subordinated to Guō Tú.



〔二〕　獻帝傳曰：紹將濟河，沮授諫曰：「勝負變化，不可不詳。今宜留屯延津，分兵官渡，若其克獲，還迎不晚，設其有難，眾弗可還。」紹弗從。授臨濟歎曰：「上盈其志，下務其功，悠悠黃河，吾其不反乎！」遂以疾辭。紹恨之，乃省其所部兵屬郭圖。













[58] Wèishì Chūnqiū states: As antiquity had projectile stones, also there was a saying: “The Kuài moves and drums.” Shuōwén states: “Kuài is a shot stone.” Thereupon built Shooting Stone Carts.



〔三〕　魏氏春秋曰：以古有矢石，又傳言「旝動而鼓」，說〔文〕曰「旝，發石也」，於是造發石車。













[59] Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì says: Killed [Yuán] Shào’s soldiers altogether eighty thousand people.



〔四〕　張璠漢紀云：殺紹卒凡八萬人。







[60] Xiànd-ì Zhuàn says: [Jū] Shòu greatly shouted stating: “[I, Jū] Shòu do not surrender, I was only by the army captured!” Tàizǔ and he had an old relationship, faced and spoke to [Jū] Shòu stating: “Our Field Allocations were different,119 and therefore we were estranged, unexpectedly today then I captured you.” [Jū] Shòu replied stating: “Jìzhōu120 failed in strategy, and by this resulted in fleeing north. [I, Jū] Shòu in intelligence and strength was both lacking, it is merely appropraite to meet with capture.” Tàizǔ said: “Běnchū was without strategy, did not employ your plans, now the decline and chaos has passed a decade, the country is not yet settled, we should work together to plan for it.” [Jū] Shòu said: “The lives of my father’s younger brother, mother, younger brother hang on the Yuán clan. If I amy be favored with Your Excellency’s spirit, a swift death would be good fortune.” Tàizǔ sighed and said: “If I had earlier obtained you, Heaven’s Under would not be worth worrying about.”



〔五〕　獻帝傳云：授大呼曰：「授不降也，為軍所執耳！」太祖與之有舊，逆謂授曰：「分野殊異，遂用圮絕，不圖今日乃相禽也！」授對曰：「冀州失策，以取奔北。授智力俱困，宜其見禽耳。」太祖曰：「本初無謀，不用君計，今喪亂過紀，國家未定，當相與圖之。」授曰：「叔父、母、弟，縣命袁氏，若蒙公靈，速死為福。」太祖歎曰：「孤早相得，天下不足慮。」










Previously, when [Yuán] Shào went south, Tián Fēng advised [Yuán] Shào stating: “Cáo-gōng excels in using troops, his adaptability without limit. Although his multitudes are few, he cannot be taken lightly. It is not as good as holding against him for a long time. General you occupy the firmness of mountains and rivers, embrace multitudes from four provinces, outside bond with outstanding heroes, inside attend to agriculture and war, and then afterward select out the most elite and keen, divide out surprise troops, take advantage of openings to repeatedly set out, by this disturb the Hé’s south, when he rescues the right then strike his left, when he rescues the left then strike his right, to cause the enemy to be worn from fleeing about, their people to be unable to securely work, we will be without toil and they will already be exhausted, and not reaching to two years, you can overcome him while sitting. Now to discard the strategies of Temple Victory, and instead decide success or failure in a single battle, if it is not as you wish, regret would be too late.” [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. [Tián] Fēng earnestly remonstrated, [Yuán] Shào’s anger intensified, believed it discouraging the multitudes, shackled and bound him. When [Yuán] Shào’s army was defeated, someone spoke to [Tián] Fēng stating: “You will certainly meet with value.” [Tián] Fēng said: “If the army had been successful, I would certainly survive. Now that the army is defeatd, it is my death.” [Yuán] Shào returned, spoke to his Left and Right stating: “I did not use Tián Fēng’s advice, and indeed was laughed at by him.” Therefore killed him. [61] [Yuán] Shào outside was lenient and elegant, having composure, sorrow and joy not appearing in his expression, but inside had many resentments and harms, all of this sort.



初，紹之南也，田豐說紹曰：「曹公善用兵，變化無方，眾雖少，未可輕也，不如以久持之。將軍據山河之固，擁四州之眾，外結英雄，內脩農戰，然後簡其精銳，分為奇兵，乘虛迭出，以擾河南，救右則擊其左，救左則擊其右，使敵疲於奔命，民不得安業；我未勞而彼已困，不及二年，可坐克也。今釋廟勝之策，而決成敗於一戰，若不如志，悔無及也。」紹不從。豐懇諫，紹怒甚，以為沮眾，械繫之。紹軍既敗，或謂豐曰：「君必見重。」豐曰：「若軍有利，吾必全，今軍敗，吾其死矣。」紹還，謂左右曰：「吾不用田豐言，果為所笑。」遂殺之。〔一〕紹外寬雅，有局度，憂喜不形于色，而內多忌害，皆此類也。













[61] Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Tián] Fēng appellation Yuánhào was a Jùlù man, some say Bóhǎi man. [Tián] Fēng was naturally endowned with extraordinary distinguishment, expedient strategies with many marvels, in youth lost his parents, observed mourning with thorough grief, although the days and moons passed, smiles never reached his lips. He extensively read with much knowledge, his reputation valued in the province and locality. First he was recruited to the Grand Commandant’s Office, nominated Abundant Talent, promoted to Attendant Censor. The castrate eunuchs dominated the Court, outstanding worthies were harmed, [Tián] Fēng thus left office and returned home. When Yuán Shào rose up in righteousness, he used humble statements and generous gifts to recruit and attract [Tián] Fēng, [Tián] Fēng, because the Ruling House had many troubles, his ambition was to preserve and rescue it, and so he answered [Yuán] Shào’s summons, becoming Separate Carriage. He urged [Yuán] Shào to welcome Heaven’s Son, [Yuán] Shào did not accept [the proposal]. [Yuán] Shào later employed [Tián] Fēng’s plans to pacify Gōngsūn Zàn. Páng Jì feared [Tián] Fēng’s clear directness, repeatedly slandered him to [Yuán] Shào, [Yuán] Shào therefore dreaded [Tián] Fēng. At the defeat of [Yuán] Shào’s army, they collapsed apart and fled north, the brigades and followers almost wiped out, the army all beat their chests and sobbed stating: “If Tián Fēng had been here, it would not have reached to this.” [Yuán] Shào spoke to [Páng] Jì stating: “Jì Province’s men on hearing that my army is defeated, will all pity me, only Separate Carriage Tián formerly remonstrated to stop me, with the masses not the same, I also am ashamed to see him.” [Páng] Jì further said: “[Tián] Fēng on hearing of your retreat General, clapped his hands and greatly laughed, pleased that his advice was correct.” [Yuán] Shào thereupon had the intention to harm [Tián] Fēng. Previously, Tàizǔ heard that [Tián] Fēng was not accompanying the army, was pleased and said: “[Yuán] Shào will certainly be defeated.” Reaching to [Yuán] Shào fleeing and escaping, he further said: “If [Yuán] Shào had employed Separate Carriage Tián’s plans, things would yet be uncertain.”
Sūn Shèng states: Observing the plans of Tián Fēng and Jū Shòu, how would even [Zhāng] Liáng and [Chén] Píng surpass them?121 Therefore the lord values searching for talent, the minister esteemes measuring the master. When the lord employs the loyal and good, then the enterprise of hegemon kings expands. When the minister serves an ignorant ruler, then the disaster of downfall arrives. Survival or destruction, glory or disgrace, always are certain to come from this. [Tián] Fēng knew [Yuán] Shào was about to be defeated, and on defeat then he himself would certainly die, but willingly entered the tiger’s mouth to be exhaustive in loyal admonishment. The ardent martyrs in their services, their considerations are not to preserve themselves. For the ministers of vassal lords, their relationships allow leaving and going, all the more when [Tián] Fēng to [Yuán] Shào was not an absolute minister.122 The Shī says: ‘I will leave you, to go to that happy land,’ saying that leaving a chaotic country and going to where there is morality is permitted.



〔一〕先賢行狀曰：豐字元皓，鉅鹿人，或云勃海人。豐天姿瑰傑，權略多奇，少喪親，居喪盡哀，日月雖過，笑不至矧。博覽多識，名重州黨。初辟太尉府，舉茂才，遷待御史。閹宦擅朝，英賢被害，豐乃棄官歸家。袁紹起義，卑辭厚幣以招致豐，豐以王室多難，志存匡救，乃應紹命，以為別駕。勸紹迎天子，紹不納。紹後用豐謀，以平公孫瓚。逢紀憚豐亮直，數讒之於紹，紹遂忌豐。紹軍之敗也，土崩奔北，師徒略盡，軍皆拊膺而泣曰：「向令田豐在此，不至於是也。」紹謂逢紀曰：「冀州人聞吾軍敗，皆當念吾，惟田別駕前諫止吾，與眾不同，吾亦慚見之。」紀復曰：「豐聞將軍之退，拊手大笑，喜其言之中也。」紹於是有害豐之意。初，太祖聞豐不從戎，喜曰：「紹必敗矣。」及紹奔遁，復曰：「向使紹用田別駕計，尚未可知也。」孫盛曰：觀田豐、沮授之謀，雖良、平何以過之？故君貴審才，臣尚量主；君用忠良，則伯王之業隆，臣奉闇后，則覆亡之禍至：存亡榮辱，常必由茲。豐知紹將敗，敗則己必死，甘冒虎口以盡忠規，烈士之於所事，慮不存己。夫諸侯之臣，義有去就，況豐與紹非純臣乎！詩云「逝將去汝，適彼樂土」，言去亂邦，就有道可也。







Of Jì Province’s cities and towns many rebelled, [Yuán] Shào again struck and settled them. From since his army’s defeat afterward he fell ill, Seventh Year [202] in distress died.



冀州城邑多叛，紹復擊定之。自軍敗後發病，七年，憂死。



Sons Tán, Xī, Shàng


[Yuán] Shào’s favorite and youngest son [Yuán] Shàng was handsome and beautiful, wished to make him his successor but had not made it explicit. [62] Shěn Pèi, Páng Jì, with Xīn Píng, Guō Tú fought for power, [Shěn] Pèi, [Páng] Jì sided with [Yuán] Shàng, [Xīn] Píng, [Guō] Tú sighed with [Yuán] Tán. The multitudes because [Yuán] Tán was the eldest wished to establish him. [Shěn] Pèi and the rest feared if [Yuán] Tán was established then [Xīn] Píng and the rest would harm them, relied on [Yuán] Shào’s previous intentions, and so served supported [Yuán] Shàng to succeeded [Yuán] Shào’s positions. [Yuán] Tán arrived, could not be established, declared himself Chariots and Cavalry General. From this [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng had discord. Tàizǔ campaigned north against [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Tán’s army stationed Líyáng. [Yuán] Shàng gave a few troops to [Yuán] Tán, but sent [Páng] Jì to follow [Yuán] Tán. [Yuán] Tán requested additional troops, [Shěn] Pèi and the rest discussed and did not give them. [Yuán] Tán was angry, killed [Páng] Jì. [63] Tàizǔ crossed the Hé and attacked [Yuán] Tán, [Yuán] Tán reported the emergency to [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Shàng wished to divide troops to reinforce [Yuán] Tán, feared that [Yuán] Tán would then seize away his multitudes, and so had Shěn Pèi defend Yè, [Yuán] Shàng personally commanded troops to assist [Yuán] Tán, with Tàizǔ resisting one another at Líyáng. From the Ninth Moon [202 Oct 4 - Nov 2] reaching to the Second Moon [203 Mar 1 - Mar 30] greatly battled below the city walls, [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng were defeated and retreated, entered the city walls to defend. Tàizǔ was about to encircle them, then in the night they escaped. Pursued reaching Yè, collected their wheat, captured Yīn’ān, led the army to return to Xǔ. Tàizǔ campaigned south against Jīng Province, the army reached Xīpíng. [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng therefore raised troops to attack one another, [Yuán] Tán was defeated and fled to Píngyuán. [Yuán] Shàng attacked him urgently, [Yuán] Tán sent Xīn Pí to visit Tàizǔ to request rescue. Tàizǔ thus returned to rescue [Yuán] Tán, Tenth Moon [203 Nov 22 - Dec 20] reached Líyáng. [64] [Yuán] Shàng heard that Tàizǔ had gone north, released Píngyuán and returned to Yè. His officers Lǚ Kuàng and Lǚ Xiáng rebelled against [Yuán] Shàng to submit to Tàizǔ, [Yuán] Tán further secretly carved General’s seals to lend to Kuàng and Xiáng. Tàizǔ knew [Yuán] Tán was being deceitful, formed a marriage alliance to calm him, and then led the army to return. [Yuán] Shàng had Shěn Pèi and Sū Yóu defend Yè and again attacked [Yuán] Tán at Píngyuán. Tàizǔ advanced the arm and was about to attack Yè, arrived at the Huán river, from Yè by fifty lǐ, [Sū] Yóu wished to be inside support, the plan leaked, he with [Shěn] Pèi battled inside the city, was defeated, went out and fled to Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ therefore advanced and attacked them, making earthen tunnels, [Shěn] Pèi also in the inside made moats to block them. [Shěn] Pèi’s officer Féng Lǐ opened a sortie gate123 to let in Tàizǔ’s troops of over three hundred people, [Shěn] Pèi discovered it, from the city wall’s top used large stones to strike the sortie interior screen gate, the screen gate closed, those that entered were all lost. Tàizǔ therefore encircled them, made a moat, circumference forty lǐ, at first ordering it shallow, to appear as if it could be crossed. [Shěn] Pèi saw from afar and laughed at it, and did not go out to contest the advantage. Tàizǔ in one night dug it, width and depth two zhàng, breached the Zhāng river to irrigate it. From the Fifth Moon [204 Jun 16 - Jul 14] reaching to the Eighth Moon [204 Sep 12 - Oct 11], inside the city the starved to death were over half. [Yuán] Shàng heard that Yè was in emergency, commanded troops of over ten thousand men to return to rescue it, following the western mountains to come, east reaching Yángpíng precinct, from Yè by seventy lǐ, overlooking the Fǔ river, lit fires to signal to the city interior, the city interior also lit fires to answer them. [Shěn] Pèi sent out troops to the city’s north, wishing to with [Yuán] Shàng together break the encirclement. Tàizǔ opposed and struck them, defeated and returned, [Yuán] Shàng also was defeated and fled, along the bend of the Zhāng making camp, Tàizǔ therefore went to encircle him, it was not yet complete, [Yuán] Shàng was afraid and sent Yīn Kuí and Chén Lín to ask to surrender, did not listen. [Yuán] Shàng returned to flee to Lànkǒu, advanced to again encircle him urgently, his officers Mǎ Yán and others on facing the battle lines surrendered, the multitudes greatly collapsed, [Yuán] Shàng fled to Zhōngshān. Completely collected his heavy baggage, obtained [Yuán] Shàng’s seal and ribbon, Stave and Battle-Ax and his clothes and things, to show to his family, the city interior collapsed in despair. [Shěn] Pèi’s elder brother’s Son [Shěn] Róng defended the east gate, in the night opened the gate to let in Tàizǔ’s troops. With [Shěn] Pèi battled inside the city, captured alive [Shěn] Pèi. [Shěn] Pèi’s voice and spirit was strong and fierce, to the end without yielding statements, of those who saw none did not sigh. Therefore beheaded him. [65] Gāo Gàn with Bìng Province surrendered, restored [Gāo] Gàn as Inspector.



紹愛少子尚，貌美，欲以為後而未顯。〔一〕審配、逢紀與辛評、郭圖爭權，配、紀與尚比，評、圖與譚比。眾以譚長，欲立之。配等恐譚立而評等為己害，緣紹素意，乃奉尚代紹位。譚至，不得立，自號車騎將軍。由是譚、尚有隙。太祖北征譚、尚。譚軍黎陽，尚少與譚兵，而使逢紀從譚。譚求益兵，配等議不與。譚怒，殺紀。〔二〕太祖渡河攻譚，譚告急於尚。尚欲分兵益譚，恐譚遂奪其眾，乃使審配守鄴，尚自將兵助譚，與太祖相拒於黎陽。自〔二〕〔九〕月至（九）〔二〕月，大戰城下，譚、尚敗退，入城守。太祖將圍之，乃夜遁。追至鄴，收其麥，拔陰安，引軍還許。太祖南征荊州，軍至西平。譚、尚遂舉兵相攻，譚敗奔平原。尚攻之急，譚遣辛毗詣太祖請救。太祖乃還救譚，十月至黎陽。〔三〕尚聞太祖北，釋平原還鄴。其將呂曠、呂翔叛尚歸太祖，譚復陰刻將軍印假曠、翔。太祖知譚詐，與結婚以安之，乃引軍還。尚使審配、蘇由守鄴，復攻譚平原。太祖進軍將攻鄴，到洹水，去鄴五十里，由欲為內應，謀泄，與配戰城中，敗，出奔太祖。太祖遂進攻之，為地道，配亦於內作塹以當之。配將馮禮開突門，內太祖兵三百餘人，配覺之，從城上以大石擊突中柵門，柵門閉，入者皆沒。太祖遂圍之，為塹，周四十里，初令淺，示若可越。配望而笑之，不出爭利。太祖一夜掘之，廣深二丈，決漳水以灌之，自五月至八月，城中餓死者過半。尚聞鄴急，將兵萬餘人還救之，依西山來，東至陽平亭，去鄴十七里，臨滏水，舉火以示城中，城中亦舉火相應。配出兵城北，欲與尚對決圍。太祖逆擊之，敗還，尚亦破走，依曲漳為營，太祖遂圍之。未合，尚懼，遣陰夔、陳琳乞降，不聽。尚還走濫口，進復圍之急，其將馬延等臨陳降，眾大潰，尚奔中山。盡收其輜重，得尚印綬、節鉞及衣物，以示其家，城中崩沮。配兄子榮守東門，夜開門內太祖兵，與配戰城中，生禽配。配聲氣壯烈，終無撓辭，見者莫不歎息。遂斬之。〔四〕高幹以并州降，復以幹為刺史。

〔一〕　典論曰：譚長而惠，尚少而美。紹妻劉氏愛尚，數稱其才，紹亦奇其貌，欲以為後，未顯而紹死。劉氏性酷妒，紹死，僵尸未殯，寵妾五人，劉盡殺之。以為死者有知，當復見紹於地下，乃髡頭墨面以毀其形。尚又為盡殺死者之家。

〔二〕　英雄記曰：紀字元圖。初，紹去董卓出奔，與許攸及紀俱詣冀州，紹以紀聰達有計策，甚親信之，與共舉事。後審配任用，與紀不睦。或有讒配于紹，紹問紀，紀稱「配天性烈直，古人之節，不宜疑之」。紹曰：「君不惡之邪？」紀答曰：「先日所爭者私情，今所陳者國事。」紹善之，卒不廢配。配由是更與紀為親善。
