May you General in detail consider the situation, and bestow a ring or pendant.”144
Diǎnlüè states: [Yuán] Tán obtained the letter and was frustrated, ascended the city walls and sobbed. He was coerced by Guō Tú, also as the troop spearpoints were repeatedly engaged, therefore the battle could not be resolved.



〔三〕　魏氏春秋載劉表遺譚書曰：「天篤降害，禍難殷流，尊公殂殞，四海悼心。賢胤承統，遐邇屬望，咸欲展布旅力，以投盟主，雖亡之日，猶存之願也。何寤青蠅飛於干旍，無極游於二壘，使股肱分為二體，背膂絕為異身！昔三王五伯，下及戰國，父子相殘，蓋有之矣；然或欲以成王業，或欲以定霸功，或欲以顯宗主，或欲以固冢嗣，未有棄親即異，扤其本根，而能崇業濟功，垂祚後世者也。若齊襄復九世之讎，士匄卒荀偃之事，是故春秋美其義，君子稱其信。夫伯游之恨于齊，未若（文公）〔太公〕之忿曹；宣子之承業，未若仁君之繼統也。且君子之違難不適讎國，豈可忘先君之怨，棄至親之好，為萬世之戒，遺同盟之恥哉！冀州不弟之傲，既已然矣；仁君當降志辱身，以匡國為務；雖見憎於夫人，未若鄭莊之於姜氏，兄弟之嫌，未若重華之於象傲也。然莊公有大隧之樂，象受有鼻之封。願棄捐前忿，遠思舊義，復為母子昆弟如初。」又遺尚書曰：「知變起辛、郭，禍結同生，追閼伯、實沈之蹤，忘常棣死喪之義，親尋干戈，僵尸流血，聞之哽咽，雖存若亡。昔軒轅有涿鹿之戰，周武有商、奄之師，皆所以翦除穢害而定王業，非彊弱之（事）爭，喜怒之忿也。故雖滅親不為尤，誅兄不傷義。今二君初承洪業，纂繼前軌，進有國家傾危之慮，退有先公遺恨之負，當唯義是務，唯國是康。何者？金木水火以剛柔相濟，然後克得其和，能為民用。今青州天性峭急，迷于曲直。仁君度數弘廣，綽然有餘，當以大包小，以優容劣，先除曹操以卒先公之恨，事定之後，乃議曲直之計，不亦善乎！若留神遠圖，克己復禮，當振旆長驅，共獎王室，若迷而不反，違而無改，則胡夷將有誚讓之言，況我同盟，復能戮力為君之役哉？此韓盧、東郭自困於前而遺田父之獲者也。憤踴鶴望，冀聞和同之聲。若其泰也，則袁族其與漢升降乎！如其否也，則同盟永無望矣。」譚、尚盡不從。漢晉春秋載審配獻書於譚曰：「春秋之義，國君死社稷，忠臣死王命。苟有圖危宗廟，敗亂國家，王綱典律，親疏一也。是以周公垂泣而蔽管、蔡之獄，季友歔欷而行鍼叔之鴆。何則？義重人輕，事不得已也。昔衛靈公廢蒯聵而立輒，蒯聵為不道，入戚以篡，衛師伐之。春秋傳曰：『以石曼姑之義，為可以拒之。』是以蒯聵終獲叛逆之罪，而曼姑永享忠臣之名。父子猶然，豈況兄弟乎！昔先公廢絀將軍以續賢兄，立我將軍以為適嗣，上告祖靈，下書譜牒，先公謂將軍為兄子，將軍謂先公為叔父，海內遠近，誰不備聞？且先公即世之日，我將軍斬衰居廬，而將軍齋于堊室，出入之分，於斯益明。是時凶臣逢紀，妄畫蛇足，曲辭諂媚，交亂懿親，將軍奮赫然之怒，誅不旋時，〔我〕將軍亦奉命承旨，加以淫刑。自是之後，癰疽破潰，骨肉無絲髮之嫌，自疑之臣，皆保生全之福。故悉遣彊胡，簡命名將，料整器械，選擇戰士，殫府庫之財，竭食土之實，其所以供奉將軍，何求而不備？君臣相率，共衛旌麾，戰為雁行，賦為幣主，雖傾倉覆庫，翦剝民物，上下欣戴，莫敢告勞。何則？推戀戀忠赤之情，盡家家肝腦之計，脣齒輔車，不相為賜。謂為將軍心合意同，混齊一體，必當并威偶勢，禦寇寧家。何圖凶險讒慝之人，造飾無端，誘導姦利，至令將軍翻然改圖，忘孝友之仁，聽豺狼之謀，誣先公廢立之言，違近者在喪之位，悖紀綱之理，不顧逆順之節，橫易冀州之主，欲當先公之繼。遂放兵鈔撥，屠城殺吏，交尸盈原，裸民滿野，或有髡{髟剔}髮膚，割截支體，冤魂痛於幽冥，創痍號於草棘。又乃圖獲鄴城，許賜秦、胡，財物婦女，豫有分界。或聞告令吏士云：『孤雖有老母，輒使身體完具而已。』聞此言者，莫不驚愕失氣，悼心揮涕，使太夫人憂哀憤懣于堂室，我州君臣士友假寐悲歎，無所措其手足；念欲靜師拱默以聽執事之圖，則懼違春秋死命之節，貽太夫人不測之患，隕先公高世之業。且三軍憤慨，人懷私怒，我將軍辭不獲已，以及館陶之役。是時外為禦難，內實乞罪，既不見赦，而（屠辱谷）〔屠各〕二三其心，臨陳叛戾。我將軍進退無功，首尾受敵，引軍奔避，不敢告辭。亦謂將軍當少垂親親之仁，貺以緩追之惠，而乃尋蹤躡軌，無所逃命。困獸必鬥，以干嚴行，而將軍師旅土崩瓦解，此非人力，乃天意也。是後又望將軍改往修來，克己復禮，追還孔懷如初之愛；而縱情肆怒，趣破家門，企踵鶴立，連結外讎，散鋒於火，播增毒螫，烽煙相望，涉血千里，遺城厄民，引領悲怨，雖欲勿救，惡得已哉！故遂引軍東轅，保正疆埸，雖近郊壘，未侵境域，然望旌麾，能不永歎？配等備先公家臣，奉廢立之命。而圖等干國亂家，禮有常刑。故奮敝州之賦，以除將軍之疾，若乃天啟于心，早行其誅，則我將軍匍匐悲號于將軍股掌之上，配等亦袒躬布體以待斧鉞之刑。若必不悛，有以國斃，圖頭不縣，軍不旋踵。願將軍詳度事宜，錫以環玦。」典略曰：譚得書悵然，登城而泣。既劫于郭圖，亦以兵鋒累交，遂戰不解。













[65] Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Shěn] Pèi appellation Zhèngnán was a Wèi prefecture man, in youth fiercely loyal and ardently fervent, having integrity that could not be violated. When Yuán Shào was designated Jì Province, entrusted with appointment as belly and heart, becoming Manager Central and Separate Carriage, further presiding over the Tent Office. Previously, when [Yuán] Tán departed, Xīn Pí’s and Guō Tú’s families were all called and able to get out, but Xīn Píng’s family alone was arrested. When [Shěn] Pèi’s elder brother’s son opened the city gates to let in the troops, at the time [Shěn] Pèi was at the city wall’s southeast corner tower top, looked out and saw Tàizǔ’s troops entering, was furious that Xīn and Guō had ruined Jì Province, and so sent someone to gallop to visit Yè prison, directing to kill [Xīn Píng] Zhòngzhì’s family. At the time Xīn Pí was in the army, heard the gates were open, galloped to run to visit the prison, wishing to release his elder brother’s family, his elder brother’s family was already dead. that day captured alive [Shěn] Pèi, brought to visit below the curtains, Xīn Pí and others opposed him and with horsewhips struck his head, cursing him stating: “Slave, today you are truly dead!” [Shěn] Pèi looked back and said: “You dogs, exactly because of you all our Jì Province is ruined, I regret not being able to kill you! Moreover today are you able to kill or spare me?” Shortly afterward the Excellency [Cáo Cāo] invited him to meet, said to [Shěn] Pèi: “Do you know who opened your city gate?” [Shěn] Pèi said: “I do not know.” Said: “It was your boy [Shěn] Róng.” [Shěn] Pèi said: “The petty boy was so not worth employing that it came to this!” The Excellency furhter said: “On a previous day I was walking the encirclement, why were there so many crossbows?” [Shěn] Pèi said: “I only regret they were too few!” The Excellency said: “You are loyal to the Yuán clan father and sons, and also surely could not not be so.” He had the intention to spare him. [Shěn] Pèi was without statements of yielding, and further Xīn Pí and the rest wailed and wept without end, and so killed him. Previously, Jì Province man Zhāng Zǐqiān in advance surrendered, formerly with [Shěn] Pèi was not friendly, laughed and spoke to [Shěn] Pèi stating: “Zhèngnán, how do you care to me now?” [Shěn] Pèi in stern voice said: “You are a surrendered caitiff, Shěn Pèi is a loyal minister, even if death how can I be compared to you living?” Facing the execution enactment, he shouted at the soldiers holding him to have him face north, stating: “My lord is in the north.”
Lè Zī’s Shaāyáng Gōng Zàijì and Yuán Wěi’s Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū both say that when Tàizǔ’s troops entered the city, Shěn Pèi battled in the gates, was defeated, and fled into a well, and in the well captured him. Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: [Shěn] Pèi was an ardent martyr of an era, the Yuán clan’s servant to the death, how could it be on the day of his fortunes ending, that he would hide his body in a well, that this is difficult to trust, is truly easy to understand. It is unknown what kind of men were the sorts as [Lè] Zī and [Yuán] Wěi, to be unable to recognize and destinguish right and wrong, and yet recklessly play with writing brush and ink, rashly creating bizarre heresy, to circulate their books. Sorts like this, are exactly sufficient to deceive in sight and sound, to confuse and mislead the later born. They truly are criminals to historical record, what understanding scholars would not accept.



〔四〕　先賢行狀曰：配字正南，魏郡人，少忠烈慷慨，有不可犯之節。袁紹領冀州，委以腹心之任，以為治中別駕，并總幕府。初，譚之去，皆呼辛毗、郭圖家得出，而辛評家獨被收。及配兄子開城門內兵，時配在城東南角樓上，望見太祖兵入，忿辛、郭壞敗冀州，乃遣人馳詣鄴獄，指殺仲治家。是時，辛毗在軍，聞門開，馳走詣獄，欲解其兄家，兄家已死。是日生縛配，將詣帳下，辛毗等逆以馬鞭擊其頭，罵之曰：「奴，汝今日真死矣！」配顧曰：「狗輩，正由汝曹破我冀州，恨不得殺汝也！且汝今日能殺生我邪？」有頃，公引見，謂配：「知誰開卿城門？」配曰：「不知也。」曰：「自卿（文）〔子〕榮耳。」配曰：「小兒不足用乃至此！」公復謂曰：「曩日孤之行圍，何弩之多也？」配曰：「恨其少耳！」公曰：「卿忠于袁氏父子，亦自不得不爾也。」有意欲活之。配既無撓辭，而辛毗等號哭不已，乃殺之。初，冀州人張子謙先降，素與配不善，笑謂配曰：「正南，卿竟何如我？」配厲聲曰：「汝為降虜，審配為忠臣，雖死，豈若汝生邪！」臨行刑，叱持兵者令北向，曰：「我君在北。」樂資山陽公載記及袁暐獻帝春秋並云太祖兵入城，審配戰于門中，既敗，逃于井中，於井獲之。臣松之以為配一代之烈士，袁氏之死臣，豈當數窮之日，方逃身于井，此之難信，誠為易了。不知資、暐之徒竟為何人，未能識別然否，而輕弄翰墨，妄生異端，以行其書。如此之類，正足以誣罔視聽，疑誤後生矣。寔史籍之罪人，達學之所不取者也。







When Tàizǔ was besieging Yè, [Yuán] Tán captured Gānlíng, Ānpíng, Bóhǎi, Héjiān, attacked [Yuán] Shàng at Zhōngshān. [Yuán] Shàng fled to Gù’ān to follow [Yuán] Xī, [Yuán] Tán completely collected his multitudes. Tàizǔ was about to suppress him, [Yuán] Tán thus evacuated Píngyuán, consolidated Nánpí, personally garrisoned Lóngcòu. Twelfth Moon [205 Jan 8 - Feb 6], Tàizǔ’s army was at his gates, [Yuán] Tán did not go out, in the night escaped to flee to Nánpí, overlooking Qīnghé and garrisoned. Tenth Year Standard Moon [205 Feb 7 - Mar 7], attacked and captured it, beheaded [Yuán] Tán and [Guō] Tú and others. [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng were by their officers Jiāo Chù and Zhāng Nán attacked, fled to Liáoxī’s Wūhuán. [Jiāo] Chù declared himself Yōu Province Inspector, compelled the various prefecture administrators and magistrates and chiefs to turn back on the Yuán and turn to the Cáo, lining up troops of several tens of thousands, killing a white horse for [blood] oath, the order stating: “Those that violate the command are beheaded.” Of the multitudes none dared speak, each in their sequence drank [the sacrificial blood]. On reaching Separate Carriage Hán Héng, he said: “I received generous favor from Excellency Yuán, father and sons, now they are defeated and destroyed, my wisdom could not save them, my valor could not die for them, in terms of righteousness I was deficient. As for then facing north to the Cáo clan, it is not what I am able to do.” The entire seated assembly for [Hán] Héng lost color. [Jiāo] Chú said: “In raising great affairs, one must establish great righteousness. Whether affairs are relieved or not, does not depend on one man. We can grant [Hán] Héng his will, to encourage service to one’s lord.” Gāo Gàn rebelled, seized the Shàngdǎng Administrator, raised troops to defend Húkǒu Pass. Sent Yuè Jìn and Lǐ Diǎn to strike him, had not yet succeeded. Eleventh Year [206], Tàizǔ campaigned against [Gāo] Gàn. [Gāo] Gàn then left his officers Xià Zhāo and Dèng Shēng to defend the city, and personally visited the Xiōngnú Chányú to ask for rescue, did not obtain it, and alone with several cavalry fled, wishing to flee south to Jīng Province, the Shàngluò Commandant captured and beheaded him. [66] Twelfth Year [207], Tàizǔ reached Liáoxī to strike the Wūhuán. [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī with the Wūhuán opposed the army in battle, was defeated and fled to Liáodōng, Gōngsūn Kāng enticed and beheaded them, sent their heads. [67] Tàizǔ highly regarded Hán Héng’s integrity, repeatedly recruited him, he did not come, and died at home. [68]



太祖之圍鄴也，譚略取甘陵、安平、勃海、河間，攻尚於中山。尚走故安從熙，譚悉收其眾。太祖將討之，譚乃拔平原，并南皮，自屯龍湊。十二月，太祖軍其門，譚不出，夜遁奔南皮，臨清河而屯。十年正月，攻拔之，斬譚及圖等。熙、尚為其將焦觸、張南所攻，奔遼西烏丸。觸自號幽州刺史，驅率諸郡太守令長，背袁向曹，陳兵數萬，殺白馬盟，令曰：「違命者斬！」眾莫敢語，各以次歃。至別駕韓珩，曰：「吾受袁公父子厚恩，今其破亡，智不能救，勇不能死，於義闕矣；若乃北面於曹氏，所弗能為也。」一坐為珩失色。觸曰：「夫興大事，當立大義，事之濟否，不待一人，可卒珩志，以勵事君。」高幹叛，執上黨太守，舉兵守壺口關。遣樂進、李典擊之，未拔。十一年，太祖征幹。幹乃留其將夏昭、鄧升守城，自詣匈奴單于求救，不得，獨與數騎亡，欲南奔荊州，上洛都尉捕斬之。〔一〕十二年，太祖至遼西擊烏丸。尚、熙與烏丸逆軍戰，敗走奔遼東，公孫康誘斬之，送其首。〔二〕太祖高韓珩節，屢辟不至，卒於家。〔三〕










[66] Diǎnlüè states: Shàngluò Commandant Wáng Yǎn captured Gāo Gàn, for the achievement enfeoffed a Marquess, his wife wept in her room, believing that [Wáng] Yǎn on obtaining riches and honor would further take concubines that would seize away her favor.



〔一〕　典略曰：上洛都尉王琰獲高幹，以功封侯；其妻哭于室，以為琰富貴將更娶妾媵而奪己愛故也。













[67] Diǎnlüè states: [Yuán] Shàng as a man had valor and strength, wished to seize and take away [Gōngsūn] Kāng’s multitudes, with [Yuán] Xī plotted stating: “Now we have arrived, [Gōngsūn] Kāng certainly will meet with us. I wish to with you elder brother personally strike him, with Liáodōng we yet can expand ourselves.” [Gōngsūn] Kāng also in his heart calculated stating: “Now to not capture [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng, is to have nothing to offer to the country.” Thus he in advance placed is elite and valorous inside the stables, and afterward invited [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng entered, [Gōngsūn] Kāng’s hidden troops went out, bound them all, seated on freezing ground. [Yuán] Shàng was cold and requested a seating mat. [Yuán] Xī said: “Our heads are about to travel ten thousand lǐ, what use is a seating mat?” Therefore cut off their heads.
[Yuán] Tán appellation Xiǎnsī. [Yuán] Xī appellation Xiǎnyì. [Yuán] Shàng appellation Xiǎnfǔ.
Wú shū states: [Yuán] Shàng held a younger brother named [Yuán] Mǎi, with [Yuán] Shàng together fled to Liáodōng.
Cáo Mán Zhuàn says [Yuán] Mǎi was [Yuán] Shàng’s elder brother’s son. It is uncertain.



〔二〕　典略曰：尚為人有勇力，欲奪取康眾，與熙謀曰：「今到，康必相見，欲與兄手擊之，有遼東猶可以自廣也。」康亦心計曰：「今不取熙、尚，無以為說於國家。」乃先置其精勇于廄中，然後請熙、尚。熙、尚入，康伏兵出，皆縛之，坐于凍地。尚寒，求席，熙曰：「頭顱方行萬里，何席之為！」遂斬首。譚，字顯思。熙，字顯奕。尚，字顯甫。吳書曰：尚有弟名買，與尚俱走遼東。曹瞞傳云：買，尚兄子。未詳。













[68] Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Hán] Héng appellation Zǐpèi was a Dài prefecture man, pure and having magnamity. In youth lost his father and mother, served and supported his elder brothers and elder sisters, the clansmen praised his filial piety and fraternal duty.



〔三〕　先賢行狀曰：珩字子佩，代郡人，清粹有雅量。少喪父母，奉養兄姊，宗族稱孝悌焉。
crumbs: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú

title: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú
text:
Yuán Shù


Yuán Shù appellation Gōnglù was Excellency of Works [Yuán] Féng’s son, [Yuán] Shào’s younger cousin. For his vigilantism he was famed. Nominated Filial-Incorruptible, appointed Cadet Central, successively holding offices interior and exterior, later became Breaking Charge Colonel, Tiger Elite Central Cadet General. When Dǒng Zhuó was about to depose the Emperor, he appointed [Yuán] Shù as Rear General, [Yuán] Shù also feared the disaster of [Dǒng] Zhuó, and went out to flee to Nányáng. It happened that Chángshā Administrator Sūn Jiān killed Nányáng Administrator Zhāng Zī, [Yuán] Shù was able to occupy his prefecture. Nányáng’s registered population was several million, but [Yuán] Shù was extravagantly excessive and unrestrained in desires, conscription and extraction without limit, the Hundred Surnames suffered from it. He and [Yuán] Shào had discord, and also with [Liú] Biào was not at peace and so to the north allied with Gōngsūn Zàn; [Yuán] Shào with [Gōngsūn] Zàn was not harmonious and so to the south allied with Liú Biǎo. These brothers drifted to treachery, abandoned the near to join with the far like this. [69] Led his army to enter Chénliú. Tàizǔ with [Yuán] Shào joined to strike, greatly defeated [Yuán] Shù’s army. [Yuán] Shù with his remaining multitudes fled to Jiǔjiāng, killed Yáng Province Inspector Chén Wēn, took over his province, [70] with Zhāng Xūn, Qiáo Ruí and others as his chief Generals. Lǐ Jué entered Cháng’ān, wished to ally with [Yuán] Shù to be his assistance, appointed [Yuán] Shù as Left General, enfeoffed Marquess of Yángdí, Lent Stave, sent Grand Tutor Mǎ Mìdī to take advantage of his tour145 to enact the appointments and conferments. [Yuán] Shù seized away [Mǎ] Mìdī’s Stave, detained and did not send him. [71]



袁術字公路，司空逢子，紹之從弟也。以俠氣聞。舉孝廉，除郎中，歷職內外，後為折衝校尉、虎賁中郎將。董卓之將廢帝，以術為後將軍；術亦畏卓之禍，出奔南陽。會長沙太守孫堅殺南陽太守張咨，術得據其郡。南陽戶口數百萬，而術奢淫肆欲，徵斂無度，百姓苦之。既與紹有隙，又與劉表不平而北連公孫瓚；紹與瓚不和而南連劉表。其兄弟攜貳，舍近交遠如此。〔一〕引軍入陳留。太祖與紹合擊，大破術軍。術以餘眾奔九江，殺揚州刺史陳溫，領其州。〔二〕以張勳、橋蕤等為大將軍。李傕入長安，欲結術為援，以術為左將軍，封陽翟侯，假節，遣太傅馬日磾因循行拜授。術奪日磾節，拘留不遣。〔三〕










[69] Wú shū states: At the time commentators believed that Emperor Líng had lost the Way, causing Heaven’s Under to rebel in chaos, the Young Emperor was young and weak, had been established by a rebel minister, and also was born by an unknown maternal clan. Yōu Province Governor Liú Yú formerly had virtue and prestige, [Yuán] Shào and others wished to enthrone him to calm the times, sending someone to inform [Yuán] Shù. [Yuán] Shù observed the Hàn House was declining, secretly held ulterior ambitions, and therefore outside claimed public righteousness in order to refuse [Yuán] Shào. [Yuán] Shào further sent [Yuán] Shù a letter that said: “Formerly with Hán Wénjié we together established an eternal path, wishing for Within the Seas to see a ruler of a second restoration. Now the west claims to have a young lord, without bloodline relation, the Excellencies and Ministers on down all flatter and serve [Dǒng] Zhuó, how can they again be trusted? We merely should send troops to go garrison the passes and critical points, and all will on their own wither and die in the west. The east establishes a sagely lord, Grand Peace can be waited for, why have any doubts? Also your household met with slaughter, do you not think of Zǐxū, can you again face north? Opposing Heaven is not auspicious, may you in detail consider it.” [Yuán] Shù’s answer said: “The sagely ruler is intelligent and astute, having the character of Zhōu Chéng. The rebel [Dǒng] Zhuó took advantage of an interval of danger and chaos, his power subdues the Hundred Offices, this then is the Hàn House encountering a minor distress. The chaos is not yet satiated, yet you wish to further instigate it. As for saying the present ruler is ‘without bloodline relation,’ how is this not false accusation? From our ancestors onward, in sequence the generations followed one another, loyalty and righteousness as foremost. His Excellency the Grand Tutor [Yuán Wěi] was benevolent and compassionate, though he knew the rebel [Dǒng] Zhuó would certainly do harm, by faith he followed righteousness, unable to bear to leave. Our household was exterminated, dead and scattered apart, by good fortune far and near have come to help us, to not take advantage of this time to above suppress the state traitor, below not wipe away the family disgrace, but instead plot this, it is unheard of. Also you stated: ‘household me with slaughter, can you again face north,’ this was [Dǒng] Zhuó’s doing, how was it the country? The lord’s command is Heaven, Heaven cannot be an enemy, all the more when it was not the lord’s command. My sincere red heart’s ambition is on exterminating [Dǒng] Zhuó, not knowing anything else.”



〔一〕　吳書曰：時議者以靈帝失道，使天下叛亂，少帝幼弱，為賊臣所立，又不識母氏所出。幽州牧劉虞宿有德望，紹等欲立之以安當時，使人報術。術觀漢室衰陵，陰懷異志，故外託公義以拒紹。紹復與術書曰：「前與韓文節共建永世之道，欲海內見再興之主。今西名有幼君，無血脈之屬，公卿以下皆媚事卓，安可復信！但當使兵往屯關要，皆自蹙死于西。東立聖君，太平可冀，如何有疑！又室家見戮，不念子胥，可復北面乎？違天不祥，願詳思之。」術答曰：「聖主聰叡，有周成之質。賊卓因危亂之際，威服百寮，此乃漢家小厄之會。亂尚未厭，復欲興之。乃云今主『無血脈之屬』，豈不誣乎！先人以來，奕世相承，忠義為先。太傅公仁慈惻隱，雖知賊卓必為禍害，以信徇義，不忍去也。門戶滅絕，死亡流漫，幸蒙遠近來相赴助，不因此時上討國賊，下刷家恥，而圖於此，非所聞也。又曰『室家見戮，可復北面』，此卓所為，豈國家哉？君命，天也，天不可讎，況非君命乎！慺慺赤心，志在滅卓，不識其他。」













[70] Your Servant Sōngzhī cites Yīngxióng jì: “Chén Wēn appellation Yuántì was a Rǔnán man. Formerly was Yáng Province Inspector, of illness died. Yuán Shào sent Yuán Yí to take charge of the province, was defeated and scattered, fled to Pèi state, was killed by his troops. Yuán Shù further employed Chén Yǔ as Yáng Province. [Chén] Yǔ appellation Gǒngwěi was a Xiàpī man. [Chén] Yǔ had taken charge of the province, but [Yuán] Shù was defeated at Fēngqiū, headed south to Shòuchūn, [Chén] Yǔ refused [Yuán] Shù and did not accept him. [Yuán] Shù retreated to protect Yīnlíng, again united his armies and attacked [Chén] Yǔ, [Chén] Yǔ was afraid and fled to return to Xiàpī.” By this, then [Chén] Wēn was not killed by [Yuán] Shù, with the base biography not the same.



〔二〕　臣松之案英雄記：「陳溫字元悌，汝南人。先為揚州刺史，自病死。袁紹遣袁遺領州，敗散，奔沛國，為兵所殺。袁術更用陳瑀為揚州。瑀字公瑋，下邳人。瑀既領州，而術敗于封丘，南向壽春，瑀拒術不納。術退保陰陵，更合軍攻瑀，瑀懼走歸下邳。」如此，則溫不為術所殺，與本傳不同。













[71] Sānfǔ Juélù zhù states: [Mǎ] Mìdī appellation Wēngshū was Mǎ Róng’s distant cousin’s son. In youth continued [Mǎ] Róng’s scholarship, for his talent and learning advanced. With Yáng Biāo, Lú Zhí, Cài Yōng and others managed and collated the Central Documents, successively held position in the Nine Ministers, then ascended to the Terrace Assistants.
Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shù from [Mǎ] Mìdī borrowed the Stave to examine it, took advantage to seize it and not return it, prepared withint he army over a thousand men, sent to pressure and recruit him. [Mǎ] Mìdī spoke to [Yuán] Shù stating: “Your family’s former generations of varous Excellencies, to recruit servicemen what did they say? As far as pressuring, is it to say that the Excellency’s Office Assistants can be obtained by force?” He asked [Yuán] Shù to leave, but [Yuán] Shù detained him and would not send him. Having lost his Stave and humiliated, in distress and rage he died.



〔三〕　三輔決錄注曰：日磾字翁叔，馬融之族子。少傳融業，以才學進。與楊彪、盧植、蔡邕等典校中書，歷位九卿，遂登台輔。獻帝春秋曰：術從日磾借節觀之，因奪不還，備軍中千餘人，使促辟之。日磾謂術曰：「卿家先世諸公，辟士云何，而言促之，謂公府掾可劫得乎！」從術求去，而術留之不遣；既以失節屈辱，憂恚而死。







At the time Pèi Chancellor Xiàpī’s Chén Guī was former Grand Commandant [Chén] Qiú’s younger brother’s son. [Yuán] Shù with [Chén] Guī were both the junior clansmen of Excellencies, in youth had friendly relations together. His letter to [Chén] Guī said: “In the past Qín lost its government, Heaven’s Under’s various heroes fought to take it, those with both wisdom and valor in the end received their submission. In the present age affairs are in turmoil, again having a situation of collapse, truly the time for those of outstanding ability to take action. We have an old friendship, will you consent to be my Left and Right? If we gather great affairs, you truly will be my heart and spine.” [Chén] Guī’s middle son [Chén] Yīng at the time was at Xiàpī, [Yuán] Shù further coerced and took hostage [Chén] Yīng, plotting that it would certainly deliver [Chén] Guī. [Chén] Guī’s answer letter said: “In the past of Qín’s final generation, it was unrestrained and cruel and indulged its passions, oppression flowed Under Heaven, poison covering living people, the below could not bear the commands, and therefore then the lands collapsed. Now although it is a final generation, it does not have the chaos of fallen Qín’s oppressive cruelty. General Cáo [Cāo] has divine military ability and answers the times, raising and restoring order and punishments, about to dispel and pacify the vicious and evil, purify and settle Within the Seas, and truly this has verification. I believed you would devote strength and join in heart, to rectify and support the Hàn House, but yet you secretly plot to oppose course, with your body testing disaster, how is it not painful? If you are lost but know to turn around, yet you can escape. I am an old friend, and therefore explain my utmost feelings. Although it displease the ear, it is the kindness of bone and flesh. If you wish me to seek private gains and flatter, even if facing death I cannot.”



時沛相下邳陳珪，故太尉球弟子也。術與珪俱公族子孫，少共交游，書與珪曰：「昔秦失其政，天下群雄爭而取之，兼智勇者卒受其歸。今世事紛擾，復有瓦解之勢矣，誠英乂有為之時也。與足下舊交，豈肯左右之乎？若集大事，子實為吾心膂。」珪中子應時在下邳，術並脅質應，圖必致珪。珪答書曰：「昔秦末世，肆暴恣情，虐流天下，毒被生民，下不堪命，故遂土崩。今雖季世，未有亡秦苛暴之亂也。曹將軍神武應期，興復典刑，將撥平凶慝，清定海內，信有徵矣。以為足下當戮力同心，匡翼漢室，而陰謀不軌，以身試禍，豈不痛哉！若迷而知反，尚可以免。吾備舊知，故陳至情，雖逆于耳，骨肉之惠也。欲吾營私阿附，有犯死不能也。」




Xīngpíng Second Year [195] Winter, Heaven’s Son was defeated at Cáoyáng. [Yuán] Shù met with his various subordinates and spoke stating: “Now the Liú clan is declined and weak, Within the Seas a cauldron boiling. My family for four generations were Excellency Assistants, to which the Hundred Surnames submitted. I wish to answer Heaven and obey the People, what do you sirs think about it?” Of the multitudes none dared reply. Registrar Yán Xiàng advanced and said: “In the past Zhōu from Hòujì reaching to King Wén accmululated virtue and amassed achievements, of three parts of Heaven’s Under possed two, yet they submitted to and served Yīn. Although your Enlightened Excellency’s family for generations dominated in prosperity, it does not compare to the flourishing of Yǒu Zhōu, and although the Hàn House is declined, it does not compare to the cruelty of Yīn Zhòu.” [Yuán] Shù was silent and displeased. Employed Hénèi’s Zhāng Jiǒng’s talismen mandate, therefore usurped title [72] appointing Jiǔjiāng Administrator as Huáinán Intendant.146 Installed Excellencies and Ministers, sacrificed to South and North Suburbs.147 His wasteful extravagance was increasingly extreme, his Rear Palace’s several hundred [women] all wore fine silks and gauze, ate sorghum and meat, [73] but the soldiers were cold and hungry, between the Jiāng and Huái emptied completely, the people ate each other. [Yuán] Shù formerly was beaten by Lǚ Bù, later was defeated by Tàizǔ, fled to his division retainers Léi Bó and Chén Lán at Qián mountain, and further was refused by them, distressed and afraid not knowing what to do. He was about to submit his Emperor’s title to [Yuán] Shào, wishing to go to Qīng Province to join Yuán Tán, fell ill on the road and died. [74] His wife and children took refuge with [Yuán] Shù’s former clerk Lújiāng Administrator Liú Xūn, Sūn Cè defeated [Liú] Xūn, and they further met with capture and custody. [Yuán] Shù’s daughter entered Sūn Quán’s Palace, son [Yuán] Yào appointed a Cadet Central, [Yuán] Yào’s daughter also was matched to [Sūn] Quán’s son [Sūn] Fèn.



興平二年冬，天子敗於曹陽。術會群下謂曰：「今劉氏微弱，海內鼎沸。吾家四世公輔，百姓所歸，欲應天順民，於諸君意如何？」眾莫敢對。主簿閻象進曰：「昔周自后稷至于文王，積德累功，三分天下有其二，猶服事殷。明公雖奕世克昌，未若有周之盛，漢室雖微，未若殷紂之暴也。」術嘿然不悅。用河內張炯之符命，遂僭號〔一〕以九江太守為淮南尹。置公卿，祠南北郊。荒侈滋甚，後宮數百皆服綺縠，餘粱肉，〔二〕而士卒凍餒，江淮閒空盡，人民相食。術前為呂布所破，後為太祖所敗，奔其部曲雷薄、陳蘭于灊山，復為所拒，憂懼不知所出。將歸帝號於紹，欲至青州從袁譚，發病道死。〔三〕妻子依術故吏廬江太守劉勳，孫策破勳，復見收視。術女入孫權宮，子燿拜郎中，燿女又配於權子奮。










[72] Diǎnlüè states: [Yuán] Shù believed the Yuán family name came from Chén, Chén was Shùn’s posterity, and as Earth continued from Fire, it obtained the sequence of answering fate. Also he observed a prophecy writing that said: “The one to succeed Hàn will be on the street high.” He believed his name and appellation fulfilled this,148 and so established title and proclaimed the Zhòng dynasty.



〔一〕　典略曰：術以袁姓出陳，陳，舜之後，以土承火，得應運之次。又見讖文云：「代漢者，當塗高也。」自以名字當之，乃建號稱仲氏。













[73] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: Director of Retainers Féng Fāng’s daughter was a state beauty, fled the chaos to Yáng Province, [Yuán] Shù ascended a city wall and saw and was charmed by her, and therefore accepted her [as a concubine], she extremely met with love and intimacy. The various women resented her favor, and told her stating: “The General is a noble man with ambition and integrity, at times you should weep in distress and anxiety. You will certainly increasingly meet with respect and value.” Féng-shì believed it so, and later on seeing [Yuán] Shù then at once shed tears, [Yuán] Shù believed she had deep will, and increasingly pitied her. The various women took advantage to together strangle and kill her, hanging her from a lavatory roof beam. [Yuán] Shù truly believed she could not obtain her will and died, and so applied lavish coffin and burial dress.



〔二〕　九州春秋曰：司隸馮方女，國色也，避亂揚州，術登城見而悅之，遂納焉，甚愛幸。諸婦害其寵，語之曰：「將軍貴人有志節，當時時涕泣憂愁，必長見敬重。」馮氏以為然，後見術輒垂涕，術以有心志，益哀之。諸婦人因共絞殺，懸之廁梁，術誠以為不得志而死，乃厚加殯斂。













[74] Wèi shū states: [Yuán] Shù submitted the Emperor’s title to [Yuán] Shào stating: “Hàn’s loss of Heaven’s Under has been for a long time, Heaven’s Son is held up, the government with other families, powerful heroes in competition, dividing apart the realm, this with the situation of Zhōu’s final years of division into Seven States is without difference, in the end the strong will merely conquer it. Moreover the Yuán clan received the Mandate to be King, the talismen omens are shining clear. Now you possess four provinces, people and households in the millions, in strength then none can compare in size, in discussing virtue then none can compare in loftiness. Cáo Cāo wishes to hold up the declined and prop up the weak, how can he continue the severed or rescue the already extinguished?” [Yuán] Shào secretly agreed with this.
Wú shū states: [Yuán] Shù had been refused by Léi Bó and the rest, remained stationed for three days, the servicemen multitudes had exhuasted provisions, and so returned reaching Jiāngtíng, from Shòuchūn by eighty lǐ. He asked the kitchen staff, and there was still wheat chaff of thirty hú. At the time it was the peak of summer heat, he wished to obtain honey broth, also there was no honey. He sat atop a latticed couch, sighed for a long time, and then greatly shouted stating: “Has Yuán Shù come to this?” Therefore he collapsed below the couch, vomited blood of over a dòu and died.



〔三〕　魏書曰：術歸帝號于紹曰：「漢之失天下久矣，天子提挈，政在家門，豪雄角逐，分裂疆宇，此與周之末年七國分勢無異，卒彊者兼之耳。加袁氏受命當王，符瑞炳然。今君擁有四州，民戶百萬，以彊則無與比大，論德則無與比高。曹操欲扶衰拯弱，安能續絕命救已滅乎？」紹陰然之。吳書曰：術既為雷薄等所拒，留住三日，士眾絕糧，乃還至江亭，去壽春八十里。問廚下，尚有麥屑三十斛。時盛暑，欲得蜜漿，又無蜜。坐櫺床上，歎息良久，乃大吒曰：「袁術至于此乎！」因頓伏床下，嘔血斗餘而死。
crumbs: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú

title: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú
text:
Liú Biǎo


Liú Biǎo appellation Jǐngshēng was a Shānyáng Gāopíng man. In youth was famed, called the Eight Eminents. [75] Height over eight chǐ, appearance and looks extremely grand. As a General-in-Chief’s Assistant became North Army Central Captain. When Emperor Líng passed away, succeeded Wáng Ruì as Jīng Province Inspector. At the time east of the mountains troops rose, [Liú] Biǎo also united troops and stationed Xiāngyáng. [76] Yuán Shù was at Nányáng, with Sūn Jiān joining as his follower, wished to surprise attack and seize [Liú] Biǎo’s province, sent [Sūn] Jiān to attack [Liú] Biǎo. [Sūn] Jiān was by a stray arrow hit and died, the army defeated, [Yuán] Shù therefore could not overcome [Liú] Biǎo. Lǐ Jué and Guō Sì entered Cháng’ān, wished to connect [Liú] Biǎo to be their assistance, and so appoitned [Liú] Biǎo as Defending South General, Jīng Province Governor, enfeoffed Marquess of Chéngwǔ, Lent Stave. Heaven’s Son set capital at Xǔ, although [Liú] Biǎo sent envoy to proffer tribute, however to the north he allied with Yuán Shào. Manager Central Dèng Xī remonstrated [Liú] Biǎo, [Liú] Biǎo did not listen, [77] [Dèng] Xī claimed illness and retired, to the end of [Liú] Biǎo’s reign. Zhāng Jì led troops to enter Jīng Province’s border, attacked Rángchéng, was by a stray arrow hit and died. Jīng Province’s office associates all congratulated, [Liú] Biǎo said: “[Zhāng] Jì due to destitution came, I was a host without courtesy, so that it came to crossed spearpoints, this was not my intention as Governor, I the Governor will accept condolences, not accept congratulations.” Sent someone to accept their multitudes, the multitudes heard this and was pleased, and therefore submitted and followed. Chángshā Administrator Zhāng Xiàn rebelled against [Liú] Biǎo, [78] [Liú] Biǎo beseiged him for successive years but could not subdue him. [Zhāng] Xiàn died of illness, Chángshā again established his son [Zhāng] Yì, [Liú] Biǎo therefore attacked and conquered [Zhāng] Yì, to the south collected Líng, Guì, to the north occupied Hànchuān, the land area several thousand lǐ, those wearing armor over a hundred thousand. [79]



劉表字景升，山陽高平人也。少知名，號八俊。〔一〕長八尺餘，姿貌甚偉。以大將軍掾為北軍中候。靈帝崩，代王叡為荊州刺史。是時山東兵起，表亦合兵軍襄陽。〔二〕袁術之在南陽也，與孫堅合從，欲襲奪表州，使堅攻表。堅為流矢所中死，軍敗，術遂不能勝表。李傕、郭汜入長安，欲連表為援，乃以表為鎮南將軍、荊州牧，封成武侯，假節。天子都許，表雖遣使貢獻，然北與袁紹相結。治中鄧羲諫表，表不聽，〔三〕羲辭疾而退，終表之世。張濟引兵入荊州界，攻穰城，為流矢所中死。荊州官屬皆賀，表曰：「濟以窮來，主人無禮，至于交鋒，此非牧意，牧受弔，不受賀也。」使人納其眾；眾聞之喜，遂服從。長沙太守張羨叛表，〔四〕表圍之連年不下。羨病死，長沙復立其子懌，表遂攻并懌，南收零、桂，北據漢川，地方數千里，帶甲十餘萬。〔五〕










[75] Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: [Liú] Biǎo with his same prefecture men Zhāng Yǐn, Xuē Yù, Wáng Fǎng, Xuān Jìng, Gōngxù Gōng, Liú Zhī, Tián Lín were the Eight Associates, some called them the Eight Esteemed.
Hàn Mò Míngshì Lù says: [Liú] Biǎo with Rǔnán’s chén Xiáng appellation Zhònglín, Fàn Pāng appellation Mèngbó, Lǔ state’s Kǒng Yù appellation Shìyuán, Bóhǎi’s Yuàn Kāng appellation Zhòngzhēn, Shānyáng’s Tán Fū appellation Wényǒu, Zhāng Jiǎn appellation Yuánjié, Nányáng’s Cén Zhǐ appellation Gōngxiào were the Eight Friends.
Xiè Chéng’s Hòu Hàn shū states: [Liú] Biǎo received his studies from his same prefecture’s Wáng Chàng. [Wáng] Chàng became Nányáng Administrator, his conduct excessive in frugality. [Liú] Biǎo at the time was aged seventeen, advanced to remonstrate stating: “Extravagance not overstepping above, frugality not pressing down below, overall is the way of the central mean, therefore Qú Bóyù was shamed to alone be a noble man. If the Office Lord149 will not lear from the enlightened admonishments of Kǒng the Sage, but admire the final actions of Yí and Qí,150, is it not be to make oneself conspicuous to omit oneself from the world?” [Wáng] Chàng answered stating: “Those who fail through restraint are few. Moreover it is to redress customs.”



〔一〕　張璠漢紀曰：表與同郡人張隱、薛郁、王訪、宣靖、（公褚恭）〔公緒恭〕、劉祗、田林為八交，或謂之八顧。漢末名士錄云：表與汝南陳翔字仲麟、范滂字孟博、魯國孔昱字世元、勃海苑康字仲真、山陽檀敷字文友、張儉字元節、南陽岑晊字公孝為八友。謝承後漢書曰：表受學於同郡王暢。暢為南陽太守，行過乎儉。表時年十七，進諫曰：「奢不僭上，儉不逼下，蓋中庸之道，是故蘧伯玉恥獨為君子。府君若不師孔聖之明訓，而慕夷齊之末操，無乃皎然自遺於世！」暢答曰：「以約失之者鮮矣。且以矯俗也。」













[76] Sīmǎ Biāo’s Zhànlüè states: When Liú Biǎo first became Jīng Province, south of the Jiāng the clans of rebels were flourishing, Yuán Shù garrisoned Lǔyáng,151 completely possessing the multitudes of Nányáng. Wú man Sū Dài was designated Chángshā Administrator, Bèi Yǔ as Huáróng Chief,152 each resisting with troops to make chaos. When [Liú] Biǎo first arrived, on single horse he entered Yíchéng,153 and so invited Zhōnglú men154 Kuǎi Liáng, Kuǎi Yuè and Xiāngyáng man155 Cài Mò to plan with them. [Liú] Biǎo said: “The clan rebels are extremely flourishing, and the multitudes are not attached, Yuán Shù takes advantage of this, disaster now has arrived. I wish to levy troops, fear they will not gather, what strategy should be used?” [Kuǎi] Liáng said: “Multitudes not attaching is benevolence being insufficient. Attached but not governed is righteousness being insufficient. If the ways of benevolence and righteousness are enacted, the Hundred Surnames submit like water flows down. Why worry of them not following when you arrive and ask of raising troops and strategies?” [Liú] Biǎo turned and asked [Kuǎi] Yuè, [Kuǎi] Yuè said: “Governing peace prioritizes benevolence and righteousness, governing chaos prioritizes expedience and planning. Warfare is not in numbers, it is in obtaining [the right] people. Yuán Shù is valorous but without decisiveness, Sū Dài and Bèi Yǔ both are military men, not worth worrying about. The clan rebel leaders are mostly greedy and cruel, resented by their subordinates. [I, Kuǎi] Yuè have those I have previously nurtured, will send them to show them the potential gains, they will certainly come with their multitudes. You will execute those without morality, and succor and employ them. The people of the entire province have hearts that delight in security, on hearing of your flourishing virtue, will certainly carry their infants ont heir back and arrive. Troops will gather and multitudes attach, to the south occupy Jiānglíng, to the north defend Xiāngyáng, and Jīng Province’s eight prefectures can be settled by spreading proclamations. Even if [Yuán] Shù and the rest arrive, there is nothing they can do.” [Liú] Biǎo said: “[Kuǎi Liáng] Zǐróu’s advice is the discouse of Yōng Jì. [Kuǎi Yuè] Yìdù’s calculations are the planning of Jiù Fàn.” Therefore had [Kuǎi] Yuè send peopel to entice the clan rebels, those that arrived were fifty-five men, beheaded them all. Surprise attacked and took over their multitudes, some at once appoitned as division retainers. Only Jiāngxià bandits Zhāng Hǔ, Chén Shēng gathered multitudes to occupy Xiāngyáng, [Liú] Biǎo thus sent [Kuǎi] Yuè with Páng Jì alone on horseback to go persuade them to surrender, the Jiāng’s south therefore was all pacified.



〔二〕　司馬彪戰略曰：劉表之初為荊州也，江南宗賊盛，袁術屯魯陽，盡有南陽之眾。吳人蘇代領長沙太守，貝羽為華容長，各阻兵作亂。表初到，單馬入宜城，而延中廬人蒯良、蒯越、襄陽人蔡瑁與謀。表曰：「宗賊甚盛，而眾不附，袁術因之，禍今至矣！吾欲徵兵，恐不集，其策安出？」良曰：「眾不附者，仁不足也，附而不治者，義不足也；苟仁義之道行，百姓歸之如水之趣下，何患所至之不從而問興兵與策乎？」表顧問越，越曰：「治平者先仁義，治亂者先權謀。兵不在多，在得人也。袁術勇而無斷，蘇代、貝羽皆武人，不足慮。宗賊帥多貪暴，為下所患。越有所素養者，使示之以利，必以眾來。君誅其無道，撫而用之。一州之人，有樂存之心，聞君盛德，必襁負而至矣。兵集眾附，南據江陵，北守襄陽，荊州八郡可傳檄而定。術等雖至，無能為也。」表曰：「子柔之言，雍季之論也。異度之計，臼犯之謀也。」遂使越遣人誘宗賊，至者五十五人，皆斬之。襲取其眾，或即授部曲。唯江夏賊張虎、陳生擁眾據襄陽，表乃使越與龐季單騎往說降之，江南遂悉平。













[77] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: [Liú] Biǎo answered [Dèng] Xī stating: “Inside not failing tribute duties, outside not turning back on the alliance leader, this is the attainment of righteousness Under Heaven. Why is the Manager Central alone bewildered?”



〔三〕　漢晉春秋曰：表答羲曰：「內不失貢職，外不背盟主，此天下之達義也。治中獨何怪乎？」













[78] Yīngxióng jì states: Zhāng Xiàn was a Nányáng man. First served as Línglíng and Guìyáng Chief, extremely obtained the hearts between the Jiāng and Xiāng, however by nature he was stubborn and not obedient. [Liú] Biǎo belittled his conduct as a man, and was not very courteous. [Zhāng] Xiàn because of this harbored a grudge, and therefore rebelled against [Liú] Biăo.



〔四〕　英雄記曰：張羨，南陽人。先作零陵、桂陽長，甚得江、湘間心，然性屈彊不順。表薄其為人，不甚禮也。羨由是懷恨，遂叛表焉。













[79] Yīngxióng jì states: When the various bandits in the provincial borders were thoroughly eliminated, [Liú] Biǎo then opened and established school officials, widely sought classicist servicemen, employed Qíwú Kǎi, Sòng Zhōng and others to compile section and phrase [commentaries] on the Five Classics,156 called as the Later Definitive.



〔五〕　英雄記曰：州界群寇既盡，表乃開立學官，博求儒士，使綦毋闓、宋忠等撰五經章句，謂之後定。







Tàizǔ and Yuán Shào were just locked together at Guāndù, [Yuán] Shào sent someone to request assistance, [Liú] Biǎo agreed to it but did not arrive, and also did not assist Tàizǔ, wishing to protect between the Jiāng and Hàn, observing the changes Under Heaven. Following Official Central Cadet Hán Sōng and Separate Carriage Liú Xiān advised [Liú] Biǎo stating: “Powerful figures are all competing, two heroes locked together, the weight of Heaven’s Under is on you General. General if you wish if you wish to take action, rising to take advantage of their exhaustion is possible. If not so, assuredly you must choose who to follow. General you gather multitudes of a hundred thousand, calmly sitting and watching. To see a worthy and yet be unable to assist, request peace but yet not obtain it, these two resentments will certainly gather upon you General, General you will not be able to stand in neutrality. With the enlightened wisdom of Cáo-gōng, the worthy and eminent Under Heaven all join him, he will certainly overcome Yuán Shào, and afterward turn troops to head toward the Jiāng and Hàn, and I fear General you will not be able to resist. Therefore in calculating for you General, it is not as good as leading the province to attach to Cáo-gōng, Cáo-gōng will certainly value your virtue General. Long enjoying fortunes and blessings, bequeathing it to your posterity successors, this is the strategy of total security.” [Liú] Biǎo’s chief officer Kuǎi Yuè also encouraged [Liú] Biǎo, [Liú] Biǎo was suspicioius, and so sent [Hán] Sōng to visit Tàizǔ to observe the false or true. [Hán] Sōng returned, deeply explained Tàizǔ’s authority and virtue, advising [Liú] Biǎo to send a son to enter as hostage. [Liú] Biǎo suspected [Hán] Sōng had turned and speaking on behalf of Tàizǔ, was greatly furious, wished to kill [Hán] Sōng, tortured and killed those that had accopanyied [Hán] Sōng on the journey, became aware [Hán] Sōng was without ulterior intentions, and so stopped. [80] Although [Liú] Biǎo outside appeared scholarly and refined, yet his heart had many suspicions and distrust, all of this sort.



太祖與袁紹方相持于官渡，紹遣人求助，表許之而不至，亦不佐太祖，欲保江漢間，觀天下變。從事中郎韓嵩、別駕劉先說表曰：「豪傑並爭，兩雄相持，天下之重，在於將軍。將軍若欲有為，起乘其弊可也；若不然，固將擇所從。將軍擁十萬之眾，安坐而觀望。夫見賢而不能助，請和而不得，此兩怨必集於將軍，將軍不得中立矣。夫以曹公之明哲，天下賢俊皆歸之，其勢必舉袁紹，然後稱兵以向江漢，恐將軍不能禦也。故為將軍計者，不若舉州以附曹公，曹公必重德將軍；長享福祚，垂之後嗣，此萬全之策也。」表大將蒯越亦勸表，表狐疑，乃遣嵩詣太祖以觀虛實。嵩還，深陳太祖威德，說表遣子入質。表疑嵩反為太祖說，大怒，欲殺嵩，考殺隨嵩行者，知嵩無他意，乃止。〔一〕表雖外貌儒雅，而心多疑忌，皆此類也。










[80] Fù-zǐ states: Previously [Liú] Biǎo spoke to [Hán] Sōng stating: “Now Heaven’s Under is in great choas, unknown how it will be settled, Cáo-Gōng holds Heaven’s Son with capital at Xǔ, for me you will watch for their vulnerabilities.” [Hán] Sōng replied stating: “Sages attain integrity, the next maintain integrity. [I, Hán] Sōng am one who maintains integrity. In serving a lord as a lord, the names of lord and servant are settled, and maintained to the death. Now I have registered name and entrusted hostage, only commanded by you General, even plunging into boiling water and stepping into fire, I would die without refusal. with [me, Hán] Sōng observing it, Cáo-Gōng is of utmost enlightenment, and will certainly rescue Heaven’s Under. General if you are able to above obey Heaven’s Son, below submit to Cáo-gōng, you will certainly enjoy benefits for a hundred generations, Chǔ state will truly receive the blessings, and sending [me, Hán] Sōng is permissible. If your calculations are not settled, and [I, Hán] Sōng am sent to the capital region, and Heaven’s Son lends [me, Hán] Sōng one official rank, then I will be a servant of Heaven’s Son, and only a former clerk to you General. With a lord as a lord, then [I, Hán] Sōng will maintain the commands of Heaven’s Son, and by righteousness no longer able to die for you General. May you General heavily consider, and not betray [me, Hán] Sōng.” [Liú] Biǎo therefore sent him, and indeed it was as he said, Heaven’s Son appointed [Hán] Sōng as Atendant Central, promoted to Línglíng Administrator, returned and praised the virtues of the Court and Cáo-gōng. [Liú] Biǎo believed him harboring treachery, greatly gathered his officials and associates of several hundred men, arrayed troops to meet [Hán] Sōng, was overwhelmingly furious, held Stave and about to behead him, repeatedly stating: “Hán Sōng dares harbor treachery?” The multitudes were all afraid, and wished to make [Hán] Sōng apologize. [Hán] Sōng did not move, and spoke to [Liú] Biǎo stating: “General you betray [me, Hán] Sōng, [I, Hán] Sōng do not betray you General.” He completely explained his previous words. [Liú] Biǎo was furious without end, his wife Cài-shì remonstrated him stating: “Hán Sōng is looked toward by Chǔ state, moreover his words are upright, executing him is without justification.” [Liú] Biǎo thus did not execute but only imprisoned him.



〔一〕　傅子曰：初表謂嵩曰：「今天下大亂，未知所定，曹公擁天子都許，君為我觀其釁。」嵩對曰：「聖達節，次守節。嵩，守節者也。夫事君為君，君臣名定，以死守之；今策名委質，唯將軍所命，雖赴湯蹈火，死無辭也。以嵩觀之，曹公至明，必濟天下。將軍能上順天子，下歸曹公，必享百世之利，楚國實受其祐，使嵩可也；設計未定，嵩使京師，天子假嵩一官，則天子之臣，而將軍之故吏耳。在君為君，則嵩守天子之命，義不得復為將軍死也。唯將軍重思，無負嵩。」表遂使之，果如所言，天子拜嵩侍中，遷零陵太守，還稱朝廷、曹公之德也。表以為懷貳，大會寮屬數百人，陳兵見嵩，盛怒，持節將斬之，數曰：「韓嵩敢懷貳邪！」眾皆恐，欲令嵩謝。嵩不動，謂表曰：「將軍負嵩，嵩不負將軍！」具陳前言。表怒不已，其妻蔡氏諫之曰：「韓嵩，楚國之望也；且其言直，誅之無辭。」表乃弗誅而囚之。







Liú Bèi fled to [Liú] Biǎo, [Liú] Biǎo generously treated him, but could not employ him. [81] Jiàn’ān Thirteenth Year [208], Tàizǔ campaigned against [Liú] Biǎo, had not yet arrived, [Liú] Biǎo fell ill and died.



劉備奔表，表厚待之，然不能用。〔一〕建安十三年，太祖征表，未至，表病死。










[81] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: When Tàizǔ first campaigned against Liǔchéng, Liú Bèi advised [Liú] Biǎo to send him to surprise attack Xǔ, [Liú] Biǎo did not follow this. When Tàizǔ returned, [Liú Biǎo] spoke to [Liú] Bèi stating: “I did not employ your advice, and therefore lost this great opportunity.” [Liú] Bèi said: “Now Heaven’s Under is divided apart, every day seeking shields and spears, the coming of opportunities, how can there be a final end? If one is able to answer them in the future, then this is not enough to be a regret.”



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：太祖之始征柳城，劉備說表使襲許，表不從。及太祖還，謂備曰：「不用君言，故失此大會也。」備曰：「今天下分裂，日尋干戈，事會之來，豈有終極乎？若能應之於後者，則此未足為恨也。」






Sons Qí, Cóng


Previously, [Liú] Biǎo and his wife favored the youngest son [Liú] Cóng, wishing to have him be his posterity, and further Cài Mào and Zhāng Yǔn were his branch faction, and so sent out the eldest son [Liú] Qí as Jiāngxià Administrator, the multitudes therefore supported [Liú] Cóng as the successor. [Liú] Qí with [Liú] Cóng therefore became feuding enemies. [82] [Kuǎi] Yuè, [Hán] Sōng, with East Department Assistant Fù Xùn and others persuaded [Liú] Cóng to submit to Tàizǔ, [Liú] Cóng said: “Now with you sirs I occupy all the lands of Chǔ, maintain my late father’s enterprise, to watch Heaven’s Under, why would this not be possible?” [Fù] Xùn replied stating: “Defiance and obeidence have an overall situation, strength and weakness have settled momentum. To as a servant of men refuse the ruler of men is defiance. To with the newly established Chǔ yet resist the country, its momentum is no match. To use Liú Bèi to yet resist Cáo-gōng, also is no match. These three are all shortcomings, to wish to resist the spearpoints of the ruler’s troops, is a path to certain destruction. General, how do you estimate yourself compared to Liú Bèi?” [Liú] Cóng said: “I do not compare.” [Fù] Xùn said: “Truly if Liú Bèi is not enough to resist Cáo-gōng, then even protecting the lands of Chǔ is not enough to save yourself. Truly if Liú Bèi is enough to resist Cáo-gōng, then [Liú] Bèi will not subordinate himself to you General. May you General not doubt.” Tàizǔ’s army arrived at Xiāngyáng, [Liú] Cóng led the province to surrender. [Liú] Bèi ran and fled to Xiàkǒu. [83]



初，表及妻愛少子琮，欲以為後，而蔡瑁、張允為之支黨，乃出長子琦為江夏太守，眾遂奉琮為嗣。琦與琮遂為讎隙。〔一〕越、嵩及東曹掾傅巽等說琮歸太祖，琮曰：「今與諸君據全楚之地，守先君之業，以觀天下，何為不可乎？」巽對曰：「逆順有大體，彊弱有定勢。以人臣而拒人主，逆也；以新造之楚而禦國家，其勢弗當也；以劉備而敵曹公，又弗當也。三者皆短，欲以抗王兵之鋒，必亡之道也。將軍自料何與劉備？」琮曰：「吾不若也。」巽曰：「誠以劉備不足禦曹公乎，則雖保楚之地，不足以自存也；誠以劉備足禦曹公乎，則備不為將軍下也。願將軍勿疑。」太祖軍到襄陽，琮舉州降。備走奔夏口。〔二〕










[82] Diǎnlüè states: [Liú] Biǎo was ill, [Liú] Qí returned to check on the illness. [Liú] Qí by nature was compassionate and filial, [Cài] Mào and [Zhāng] Yǔn feared if [Liú] Qí met [Liú] Biǎo, father and son would emotionally move one another, and again there would be an intention to entrust him as posterity, and spoke stating: “The General ordered you to succor and oversee Jiāngxià, to be the state’s eastern screen, this appointment is of utmost importance. Now to leave the multitudes and come, you will certainly meet with reprimand and anger. To wound the pleased heart of your parent and aggravate his illness is not filial respect.” Therefore they restrained him outside the doors, to cause him to be unable to meet, [Liú] Qí shed tears and left.



〔一〕　典略曰：表疾病，琦還省疾。琦性慈孝，瑁、允恐琦見表，父子相感，更有託後之意，謂曰：「將軍命君撫臨江夏，為國東藩，其任至重；今釋眾而來，必見譴怒，傷親之歡心以增其疾，非孝敬也。」遂遏于戶外，使不得見，琦流涕而去。













[83] Fù-zǐ states: [Fù] Xùn appellation Gōngtì was extraordinarily magnificent and broadly perceptive, had discernment in understanding men. Recruited to the Excellency’s Offices, appointed Secretariat Writer Cadet, later was a guest in Jīng Province, for the achievement of persuading Liú Cóng, bestowed noble title as Marquess Within the Passes. In Emperor Wén’s time became Attendnat Central, during Tàihé [227 - 232] died. When [Fù] Xùn was at Jīng Province, he catalogued Páng Tǒng as a Half Hero and certified that Péi Qián in the end for his pure conduct would be prominent. [Páng] Tǒng then attached to Liú Bèi, met with treatment next aftr Zhūgě Liàng, [Péi] Qián’s position reached Secretariat Writers Director, both having fame and virtue. Reaching to when he was at the Wèi Court, Wèi Fěng for talent and intelligence was famed, [Fù] Xùn said he would certainly rebel, in the end it was as he said.
[Fù] Xùn’s younger brother’s son [Fù] Gǔ separately has a biography.
Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Wáng Wēi advised Liú Cóng stating: “When Cáo Cāo receives your surrender, with Liú Bèi already fleeing, he will certainly slacken and be without preparations, recklessly travel and alone advance. If you give [me, Wáng] Wēi surprise troops of several thousand, intercepting them at rugged terrain, [Cáo] Cāo can be captured. Capturing [Cáo] Cāo then your power will shake Heaven’s Under, seated and yet a tiger pouncing, though the central Xià is wide, it can be settled by spreading proclamations, not merely the achievement of collecting one victory or maintaining today and nothing more. This is a difficult to encounter opportunity and cannot be missed.” [Liú] Cóng did not accept.
Sōushénjì states: At Jiàn’ān’s beginning, a Jīng Province children’s rhyme stated: “Within the Eighth to Ninth Year beginning to decline, reaching the Thirteenth Year no remnants left.” It said that since Zhōngpíng [184 - 189] onward, Jīng Province alone was preserved, reaching to Liú Biǎo becoming Governor, the people also were prosperous and happy, reaching Jiàn’ān Eighth Year and Ninth Year there would be the beginning of decline. The beginning of decline was speaking of Liú Biǎo’s wife dying and his various officers all scattering. Thirteenth Year no remnants left was that [Liú] Biǎo would also die, and defeat due to the mourning. At the time, Huáróng157 had a women suddenly wail and shout saying “Jīng Province will have great mourning.” The speech was out of the ordinary, the county believed it witch talk, bound her in prison for over a moon, suddenly in the prison she wept and said: “Liú Jīngzhōu158 today died.” Huáróng from the provincial [seat] was several hundred lǐ, at once sent horse and clerk to check and see, and Liú Biǎo indeed died, the county thus released her. Continuing she also sang aloud stating: “Unexpectedly Lǐ Lì becomes a man of nobility.” Later very soon Tàizǔ pacified Jīng Province, appointing Zhuō prefecture’s Lǐ Lì appellation Jiànxián as Jīng Province Inspector.



〔二〕　傅子曰：巽子公悌，瑰偉博達，有知人鑒。辟公府，拜尚書郎，後客荊州，以說劉琮之功，賜爵關內侯。文帝時為侍中，太和中卒，巽在荊州，目龐統為半英雄，證裴潛終以清行顯；統遂附劉備，見待次于諸葛亮，潛位至尚書令，並有名德。及在魏朝，魏諷以才智聞，巽謂之必反，卒如其言。巽弟子嘏，別有傳。漢晉春秋曰：王威說劉琮曰：「曹操得將軍既降，劉備已走，必解弛無備，輕行單進；若給威奇兵數千，徼之於險，操可獲也。獲操即威震天下，坐而虎步，中夏雖廣，可傳檄而定，非徒收一勝之功，保守今日而已。此難遇之機，不可失也。」琮不納。搜神記曰：建安初，荊州童謠曰：「八九年間始欲衰，至十三年無孑遺。」言自（中興）〔中平〕以來，荊州獨全，及劉表為牧，民又豐樂，至建安八年九年當始衰。始衰者，謂劉表妻死，諸將並零落也。十三年無孑遺者，表當又死，因以喪破也。是時，華容有女子忽啼呼云：「荊州將有大喪。」言語過差，縣以為妖言，繫獄月餘，忽于獄中哭曰：「劉荊州今日死。」華谷去州數百里，即遣馬吏驗視，而劉表果死，縣乃出之。續又歌吟曰：「不意李立為貴人。」後無幾，太祖平荊州，以涿郡李立字建賢為荊州刺史。







Tàizǔ appoitned [Liú] Cóng as Qīng Province Inspector, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess. [84] Kuǎi Yuè and others that became Marquesses were fifteen men. [Kuǎi] Yuè became Minister of Staff,159 [85] [Hán] Sōng, Minister Herald160 [86] [Dèng] Xī, Attendant Central, [87] [Liú] Xiān, Secretariat Writers Director, of the rest many reached great office. [88]



太祖以琮為青州刺史、封列侯。〔一〕蒯越等侯者十五人。越為光祿勳；〔二〕嵩，大鴻臚；〔三〕羲，侍中；〔四〕先，尚書令；其餘多至大官。〔五〕










[84] Wèi Wǔ Gùshì records the Order stating: “Chǔ possessed the rugged terrain of the mountains and rivers of the Jiāng and Hàn, rear submitted and advancing borders, with Qín competing for dominance, Jīng Province then is its former territory. Liú Zhènnán161 for a long time employed its people. After his body perished, his various sons as a tripod stood, and although in the end it would be difficult to preserve, yet they could delay for days. Qīng Province Inspector [Liú] Cóng, heart lofty and will pure, wisdom deep and considerations wide, thought light of glory and heavy of righteousness, little of profits and much of virtue, dismisses the enterprise of ten thousand lǐ, disregards the multitudes of Three Armies, devoted to embodying the correct and upright, cherishes the acclaim of a good reputation, above glorifies the remnant dust of his late father, below seeks remaining blessings without decay. Bào Yǒng relinquishing Bìng Province and Dòu Róng departing five prefecutres are not enough to be a comparison. Although enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess and a position of an entire province, yet I regret his favor does not yet match his person, and recently there was a dispatch requesting to return [Qīng] Province. Although overseer inspectors are honored, the rank and salary are not superior. Now listen to what was requested, memorialize [Liú] Cóng as Remonstration Consultant Grandee, participating in military affairs.”



〔一〕　魏武故事載令曰：「楚有江、漢山川之險，後服先疆，與秦爭衡，荊州則其故地。劉鎮南久用其民矣。身沒之後，諸子鼎峙，雖終難全，猶可引日。青州刺史琮，心高志潔，智深慮廣，輕榮重義，薄利厚德，蔑萬里之業，忽三軍之眾，篤中正之體，教令名之譽，上耀先君之遺塵，下圖不朽之餘祚；鮑永之棄并州，竇融之離五郡，未足以喻也。雖封列侯一州之位，猶恨此寵未副其人；而比有牋求還州。監史雖尊，秩祿未優。今聽所執，表琮為諫議大夫，參同軍事。」













[85] Fù-zǐ states: [Kuǎi] Yuè was Kuǎi Tōng’s posterity, deeply profound and amply wise, exceptionally distinguished and having heroic appearance. General-in-Chief Hé Jìn heard of his reputation, recruited him as East Department Assistant. [Kuǎi] Yuè urged [Hé] Jìn to execute the various castrate officials, [Hé] Jìn hesitated and was undecided. [Kuǎi] Yuè knew [Hé] Jìn would certainly be defeated, requested to be sent out as Rǔyáng Magistrate,162 aided Liú Biǎo in pacifying and settling within the borders, [Liú] Biǎo was able to become strong and great. Edict letter appointed him Zhānglíng Administrator,163 enfeoffed Marquess of Fán precinct. When Jīng Province was pacified, Tàizǔ’s letter to Xún Yù stated: “I am not pleased to obtain Jīng Province, I am merely pleased to obtain Kuǎi Yìdù.” Jiàn’ān Nineteenth Year [214] died. Facing his end, he wrote a letter to Tàizǔ, entrusting his family. Tàizǔ’s reply letter stated: “If the dead could return to life, the living would not be shamed [to face them]. Of the nominations I made in my youth, those that fulfilled them were many. If the soul has awareness, it also will hear these words of mine.”



〔二〕　傅子曰：越，蒯通之後也，深中足智，魁傑有雄姿。大將軍何進聞其名，辟為東曹掾。越勸進誅諸閹官，進猶豫不決。越知進必敗，求出為汝陽令，佐劉表平定境內，表得以彊大。詔書拜章陵太守，封樊亭侯。荊州平，太祖與荀彧書曰：「不喜得荊州，喜得蒯異度耳。」建安十九年卒。臨終，與太祖書，託以門戶。太祖報書曰：「死者反生，生者不愧。孤少所舉，行之多矣。魂而有靈，亦將聞孤此言也。」













[86] Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Hán] Sōng appellation Dégāo was a Yìyáng man. In youth enjoyed study, was poor but did not change his principles, knew the world was about to be in chaos, did not answer the recruitments of the Three Excellencies, with the like-minded of several men resided in seclusion in Lì’s west’s mountains.164 The Huángjīn rose, [Hán] Sōng avoided the troubles in the south, Liú Biǎo pressured him to become Separate Carriage, transferred to Following Official Central Cadet. [Liú] Biǎo performed Suburb Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, [Hán] Sōng’s upright remonstrations were not followed,165 gradually met with estrangement. Served as envoy to arrive at Xǔ, the matter is in a previous annotation. When Jīng Province was pacified, [Hán] Sōng was ill, and received the appointment and conferment of the Minister Herald’s seal and ribbon where he was.



〔三〕　先賢行狀曰：嵩字德高，義陽人。少好學，貧不改操。知世將亂，不應三公之命，與同好數人隱居于酈西山中。黃巾起，嵩避難南方，劉表逼以為別駕，轉從事中郎。表郊祀天地，嵩正諫不從，漸見違忤。奉使到許，事在前注。荊州平，嵩疾病，就在所拜授大鴻臚印綬。













[87] [Dèng] Xī was a Zhānglíng man.



〔四〕　羲，章陵人。













[88] Línglíng Xiānxián zhuàn states: [Liú] Xiān appellation Shǐzōng was widely learned with strong memory, particularly enjoyed Huáng-Lǎo teachings, understood and experienced in Hàn dynasty canon and precedents. Became [Liú] Biǎo’s Separate Carriage, presented a Reply to visit Xǔ, met Tàizǔ. At the time guest retainers were all gathered, Tàizǔ asked [Liú] Xiān: “Why did Governor Liú perform Suburb [Sacrficies] to Heaven?” [Liú] Xiān replied stating: “Governor Liú is entrusted as the Hàn House’s lungs and bowels, occupies position as Governor Senior, but encountered the King’s Way not yet pacified, crowds of the vicious blocking the roads, held jade and silk but nowhere to send embassy, drafted Reply Memorials but could not reach the government, therefore Suburb to Heaven and Sacrifices to Earth, to openly declare red sincerity.” Tàizǔ said: “Who are the crowds of the vicious?” [Liú] Xiān said: “Everywhere one looks.” Tàizǔ said: “Now I have servicemen of bears,166 infantry and cavalry a hundred thousand, serve command to cut down the guilty, who dares not submit?” [Liú] Xiān said: “Hàn’s Way has declined, the crowds of living worn and haggard, If you are without servicemen of loyalty and righteousness, to assist and support Heaven’s Son, soothe and calm Within the Seas, to cause myriad countries to submit to virtue, but instead rely on troops and tolerate cruelty, stating ‘none compare to me,’ it is Chīyóu and Zhì Bó again seen in the present.” Tàizǔ was silent. Appointed [Liú] Xiān as Wǔlíng Administrator. When Jīng Province was pacified, [Liú] Xiān first was a Hàn Secretariat Writer, later became Wèi state Secretariat Writers Director.
[Liú] Xiān’s sister’s son the same prefecture’s Zhōu Bùyí appellation Yuánzhí was a Línglíng man. Xiānxián Zhuàn says [Zhōu] Bùyí in childhood had unusual talent, intelligent and quick-witted, Tàizǔ wished to have a daughter be his wife, [Zhōu] Bùyí did not dare accept. Tàizǔ’s favorite son [Cáo Chōng] Cāngshū was early to have talent and wisdom, said that he could a peer to [Zhōu] Bùyí. When Cāngshū died, Tàizǔ in his heart feared [Zhōu] Bùyí, wished to eliminate him. Emperor Wén remonstrated believing it should not be done, Tàizǔ said: “This man is not someone you can control.” Thus sent an assassin to kill him. Zhì Yú’s Wénzhāng zhì states: When [Zhōu] Bùyí died his age was seventeen, had written essays and discourses of four.
Shìyǔ states: After [Liú] Biǎo had died for over eighty years, reaching to during Jìn’s Tàikāng, [Liú] Biǎo’s burial mound met with excavation. [Liú] Biǎo and his wife in bodily appearance was as if alive, fragrance could be smelled for several lǐ.



〔五〕　零陵先賢傳曰：先字始宗，博學彊記，尤好黃老言，明習漢家典故。為劉表別駕，奉章詣許，見太祖。時賓客並會，太祖問先：「劉牧如何郊天也？」先對曰：「劉牧託漢室肺腑，處牧伯之位，而遭王道未平，群凶塞路，抱玉帛而無所聘頫，修章表而不獲達御，是以郊天祀地，昭告赤誠。」太祖曰：「群凶為誰？」先曰：「舉目皆是。」太祖曰：「今孤有熊羆之士，步騎十萬，奉辭伐罪，誰敢不服？」先曰：「漢道陵遲，群生憔悴，既無忠義之士，翼戴天子，綏寧海內，使萬邦歸德，而阻兵安忍，曰莫己若，既蚩尤、智伯復見于今也。」太祖嘿然。拜先武陵太守。荊州平，先始為漢尚書，後為魏國尚書令。先甥同郡周不疑，字元直，零陵人。先賢傳稱不疑幼有異才，聰明敏達，太祖欲以女妻之，不疑不敢當。太祖愛子倉舒，夙有才智，謂可與不疑為儔。及倉舒卒，太祖心忌不疑，欲除之。文帝諫以為不可，太祖曰：「此人非汝所能駕御也。」乃遣刺客殺之。摯虞文章志曰：不疑死時年十七，著文論四首。世語曰：表死後八十餘年，至晉太康中，表冢見發。表及妻身形如生，芬香聞數里。
crumbs: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú

title: 6  Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú
text:
Appraisal


Appraisal states: Dǒng Zhuó was wolf in ruthlessness and bandit in cruelty, violent and oppressive without benevolence, from since written history onward, probably there has never been anything like him. [89] Yuán Shù was extravagant and depraved and unrestrained in indulgences, that his glory did not last to his end, he brought on himself. [90] Yuán Shào and Liú Biǎo, both had imposing presence and appearance of capacity, famed reputation in their era. [Liú] Biǎo strode and tread the Hàn’s south, [Yuán] Shào falcon soared the Hé’s north, however both were outwardly tolerant but inside jealous, enjoyed planning without decisiveness, had talents but could not employ them, heard good advice but could not accept them, deposed the legitimate to establish the lesser [son as heir], abandoned propriety to esteem favoritism, leading to their posterity successors to topple into ruin, their State Altars to be overturned, it was not by misfortune. In the past Xiàng Yǔ turned back on Fàn Zēng’s planning, and so ruined his King’s enterprise. [Yuán] Shào’s killing of Tián Fēng then was more extreme than [Xiàng] Yǔ by far.



評曰：董卓狼戾賊忍，暴虐不仁，自書契已來，殆未之有也〔一〕。袁術奢淫放肆，榮不終己，自取之也。〔二〕袁紹、劉表，咸有威容、器觀，知名當世。表跨蹈漢南，紹鷹揚河朔，然皆外寬內忌，好謀無決，有才而不能用，聞善而不能納，廢嫡立庶，舍禮崇愛，至于後嗣顛蹙，社稷傾覆，非不幸也。昔項羽背范增之謀，以喪其王業；紹之殺田豐，乃甚於羽遠矣！










[89] Yīngxióngjì states: In the past giants were seen at Líntáo and so the Bronze Men were cast. Líntáo produced [Dǒng] Zhuó and so the Bronze Men were destroyed. The world had [Dǒng] Zhuó and so great chaos was created, great chaos was created and so [Dǒng] Zhuó himself was exterminated. Surely there was a reason for this.



〔一〕　英雄記曰：昔大人見臨洮而銅人鑄，臨洮生卓而銅人毀；世有卓而大亂作，大亂作而卓身滅，抑有以也。













[90] Your Servant Sōngzhī believes Jié and Zhòu were without morality, Qín [Shǐhuáng] and [Wáng] Mǎng unleashed oppression, all had many successive years and only afterward was their multitudes of evils revealed. Dǒng Zhuó from when he stole the handles of power, reaching to his fall and death, calculating the days and moons, it did not even fill three years, and yet the disasters piled into mountains, the poisons flowed into the Four Seas. His nature as a destructive bandit, truly even jackals and wolves cannot compare. ‘Never been in written history,’ this speech is appropriate. However the appraisal already states ‘bandit cruelty,’ also says ‘without benevolence.’ Bandit cruelty and without benevolence is redundant phrasing. Yuán Shù was without a hair or tip of achievement or the slightest crevice of goodness, yet was wildly reckless in his time, absurdly honored and established himself, assuredly righteous men would wring their hands at him, men and spirits would alike abhor him. Even if he were respectful and frugal and limited in expenditure, yet he still would certainly be destroyed with no escape, but yet the appraisal merely says ‘extravagant and depraved’ and ‘not lasting to the end,’ it is not sufficient to show his great evil.



〔二〕　臣松之以為桀、紂無道，秦、莽縱虐，皆多歷年所，然後眾惡乃著。董卓自竊權柄，至于隕斃，計其日月，未盈三周，而禍崇山岳，毒流四海。其殘賊之性，寔豺狼不若。「書契未有」，斯言為當。但評既曰「賊忍」，又云「不仁」，賊忍，不仁，於辭為重。袁術無毫芒之功，纖介之善，而猖狂于時，妄自尊立，固義夫之所扼腕，人鬼之所同疾。雖復恭儉節用，而猶必覆亡不暇，而評但云「奢淫不終」，未足見其大惡。
