title: 7  Biographies of Lǚ Bù and Zāng Hóng
text:
There was no Nán county during Hàn. This may be an error for Shā’nán county in Yúnzhōng prefecture in Bìng Province.↩︎
Wēn county was in Hénèi prefecture.↩︎
The name can be interpreted as “Red Hare”↩︎
The term for maneuvering here is zònghéng, which can refer to the warp and weft in weaving, or vertical and horizontal. It came to refer to the School of Diplomacy during the Warring States period, in reference to the competing strategies of the ”horizontal” alliance with Qín or ”vertical” alliance against Qín.↩︎
A bell subordinate (língxià) was a type of subordinate, usually used for announcing visitors and messages with a bell.↩︎
Píngtáo county was in Tàiyuān prefecture.↩︎
Bannermen (huīxià) refered to the soldiers under the direct command of the army commander.↩︎
Superior (shàng) was a term for referring to an Emperor.↩︎
Based on records of other alcohol bans, this may have been due to rationing during food shortages or while under siege: grain used for alochol brewing was grain that was not being eaten.↩︎
Before his enthronment, Duke Huán of Qí was involved in a succession struggle with his brother. Guǎn Zhòng was a subordinate of his brother, and once shot an arrow that hit the hook of Duke Huán’s belt. Nevertheless, after his enthronment, Duke Huán forgave and employed Guǎn Zhòng due to Guǎn Zhòng’s great talent.↩︎
Inspectorship (shǐjūn) is the term of address for a provincial Governor or Inspector. At this time Liú Bèi claimed office as Inspector of Yù Province.↩︎
Inner refers to paternal same-surname kinship, outer to maternal different-surname kinship.↩︎
Dragging (jǐ) and horning (jiǎo) refer to the strategy of attacking the front and rear simultaneously, in the metaphor of engaging a beast’s horns at the front while dragging their legs from behind.↩︎
Dōngyáng county was in Guǎnglíng prefecture↩︎
Inspector of Treason (cìjiān) was an official in charge of detecting treachery and espionage.↩︎
Mǎ Yuán appellation Wényuān was a famed officer of early Later Hàn. He had previously held the rank of Subduing Waves General.↩︎
Counties with populations below ten thousand were headed by a Chief (zhǎng) instead of a Magistrate (lìng).↩︎
Jǔ county was in Lángyé prefecture.↩︎
Xiàyì county was in Liáng prefecture.↩︎
Zīqiū was in Péngchéng prefecture.↩︎
Jíqiū county was in Lángyé prefecture.↩︎
Lúnú county was in Zhōnghsān prefecture.↩︎
Xīyù zhuàn ”Biographies of the Western Regions” is a chapter in the Hàn shū.↩︎
Enlightened Office (míngfǔ) is a term of address for a prefecture Administrator (tàishǒu).↩︎
Zhāng Chāo’s elder brother Zhāng Miǎo was Administrator of Chénliú.↩︎
The term xiāo in this context refers to the punishment of cutting off and hanging up the head↩︎
Liú Dài appellation Gōngshān was Inspector of Yǎn Province (Yǎnzhōu).↩︎
Kǒng Zhòu appellation Gōngxù was Inspector of Yù Province (Yùzhōu).↩︎
The ritual involved smearing blood on the mouth.↩︎
Yǔn shǒu and sāng yuán are both terms for losing one’s head.↩︎
I think Chén Shòu had a sense of humor here.↩︎
“Mìng bù kě zhī” can also be translated as “his fate could not be known,” but I personally favor interpreting “mìng” as “command” as it ties into the previous statements on his skill in pure conversation inside but the total chaos outside.↩︎
Memorialized (biǎo) reflects the legal fiction that government appointments required approval by the Hàn Imperial Court. Legally speaking, the powerful warlords were ”memorializing recommendations to the Court” rather than appointing their subordinates to government positions.↩︎
Here the term qùshě can be understood as what one pursues (qù) and what one abandons (shě).↩︎
This refers to Chén Lín’s letter.↩︎
Side rooms (cèshì) can refer to one’s women and concubines.↩︎
This refers to Yuán Shào.↩︎
Zāng Hóng uses the first person pronoun pú, which can mean “servant.” The Japanese first person pronoun “boku” derives from this.↩︎
The phrase kòu qiè dà zhōu is also commonly interpreted as “bandits stealing a great province” in reference to the cause of the military campaign, but I prefer to interpret it as referring to Zāng Hóng’s tenure as Inspector of Qīng Province. The variant version of this letter in Hòu Hàn shū 58 supports this interpretation.↩︎
The danger of Yǒulǐ refers to the story that the future King Wén of Zhōu was imprisoned for seven years at Yǒulǐ.↩︎
Jì Zhá was a Spring and Autumn era son of the ruling family of Wú state. He famously refused the offered throne of Wú state.↩︎
Zǐqí seems to be a transcription error for Zǐhuáng. The corresponding Péi Sōngzhī annotation and the version of this letter in Hòu Hàn shū 58 both have Zǐhuáng instead of Zǐqí.↩︎
The term chéngzhì “carried regulations” refers to being granted authority by the ruler to act on the ruler’s behalf.↩︎
In the Spring and Autumn era, Shēn Bāoxū and Wǔ Yuán were friends from rival states. When Wǔ Yuán’s home state of Wú invaded Bāoxū’s home state of Chǔ, Shēn Bāoxū went to Qín state to beg for their assistance to rescue Chǔ.↩︎
Gōngsūn Zàn appellation Bóguī was the warlord to the north of Yuán Shào.↩︎
Zhāng Yáng was a warlord to the west of Yuán Shào. Zhāng Yàn was a bandit warlord also known as Fēi Yàn “Flying Swallow,” also to the west of Yuán Shào.↩︎
Legs and arms (gǔgōng) are a metaphor for trusted ministers and supporters.↩︎
The Hēishān “Black Mountain” were a bandit confederation to the west of Yuán Shào.↩︎
Péng Yuè was originally a bandit warlord during the collapse of Qín and rise of Former Hàn. Lùlín “Green Woods” was originally a bandit group during the Former Hàn-Xīn-Later Hàn transition period.↩︎
Zhāng Miǎo was Administrator of Chénliú.↩︎
Office Lord (fǔjūn) is a term of respect for an Administrator, in this case Zhāng Miǎo’s younger brother Zhāng Chāo, Administrator of Guǎnglíng.↩︎
Deputy (chéng) was an assistant to the Administrator of a prefecture.↩︎
Major (sīmǎ) was a chief of staff for military affairs used by higher ranking military officers.↩︎
Zhījǐ “know oneself” is a term for a true close friend who truly knows and understands you.↩︎
This is a quote from the Shàng Shū.↩︎

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text: Gōngsūn Zàn
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Gōngsūn Zàn appellation Bóguī was a Liáoxī Lìngzhī man. [1] He became a prefecture’s Below the Gates writing aide,1 had impressive appearance and loud voice, Administrator Hóu valued him, had a daughter be wife to him, [2] and sent him to visit Zhuō prefecture’s Lú Zhí to study the classics. Later he returned and became a prefecture clerk. Administrator Liú in connection to a matter was summoned to visit the Ministry of Justice, [Gōngsūn] Zàn was the chariot driver, personally working as an attendant. When Liú was exiled to Rìnán, [Gōngsūn] Zàn prepared rice and meat, at Běimáng’s top sacrificed to his ancestors, raised the goblet and praid stating: “In the past I was a man’s son, now I am a man’s servant, about to visit Rìnán. Rìnán has bad air, I fear perhaps I will not return, and will take leave of my ancestors from here.” He bowed twice and passionately rose, at the time of those that saw none did not sob. Liú on the road obtained pardon and returned. [Gōngsūn] Zàn as a Filial-Incorruptible became a Cadet,2 appointed Liáodōng Dependent State3 Chief Clerk. Once he with following several tens of cavalry went out the frontier, encountered Xiānbēi of several hundred cavalry, [Gōngsūn] Zàn then withdrew and entered inside an empty station, made a pact with his following cavalry stating: “Now to not charge them, then is to completely die.” [Gōngsūn] Zàn then personally held lance, on both ends attached blades, galloped out to stab the Hú, killing and wounding several tens of men, also lost half of his following cavalry, and therefore was able to escape. The Xiānbēi were deterred, and later did not dare again enter the frontiers. Promoted to Zhuō Magistrate.4 During Guānghé, Liáng Province rebels rose up, mobilized Yōu Province charger cavalry of three thousand men, temporarily granted [Gōngsūn] Zàn Overall Supervisor Enacting Affairs credentials, sent to command them. The army arrived at Jìzhōng,5 Yúyáng’s Zhāng Chún enticed Liáoxī’s Wūhuán6 Qiūlìjū and others to rebel, rob and plunder Jìzhōng, declared himself a General, [3] captured clerks and civilians and attacked Yòuběipíng’s and Liáoxī Dependent State’s various cities, wherever he arrived as ruined and broken. [Gōngsūn] Zàn commanded those he managed, pursued and suppressed [Zhāng] Chún and the rest and had achievements, promoted to Cavalry Commandant. Dependent State Wūhuán Tānzhìwáng led his tribesmen to visit [Gōngsūn] Zàn to surrender. Promoted to Central Cadet General, enfeoffed a city precinct Marquess, advanced to garrison the Dependent State, with the Hú attacking and striking one another for five to six years. Qiūlìjū and others plundered and raided Qīng, Xú, Yōu, Jì, four provinces were harmed, [Gōngsūn] Zàn could not resist.



公孫瓚字伯珪，遼西令支人也。〔一〕為郡門下書佐。有姿儀，大音聲，侯太守器之，以女妻焉，〔二〕遣詣涿郡盧植讀經。後復為郡吏。劉太守坐事徵詣廷尉，瓚為御車，身執徒養。及劉徙日南，瓚具米肉，於北芒上祭先人，舉觴祝曰：「昔為人子，今為人臣，當詣日南。日南瘴氣，或恐不還，與先人辭於此。」再拜慷慨而起，時見者莫不歔欷。劉道得赦還。瓚以孝廉為郎，除遼東屬國長史。嘗從數十騎出行塞，見鮮卑數百騎，瓚乃退入空亭中，約其從騎曰：「今不衝之，則死盡矣。」瓚乃自持矛，兩頭施刃，馳出刺胡，殺傷數十人，亦亡其從騎半，遂得免。鮮卑懲艾，後不敢復入塞。遷為涿令。光和中，涼州賊起，發幽州突騎三千人，假瓚都督行事傳，使將之。軍到薊中，漁陽張純誘遼西烏丸丘力居等叛，劫略薊中，自號將軍，〔三〕略吏民攻右北平、遼西屬國諸城，所至殘破。瓚將所領，追討純等有功，遷騎都尉。屬國烏丸貪至王率種人詣瓚降。遷中郎將，封都亭侯，進屯屬國，與胡相攻擊五六年。丘力居等鈔略青、徐、幽、冀，四州被其害，瓚不能禦。










[1] Lìng pronounced láng and dìng together. Zhī pronounced qí and ér together.



〔一〕　令音郎定反。支音其兒反。













[2] Diǎnlüè states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn by nature was eloquent and intelligent, every time in reporting a matter he was not willing to be tentative, always collectively explaining multiple department affairs, without any forgetting or errors, the Administrator was amazed with his talent.



〔二〕　典略曰：瓚性辯慧，每白事不肯梢入，常總說數曹事，無有忘誤，太守奇其才。













[3] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Zhāng] Chún declared himself Filling Heaven General, King of Āndìng.



〔三〕　九州春秋曰：純自號彌天將軍、安定王。






Liú Yú


The Court discussed believing: “Minister of the Imperial Clan7 Dōnghǎi’s Liú Bó’ān already possesses virtue and righteousness, in the past was Yōu Province Inspector, his grace and faith flowed widely, the Róng and Dí attached to him, if he is sent to defend and succor, without laboring the multitudes it can be settled.” Thus appointed Liú Yú as Yōu Province Governor. [4] [Liú] Yú arrived, sent envoy to reach among the Hú, announcing the benefits and harms, demanding they send [Zhāng] Chún’s head. Qiūlìjū and the rest heard that [Liú] Yú had arrived, were pleased, and each sent translators to on their own submit. [Gōngsūn] Zàn resented that [Liú] Yú had the achievement, and so secretly sent someone to intercept and kill the Hú envoys. The Hú knew the situation, and indirectly traveled to visit [Liú] Yú. [Liú] Yú sent up to dismiss the various garrison soldiers, only keeping [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s commanded infantry and cavalry of ten thousand men to garrison Yòuběipíng. [Zhāng] Chún then abandoned his wife and children, fled to enter among the Xiānbēi, and was by his retainer Wáng Zhèng killed, sent the head to [Liú] Yú. Enfeoffed [Wáng] Zhèng as a Ranked Marquess. [Liú] Yú for the achievement was immediately appointed Grand Commandant, enfeoffed Marquess of Xiāngbēn.8 [5] It happened that Dǒng Zhuó reached Luòyáng, promoted [Liú] Yú to Marshal-in-Chief, [Gōngsūn] Zàn to Exerting Warfare General and enfeoffed Marquess of Jì.



朝議以宗正東海劉伯安既有德義，昔為幽州刺史，恩信流著，戎狄附之，若使鎮撫，可不勞眾而定，乃以劉虞為幽州牧。〔一〕虞到，遣使至胡中，告以利害，責使送純首。丘力居等聞虞至，喜，各遣譯自歸。瓚害虞有功，乃陰使人徼殺胡使。胡知其情，閒行詣虞。虞上罷諸屯兵，但留瓚將步騎萬人屯右北平。純乃棄妻子，逃入鮮卑，為其客王政所殺，送首詣虞。封政為列侯。虞以功即拜太尉，封襄賁侯。〔二〕會董卓至洛陽，遷虞大司馬，瓚奮武將軍，封薊侯。










[4] Wú shū states: [Liú] Yú was a descendant of King Gōng of Dōnghǎi, encountered an era of decline and chaos, and also with the time’s ruler was very distantly related, served in the county as Households Department clerk. For his ability in managing himself and serving duties, summoned to be a prefecture clerk, as a Filial-Incorruptible became a Cadet, eventually promoted to reach Yōu Province Inspector, transferred to Gānlíng Chancellor,9 extremely obtained the hearts of the eastern lands’ Róng and Dí. Later due to illness he returned home, always humbling himself and living unobtrusively, with those of his town and community sharing in joys and sorrows, treating equally those with and without, and did not for his fame and position distinguish himself, the village community all together revered him. At the time when the village community had a law dispute, they did not visit the clerks, but personally went to [Liú] Yú to judge it. [Liú] Yú by the circumstances and reason for them discussed and judged, all large or small respectfully followed, and were not resentful. Once there was someone who lost an ox, in bone and body and fur color resembled [Liú] Yú’s ox and therefore believed it was his, [Liú] Yú immediately yielded and gave it to him. Later the owner himself obtained the original ox, and then returned and apologized for the offense. It happened that Gānlíng was again in chaos, the clerks and civilians remembered [Liú] Yú’s governance and conduct, again he became Gānlíng Chancellor, Gānlíng was greatly governed. Summoned and appointed Secretariat Writers Director, Minister of Staff,10 and as a member of the Ruling Clan with courtesy, he further became Minister of the Imperial Clan.
Yīngxióng jì states: [Liú] Yú became Bópíng Magistrate,11 governance upright and extended fairness, lofty and esteemed, pure and unadorned, within the borders without robbers and bandits, calamities did not appear. At the time in neighboring counties that shared a border, locusts did harm, on reaching Bópíng’s border, flew past and did not enter.
Wèi shū states: [Liú] Yú in Yōu Province was pure and quiet, frugal and restrained, used ritual and righteousness to influence the people. In Emperor Líng’s time, the South Palace burned down, clerks sent to fill vacancies in the provinces and prefectures were all required to contribute cash for repairs of the Palace, some ten million, some twenty million, the rich used private wealth to settle it, some extracted the people’s cash to provide it, the poor that were pure and conscientious had no way to meet the requirements, some going as far as to kill themselves. Emperor Líng because [Liú] Yú was pure and poor, specially did not have him send cash.



〔一〕　吳書曰：虞，東海恭王之後也。遭世衰亂，又與時主疏遠，仕縣為戶曹吏。以能治身奉職，召為郡吏，以孝廉為郎，累遷至幽州刺史，轉甘陵相，甚得東土戎狄之心。後以疾歸家，常降身隱約，與邑黨州閭同樂共卹，等齊有無，不以名位自殊，鄉曲咸共宗之。時鄉曲有所訴訟，不以詣吏，自投虞平之；虞以情理為之論判，皆大小敬從，不以為恨。嘗有失牛者，骨體毛色，與虞牛相似，因以為是，虞便推與之；後主自得本牛，乃還謝罪。會甘陵復亂，吏民思虞治行，復以為甘陵相，甘陵大治。徵拜尚書令、光祿勳，以公族有禮，更為宗正。英雄記曰：虞為博平令，治正推平，高尚純樸，境內無盜賊，災害不生。時鄰縣接壤，蝗蟲為害，至博平界，飛過不入。魏書曰：虞在幽州，清靜儉約，以禮義化民。靈帝時，南宮災，吏遷補州郡者，皆責助治宮錢，或一千萬，或二千萬，富者以私財辨，或發民錢以備之，貧而清慎者，無以充調，或至自殺。靈帝以虞清貧，特不使出錢。













[5] Yīngxióng jì states: [Liú] Yú declined the Grand Commandant office, took advantage to recommend Minister of the Guard12 Zhào Mó, Yì Province Governor Liú Yān, Yù Province Governor Huáng Wǎn, Nányáng Administrator Yáng Xù, all were appointed as Excellencies.



〔二〕　英雄記曰：虞讓太尉，因薦衛尉趙謨、益州牧劉焉、豫州牧黃琬、南陽太守羊續，並任為公。







East of the passes Righteous Troops rose up, [Dǒng] Zhuó therefore seized the Emperor to relocate west, summoned [Liú] Yú as Grand Tutor, the roads were blocked, the letter of appointment was unable to reach. Yuán Shào and Hán Fù discussed, believing: “The Young Emperor is controlled by a Traitor Minister, Heaven’s Under has nowhere to devote heart. [Liú] Yú is of the Imperial Clan and famed, who the people look toward.” Therefore nominated [Liú] Yú to be Emperor. Sent envoy to visit [Liú] Yú, [Liú] Yú to the end would not agree to accept. [Yuán] Shào and the rest further urged [Liú] Yú to manage Secretariat Writer affairs, to undertake authority to enfeoff and appoint,13 [Liú] Yú also did not listen, however he yet with [Yuán] Shào and the rest joined in alliance. [6] [Liú] Yú’s son [Liú] Hé was Attendant Central, at Cháng’ān. Heaven’s Son thought of returning east, sent [Liú] Hé to pretend to escape from [Dǒng] Zhuó, secretly sent out Wǔ Pass to visit [Liú] Yú, to have him lead troops to come welcome. [Liú] Hé on the road passed Yuán Shù, and explained Heaven’s Son’s intentions. [Yuán] Shù thought it advantageous to have [Liú] Yú be an assistance, detained [Liú] Hé and did not send him, promising when troops arrive they would together go west, having [Liú] Hé make a letter to [Liú] Yú. [Liú] Yú obtained [Liú] Hé’s letter, and so sent several thousand cavalry to visit [Liú] Hé. [Gōngsūn] Zàn knew [Yuán] Shù had ulterior ambitions, did not wish to send troops, stopped [Liú] Yú, [Liú] Yú did not agree. [Gōngsūn] Zàn feared [Yuán] Shù would hear and resent him, and also sent his younger cousin [Gōngsūn] Yuè to command a thousand cavalry to visit [Yuán] Shù to himself join alliance, and secretly instruct [Yuán] Shù to seize [Liú] Hé and take away his troops. Because of this [Liú] Yú and [Gōngsūn] Zàn increasingly had discord. [Liú] Hé escaped [Yuán] Shù and came north, and again was by [Yuán] Shào detained.



關東義兵起，卓遂劫帝西遷，徵虞為太傅，道路隔塞，信命不得至。袁紹、韓馥議，以為少帝制於姦臣，天下無所歸心。虞，宗室知名，民之望也，遂推虞為帝。遣使詣虞，虞終不肯受。紹等復勸虞領尚書事，承制封拜，虞又不聽，然猶與紹等連和。〔一〕虞子和為侍中，在長安。天子思東歸，使和偽逃卓，潛出武關詣虞，令將兵來迎。和道經袁術，為說天子意。術利虞為援，留和不遣，許兵至俱西，令和為書與虞。虞得和書，乃遣數千騎詣和。瓚知術有異志，不欲遣兵，止虞，虞不可。瓚懼術聞而怨之，亦遣其從弟越將千騎詣術以自結，而陰教術執和，奪其兵。由是虞、瓚益有隙。和逃術來北，復為紹所留。










[6] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shào and [Hán] Fù sent former Lèláng Administrator Gānlíng’s Zhāng Qí to present the discussions to [Liú] Yú, to have him accept the Honored Title. [Liú] Yú in stern voice rebuked [Zhāng] Qí stating: “How dare you produce these words? The way of loyalty and filial piety I already have been unable to reach. I received the state’s favor, Heaven’s Under is disturbed in chaos, I have been unable to devote my life to eliminate the state’s humilation, look to the various provinces and prefectures’ servicemen of ardent righteousness to join forces to face west, to aid and welcome the young Ruler, but yet you then recklessly devise a rebellious plot, do you wish to smear and defile a loyal minister?”
Wú shū states: [Hán] Fù sent a letter to Yuán Shù that said: “The Emperor is not Xiào-Líng’s son.14 We wish to comply with the precedent of Jiàng and Guàn executing and deposing the Young Ruler and welcoming and establishing the King of Dài.15 In praise of [Liú] Yú’s achievements and virtue, governance and conduct, in the Huáxià few compare, right now of the Ruling House branch associates, of all none are able to reach him.” It also said: “In the past Guāng-Wǔ from King Dìng was five generations, as Marshal-in-Chief he managed the Hé’s north, Gěng Yǎn and Féng Yì urged him to accept the Honored Title, and in the end he replaced Gēngshǐ.16 Now Liú-gōng from King Gōng’s branch, its count is also five, as Marshal-in-Chief he manages as Yōu Province Governor, this is to be the same as Guāng-Wǔ.” At the time there were four stars converging at Jīwěi, [Hán] Fù claimed a prophecy said a divine man would appear in Yān’s allocation. Also reported that Jǐyīn man Wáng Dìng found a jade seal, the inscription stating: “Expectation of Heaven’s Son.”17 Also sighting of two sons appearing in Dài prefecture, saying Yú should replace and be established.18 [Yuán] Shào also separately wrote letter to inform [Yuán] Shù. At the time [Yuán] Shù secretly had a heart to not be a servant, believed it not advantageous for the country to have a mature ruler, and outside claimed public righteousness to answer and refuse them. [Yuán] Shào also sent someone to secretly inform [Liú] Yú. [Liú] Yú believed the state had a legitimate lineage, it was not what servants of men should discuss, firmly declined and would not agree, and so wished to plan to flee to the Xiōngnú to sever himself, [Yuán] Shào and the rest thus stopped. [Liú] Yú thereupon served duties and prepared tribute, and was increasingly respectful and solemn. The various outer states of Qiāng and Hú had tribute to proffer, the roads could not be connected, all he passed on and delivered to the capital.



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：紹、馥使故樂浪太守甘陵張岐齎議詣虞，使即尊號。虞厲聲呵岐曰：「卿敢出此言乎！忠孝之道，既不能濟。孤受國恩，天下擾亂，未能竭命以除國恥，望諸州郡烈義之士戮力西面，援迎幼主，而乃妄造逆謀，欲塗污忠臣邪！」吳書曰：馥以書與袁術，云帝非孝靈子，欲依絳、灌誅廢少主，迎立代王故事；稱虞功德治行，華夏少二，當今公室枝屬，皆莫能及。又云：「昔光武去定王五世，以大司馬領河北，耿弇、馮異勸即尊號，卒代更始。今劉公自恭王枝別，其數亦五，以大司馬領幽州牧，此其與光武同。」是時有四星會于箕尾，馥稱讖云神人將在燕分。又言濟陰男子王定得玉印，文曰「虞為天子」。又見兩日出于代郡，謂虞當代立。紹又別書報術。是時術陰有不臣之心，不利國家有長主，外託公義以答拒之。紹亦使人私報虞，虞以國有正統，非人臣所宜言，固辭不許；乃欲圖奔匈奴以自絕，紹等乃止。虞於是奉職脩貢，愈益恭肅；諸外國羌、胡有所貢獻，道路不通，皆為傳送，致之京師。







At the time, [Yuán] Shù sent Sūn Jiān to garrison Yángchéng to resist [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Yuán] Shào sent Zhōu Áng to seize away his position.19 [Yuán] Shù sent [Gōngsūn] Yuè with [Sūn] Jiān to attack [Zhōu] Áng, was not successful, [Gōngsūn] Yuè was by a stray arrow hit and died. [Gōngsūn] Zàn angrily said: “My younger brother is dead, the disaster arose from [Yuán] Shào.” Therefore he sent out the army to garrison the Pán river,20 about to take revenge on [Yuán] Shào. [Yuán] Shào was afraid, and had his own girdled Bóhǎi Administrator seal and ribbon conferred on [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s younger cousin [Gōngsūn] Fàn, sent to the prefecture, wishing to by this secure an alliance. [Gōngsūn] Fàn therefore with Bóhǎi’s troops assisted [Gōngsūn] Zàn, defeated Qīng and Xú [Provinces] Huángjīn, the troops increasingly flourishing. Advanced the army to Jiè Bridge. [7] Appointed Yán Gāng to Jì Province, Tián Kǎi to Qīng Province, Shàn Jīng to Yǎn Province, installed various prefectures and counties. [Yuán] Shào’s army stationed Guǎngchuān,21 ordered his officer Qū Yì as the first to ascend to battle with [Gōngsūn] Zàn, captured [Yán] Gāng alive. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s army was defeated and fled to Bóhǎi, with [Gōngsūn] Fàn together returned to Jì, to the large city’s southeast built a small city, with [Liú] Yú close to one another, and gradually they resented one another.



是時，術遣孫堅屯陽城拒卓，紹使周昂奪其處。術遣越與堅攻昂，不勝，越為流矢所中死。瓚怒曰：「余弟死，禍起于紹。」遂出軍屯磐河，將以報紹。紹懼，以所佩勃海太守印綬授瓚從弟範，遣之郡，欲以結援。範遂以勃海兵助瓚，破青、徐黃巾，兵益盛；進軍界橋。〔一〕以嚴綱為冀州，田楷為青州，單經為兗州，置諸郡縣。紹軍廣川，令將麴義先登與瓚戰，生禽綱。瓚軍敗走勃海，與範俱還薊，於大城東南築小城，與虞相近，稍相恨望。










[7] Diǎnlüè records [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s memorial of [Yuán] Shào’s charged crimes stating: “Your Servant has heard that from Huáng and Xī onward,22 first there was the situations of lord and servant and above and below, spreading transformation to guide the people, punishments and penalties to restrain violence. Now the Acting Chariots and Cavalry General Yuán Shào, relies on precedents of his predecessors, robs and steals the honors of others, already by nature violent and chaotic, his conduct licentious and obscene. In the past as Director of Retainers Colonel, he happened to encounter an interval of the country in mourning and disaster, the Dowager Empress undertaking control, Hé-shì assisting in government, [Yuán] Shào exclusively became a nefarious flatterer, unable to raise the upright, so that it cause Dīng Yuán to burn Mèngjīn, the summoning and coming of Dǒng Zhuó, creating the root of the chaos. this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime one. When [Dǒng] Zhuó had entered Luò and the Ruler was taken hostage, [Yuán] Shào was not able to use expedient deceptions to rescue lord and father, but instead abandoned stave and warrants, scuttled and fled, shaming and disgracing title and appointment, turning back on superior and disloyal, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime two. When [Yuán] Shào became Bóhǎi Administrator, he silently selected war horses, about to attack Dǒng Zhuó, did not inform father and elder brother, so that it caused the Grand Tutor’s household and Minister Charioteer mother and sons to in one morning be wiped out, not benevolent and not filial, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime three. When [Yuán] Shào had raised troops, going through two years, he did not sympathize with the state’s troubles, expanded his own fief and wealth, so that most of the resouces and provisions were exclusively used for non-emergencies, cut apart the wealthy households, arrested and interrogated to demand money, the Hundred Surnames groaned and sighed, none were not pained and resentful, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime four. When Hán Fù was oppressed, he stole the vacant position, falsely claimed Edict and favor, carved gold seal and jade Ruler’s Seal, every time in sending down written documents, they sealed in black bags, the inscription stating: ‘Edict letter one seal, Marquess of Kàng village sealed.’ [a] In the past in the chaos of the Xīn house, gradually it assumed to the true.23 Now what [Yuán] Shào puts into effect, imitates and is comparable to that. This is [Yuán] Shào’s crime five. [Yuán] Shào had Cuī Jùyè watch and observe the stars and sun, gifting wealth and money as bribes, with him together drinking and eating, set a date to meet together, attacking and plundering prefectures and counties, how is this what a chief minister should do? This is [Yuán] Shào’s crime six. Yuán] Shào with former Tiger Fang General Liú Xūn first together raised troops, [Liú] Xūn repeatedly proved himself, ald also he subdued Zhāng Yáng, but yet for a petty anger he unjustly murdered [Liú] Xūn, trusting and employing the slanderous and evil, killing and murdering those with achievement, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime seven. [Yuán] Shào also sent up former Shànggǔ Administrator Gāo Yān, former Gānlíng Chancellor Yáo Gōng, arbitrarily demanding money from them, when the money was not provided, both men lost their lives, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime eight. In the principles of the Chūnqiū, the son by the mother is noble. [Yuán] Shào’s mother was a maid servant, [Yuán] Shào in fact is humble and lowly, and cannot be another man’s posterity, by righteousness it is not appropriate, but yet he occupies rich and prosperous heavy position, shaming and defiling royal honors, damaging and humiliating the Yuán clan, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime nine. Also Chángshā Administrator Sūn Jiān, formerly was designate Yù Province Inspector, drove away Dǒng Zhuó, swept and cleaned the Tombs and Temples, his achievements have none greater, [Yuán] Shào ordered Zhōu Áng to steal and take his position, cutting off [Sūn] Jiān’s provisions, causing him to be unable to proceed, allowing [Dǒng] Zhuó to not be executed, this is [Yuán] Shào’s crime ten. Your Servant also ever time obtained Rear General Yuán Shù’s letters, saying that [Yuán] Shào is not of [Yuán] Shù’s kind. [Yuán] Shào’s crimes and transgressions, even the bamboo of the southern mountains would not be enough to record. In the past Jī Zhōu’s government was weak, the King’s Way declined and slackened, Heaven’s Son moved the capital, the various lords turned back and rebelled, thereupon Qí Huán established the Oath of Kētíng, Jìn Wén made the Assembly of Jiàntǔ, attacked Jīng-Chǔ to deliver lush reeds, punished Cáo and Wèi to make clear their lack of courtesy. Although Your Servant is narrow and soft, reputation not those of the former worthies, I have been immersed in the Court’s grace, bear this heavy responsibility, my duty in the axe and battle-axe, serve command to attack the criminal, and at once with the various officers and provincial and prefecture troops suppress [Yuán] Shào and the rest. If the matter is successful and victorious, the criminals captured, perhaps I will continue the enactment of the loyal sincerity of Huán and Wén. The circumstances and reports of the attacks and battles, beginning to end will be continuously reported up.” Therefore he raised troops and with [Yuán] Shào opposed in battle, [Yuán] Shào was not successful.
[a] Kàng pronounced Kǒu and Làng together.



〔一〕　典略載瓚表紹罪狀曰：「臣聞皇、羲以來，始有君臣上下之事，張化以導民，刑罰以禁暴。今行車騎將軍袁紹，託其先軌，寇竊人爵，既性暴亂，厥行淫穢。昔為司隸校尉，會值國家喪禍之際，太后承攝，何氏輔政，紹專為邪媚，不能舉直，至令丁原焚燒孟津，招來董卓，造為亂根，紹罪一也。卓既入雒而主見質，紹不能權譎以濟君父，而棄置節傳，迸竄逃亡，忝辱爵命，背上不忠，紹罪二也。紹為勃海太守，默選戎馬，當攻董卓，不告父兄，至使太傅門戶，太僕母子，一旦而斃，不仁不孝，紹罪三也。紹既興兵，涉歷二年，不卹國難，廣自封殖，乃多以資糧專為不急，割剝富室，收考責錢，百姓吁嗟，莫不痛怨，紹罪四也。韓馥之迫，竊其虛位，矯命詔恩，刻金印玉璽，每下文書，皁囊施檢，文曰『詔書一封，邟鄉侯印』。〔一〕昔新室之亂，漸以即真，今紹所施，擬而方之，紹罪五也。紹令崔巨業候視星日，財貨賂遺，與共飲食，克期會合，攻鈔郡縣，此豈大臣所當宜為？紹罪六也。紹與故虎牙都尉劉勳首共造兵，勳仍有效，又降伏張楊，而以小忿枉害于勳，信用讒慝，殺害有功，紹罪七也。紹又上故上谷太守高焉、故甘陵相姚貢，橫責其錢，錢不備畢，二人并命，紹罪八也。春秋之義，子以母貴。紹母親為婢使，紹實微賤，不可以為人後，以義不宜，乃據豐隆之重任，忝污王爵，損辱袁宗，紹罪九也。又長沙太守孫堅，前領豫州刺史，驅走董卓，掃除陵廟，其功莫大；紹令周昂盜居其位，斷絕堅糧，令不得入，使卓不被誅，紹罪十也。臣又每得後將軍袁術書，云紹非術類也。紹之罪戾，雖南山之竹不能載。昔姬周政弱，王道陵遲，天子遷都，諸侯背叛，於是齊桓立柯亭之盟，晉文為踐土之會，伐荊楚以致菁茅，誅曹、衛以彰無禮。臣雖闒茸，名非先賢，蒙被朝恩，當此重任，職在鈇鉞，奉辭伐罪，輒與諸將州郡兵討紹等。若事克捷，罪人斯得，庶續桓、文忠誠之效，攻戰形狀，前後續上。」遂舉兵與紹對戰，紹不勝。
〔一〕邟，口浪反。







[Liú] Yú feared that [Gōngsūn] Zàn would rebel, and therefore raised troops to surprise attack [Gōngsūn] Zàn. [Liú] Yú was by [Gōngsūn] Zàn defeated, went out and fled to Jūyōng.24 [Gōngsūn] Zàn attacked and captured Jūyōng, captured [Liú] Yú alive, brought [Liú] Yú to return to Jì. It happened that [Dǒng] Zhuó died, Heaven’s Son sent an envoy Duàn Xùn to increase [Liú] Yú’s estate and be Supervisor of Six Provinces, [Gōngsūn] Zàn promoted to Front General, enfeoffed Marquess of Yì.25 [Gōngsūn] Zàn falsely accused [Liú] Yú of wishing to claimed the Honored Title, coerced [Duàn] Xùn to behead [Liú] Yú. [8] [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent up nomination for [Duàn] Xùn to be Yōu Province Inspector. [Gōngsūn] Zàn therefore became arrogant and conceited, remembered faults and forgot good deeds, many were robbed and harmed. [9] [Liú] Yú’s Following Officials Yúyáng’s Xiānyú Fǔ, Qí Zhōu, Cavalry Commandant Xiānyú Yín and others led the provincial troops wishing to take revenge on [Gōngsūn] Zàn, and as Yān state’s Yán Róu previously had grace and faith, together nominated [Yán] Róu to be Wūhuán Major. [Yán] Róu recruited and enticed the Wūhuán and Xiānbēi, obtained Hú and Hàn of several tens of thousands of men, with [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s appointed Yúyáng Administrator Zōu Dān battled at Lù’s north,26 greatly defeated him, beheaded [Zōu] Dān. Yuán Shào also sent Qū Yì with [Liú] Yú’s son [Liú] Hé to command troops to with [Xiānyú] Fǔ together strike [Gōngsūn] Zàn. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s army was repeatedly defeated, and so he fled to return to Yì citadel to firmly defend. [10] Made encircling moats of ten layers, within the moats built citadels, all height five to six zhàng, made towers at their the tops. At the center moat made a citadel, special height of ten zhàng, personally resided there, amassed grain of three million hú. [11] [Gōngsūn] Zàn said: “In the past I said Heaven’s Under’s affairs could at the direction of a signal flag be settled, today observing things, it is not what I can determine. It is not as good as resting the troops, putting strength to farming and accumulating grain. By military methods, ‘for a hundred towers do not attack.’ Now my towers and turrets are a thousand layers. After completely eating this grain, it will be enough to understand Heaven’s Under’s affairs.” He wished to by this exhaust [Yuán] Shào. [Yuán] Shào sent officers to attack them, for successive years unable to capture it. [12] Jiàn’ān Fourth Year [199], [Yuán] Shào had all his armies encircle them. [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent his son to request rescue from the Hēishān bandits, further wished to personally command charger cavalry to directly set out, go along the southwestern mountains, gather the multitudes of the Hēishān, rampage through Jì Province, cut across [Yuán] Shào’s rear. Chief Clerk Guān Jìng advised [Gōngsūn] Zàn stating: “Now General your officers and servicemen all are already collapsed and disintegrated, that they are able to hold and maintain together, is only that they look after and long for their homes and old and small and regard you General as master. General if you firmly hold for many days, Yuán Shào surely will on his own withdraw. After he withdraws on his own, the multitudes of the Four Quarters certainly again can be united. General if you now abandon here and leave, the army will be without stability, and the toppling of Yì citadel can be waited for standing. You General will lose your root, isolated in the grasses and wilds, how can you succeed?” [Gōngsūn] Zàn therefore stopped and did not go out. [13] Rescue arrived, wishing to inside and outside strike [Yuán] Shào, sent someone with a letter to his son, setting a time for the troops to arrive, to light a fire as the signal. [14] [Yuán] Shào’s scouts obtained the letter, and as scheduled lit the fire. [Gōngsūn] Zàn believed rescue troops had arrived, and therefore set out wishing to battle. [Yuán] Shào set up ambush strike, greatly defeated him, he again returned to defend. [Yuán] Shào made earthen tunnels, broke through and broke the towers, eventually reaching the center citadel. [15] [Gōngsūn] Zàn himself knew he would certainly be defeated, completely killed his wife and children, and then killed himself. [16]



虞懼瓚為變，遂舉兵襲瓚。虞為瓚所敗，出奔居庸。瓚攻拔居庸，生獲虞，執虞還薊。會卓死，天子遣使者段訓增虞邑，督六州；瓚遷前將軍，封易侯。瓚誣虞欲稱尊號，脅訓斬虞。〔一〕瓚上訓為幽州刺史。瓚遂驕矜，記過忘善，多所賊害。〔二〕虞從事漁陽鮮于輔、齊周、騎都尉鮮于銀等，率州兵欲報瓚，以燕國閻柔素有恩信，共推柔為烏丸司馬。柔招誘烏丸、鮮卑，得胡、漢數萬人，與瓚所置漁陽太守鄒丹戰于潞北，大破之，斬丹。袁紹又遣麴義及虞子和，將兵與輔合擊瓚。瓚軍數敗，乃走還易京固守。〔三〕為圍塹十重，於塹裏築京，皆高五六丈，為樓其上；中塹為京，特高十丈，自居焉，積穀三百萬斛。〔四〕瓚曰：「昔謂天下事可指麾而定，今日視之，非我所決，不如休兵，力田畜穀。兵法，百樓不攻。今吾樓櫓千重，食盡此穀，足知天下之事矣。」欲以此弊紹。紹遣將攻之，連年不能拔。〔五〕建安四年，紹悉軍圍之。瓚遣子求救于黑山賊，復欲自將突騎直出，傍西南山，擁黑山之眾，陸梁冀州，橫斷紹後。長史關靖說瓚曰：「今將軍將士，皆已土崩瓦解，其所以能相守持者，顧戀其居處老小，以將軍為主耳。將軍堅守曠日，袁紹要當自退；自退之後，四方之眾必復可合也。若將軍今舍之而去，軍無鎮重，易京之危，可立待也。將軍失本，孤在草野，何所成邪！」瓚遂止不出。〔六〕救至，欲內外擊紹。遣人與子書，刻期兵至，舉火為應。〔七〕紹侯者得其書，如期舉火。瓚以為救兵至，遂出欲戰。紹設伏擊，大破之，復還守。紹為地道，突壞其樓，稍至中京。〔八〕瓚自知必敗，盡殺其妻子，乃自殺。〔九〕










[8] Wèi-shì Chūnqiū states: Previously, Liú Yú harmonized and embraced the Róng and Dí, [Gōngsūn] Zàn believed: “The Hú and Yí are difficult to control, we should take advantage of their not submitting to suppress them. Now to apply wealth and rewards, certainly they will increasely think lightly of Hàn. To pursue a reputation for one time is not to deeply consider the long term.” Therefore what [Liú] Yú had rewarded and bestowed, [Gōngsūn] Zàn at once plundered and seized. [Liú] Yú repeatedly requested a meeting, he claimed illness and did not go. Reaching to the battle defeat, [Liú] Yú wished to suppress him, informed East Department Assistant Yòuběipíng man Wèi Yōu. [Wèi] Yōu said: “Now Heaven’s Under cranes neck, taking Your Excellency as one to submit to. Strategy ministers and claws and teeth cannot be lacking. [Gōngsūn] Zàn has civil and martial talent and strength sufficient to rely on, though he has some small evils, assuredly he should be tolerated.” Thus he stopped. Later one year, [Wèi] Yōu died of illness. [Liú] Yú again with his office associates discussed, secretly ordered the multitudes to surprise attack [Gōngsūn] Zàn. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s division retainers were scattered outside, themselves feared defeat, dug through the east city wall wishing to flee. [Liú] Yú’s troops were without organization, not trained in battle, and also caring for the people’s houses, ordered to not set fires. Therefore [Gōngsūn] Zàn was about to set fires, and took advantage to use the elite and sharp to charge through. [Liú] Yú’s multitudes greatly collapsed, fled to Jūyōng city. [Gōngsūn] Zàn attacked and reached the families and associates and returned, killing and murdering the provincial office, the robed and capped good servicemen were completely killed.
Diǎnlüè states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn exposed [Liú] Yú in the market and prayed stating: “If he should be Heaven’s Son, let Heaven send down rain to rescue him.” At the time it was the peak of summer heat, the entire day it did not rain, therefore killed [Liú] Yú.
Yīngxióng jì states: When [Liú] Yú met with murder, former Chángshān Administrator Sūn Jǐn, Assistant Zhāng Yì, Zhāng Zàn and others were stirred by loyal and righteous fury, together went to [Liú] Yú, cursed at [Gōngsūn] Zàn without restraint, and afterward together died.



〔一〕　魏氏春秋曰：初，劉虞和輯戎狄，瓚以胡夷難禦，當因不賓而討之，今加財賞，必益輕漢，效一時之名，非久長深慮。故虞所賞賜，瓚輒鈔奪。虞數請會，稱疾不往。至是戰敗，虞欲討之，告東曹掾右北平人魏攸。攸曰：「今天下引領，以公為歸，謀臣爪牙，不可無也。瓚，文武才力足恃，雖有小惡，固宜容忍。」乃止。後一年，攸病死。虞又與官屬議，密令眾襲瓚。瓚部曲放散在外，自懼敗，掘東城門欲走。虞兵無部伍，不習戰，又愛民屋，敕令勿燒。故瓚得放火，因以精銳衝突。虞眾大潰，奔居庸城。瓚攻及家屬以還，殺害州府，衣冠善士殆盡。典略曰：瓚曝虞于市而祝曰：「若應為天子者，天當降雨救之。」時盛暑，竟日不雨，遂殺虞。英雄記曰：虞之見殺，故常山相孫瑾、掾張逸、張瓚等忠義憤發，相與就虞，罵瓚極口，然後同死。













[9] Yīngxióng jì states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn controlled the interior and exterior, the robed and capped junior relatives that had exceptional talent, were certain to be repressed and sent to be trapped in lands of poverty and hardship. Someone asked the reason, answered stating: “Now if I select the robed and capped families’ junior relatives and excellent servicemen and give them riches and honor, all will themselves believe that for their offices they should obtain them, and not thank others for the kindness.” Those he favored and treated well were arrogant and unrestrained, many were the sorts of mediocre fellows, like former fortune-teller and numerologist Liú Wěitái, fabric peddler Lǐ Yízǐ, merchant Yuè Hédāng and others three men, with them established oath of brotherhood, calling himself Bó, calling the three men as Zhòng, Shū, jì,27 their wealth all in the hundreds of millions. Sometimes he took their daughters to be matched to his own sons, always citing the ancient sorts as Qǔ Zhōu and Guàn Yīng as an example.



〔二〕　英雄記曰：瓚統內外，衣冠子弟有材秀者，必抑使困在窮苦之地。或問其故，答曰：「今取衣冠家子弟及善士富貴之，皆自以為職當得之，不謝人善也。」所寵遇驕恣者，類多庸兒，若故卜數師劉緯臺、販繒李移子、賈人樂何當等三人，與之定兄弟之誓，自號為伯，謂三人者為仲叔季，富皆巨億，或取其女以配己子，常稱古者曲周、灌嬰之屬以譬也。













[10] Yīngxióng jì states: Before this there was a children’s rhyme stating: “Yān’s south boundary, Zhào’s north border, the center where they do not meet as big as a whetstone, only here at this center can one escape the world.” [Gōngsūn] Zàn believed Yì fit this, and so built the citadel to firmly defend. [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s separate officers had those besieged by the enemy, on principle he did not rescue, his explanation stating: “To rescue one man is to cause later officers to rely on rescue and not fiercely battle. Now to not rescue this one, later officers will remember to exhert themselves.” Therefore at the time when Yuán Shào first to the north struck, the separate camps atop [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s south border themselves assessed that if they defended then they could not secure themselves, and also knew they certainly would not meet with rescue, therefore some themselves killed their commanders, some were by [Yuán] Shào’s troops defeated, therefore allowing [Yuán] Shào’s army to directly reach the gates.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Of the words of children’s rhyme, none were not all fulfilled. As for this record, it seems to be without verification. The composition of the rhyme’s words, probably was to cause [Gōngsūn] Zàn to from the beginning to end protect Yì, with no concern for long term strategy. But [Gōngsūn] Zàn taking advantage of the prestige of defeating the Huángjīn, his ambitions spreading far, therefore installing three provinces of Inspectors, plotting to exterminate Yuán-shì, was what brought about the defeat.



〔三〕　英雄記曰：先是有童謠曰：「燕南垂，趙北際，中央不合大如礪，惟有此中可避世。」瓚以易當之，乃築京固守。瓚別將有為敵所圍，義不救也。其言曰：「救一人，使後將恃救不力戰；今不救此，後將當念在自勉。」是以袁紹始北擊之時，瓚南界上別營自度守則不能自固，又知必不見救，是以或自殺其將帥，或為紹兵所破，遂令紹軍徑至其門。臣松之以為童謠之言，無不皆驗；至如此記，似若無徵。謠言之作，蓋令瓚終始保易，無事遠略。而瓚因破黃巾之威，意志張遠，遂置三州刺史，圖滅袁氏，所以致敗也。













[11] Yīngxióng jì states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn’s various officers household by household each made a high tower, the towers were counted in the thousands. [Gōngsūn] Zàn made an iron gate, resided atop the tower, sent away his Left and Right, maidservants and concubines attended at his side, using pulleys to pull up written documents.



〔四〕　英雄記曰：瓚諸將家家各作高樓，樓以千計。瓚作鐵門，居樓上，屏去左右，婢妾侍側，汲上文書。













[12] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Yuán Shào’s letter to [Gōngsūn] Zàn stated: “You and I already had a former alliance and old covenant, extended it with an oath to suppress chaos, the affection exceeded Yí and Shū,28 the relationship proven in vermillion and viridian, called as combined strength on the same track, sufficient to follow Qí and Jìn.29 Therefore I untied seal and undid cord,30 to have the north link with the south, partitioning the fertile lands, to support your performance of duties, is this not clear proof of my sincere feelings? How could I have expected you to abandon the high righteousness of ardent martyrs and chase the dangerous path to disaster and destruction, stopping and changing plans, having friendship exchanged for hatred, secretly sending servicemen and horses, to invade and revage Yù Province. On first hearing armored soldiers were in the south, I personally oversaw the battle lines, fearing that the flying arrows bursting forth and violent blades crossing and gathering would increase the disaster on you, and only add to my blame. Therefore I made an earnest and compassionate letter, hoping you could reform and repent. But you became all the more self indulgant, boasted of your power and strategems, saying that Heaven’s network could be devoured, towering heroes could be exterminated, and indeed caused your noble younger brother to perish at the end of blades. This report was still in the ears, but you sir did not even investigate the source of the disaster, restrain heart and blame yourself, and only wished to indulge your limitless anger, with no regard to the crossing between rebellion and obedience, concealed resentment and harmed the people, charging at my person. Therefore galloping horses and drawn bowstrings occupied my territory, afflictions upon all the living people, the violations reaching to the white bones. I could not decline to respond, and so raised the Jiè Bridge campaign. At that time your troops thundered and shook in spirit, your fine horses flashed like lightning, my brigades and followers had just gathered, the equipment not organized, the strong and the weak clearly distinct, the many and the few obviously differentiated, but borrowing the assistance of Heaven, a small battle was a great victory, therefore we overran your fleeing backs, took the ramparts and stores of grain, was this not the manifested signs of Heaven’s power assisting the faithful and fortunes abundant upon those with courtesy? Your ambitions still were not satiated, so you again gathered the remnant embers, leading the verminous bandits preying on us, to burn down Bóhǎi. I again could not be at peace, employing the brigades to Lóng river.31 Weak troops at the front to entice, the main army had not yet crossed, but your guts were broken and multitudes scattered, without beating the drums you were defeated, soldiers and multitudes disturbed in chaos, lord and servants all fleeing. This also was your doing, not my fault. From this afterward, our disastrous hostility was increasingly deep, my brigades and regiments could not contain their anger, and therefore it reached to piling up corpses into towers, skulls filled the wilds. In pity of those without crimes, never once have I not sighed and shed tears. Later on I repeatedly received your letters, the statements and intentions graceful and subdued, having words of reforming from the past and improving the coming, I rejoiced at our old friendship being restored and moreover pitied that the numerous people were not at peace, and every time I at once withdrew the brigades to drive south, to comply with dispatch letters, but in not even a short time, writings of feathered dispatches from the northern border never once did not arrive. From this I was pained in heart and distressed in head, with nowhere to express my feelings. One who occupies position as commander of the Three Armies and who bears the responsibility of ranked officers should have anger like dense frost, joy like timely rain, his praises and blames and enjoyments and dislikes should be clearly observable. But you sir are duplicitous in your virtue, changed plans based on strong or weak, in distress then humble yourself, at ease then are reckless and indulgant, conduct without consistency, speech without substance, can one who would be a strong serviceman really be like this? Then you slaughtered and killed the old and weak, the lands of Yōu were angry and resentful, the multitudes rebelled and the close departed, you were isolated and without allies. Also the Wūhuán and Huìmò were all of the same province as you sir, while they and I have different customs, but each were energized and enraged, and competed to be my spearpoint advance. Also the Eastern and Western Xiānbēi lifted heels to come attach to me. This is not what my virtue was able to attract, rather it was you sir that drove away and delivered them. In an era of desolation and peril, occupying in the dangers of shields and spears, inside violating the oath of the alliance, outside losing the hearts of the Róng and Dí, troops rising in the provincial soils, disaster appearing from within the screen walls, to like this seek to settle hegemony, is it not very difficult? Formerly as the western mountains were running rampant, I sent out troops to pacify and suppress, it happened that Qū Yì’s remnants in fear of execution fled for their lives, and therefore I then halted the main army, divided troops to sweep them away, these troops were my front advance, that at Jìe Bridge captured flags and took ramparts, the first to ascend and subdue the enemy. On first hearing that you sir were given engraved gold and woven purple, mandated to be a leading commander, I said you would because of this exert yourself, to avenge the humiliation of Mèngmíng,32 and therefore my battle men craned necks, watching for banners and pennants, and were bewildered that you then concealed light and hid in shadow, silent and unheard, in the end arriving at slaughter and extermination, on your behalf they pitied this. To have the fury to pacify Heaven’s Under, hope for achievements to endure through the ages, the authority to drive brigades and followers, maintain and nurture war horses, but the rebelling you do not suppress, the submitting you do not receive, ability to awe and to attract are both lost, how can you establish reputation? Now the old capital is restored, Heaven’s network said to be repaired, the criminals thus destroyed, the loyal and competent assist the transformation, the Huáxià orderly and solemn, looking out for the work of reverence, about to put away shield and spear, release and scatter the oxena nd horses, why do you sir alone hold to trifling servicemen to guard an expansive army interior, sweetly accepting evil reputation to hasten decay, abandoning good virtue to last long? Carefully consider it, it is not a good strategy. It is appropriate to discard regret and remove resentment, and esteem our old friendship. If these words are flawed, may August Heaven hear of it.” [Gōngsūn] Zàn did not answer, but increased his war preparations. He spoke to Guān Jìng stating: “Right now the Four Quarters like tigers compete, that none are able to sit below my city and hold for successive years is clear. What can Yuán Bvenchū do to me?”



〔五〕　漢晉春秋曰：袁紹與瓚書曰：「孤與足下，既有前盟舊要，申以討亂之誓，愛過夷、叔，分著丹青，謂為旅力同軌，足踵齊、晉，故解印釋紱，以北帶南，分割膏腴，以奉執事，此非孤赤情之明驗邪？豈寤足下棄烈士之高義，尋禍亡之險蹤，輟而改慮，以好易怨，盜遣士馬，犯暴豫州。始聞甲卒在南，親臨戰陳，懼于飛矢迸流，狂刃橫集，以重足下之禍，徒增孤（子）之咎釁也，故為薦書懇惻，冀可改悔。而足下超然自逸，矜其威詐，謂天罔可吞，豪雄可滅，果令貴弟殞于鋒刃之端。斯言猶在於耳，而足下曾不尋討禍源，克心罪己，苟欲逞其無疆之怒，不顧逆順之津，匿怨害民，聘於余躬。遂躍馬控弦，處我疆土，毒遍生民，辜延白骨。孤辭不獲已，以登界橋之役。是時足下兵氣霆震，駿馬電發；僕師徒肇合，機械不嚴，彊弱殊科，眾寡異論，假天之助，小戰大克，遂陵躡奔背，因壘館穀，此非天威棐諶，福豐有禮之符表乎？足下志猶未厭，乃復糾合餘燼，率我蛑賊，以焚爇勃海。孤又不獲寧，用及龍河之師。羸兵前誘，大軍未濟，而足下膽破眾散，不鼓而敗，兵眾擾亂，君臣並奔。此又足下之為，非孤之咎也。自此以後，禍隙彌深，孤之師旅，不勝其忿，遂至積尸為京，頭顱滿野，愍彼無辜，未嘗不慨然失涕也。後比得足下書，辭意婉約，有改往脩來之言。僕既欣於舊好克復，且愍兆民之不寧，每輒引師南駕，以順簡書。弗盈一時，而北邊羽檄之文，未嘗不至。孤是用痛心疾首，靡所錯情。夫處三軍之帥，當列將之任，宜令怒如嚴霜，喜如時雨，臧否好惡，坦然可觀。而足下二三其德，彊弱易謀，急則曲躬，緩則放逸，行無定端，言無質要，為壯士者固若此乎！既乃殘殺老弱，幽土憤怨，眾叛親離，孑然無黨。又烏丸、濊貊，皆足下同州，僕與之殊俗，各奮迅激怒，爭為鋒銳；又東西鮮卑，舉踵來附。此非孤德所能招，乃足下驅而致之也。夫當荒危之世，處干戈之險，內違同盟之誓，外失戎狄之心，兵興州壤，禍發蕭牆，將以定霸，不亦難乎！前以西山陸梁，出兵平討，會麴義餘殘，畏誅逃命，故遂住大軍，分兵撲蕩，此兵孤之前行，乃界橋搴旗拔壘，先登制敵者也。始聞足下鐫金紆紫，命以元帥，謂當因茲奮發，以報孟明之恥，是故戰夫引領，竦望旌旆，怪遂含光匿影，寂爾無聞，卒臻屠滅，相為惜之。夫有平天下之怒，希長世之功，權御師徒，帶養戎馬，叛者無討，服者不收，威懷並喪，何以立名？今舊京克復，天罔云補，罪人斯亡，忠幹翼化，華夏儼然，望於穆之作，將戢干戈，放散牛馬，足下獨何守區區之士，保軍內之廣，甘惡名以速朽，亡令德之久長？壯而籌之，非良策也。宜釋憾除嫌，敦我舊好。若斯言之玷，皇天是聞。」瓚不答，而增脩戎備。謂關靖曰：「當今四方虎爭，無有能坐吾城下相守經年者明矣。袁本初其若我何！」













[13] Yīngxióng jì states: Guān Jìng appellation Shìqǐ was a Tàiyuán man. Originally he was a ruthless clerk, flattered and without great plans, he specially was trusted and favored by [Gōngsūn] Zàn.



〔六〕　英雄記曰：關靖字士起，太原人。本酷吏也，諂而無大謀，特為瓚所信幸。













[14] Diǎnlüè states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent a messenger Wén Zé to carry a letter to inform his son [Gōngsūn] Xù stating: “Yuán-shì’s attack resembles divinities and ghosts, drums and horns sounding inside the ground, scaling ladders and siege belfries dancing atop my towers. The days are exhausted and moons tread by, with nothing to rely on. You must break your head to Zhāng Yàn,33 to quickly convey light cavalry, and on arrival to raise a signal fire to the north, I will from the inside come out. If not so, after my death, though Heaven’s Under is wide, if you wish to seek a land to camly settle, could it be found?”
Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Gōngsūn] Zàn dreamed of Jì city collapsing, knew he would certainly be defeated, and so sent a secret messenger with a letter to [Gōngsūn] Xù. [Yuán] Shào’s scouts obtained it, had Chén Lín alter the letter to state: “I have heard in the past in the era of declining Zhōu, corpses filled households and blood flowed. I had believed it not so, how could I have imagined that today I personally would bear the brunt of it?” The remaining words are the same as those recorded in Diǎnlüè.



〔七〕　典略曰：瓚遣行人文則齎書告子續曰：「袁氏之攻，似若神鬼，鼓角鳴于地中，梯衝舞吾樓上。日窮月蹴，無所聊賴。汝當碎首於張燕，速致輕騎，到者當起烽火於北，吾當從內出。不然，吾亡之後，天下雖廣，汝欲求安足之地，其可得乎！」獻帝春秋曰：瓚夢薊城崩，知必敗，乃遣閒使與續書。紹候者得之，使陳琳更其書曰：「蓋聞在昔衰周之世，僵戶流血，以為不然，豈意今日身當其衝！」其餘語與典略所載同。













[15] Yīngxióng jì states: Yuán Shào divided a division of attackers to dig the ground to make tunnels, excavating through beneath the towers, little by little installed wood to pillar it, when they estimated they had reached enough to halfway, they then burned the placed pillars, the towers at once toppled over.



〔八〕　英雄記曰：袁紹分部攻者掘地為道，穿穴其樓下，稍稍施木柱之，度足達半，便燒所施之柱，樓輒傾倒。













[16] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Guān Jìng said: “I have heard that if a noble man leads someone into danger, he must share in the troubles. How can I alone survive?” Thus he whipped his horse to charge [Yuán] Shào’s army and died. [Yuán] Shào sent all their heads to Xǔ.



〔九〕　漢晉春秋曰：關靖曰：「吾聞君子陷人於危，必同其難，豈可獨生乎！」乃策馬赴紹軍而死。紹悉送其首於許。







Xiānyú Fǔ


Xiānyú Fǔ led his multitudes to serve Royal Command. Appointed [Xiānyú] Fǔ as Establishing Loyalty General, Supervisor of Yōu Province’s Six Prefectures. When Tàizǔ and Yuán Shào resisted one another at Guāndù, Yán Róu sent envoy to visit Tàizǔ to receive instructions, promoted to Protector of the Wūhuán Colonel. But [Xiānyú] Fǔ personally visited Tàizǔ, appointed Left Crossing the Liáo General, enfeoffed a precinct Marquess, sent to return to defend and succor his own province. [17] When Tàizǔ defeated Nánpí, [Yán] Róu led his division retainers with the Xiānbēi to proffer famed horses to provide for the army, followed the campaign against the Three Prefectures Wūhuán, for the achievements enfeoffed Marquess Within the Passes. [18] [Xiānyú] Fǔ also led his multitudes to follow. When Emperor Wén ascended the throne, appointed [Xiānyú] Fǔ as Tiger Fang General, [Yán] Róu as Crossing the Liáo General, both advanced in fief to county Marquesses, position Specially Advanced.34



鮮于輔將其眾奉王命。以輔為建忠將軍，督幽州六郡。太祖與袁紹相拒於官渡，閻柔遣使詣太祖受事，遷護烏丸校尉。而輔身詣太祖，拜左度遼將軍，封亭侯，遣還鎮撫本州。〔一〕太祖破南皮，柔將部曲及鮮卑獻名馬以奉軍，從征三郡烏丸，以功封關內侯。〔二〕輔亦率其眾從。文帝踐阼，拜輔虎牙將軍，柔度遼將軍，皆進封縣侯。位特進。










[17] Wèi lüè states: [Xiānyú] Fǔ followed Tàizǔ to Guāndù. Yuán Shào was defeated and fled, Tàizǔ was pleased, looked back and spoke to [Xiānyú] Fǔ stating: “In the year before last when [Yuán] Běnchū sent Gōngsūn Zàn’s head to come, I myself only considered it unexpectedly sudden. But now to have overcome him, this indeed was Heaven’s will, and also by the strength of you few sirs.”



〔一〕　魏略曰：輔從太祖於官渡。袁紹破走，太祖喜，顧謂輔曰：「如前歲本初送公孫瓚頭來，孤自視忽然耳，而今克之。此既天意，亦二三子之力。」













[18] Wèi lüè states: Tàizǔ extremely favored Yán Róu, every time speaking with him stating: “I regard you like a son, and also wish for you to regard me like a father.” [Yán] Róu because of this entrusted himself to the Five Office General,35 like brothers.



〔二〕　魏略曰：太祖甚愛閻柔，每謂之曰：「我視卿如子，亦欲卿視我如父也。」柔由此自託於五官將，如兄弟。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Táo Qiān


Táo Qiān appellation Gōngzǔ was a Dānyáng man. [19] In youth enjoyed study, became a scholar, served in the province and prefecture, nominated Abundant Talent,36 appointed Lú Magistrate,37 [20] promoted to Yōu Province Inspector, summoned and appointed Consultant Cadet, Advisor to Chariots and Cavalry General Zhāng Wēn’s Army Affairs, to the west suppressed Hán Suí. [21] It happened that Xú Province Huángjīn rose up, appointed [Táo] Qiān as Xú Province Inspector, struck the Huángjīn, defeated and drove them away. In the chaos of Dǒng Zhuó, the provinces and prefecture raised troops, Heaven’s Son set capital at Cháng’ān, the west was cut off, [Táo] Qiān sent envoy to secretly travel to deliver tribute, promoted to Securing East General, Xú Province Governor, enfeoffed Marquess of Lìyáng.38 At the time, Xú Province’s Hundred Surnames were flourishing, grain and rice abundantly provided, of the refugees many submitted to him. But [Táo] Qiān turned back on principles and indulged his passions. Guǎnglíng Administrator Lángyé’s Zhào Yù was a famed serviceman of Xú region, and for his loyalty and uprightness met with estrangement, [22] while Cáo Hóng39 and others were slanderous and evil petty men, and [Táo] Qiān was close with and entrusted them. Punishments and government lost harmony, of the good many were harmed, and because of this there was gradually chaos. Xiàpī’s Què Xuān declared himself Heaven’s Son, [Táo] Qiān first joined with him to plunder and rob, later then killed [Què] Xuān and took over his multitudes.



陶謙字恭祖，丹楊人。〔一〕少好學，為諸生，仕州邵，舉茂才，除盧令，〔二〕遷幽州剌史，徵拜議郎，參車騎將軍張溫軍事，西討韓遂。〔三〕會徐州黃巾起，以謙為徐州剌史，擊黃巾，破走之。董卓之亂，州郡起兵，天子都長安，四方斷絕，謙遣使閒行致貢獻，遷安東將軍、徐州牧，封溧陽侯。是時，徐州百姓殷盛，穀米封贍，流民多歸之。而謙背道任情：廣陵太守琊邪趙昱，徐方名士也，以忠直見疏；〔四〕曹宏等，讒慝小人也，謙親任之。刑政失和，良善多被其害，由是漸亂。下邳闕宣自稱天子，謙初與合從寇鈔，後遂殺宣，并其眾。










[19] Wú shū states: [Táo] Qiān’s father was former Yúyáo Chief.40 [Táo] Qiān as a youth was fatherless, and at first for his unruliness was heard of in his county. Aged fourteen, he stitched silk into a banner, rode a bamboo horse and played, in the village the children all followed him. Former Cāngwú Administrator the same county’s Gān Gōng41 went out and encountered him on the road, saw his appearance, was impressed with and called him, stopped his carriage and spoke with him, was extremely pleased, and therefore promised to give a daughter to be his wife. Gān Gōng’s wife heard of this, angrily said: “Your Consort has heard that the Táo family’s boy frivolously plays without limit, how could you have a daughter promised to him?” Gōng said: “He has an amazing exterior, when grown will certainly have great success.” Therefore married off to him.



〔一〕　吳書曰：謙父，故餘姚長。謙少孤，始以不羈聞於縣中。年十四，猶綴帛為幡，乘竹馬而戲，邑中兒童皆隨之。故蒼梧太守同縣甘公出遇之塗，見其容貌，異而呼之，住車與語，甚悅，因許妻以女。甘公夫人聞之，怒曰：「妾聞陶家兒敖戲無度，如何以女許之？」公曰：「彼有奇表，長必大成。」遂妻之。













[20] Wú shū states: [Táo] Qiān by nature was stubborn and direct, had great integrity, in youth examined as Filial-Incorruptible, appoitned Secretariat Writers Cadet, appointed Shū Magistrate.42 The prefecture Administrator Zhāng Pán was an older generation of the same prefecture, with [Táo] Qiān’s father were friends, and thought to specially be close with him, but [Táo] Qiān was shamed to humble himself to him. With his multitudes he returned to the city, took advantage of public matters to advance to meet, when the seating finished, [Zhāng] Pán always privately returned to enter, with [Táo] Qiān drinking and feasting, sometimes [Táo Qiān] refused and would not stay for him. Always he would ask [Táo] Qiān to dance, [Táo] Qiān would not rise for him. He was persistently forced to. At the dance, he also would not twirl. [Zhāng] Pán said: “Should you not twirl?” Said: “I cannot twirl, to twirl then is to surpass others.”43 Because of this they were unhappy, and eventually it led to forming a rift. [Táo] Qiān in office was pure, with nothing investigated or cited. In the sacrifices to Língxīng,44 there was surplus cash of five hundred, and he wished to store it. [Táo] Qiān resigned office and left.



〔二〕　吳書曰：謙性剛直，有大節，少察孝廉，拜尚書郎，除舒令。郡守張磐，同郡先輩，與謙父友，意殊親之，而謙恥為之屈。與眾還城，因以公事進見，坐罷，磐常私還入，與謙飲宴，或拒不為留。常以舞屬謙，謙不為起，固彊之；及舞，又不轉。磐曰：「不當轉邪？」曰：「不可轉，轉則勝人。」由是不樂，卒以搆隙。謙在官清白，無以糾舉，祠靈星，有贏錢五百，欲以臧之。謙委官而去。













[21] Wú shū states: It happened that the Western Qiāng invaded the borders, Huángfǔ Sōng became Campaigning West General, memorialized to request martial officers. Summoned and appointed [Táo] Qiān as Raising Warfare Commandant, with [Huángfǔ] Sōng campaigning against the Qiāng, greatly defeated them. Later Biān Zhāng and Hán Suì made chaos, Excellency of Works Zhāng Wēn received a mandate to campaign and suppress, again invited [Táo] Qiān to be Advisor to Army Affairs, received and treated extremely generously, but [Táo] Qiān thought lightly of his conduct and affairs, and in his heart did not submit. Reaching to when the army was dismissed and returned, the Hundred Offices had a high assembly, [Zhāng] Wēn assigned [Táo] Qiān to serve the alcohol, [Táo] Qiān in front of everyone humiliated [Zhāng] Wēn. [Zhāng] Wēn was furious, exiled [Táo] Qiān to the frontier. Someone advised [Zhāng] Wēn stating: “Táo Gōngzǔ originally for talent and strategy met with value from Your Excellency, in one morning by intoxication erred, was not immersed with tolerance and forgiveness, distantly discarded into the barren, your generous virtue is not thorough to completion, how will the people of the Four Quarters look toward you? It is not as good as release resentment and eliminate hatred, restore the previous relationship, to have the distant year of your virtue and beauty.” [Zhāng] Wēn agreed with this advice, and so pursued and recalled [Táo] Qiān. [Táo] Qiān arrived, someone also spoke to [Táo] Qiān stating: “You sir recklessly insulted one of the Three Excellencies, the crime was your own doing, now to be immersed in release and forgiveness, in virtue none is more generous. You should subdue your will and use humble statements to apologize to him.” [Táo] Qiān said: “Agreed.” Also spoke to [Zhāng] Wēn stating: “Táo Gōngzǔ now deeply accepts his own guilt, and thinks of reform. When the ritual of thanking Heaven’s Son completes, he certainly will visit Your Excellency’s gates. Your Excellency should see him, to reassure his thoughts.” At the time [Zhāng] Wēn at the Palace Gates saw [Táo] Qiān, [Táo] Qiān looked up and said: “[I, Táo] Qiān on my own thanked the Court, how as it for Your Excellency?” [Zhāng] Wēn said: “Gōngzǔ has your foolishness still not been cured?” Therefore he set alcohol for him and treated him as before.



〔三〕　吳書曰：會西羌寇邊，皇甫嵩為征西將軍，表請武將。召拜謙揚武都尉，與嵩征羌，大破之。後邊章、韓遂為亂，司空張溫銜命征討；又請謙為參軍事，接遇甚厚，而謙輕其行事，心懷不服。及軍罷還，百寮高會，溫屬謙行酒，謙眾辱溫。溫怒，徙謙於邊。或說溫曰：「陶恭祖本以材略見重於公，一朝以醉飲過失，不蒙容貸，遠棄不毛，厚德不終，四方人士安所歸望！不如釋憾除恨，克復初分，於以遠聞德美。」溫然其言，乃追還謙。謙至，或又謂謙曰：「足下輕辱三公，罪自己作，今蒙釋宥，德莫厚矣；宜降志卑辭以謝之。」謙曰：「諾。」又謂溫曰：「陶恭祖今深自罪責，思在變革。謝天子禮畢，必詣公門。公宜見之，以慰其意。」時溫于宮門見謙，謙仰曰：「謙自謝朝廷，豈為公邪？」溫曰：「恭祖癡病尚未除邪？」遂為之置酒，待之如初。













[22] Xiè Chéng’s Hòu Hàn shū states: When [Zhào] Yù was aged thirteen, his mother once was ill, continuing through three moons. [Zhào] Yù wretchedly grieved and became emaciated, so that he did not sleep a wink,45 took a handful of grain to go out to perform divination, prayed and wept blood, the people of the community praised his filial piety. He went to Reclusive Serviceman46 Dōngguǎn’s Qí Guàn-jūn to learn the Gōngyáng Zhuàn, and also learned various subjects. For successive years he submerged in his resolve, not look in the garden, his kin and acquantances rarely saw his face. At the time he would enter to check on47 his father and mother, and immediately then return. He was lofty and pure, incorruptible and upright, embraced courtesy in standing, pure and outstanding, dignified and respectful, none interfered in his resolve. He commended the good to encourage transformation, eliminated the bad to correct customs. The province and prefecture invited and summoned him, always he claimed illness to not answer. The state’s Chancellor Tán Mó and Chén Zūn together summoned him, he did not take office. Some were incredibly angry, but to the end he did not change his intetions. Nominated Filial-Incorruptible, appointed Jǔ Chief,48 he spread and raised the Five Teachings, his government became a model for the state. It happened that Huángjīn made chaos, rampaging across five prefectures, the prefectures and counties mobilized troops, he was the first to deal with it. Xú Province Inspector Bā Qí memorialized his achievements as number one, and he should have received promotion and reward, [Zhào] Yù deeply beleived it shameful, resigned office and returned home. Xú Province Governor Táo Qiān first recruited him to be Separate Carriage Following Official, he claimed illness to decline and avoid it. [Táo] Qiān again ordered Yáng Province Following Official Kuàijī’s Wú Fàn to announce his intentions, [Zhào] Yù maintined his intentions and did not change. Wished to threaten him with punishments, then afterward he took office. Nominated Abundant Talent, promoted to Guǎnglíng Administrator. The bandit Zé Róng from Línhuái met with suppression and fled to enter the prefecture border. [Zhào] Yù led trops to resist and battle, was defeated utterly and met with harm.



〔四〕　謝承後漢書曰：昱年十三，母嘗病，經涉三月。昱慘戚消瘠，至目不交睫，握粟出卜，祈禱泣血，鄉黨稱其孝。就處士東莞綦毌君受公羊傳，兼該群業。至歷年潛志，不闚園圃，親疏希見其面。時入定省父母，須臾即還。高絜廉正，抱禮而立，清英儼恪，莫干其志；旌善以興化，殫邪以矯俗。州郡請召，常稱病不應。國相檀謨、陳遵共召，不起；或興盛怒，終不迴意。舉孝廉，除莒長，宣揚五教，政為國表。會黃巾作亂，陸梁五郡，郡縣發兵，以為先辦。徐州刺史巴祇表功第一，當受遷賞，昱深以為恥，委官還家。徐州牧陶謙初辟別駕從事，辭疾遜遁。謙重令揚州從事會稽吳範宣旨，昱守意不移；欲威以刑罰，然後乃起。舉茂才，遷廣陵太守。賊笮融從臨淮見討，迸入郡界，昱將兵拒戰，敗績見害。







Chūpíng Fourth Year [193], Tàizǔ campaigned against [Táo] Qiān, attacked and captured over ten cities, reached Péngchéng and greatly battled. [Táo] Qiān’s troops were defeated and fled, the dead in the tens of thousands, the Sì river because of it could not flow. [Táo] Qiān retreated to defend Tán. Tàizǔ because his provisions were few withdrew the army and returned. [23] Xīngpíng Inaugural Year [194], again campaigned east, captured and settled Lángyé’s and Dōnghǎi’s various counties. [Táo] Qiān was afraid and wished to flee to return to Dānyáng. It happened that Zhāng Miǎo rebelled and welcomed Lǚ Bù, Tàizǔ returned to strike [Lǚ] Bù. That year, [Táo] Qiān died of illness. [24]



初平四年，太祖征謙，攻拔十餘城，至彭城大戰。謙兵敗走，死者萬數，泗水為之不流。謙退守郯。太祖以糧少引軍還。〔一〕興平元年，復東征，略定瑯邪、東海諸縣。謙恐，欲走歸丹楊。會張邈叛迎呂布，太祖還擊布。是歲，謙病死。〔二〕










[23] Wú shū states: Cáo-fōng’s father at Tàishān was killed, he assigned the blame to [Táo] Qiān, wished to attack [Táo] Qiān but feared his strength, and so memorialized to order the provinces and prefectures to for a time dismiss troops. Edict said: “Now Within the Seas is in turmoil, the provinces and prefectures raise troops, campaign soldiers labored and weary, bandit troubles not yet quelled, some officers and clerks are not good, take advantage of the pretext of suppression, to infringe and abuse the numerous people, those suffering harm are many, rumors flow and are heard, shaking and disturbing cities and towns, hills and walls fear the brutal violence, the chaste and good transformed into crowds of evil, how is this different from carrying firewood to rescue a fire, or fanning a fire to stop boiling? Now the Four Peoples are wandering about, entrusting themselves to other regions, leading the white-haired into the mountains and wilds, abandoning children in gorges and ravines, looking back to their former homeland and sighing in grief, turning toward the road and shedding tears, the hunger and distress and destitute bitterness also is already extreme. Even if they regret the confused errors of the past, and think to serve instructions in the present day, however troops are joined and multitudes connect, spearpoints and arrowheads cover the wilds, and they fear in the morning to disband is to in the evening meet with binding and imprisonment, therefore they obstruct with troops to garrison and hold, wish to stop but do not dare disband. When Edict letter arrives, then each are to dismiss and send away armored servicemen, return to agriculture and sericulture, only keep the regular staff clerks to fill the office bureaus, reassure and show to the far and near, and have all hear and know.” [Táo] Qiān was given Edict, and so sent up letter that said: “Your Servant has heard that in embracing the distance and subduing by gentleness, if one is not virtuous they do not gather, in overcoming trouble and pacifying chaos, if not troops then it is not relieved. Therefore at the wilds of Zuōlù, Bǎnquán, Sānmiáo there were the brigades of the Five Emperors, Yǒuhù, Guǐfāng, Shāng, Yǎn four states were attacked by the Kings, from antiquity in the past, never once was there not the raising of power to repress chaos, shaking of the martial to stop violence. Your Servant formerly because of the Huángjīn disordering governance received certificate to charge ahead, with no leisure to stop to rest. Although the statutes and admonishments served and spread authoritative spirit, respectfully enacting Heaven’s punishment, and every attack at once successful, yet the witch bandit sorts were numerous and utterly unafraid of death, when the fathers and elder brothers were slaughtered the sons and younger brothers in crowds rose up, the management of garrisons and joining of troops to the present a concern. If one undertakes the command to remove armor, it weakens state and undermines self, releases martial preparations to feed the chaos, reduces government authority to increase the banditry. If today the troops are dismissed, tomorrow trouble certainly will arrive, above disgrace the root of the Court’s favor and endowment, below cause the crowds of evils to by day and moon grow and spread, this is not how to attend to strong trunks weak branches to restrain evil and stop chaos. Though Your Servant is foolish and ignorant, loyalty and consideration not manifest, I cherish the favor and ponder to repay it, and cannot bear to do it. At once I rein in division retainers, extend orders to maintain preparations, set out to cut down strong bandits, only considering strength, go in to announce virtue and favor, personally serve office duties, hoping to repay with humble labors, to redeem my failings.” It also said: “The Huáxià is boiling in disturbance, to the present not yet stopped, bundled reeds do not enter, duties of tribute is often lacking, awake or asleep I worry and sigh, with no day daring to rest. I truly think tribute must arrive and offerings be able to pass, and only afterward put way spearpoints and remove armor, that is Your Servant’s hope. Your Servant formerly requisitioned grain of a million hú, already it is at the river stationed, at once I order troops to guard and escort.” Cáo-gōng obtained [Táo] Qiān’s sent up matter, knew he would not dismiss troops, and so advanced to attack Péngchéng, killing many people. [Táo] Qiān led troops to strike him, Qīng Province Inspector Tián Kǎi also with troops rescued [Táo] Qiān. His Excellency withdrew troops and returned.
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: At this time Heaven’s Son was at Cháng’ān, Cáo-gōng did not yet control the government. The edict to dismiss troops could not have been produced by Cáo-shì.



〔一〕　吳書曰：曹公父於泰山被殺，歸咎於謙。欲伐謙而畏其彊，乃表令州郡一時罷兵。詔曰：「今海內擾攘，州郡起兵，征夫勞瘁，寇難未弭，或將吏不良，因緣討捕，侵侮黎民，離害者眾；風聲流聞，震蕩城邑，丘牆懼于橫暴，貞良化為群惡，此何異乎抱薪救焚，扇火止沸哉！今四民流移，託身他方，攜白首於山野，棄稚子於溝壑，顧故鄉而哀歎，向阡陌而流涕，饑厄困苦，亦已甚矣。雖悔往者之迷謬，思奉教於今日，然兵連眾結，鋒鏑布野，恐一朝解散，夕見係虜，是以阻兵屯據，欲止而不敢散也。詔書到，其各罷遣甲士，還親農桑，惟留常員吏以供官署，慰示遠近，咸使聞知。」謙被詔，乃上書曰：「臣聞懷遠柔服，非德不集；克難平亂，非兵不濟。是以涿鹿、阪泉、三苗之野有五帝之師，有扈、鬼方、商、奄四國有王者之伐，自古在昔，未有不揚威以弭亂，震武以止暴者也。臣前初以黃巾亂治，受策長驅，匪遑啟處。雖憲章敕戒，奉宣威靈，敬行天誅，每伐輒克，然妖寇類眾，殊不畏死，父兄殲殪，子弟群起，治屯連兵，至今為患。若承命解甲，弱國自虛，釋武備以資亂，損官威以益寇，今日兵罷，明日難必至，上忝朝廷寵授之本，下令群凶日月滋蔓，非所以彊幹弱枝遏惡止亂之務也。臣雖愚蔽，忠恕不昭，抱恩念報，所不忍行。輒勒部曲，申令警備。出芟彊寇，惟力是視，入宣德澤，躬奉職事，冀效微勞，以贖罪負。」又曰：「華夏沸擾，于今未弭，包茅不入，職貢多闕，寤寐憂歎，無日敢寧。誠思貢獻必至，薦羞獲通，然後銷鋒解甲，臣之願也。臣前調穀百萬斛，已在水次，輒敕兵衛送。」曹公得謙上事，知不罷兵。乃進攻彭城，多殺人民。謙引兵擊之，青州刺史田楷亦以兵救謙。公引兵還。臣松之案：此時天子在長安，曹公尚未秉政。罷兵之詔，不得由曹氏出。













[24] Wú shū states: When [Táo] Qiān died his years were sixty-three. Zhāng Zhāo and others for him made a mourning dirge that said: “Oh Admirable Inspector Lord,49 Lord Marquess General, bearing excellent virtue, truly martial truly civil, embody fully firmness and uprightness, maintained by gentle benevolence, Magistrate of Shū and Lú, leaving affection to the people, Governor of Yōu and Xú, equal to the Sweet Apples.50 The alert Yí and Mò depended on you Marquess for purity, the swarming witch bandits, if not for you Marquess there would be no peace. Oh the Emperor remembered your merits, noble title and rank made them manifest, both Governor and Marquess, developing land at Lìyáng. Then ascending as highest officer, receiving title as Securing East, about to pacify the era’s troubles, the State Altars were esteemed. The allotted years were not eternal, so suddenly you died, mourning and losing what they depended on, the people knew destitution. In not more than ten days, five prefectures collapsed apart, alas for our people, who will we look up and rely on? Recollection of memorial cannot reach, looking up to cry to the august vastness, alas the tragedy!” [Táo] Qiān’s two sons Shāng and Yīng both did not serve in office.



〔二〕　吳書曰：謙死時，年六十三，張昭等為之哀辭曰：「猗歟使君，君侯將軍，膺秉懿德，允武允文，體足剛直，守以溫仁。令舒及盧，遺愛于民；牧幽暨徐，甘棠是均。憬憬夷、貊，賴侯以清；蠢蠢妖寇，匪侯不寧。唯帝念績，爵命以章，既牧且侯，啟土溧陽。遂升上將，受號安東，將平世難，社稷是崇。降年不永，奄忽殂薨，喪覆失恃，民知困窮。曾不旬日，五郡潰崩，哀我人斯，將誰仰憑？追思靡及，仰叫皇穹。嗚呼哀哉！」謙二子：商、應，皆不仕。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Zhāng Yáng


Zhāng Yáng appellation Zhìshū was a Yúnzhōng man. For his martial valor he served in Bìng Province, becoming a Martial Ferocity Following Official. At the end of Emperor Líng’s reign, Heaven’s Under was in chaos, the Emperor’s favored Lesser Yellow Gate Jiǎn Shuò became West Garden Upper Army Colonel, stationed army in the capital city, wishing to by this manage the Four Quarters, summoning the towering heroes of Heaven’s Under to be auxiliary officers. Tàizǔ and Yuán Shào and others all became Colonels, subordinate to him. [25] Bìng Province Inspector Dīng Yuán sent [Zhāng] Yáng to lead troops to visit [Jiǎn] Shuò, became Temporary Major. Emperor Líng passed way, [Jiǎn] Shuò was killed by Hé Jìn. [Zhāng] Yáng again was sent by [Hé] Jìn to return to his home province to recruit troops, obtained over a thousand men, took advantage to remain in Shàngdǎng, striking mountain bandits. [Hé] Jìn was destroyed, Dǒng Zhuó made chaos. [Zhāng] Yáng therefore used those he commanded to attack the Shàngdǎng Administrator at Hú Pass, did not take it, captured the various counties, his multitudes reached several thousand men. East of the mountains troops rose up, wishing to execute [Dǒng] Zhuó. Yuán Shào reached Hénèi, [Zhāng] Yáng with [Yuán] Shào joined, and also with the Xiōngnú Chányú Yūfūluó51 garrisoned the Zhāng river. The Chányú wished to rebel, [Yuán] Shào and [Zhāng] Yáng did not follow. The Chányú seized [Zhāng] Yáng and left wit him, [Yuán] Shào sent his officer Qū Yì to pursue and strike at Yè’s south, defeating him. The Chányú brought [Zhāng] Yáng to reach Líyáng, attacked and defeated Crossing the Liáo General Gěng Zhǐ’s army, his multitudes recovered and roused. [Dǒng] Zhuó appointed [Zhāng] Yáng as Establishing Righteousness General, Hénèi Administrator. When Heaven’s Son was at Hédōng, [Zhāng] Yáng led troops to reach Ānyì, appointed Securing the State General, enfeoffed Marquess of Jìnyáng.52 [Zhāng] Yáng wished to welcome Heaven’s Son to return to Luò, the various officers did not listen, [Zhāng] Yáng returned to Yěwáng.53 Jiàn’ān Inaugural Year [196], Yáng Fèng, Dǒng Chéng, Hán Xiān brought Heaven’s Sun back to the old capital, the provisions were lacking. [Zhāng] Yáng with provisions welcomed on the road, therefore reached Luòyáng. He spoke to the various officers stating: “Heaven’s Son should be shared with Heaven’s Under, by good fortune there are Excellencies and Ministers and chief ministers, [I, Zhāng] Yáng should ward off outside troubles, why serve in the capital city?” Therefore he returned to Yěwáng. Then appointed as Marshal-in-Chief. [26] [Zhāng] Yáng previously with Lǚ Bù was friendly. When Tàizǔ was besieging [Lǚ] Bù, [Zhāng] Yáng wished to rescue him, but was unable, and so sent out troops to Dōngshì, from afar showing support. His officer Yáng Chǒu killed [Zhāng] Yáng to support Tàizǔ. [Zhāng] Yáng’s officer Suī Gù killed [Yáng] Chǒu, took command of the multitudes, wishing to go north to join Yuán Shào. Tàizǔ sent Shǐ Huàn to intercept and strike, defeating him at Quǎnchéng, beheaded [Suī] Gù, completely taking the multitudes. [27]



張楊字稚叔，雲中人也。以武勇給并州，為武猛從事。靈帝末，天下亂，帝以所寵小黃門蹇碩為西園上軍校尉，軍京都，欲以御四方，徵天下豪傑以為偏裨。太祖及袁紹等皆為校尉，屬之。〔一〕并州刺史丁原遣楊將兵詣碩，為假司馬。靈帝崩，碩為何進所殺。楊復為進所遣，歸本州募兵，得千餘人，因留上黨，擊山賊。進敗，董卓作亂。楊遂以所將攻上黨太守于壺關，不下，略諸縣，眾至數千人。山東兵起，欲誅卓。袁紹至河內，楊與紹合，復與匈奴單于於夫羅屯漳水。單于欲叛，紹、楊不從。單于執楊與俱去，紹使將麴義追擊於鄴南，破之。單于執楊至黎陽，攻破度遼將軍耿祉軍，眾復振。卓以楊為建義將軍、河內太守。天子之在河東，楊將兵至安邑，拜安國將軍，封晉陽侯。楊欲迎天子還洛，諸將不聽；楊還野王。建安元年，楊奉、董承、韓暹挾天子還舊京，糧乏。楊以糧迎道路，遂至洛陽。謂諸將曰：「天子當與天下共之，幸有公卿大臣，楊當捍外難，何事京都？」遂還野王。即拜為大司馬。〔二〕楊素與呂布善。太祖之圍布，楊欲救之，不能。乃出兵東市，遙為之勢。其將楊醜，殺楊以應太祖。楊將眭固殺醜，將其眾，欲北合袁紹。太祖遣史渙邀擊，破之於犬城，斬固，盡收其眾也。〔三〕










[25] Líng-dì jì states: Appointed Tiger Elite Central Cadet General Yuán Shào as Center Army Colonel, Garrison Cavalry Colonel Bào Hóng as Lower Army Colonel, Consultant Cadet Cáo Cāo as Organizing Army Colonel, Zhào Róng, Féng Fāng as Assistant Army Colonels, Xià Móu, Chúnyú Qióng as Left and Right Colonels.



〔一〕　靈帝紀曰：以虎賁中郎將袁紹為中軍校尉，屯騎校尉鮑鴻為下軍校尉，議郎曹操為典軍校尉，趙融、馮芳為助軍校尉，夏牟、淳于瓊為左右校尉。













[26] Yīngxióng jì states; [Zhāng] Yáng by nature was benevolent and harmonious, without awe-inspiring punishments. A subordinate plotted rebellion, was discovered, facing him shed tears, at once pardoned and not investigated.



〔二〕　英雄記曰：楊性仁和，無威刑。下人謀反，發覺，對之涕泣，輒原不問。













[27] Diǎnlüè states: [Suī] Gù appellation Báitù. Having killed Yáng Chǒu, the army garrisoned Shèquǎn. At the time there was a shaman who warned [Suī] Gù stating: “General, your appellation is Tù (rabbit) while this city is named Quǎn (dog). A rabbit seeing a dog, the situation is certainly alarming, it is appropriately to urgently move away.” [Suī] Gù did not follow this, and therefore died in battle.



〔三〕　典略曰：固字白兔，既殺楊醜，軍屯射犬。時有巫誡固曰：「將軍字兔而此邑名犬，兔見犬，其勢必驚，宜急移去。」固不從，遂戰死。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Gōngsūn Dù


Gōngsūn Dù appellation Shēngjì originally was a Liáodōng Xiāngpíng man. [Gōngsūn] Dù’s father [Gōngsūn] Yán fled authorities to reside in Xuántù. Appointed [Gōngsūn] Dù as a prefectural clerk. At the time Xuántù Administrator Gōngsūn Yù had a son [Gōngsūn] Bào aged eighteen years who died young. [Gōngsūn] Dù in his youth was named Bào, also with [Gōngsūn] Yù’s son was the same age, [Gōngsūn] Yù met and was close with and favored him, sent him to study under a teacher, and found a wife for him. Later nominated as Having the Way,54 appointed Secretariat Writer Cadet, eventually promoted to Jì Province Inspector, for rumors was dismissed.55 The same prefecture’s Xú Róng was Dǒng Zhuó’s Central Cadet General, recommended [Gōngsūn] Dù to be Liáodōng Administrator. [Gōngsūn] Dù had risen up from a Xuántù minor clerk, Liáodōng prefecture thought lightly of him. Before this time, [Liáodōng] Dependent State’s Gōngsūn Zhāo was provisional Xiāngpíng Magistrate and summoned [Gōngsūn] Dù’s son [Gōngsūn] Kāng as a Squad Chief. [Gōngsūn] Dù arrived in office, arrested [Gōngsūn] Zhāo, beat him to death in Xiāngpíng market. Inside the prefecture the famed and powerful great clans Tián Sháo and others formerly had treated him without kindness, he used the law to execute them all, those exterminated were over a hundred families, inside the prefecture shook in fear. To the east he attacked Gāogōulí, to the west struck the Wūhuán, and power spread beyond the seas. Chūpíng Inaugural Year [190], [Gōngsūn] Dù knew the central states were in turmoil, he spoke with his close clerks Liǔ Yì, Yáng Yí, and others stating: “Hàn’s blessings are about to end, I should merely with you sirs plot to become King.” [28] At the time at Xiāngpíng’s Yán Borough’s Altar appeared a large stone, length over a zhàng, below there were three small stones as its legs. Someone spoke to [Gōngsūn] Dù stating: “This is like the omen of Hàn Emperor Xuān’s crown stone, while the borough name is the same as your late father. The Altar controls land, making clear there will be land, with Three Excellencies as supports.” [Gōngsūn] Dù was increasingly pleased. Former Hénèi Administrator Lǐ Mǐn was famed inside the prefecture, hated what [Gōngsūn] Dù was doing, feared he would be harmed by him, and so led his family and dependents to enter the sea. [Gōngsūn] Dù was greatly furious, dug up his father’s burial mound, cut apart the coffin and burned the corpse, executed his clansmen. [29] Divided Liáodōng prefecture to form Liáoxī and Zhōngliáo prefectures, installing Administrators.56 Crossed the sea to capture Dōnglái’s various counties, installing a Yíng Province Inspector. Established himself as Marquess of Liáodōng, Píng Province Governor, posthumously enfeoffed his father [Gōngsūn] Yán as Marquess of Jiànyì. Established a Temple to Hàn’s Two Zǔ, Undertook Regulations to establish platform altar to Xiāngpíng city’s south, Suburb Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, Register Field, Drilling Troops, rode Phoenix Carriage, Nine Tassels, Banner Heads Feather Cavalry.57 Tàizǔ memorialized [Gōngsūn] Dù as Martial Authority General, enfeoffed Marquess of Yǒngníng village. [Gōngsūn] Dù said: “I am a King in Liáodōng, what is Yǒngníng?” Put away the seal and cord into his Military Arsenal. [Gōngsūn] Dù died, his son [Gōngsūn] Kāng succeeded the position, and gave the Yǒngníng village Marquess fief to his younger brother [Gōngsūn] Gōng. That year was Jiàn’ān Ninth Year [204].



公孫度字升濟，本遼東襄平人也。度父延，避吏居玄菟，任度為郡吏。時玄菟太守公孫琙，子豹，年十八歲，早死。度少時名豹，又與琙子同年，琙見而親愛之，遣就師學，為取妻。後舉有道，除尚書郎，稍遷冀州刺史，以謠言免。同郡徐榮為董卓中郎將，薦度為遼東太守。度起玄菟小吏，為遼東郡所輕。先時，屬國公孫昭守襄平令，召度子康為伍長。度到官，收昭，笞殺于襄平市。郡中名豪大姓田韶等宿遇無恩，皆以法誅，所夷滅百餘家，郡中震慄。東伐高句驪，西擊烏丸，威行海外。初平元年，度知中國擾攘，語所親吏柳毅、陽儀等曰：「漢祚將絕，當與諸卿圖王耳。」〔一〕時襄平延里社生大石，長丈餘，下有三小石為之足。或謂度曰：「此漢宣帝冠石之祥，而里名與先君同。社主土地，明當有土地，而三公為輔也。」度益喜。故河內太守李敏，郡中知名，惡度所為，恐為所害，乃將家屬入于海。度大怒，掘其父冢，剖棺焚屍，誅其宗族。〔二〕分遼東郡為遼西中遼郡，置太守。越海收東萊諸縣，置營州刺史。自立為遼東侯、平州牧，追封父延為建義侯。立漢二祖廟，承制設壇墠於襄平城南，郊祀天地，藉田，治兵，乘鸞路，九旒，旄頭羽騎。太祖表度為武威將軍，封永寧鄉侯，度曰：「我王遼東，何永寧也！」藏印綬武庫。度死，子康嗣位，以永寧鄉侯封弟恭。是歲建安九年也。










[28] Wèi shū states: [Gōngsūn] Dù said to [Liǔ] Yì and [Yáng] Yí: “Prophecy books say Sūn Dēng will be Heaven’s Son. The Administrator’s surname is Gōngsūn, appellation Shēngjì. Shēng is Dēng.”58



〔一〕　魏書曰：度語毅、儀：「讖書云孫登當為天子，太守姓公孫，字升濟，升即登也。」













[29] Jìn Yángqiū states: [Lǐ] Mǐn’s son chased after [Lǐ] Mǐn, went out the frontier, for over twenty years did not take a wife. His home region’s Xú Miǎo criticized him stating: “Of the ways to be unfilial none is greater than to have no posterity. How can you for your whole life not take a wife?” Thus he took a wife, begat a son [Lǐ] Yìn and then sent away his wife, always followed the ritual of observing mourning, could not control his grief, and in several years he died. [Lǐ] Yìn was born and did not know his father and mother, and when he learned of them, he ate vegetables and grieved also like the Three Years of Mourning. As he did not know if his grandfather was alive or dead, he set a tablet and honored it. Because of this he was famed, his service reached Excellency over the Masses.
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: The base biography says that [Lǐ] Mǐn led his family to enter the sea, yet he also became separated from a son, the reason is unclear.



〔二〕　晉陽秋曰：敏子追求敏，出塞，越二十餘年不娶。州里徐邈責之曰：「不孝莫大於無後，何可終身不娶乎！」乃娶妻，生子胤而遣妻，常如居喪之禮，不勝憂，數年而卒。胤生不識父母，及有識，蔬食哀戚亦如三年之喪。以祖父不知存亡，設主奉之。由是知名，仕至司徒。臣松之案：本傳云敏將家入海，而復與子相失，未詳其故。
