Gōngsūn Kāng


Twelfth Year [207], Tàizǔ campaigned against the Three Prefectures Wūhuán, slaughtered Liǔchéng. Yuán Shàng and others fled to Liáodōng, [Gōngsūn] Kāng beheaded and sent [Yuán] Shàng’s head. The story is in the Wǔ Annals. Enfeoffed [Gōngsūn] Kāng as Marquess of Xiāngpíng, appointed Left General. [Gōngsūn] Kāng died, his sons Huǎng and Yuān and the rest were all small, the multitudes established [Gōngsūn] Gōng as Liáodōng Administrator. When Emperor Wén ascended the throne, sent envoy to then appoint [Gōngsūn] Gōng as Chariots and Cavalry General, Lent Stave, enfeoffed Marquess of Píngguō.59 Posthumously titled [Gōngsūn] Kāng as Marshal-in-Chief.



十二年，太祖征三郡烏丸，屠柳城。袁尚等奔遼東，康斬送尚首。語在武紀。封康襄平侯，拜左將軍。康死，子晃、淵等皆小，眾立恭為遼東太守。文帝踐阼，遣使即拜恭為車騎將軍、假節，封平郭侯；追贈康大司馬。




Gōngsūn Yuān


Previously, [Gōngsūn] Gōng suffered a disease of genital atrophy and became a castrate, weak and unable to govern the state. Tàihé Second Year [228], [Gōngsūn] Yuān coerced and seized away [Gōngsūn] Gōng’s position. Emperor Míng then appointed [Gōngsūn] Yuān as Raising Intensity General, Liáodōng Administrator. [Gōngsūn] Yuān sent envoy south to communicate with Sūn Quán, back and forth exchanging gifts. [30] [Sūn] Quán sent envoys Zhāng Mí, Xǔ Yàn and others, presenting gold and jade and precious treasures, establishing [Gōngsūn] Yuān as King of Yān. [Gōngsūn] Yuān also feared [Sūn] Quán was far away and could not be relied on, and moreover was greedy for the valuables, lured in the envoys, beheaded them all and sent the heads of [Zhāng] Mí and [Xǔ] Yàn and the rest. [31] Emperor Míng thereupon appointed [Gōngsūn] Yuān Marshal-in-Chief, enfeoffed Duke of Lèlàng, Holding Stave, managing the prefecture as before. [32] The envoys arrived, [Gōngsūn] Yuān set armored troops in army formation, went out to meet the envoys, also repeatedly in front of guest retainers inside the state let out malicious talk. [33] Jǐngchū Inaugural Year [237], thus sent Yōu Province Inspector Guànqiū Jiǎn and others to present Ruler’s Seal marked letter to summon [Gōngsūn] Yuān. [Gōngsūn] Yuān therefore mobilized troops, opposed at Liáosuì, with [Guànqiū] Jiǎn and the rest battled. [Guànqiū] Jiǎn and the rest were not successful and returned. [Gōngsūn] Yuān therefore established himself as King of Yān, installed Hundred Officials and relevant managers, sent envoys Holding Stave, Lent Xiānbēi Chányú Ruler’s Seal, enfeoffed and appointed border peoples, enticed and called on the Xiānbēi to invade and disturb the northern regions. [34] Second Year [238] Spring, sent Grand Commandant Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng to campaign against [Gōngsūn] Yuān. Sixth Moon [238 May 31 - Jun 28], the army reached Liáodōng. [35] [Gōngsūn] Yuān sent Generals Bēi Yǎn and Yáng Zuò and others with infantry and cavalry of several tens of thousands to garrison Liáosuì, encircling moats of over twenty lǐ. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng’s army arrived. Ordered [Bēi] Yǎn to oppose in battle. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng sent General Hú Zūn and others to strike and defeated him. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng ordered the army to bore through the encirclement, led troops to head southeast, but then pressed northeast, at once rushing to Xiāngpíng. [Bēi] Yǎn and the rest feared Xiāngpíng was without defenses, in the night fled. The various armies advanced to reach Shǒu mountain, [Gōngsūn] Yuān again sent [Bēi] Yǎn and the rest to face the army in a battle to the death. Again struck, greatly defeated them, therefore advanced the army to reach below the city walls, made encircling moats. It happened to continuously rain for over thirty days, the Liáo river violently expanded, transport ships from the Liáo’s mouth directly reached below the city walls. The rain cleared, raised eastern mountains, built siege belfries, launching stones and repeating crossbows shooting into the city. [Gōngsūn] Yuān was in utter distress, the provisions exhausted, people ate each other, the dead were extremely many. General Yáng Zuò and others surrendered. Eighth Moon Bǐngyín [238 Sep 3] night, a large shooting star, length of several tens of zhàng, from Shǒu mountain’s northeast fell to Xiāngpíng city’s southeast. Rénwǔ [238 Sep 19], [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s multitudes collapsed, he with his son [Gōngsūn] Xiū led several hundred cavalry to burst through the encirclement and flee southeast, the main army urgently struck him, right at the location where the shooting star had fallen, beheaded [Gōngsūn] Yuān father and son. The city fell, beheaded the Chancellor of State on down, the heads numbered in the thousands. Sent [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s head to Luòyáng. Liáodōng, Dàifāng, Lèlàng, Xuántù were all pacified.



初，恭病陰消為閹人，劣弱不能治國。太和二年，淵脅奪恭位。明帝即（位）拜淵揚烈將軍、遼東太守。淵遣使南通孫權，往來賂遺。〔一〕權遣使張彌、許晏等，齎金玉珍寶，立淵為燕王。淵亦恐權遠不可恃，且貪貨物，誘致其使，悉斬送彌、晏等首，〔二〕明帝於是拜淵大司馬，封樂浪公，持節、領郡如故。〔三〕使者至，淵設甲兵為軍陳，出見使者，又數對國中賓客出惡言。〔四〕景初元年，乃遣幽州刺史毌丘儉等齎璽書徵淵。淵遂發兵，逆於遼隧，與儉等戰。儉等不利而還。淵遂自立為燕王，置百官有司。遣使者持節，假鮮卑單于璽，封拜邊民，誘呼鮮卑，侵擾北方。〔五〕二年春，遣太尉司馬宣王征淵。六月，軍至遼東。〔六〕淵遣將軍卑衍、楊祚等步騎數萬屯遼隧，圍塹二十餘里。宣王軍至，令衍逆戰。宣王遣將軍胡遵等擊破之。宣王令軍穿圍，引兵東南向，而急東北，即趨襄平。衍等恐襄平無守，夜走。諸軍進至首山，淵復遣衍等迎軍殊死戰。復擊，大破之，遂進軍造城下，為圍塹。會霖雨三十餘日，遼水暴長，運船自遼口徑至城下。雨霽，起土山、脩櫓，為發石連弩射城中。淵窘急。糧盡，人相食，死者甚多。將軍楊祚等降。八月丙寅夜，大流星長數十丈，從首山東北墜襄平城東南。壬午，淵眾潰，與其子脩將數百騎突圍東南走，大兵急擊之，當流星所墜處，斬淵父子。城破，斬相國以下首級以千數，傳淵首洛陽，遼東、帶方、樂浪、玄菟悉平。










[30] Wú shū records [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s memorial to [Sūn] Quán stating: “Your Servant in prostration considers having encountered Heaven and Earth overtured, come upon an unexpected fate. The royal road is not yet level, unstable and in turmoil. From my ancestors onward, we successively served Hàn and Wèi, following opportunities to demonstrate integrity to the state, continuous generations enjoyed appointments, able to defend as the vassal frontier, but yet knew that the signs of fate have not yet been assigned. Everytime emotionally moved by your generous kindness, repeatedly honored by your distinguished envoys, I withdrew reflecting that a servant of men in interactions does not cross borders, and therefore firmly maintained my conduct, refusing and opposing your former envoys. Although by righteousness there are no two faiths, dare I forget the great kindness? Your Majesty defends and succors, ever preserving our small state, beginning to end Colonel Péi and Commandant Gě and others arrived, presenting the orders and commandments upon me, the sagely intentions increasingly intimate, heavy silks and accumulated fabrics, the hidden and clear fully demonstrated, in order serve to extend and reveal, your words carried into my ear. Your Servant in daytime then sing, at night then dream, my entire life I will recite them, my ambition knows no satisfaction. In the final eras of desolation, heaven and earth are obstructed, weapons and leather not yet put away, the people scattered and divided. Looking up this Heaven’s Mandate will show its favor, privately from this one corner I ever gaze toward your clouds and sun. Now the Wèi House cannot recognize and record the loyal and good or commend the descendants of accomplished ministers, instead allowing slanderers and liars to be able to enact their wills, listening to the Yōu Province Inspector’s and Dōnglái Administrator’s duplicitous and false reports, rashly raising provincial troops, to plot to harm Your Servant’s prefecture. Your Servant did not betray Wèi, but Wèi cuts off from me. It is heard that servants of men have their circumstances of leaving and joining. Tián Ráo went to Qí, Yuè Yì fled Zhào, because they could not serve the ruler, therefore they protected a lord posessing the Way.60 Chén Píng and Gěng Kuàng also observed their time’s changes, in the end submitting to Hàn, inscribing name in the Emperor’s registers.61 In prostration considering that Your Majesty’s virtue will not appear again, the time not fitting the world, therefore I earnestly and admiringly submit myself, looking out the distance and regarding the difficult terrain as if it is near and easy. Sincerely may your divine plans quickly settle the vast enterprise, exert the momentum of the Six Brigades, collect the lands of the Hé and Luò, and become the founder of your sagely dynasty. Heaven’s Under’s fortune would be extreme!”
Wèilüè states: The country knew [Gōngsūn] Yuān was double-dealing, but feared Liáodōng’s clerks and civilians were deceived by [Gōngsūn] Yuān. Therefore a public document was sent down to Liáodōng, taking advantage to pardon them, stating: “Announcing to Liáodōng’s and Xuántù’s commanders nad colonels and clerks and civilians: Rebel traitor Sūn Quán encountered the progression of chaos, took advantage of his ancestors robbing and plundering provinces and prefectures, thereby created a band of criminals, usurping for himself the Jiāng’s exterior, filled with evil and harboring resentment. Hoping he could be reformed, therefore we divided land to make [Sūn] Quán a King, allowing him to face south and call himself sovereign, rank as a high officer, gifted with the nine mandates. [Sūn] Quán personally glasped hands, faced north and bowed forehead. In being lent favors of servants of men, in receiving the honors of servants of men, there were not any like [Sūn] Quán. But a wolf cub’s wild heart, is difficult for proclamations to change, in the end he returned to treachery, turning back on kindness and rebelling against ruler, defying Heaven and opposing Divinity, thus he dared usurp title, relying on the difficult terrain of the rivers and lakes, the royal punishment has not yet been applied on him. In recent years onward, he further distantly sent ships, crossing the Great Sea, carrying many treasures and goods, to deceive and entice the border peoples. The border peoples were unaware, with them exchanging and dealing. Of the chief clerks on down, none agreed to prohibit and stop it. It reached to allowing Zhōu Hè to sail boats of a hundred ships,62 filling the ferries and shores, trading and exchanging what was had and lacked. They did not suspect or refuse, gifted them with famed horses, and also sent Sù Shū to accompany [Zhōu] Hé to communicate friendship. A village of ten households yet has loyalty and faith. Letting the lord fall into evil, is what the Chūnqiū condemned. Now Liáodōng and Xuántù serve the State Court, winding blue-green and trailing purple,63 numbered in the thousands and hundreds, wearing handscarf and hanging tassels,64 all girdling seal and ribbon, but always without advice of correction and good counsel. When toirtoise shell and jade are destroyed in their cases, tiger and rhinocerous escape their cages, whose fault is it?65 The State Court is for you gentlemen ashamed of this! In the past Hú Tū had a saying:”A father that teaches his son to be double-minded, how can he serve lord? Having registered name and entrusted self, double-mindedness then is criminal.”66 Now yet you flatter and comply with evil schemes, submit to and follow treacherous delusion, how can it only be the teachings of fathers and elder brohters being unclear and the actions of sons and younger brothers being accustomed to wrong and nothing more? If sprouting weeds harm farm the fields, wind spreads the raging fire, the crops and weeds are both burned,67 how can one clearly distinguish them? Moreover also this situation is assuredly easy to see, not reaching to reflecting on antiquity’s successes and failures recorded in books and commentaries. The Jiāng’s south and Sea’s north have a separation of of ten thousand lǐ, Liáodōng’s lord and ministers without worry of alarm, seeking profit then righteousness is not considered profitable, seeking nobility then righteous is not considered noble, this is to weary of residing in calm and happiness, to seek the disaster of danger and destruction, to despise the integrity of loyalty and fidelity, to value the reputation for betrayal and rebellion. Even the chieftains of the Mán and Mò yet know to love courtesy. To like this serve others, also would make it difficult to show one’s face. Moreover also Sù Shū was without crime, forced to be envoy to enter Wú, serving an unrighteous mission, first with his family bid farewell, shedding tears and going. Reaching to the day of [Zhōu] Hè’s death, capsizing multitudes at Chéng mountain,68 although [Sù] Shū escaped death, his soul left his body.69 Why was he forced then to reach to this? Now the loyal ministers and ardent officers are all enraged by Liáodōng’s vacillation and treachery, all wish to ride rafts and sail the sea, resolved to unleash their intentions. We are father and mother to Heaven’s Under,70 and additionally consider that Heaven’s Under is newly settled,71 do not wish to toil and mobilize shields and spears, distantly cross great streams, the costs and labors like that, and also lament that the border frontier’s remaining numerous people, misled into error like this, and therefore sent Cadet Centrals Wèi Shèn, Shào Mào and others ahead of time to present Edict to show my intentions. If the legs and arms loyal and good are able to prove integrity and establish faith to assist the time’s lord, turn from evil to join the correct to establish a great achievement, in fortunes none would be greater. Perhaps you fear and suspect yourself as already being seen as contaminated and defiled by evil rebellion, do not dare to speak out, forever burdened with this regret. Thus for all that with the rebel envoys had exchanges and communications, pardon and exempt them all, to with them start anew.”



〔一〕　吳書載淵表權曰：「臣伏惟遭天地反易，遇無妄之運；王路未夷，傾側擾攘。自先人以來，歷事漢、魏，階緣際會，為國效節，繼世享任，得守藩表，猶知符命未有攸歸。每感厚恩，頻辱顯使，退念人臣交不越境，是以固守所執，拒違前使。雖義無二信，敢忘大恩！陛下鎮撫，長存小國，前後裴校尉、葛都尉等到，奉被敕誡，聖旨彌密，重紈累素，幽明備著，所以申示之事，言提其耳。臣晝則謳吟，宵則發夢，終身誦之，志不知足。季末凶荒，乾坤否塞，兵革未戢，人民蕩析。仰此天命將有眷顧，私從一隅永瞻雲日。今魏家不能採錄忠善，褒功臣之後，乃令讒訛得行其志，聽幽州刺史、東萊太守誑誤之言，猥興州兵，圖害臣郡。臣不負魏，而魏絕之。蓋聞人臣有去就之分；田饒適齊，樂毅走趙，以不得事主，故保有道之君；陳平、耿況，亦睹時變，卒歸於漢，勒名帝籍。伏惟陛下德不再出，時不世遇，是以慺慺懷慕自納，望遠視險，有如近易。誠願神謨蚤定洪業，奮六師之勢，收河、洛之地，為聖代宗。天下幸甚！」魏略曰：國家知淵兩端，而恐遼東吏民為淵所誤。故公文下遼東，因赦之曰：「告遼東、玄菟將校吏民：逆賊孫權遭遇亂階，因其先人劫略州郡，遂成群凶，自擅江表，含垢藏疾。冀其可化，故割地王權，使南面稱孤，位以上將，禮以九命。權親叉手，北向稽顙。假人臣之寵，受人臣之榮，未有如權者也。狼子野心，告令難移，卒歸反覆，背恩叛主，滔天逆神，乃敢僭號。恃江湖之險阻，王誅未加。比年已來，復遠遣船，越渡大海，多持貨物，誑誘邊民。邊民無知，與之交關。長吏以下，莫肯禁止。至使周賀浮舟百艘，沈滯津岸，貿遷有無。既不疑拒，齎以名馬，又使宿舒隨賀通好。十室之邑，猶有忠信，陷君於惡，春秋所書也。今遼東、玄菟奉事國朝，紆青拖紫，以千百為數，戴纚垂纓，咸佩印綬，曾無匡正納善之言。龜玉毀于匵，虎兕出于匣，是誰之過歟？國朝為子大夫羞之！昔狐突有言：『父教子貳，何以事君？策名委質，貳乃辟也。』今乃阿順邪謀，脅從姦惑，豈獨父兄之教不詳，子弟之舉習非而已哉！若苗穢害田，隨風烈火，芝艾俱焚，安能白別乎？且又此事固然易見，不及鑒古成敗，書傳所載也。江南海北有萬里之限，遼東君臣無怵惕之患，利則義所不利，貴則義所不貴，此為厭安樂之居，求危亡之禍，賤忠貞之節，重背叛之名。蠻、貊之長，猶知愛禮，以此事人，亦難為顏！且又宿舒無罪，擠使入吳，奉不義之使，始與家訣，涕泣而行。及至賀死之日，覆眾成山，舒雖脫死，魂魄離身。何所逼迫，乃至於此！今忠臣烈將，咸忿遼東反覆攜貳，皆欲乘桴浮海，期於肆意。朕為天下父母，加念天下新定，既不欲勞動干戈，遠涉大川，費役如彼，又悼邊陲遺餘黎民，迷誤如此，故遣郎中衛慎、邵瑁等且先奉詔示意。若股肱忠良，能效節立信以輔時君，反邪就正以建大功，福莫大焉。儻恐自嫌已為惡逆所見染汙，不敢倡言，永懷伊戚。其諸與賊使交通，皆赦除之，與之更始。」













[31] Wèi lüè records [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s memorial stating: “Your Servant formerly sent Colonel Sù Shū and Cadet Centrals Director Sūn Zōng with sweet words and generous gifts, to entice the Wú rebels. By good fortune relying on Heaven’s Way blessing and assisting Great Wèi, it cause this rebel caitiff to be blind and deluded, go against his crowd of subordinates, not follow the remonstrations of the multitudes,72 accept and believe Your Servant’s words, distantly send ships and envoys, many officers and soldiers, coming to deliver enfeoffment and appointment. What Your Servant has done, was obtain my original intention, though worrying of guilt and offense, privately I feel extremely fortunate. The rebel multitudes were originally claimed as ten thousand men, [Sù] Shū and [Sūn] Zōng spied and investigated, it could be seven to eight thousand men, arriving at Tàjīn.73 The false envoys Zhāng Mí and Xǔ Yàn with Central Cadet General Wàn Tài and Colonel Péi Qián led clerks and soldiers of over four hundred men, presenting written letter and mandated dress and assorted objects, down to arrive at Your Servant’s prefecture. [Wàn] Tài and [Péi] Qián separately presented and delivered the gifted goods, wishing to take advantage to sell horses. Army officers Hè Dá and Yú Zī managed the remaining multitudes at the where the ships were. Your Servant originally wished to wait for the cooling season and then capture [Zhāng] Mí and the rest, but [Zhāng] Mí and the rest’s men and soldiers were numerous and many, saw that Your Servant did not immediately accept the Wú mandates, and their thoughts had suspicions. Fearing they would act first, dangerous changings suddenly appearing, at once I advanced troops to encircle and capture, cut off the heads of [Zhāng] Mí, [Xǔ] Yàn, [Wàn] Tài, [Péi] Qián and the rest. Their clerks and following soldier multitudes were all servicemen squads and petty men, provided to serve east or west, unable to do as they wished, face bound they begged to surrender,74 I could not bear to execute and kill them, and at once listened and accepted, exiling them to fill the frontier cities. Separately sent officer Hán Qǐ and others to lead and command the Three Armies, galloping to go to Tà. Sent designate Chief Clerk Liǔ Yuǎn to set up courtesies of guests and hosts to entice and invite [Hè] Dá and [Yú] Zī, the Three Armies hiding in ambush to wait for their coming down, and also herded crowds of horses and goods, wishing to exchange and well. [Hè] Dá and [Yú] Zī were suspicious and did not come down, sending various traders and buyers of five to six hundred men down, wishing to trade. [Hán] Qǐ and the rest’s metal drums began to thunder, spearpoints and arrows chaotically fired, cut off heads of over three hundred, the wounded and fel into the waters and drowned could be over two hundred men. Those that scattered and fled into the mountains and valleys, that came to submit and surrender, and hide away and starved to death, are not included in these numbers. The captured silver seals, bronze seals, weapons, supplies, cannot be counted. I solemnly send West Department Assistant Gōngsūn Héng to present and escort the rebel [Sūn] Quán’s Lent to Your Servant Stave, Seal and Ribbon, tallies and certificates, Nine Bestowments, assorted goods, with [Zhāng] Mí and the rest’s false staves, seals and ribbons, and heads.” It also said: “Sù Shū, Sūn Zōng formerly arrived at Wú, the rebel [Sūn] Quán asked about Your Servant’s family interior small and large, [Sù] Shū and [Sūn] Zōng replied that Your Servant had three sons, [Gōngsūn] Xiū separately was adopted from a deceased younger brother. [Sūn] Quán dared treacherously scheme, and then without authority appointed and mandated. I solemnly seal and send the seal and ribbon, and tallies and certificates. Although Your Servant is without the men of antiquity’s custom of washing ears,75 I am ashamed to have been applied the rebel [Sūn] Quán’s contaminating harm, having enacted Heaven’s punishment, yet still I have remaining anger.” It also said: “Your Servant’s father [Gōngsūn] Kāng in the past killed [Sūn] Quán’s envoy, forming a relationship of enmity. Now then by deceit, I sent envoys to entice and lure, causing [Sūn] Quán to overturn his heart, empty his state and exhaust his resources, distantly mandate his upper minsiters, to lavishly confer utmost position, shaking and disturbing the southern lands, preparing exhaustively numerous courtesies. Also [Sūn] Quán treated [Sù] Shū and [Sūn] Zōng with enduring attachment winding and elaborate,76 lord and ministers above and below were all joyous and exhaustive in passion. But then I cause his four envoys to meet with death, hanging their heads across ten thousand lǐ, servicemen multitudes wandering in exile, slaughtered and killed on the fords and islets, the shame and humiliation distantly spread, pain and disgrace filling the sky. [Sūn] Quán’s resentment and hatred will be engraved on his flesh and bones. If Heaven causes his enterprise to decline, causing it to reach to ruin and fall, [Sūn] Quán will inwardly be injured by indignant rage and so die. If his allotted fate is not yet finished, he will spread his venomous stings, and I must fear the long serpent will come to invade and harm. Xú Province’s various garrisons and Chéngyáng various prefectures are bordering and close with him, if there are ships and multitudes in later years heading toward the sea gates, and you obtain this news, I beg it be quickly reported to Your Servant, to allow preparations in advance.” It also said: “Your Servant’s household received grace, truly deep and truly heavy, from since Your Servant succeeded and took over affairs onward, continuously I received honors and favor, distinct and special immeasurably, my duty is to fall and exceed, exhausting strength in devotion to the death. But Your Servant was rash and foolish, intentions and plans confused and blind, did not immediately take the rebels, and by this met with suspicion. The former Reply Memorial’s explanation of interests and circumstances, truly was only a wish to wear and exhaust this rebel, causing him to distress and ruin himself, truly I do not dare turn back on accumulated generations of grace, and attached with a caitiff of usurpation and theft. But later men of favoritisms and hatreds, took advantage of the situation to make false accusations, falsely creating particular details, in the end causing the Enlightened Listener to suspect a marketplace tiger,77 shifting away grace and changing affections, raising and mobilizing your awe-inspiring fury, almost bringing me to drowning, ever burdened with shame. By good fortune relying upon your compassion and grace, yet I was bequeathed three pardons, allowing me to make amends, resolve and eliminate transgressions and blames. If Heaven’s authority were distantly applied, and I did not meet with lending of leniency, I would have quickly been crushed and shattered, disgracing my ancestors and ending their sacrifices, what chance would I have to prove myself, and establish this humble achievement? Your Servant is pleased the matter was successful, to be able to explain and prove myself, but grieve of the past situations, reaching to this unforeseen change, lingering in fear jumping and leaping, I do not yet dare be at ease. May Your Majesty esteem the benevolence of the spring sun preserving life, eliminate anger and close the breach, restrain and repress the minute scruples, consider the present to understand the past, examine Your Servant’s original heart, and I will forever cherish and revere it, carrying the debt to the Three Springs.78” It also said: “Your Servant was covered in glory and honor, the grace and kindness not yet repaid, but through crimes and faults, I brought upon myself reprimand and fury, my duty should have been to be killed, to be a warning for the multitudes and society. That I violated standards and departed from norms, falsely communicating with Wú, truly was that I myself reflected upon my desperate circumstances, repayment through service not yet established, but was applied with Heaven’s authority and supervisory punishment, ever in fear to suddenly be unable to cleanse myself. Therefore I dared be deficient and absent for one year, sent envoy to entice Wú, knowing they would certainly come. [Sūn] Quán’s desire for the prefecture had accumulated for years, formerly I was without the answer of a single word of reply, now [Sūn] Quán was able to send envoys, in coming certain to be without suspicions, so that in one action, indeed it was as I had planned, his upper ministers and great multitudes, imposing and abundant, wealth and gifts, overturning the state with utmost position, on arrival met with capture, the wandering exiles and the death over a thousand men, exterminated and severed to never return. This truly injured the spearpoint of crafty rebel, crushed his boastful scheming, clearly shown to Heaven’s Under, breaking and ruining his enterprise, sufficient to shame him. Your Servant’s earnest desire is to serve the state, although I have extraordinary faults, I also have extraordinary achievements, may Your Majesty pardon the transgressions of overstepping, recognize the slightest hair of good, to allow me to obtain the state’s grace, and remain preserved to the end from the beginning.”



〔二〕　魏略載淵表曰：「臣前遣校尉宿舒、郎中令孫綜，甘言厚禮，以誘吳賊。幸賴天道福助大魏，使此賊虜暗然迷惑，違戾群下，不從眾諫，承信臣言，遠遣船使，多將士卒，來致封拜。臣之所執，得如本志，雖憂罪釁，私懷幸甚。賊眾本號萬人，舒、綜伺察，可七八千人，到沓津。偽使者張彌、許晏與中郎將萬泰、校尉裴潛將吏兵四百餘人，齎文書命服什物，下到臣郡。泰、潛別齎致遺貨物，欲因市馬。軍將賀達、虞咨領餘眾在船所。臣本欲須涼節乃取彌等，而彌等人兵眾多，見臣不便承受吳命，意有猜疑。懼其先作，變態妄生，即進兵圍取，斬彌、晏、泰、潛等首級。其吏從兵眾，皆士伍小人，給使東西，不得自由，面縛乞降，不忍誅殺，輒聽納受，徙充邊城。別遣將韓起等率將三軍，馳行至沓。使領長史柳遠設賓主禮誘請達、咨，三軍潛伏以待其下，又驅群馬貨物，欲與交市。達、咨懷疑不下，使諸市買者五六百人下，欲交市。起等金鼓始震，鋒矢亂發，斬首三百餘級，被創赴水沒溺者可二百餘人，其散走山谷，來歸降及藏竄飢餓死者，不在數中。得銀印、銅印、兵器、資貨，不可勝數。謹遣西曹掾公孫珩奉送賊權所假臣節、印綬、符策、九錫、什物，及彌等偽節、印綬、首級。」又曰：「宿舒、孫綜前到吳，賊權問臣家內小大，舒、綜對臣有三息，脩別屬亡弟。權敢姦巧，便擅拜命。謹封送印綬、符策。臣雖無昔人洗耳之風，慚為賊權汙損所加，既行天誅，猶有餘忿。」又曰：「臣父康，昔殺權使，結為讎隙。今乃譎欺，遺使誘致，令權傾心，虛國竭祿，遠命上卿，寵授極位，震動南土，備盡禮數。又權待舒、綜，契闊委曲，君臣上下，畢歡竭情。而令四使見殺，梟示萬里，士眾流離，屠戮津渚，慚恥遠布，痛辱彌天。權之怨疾，將刻肌骨。若天衰其業，使至喪隕，權將內傷憤激而死。若期運未訖，將播毒螫，必恐長蛇來為寇害。徐州諸屯及城陽諸郡，與相接近，如有船眾後年向海門，得其消息，乞速告臣，使得備豫。」又曰：「臣門戶受恩，實深實重，自臣承攝即事以來，連被榮寵，殊特無量，分當隕越，竭力致死。而臣狂愚，意計迷闇，不即禽賊，以至見疑。前章表所陳情趣事勢，實但欲罷弊此賊，使困自絕，誠不敢背累世之恩，附僭盜之虜也。而後愛憎之人，緣事加誣，偽生節目，卒令明聽疑於市虎，移恩改愛，興動威怒，幾至沈沒，長為負忝。幸賴慈恩，猶垂三宥，使得補過，解除愆責。如天威遠加，不見假借，早當麋碎，辱先廢祀，何緣自明，建此微功。臣既喜於事捷，得自申展，悲於疇昔，至此變故，餘怖踊躍，未敢便寧。唯陛下既崇春日生全之仁，除忿塞隙，抑弭纖介，推今亮往，察臣本心，長令抱戴，銜分三泉。」又曰：「臣被服光榮，恩情未報，而以罪釁，自招譴怒，分當即戮，為眾社戒。所以越典詭常，偽通於吳，誠自念窮迫，報效未立，而為天威督罰所加，長恐奄忽不得自洗。故敢自闕替廢於一年，遣使誘吳，知其必來，權之求郡，積有年歲，初無倡答一言之應，今權得使，來必不疑，至此一舉，果如所規，上卿大眾，翕赫豐盛，財貨賂遺，傾國極位，到見禽取，流離死亡，千有餘人，滅絕不反。此誠暴猾賊之鋒，摧矜夸之巧，昭示天下，破損其業，足以慚之矣。臣之慺慺念效於國，雖有非常之過，亦有非常之功，願陛下原其踰闕之愆，采其亳毛之善，使得國恩，保全終始矣。」













[32] Wèi Míng Chén zòu records Central Manager of the Army Xiàhóu Xiàn’s memorial stating: “Gōngsūn Yuān in former years dared violate Royal commands, cut off his calculated tribute, truly engaged in double-dealing. Having relied on rugged terrain, he also relied on Sūn Quán.79 Therefore he dared be domineering, reckless beyond the sea. Sù Shū personally saw the rebel [Sūn] Quán’s army multitudes and office treasuries, knew they were weak and feel and not enough to depend upon, and therefore he settled on plans to behead the rebel envoys. Also Gāogōulí, Huìmò with [Gōngsūn] Yuān are enemies, both plundering and raiding. Now outside he has lost Wú’s assistance, inside as Hú invaders, inside knows the country is able to follow land routes, in the situation he cannot not have an anxious and fearful heart. Taking advantage of this time, it is appropriate to send an envoy to explain the disasters and fortunes. Serving Chariots Commandant Zōng Hóng, in Wǔ Huángdì’s time first served envoy missions, opening and connecting roads. When Wén Huángdì succeeded the throne, wishing to connect envoy missions, he sent [Zōng] Hóng to lead his wife and children to return to his hometown, bestowed with carriages and oxen, fabric of a hundred pǐ. [Zōng] Hóng had received favor, determined to die for the State Court, without any intention to return, begged to keep his wife and children, and personally serve the envoy mission. Gōngsūn Kāng therefore declared himself servant. With [Zōng] Hóng’s serving mission achieved the intention, he was bestowed rank as Marquess Within the Passes. [Zōng] Hóng by nature is resolute and intense, devoting heart to the state, morning to night sincere, intent on exhausting himself in service. A capped clan’s descendant, from youth enjoyed learning and inquiry, widely educated in books and records, with much he has related and waded, his mouth fast and nimble in discourse, in debate yet out of the ordinary, draws upon canon statements, as if produced from his own bosom, and additionally served in his home prefecture, always to the right of others, by that region’s servicemen always respected and admired. If there is to be an envoy sent, I believe we can send [Zōng] Hóng to go. [Zōng] Hóng then is from the old territory, accustomed to the state’s manners, in explaining the benefits and harms, his debate is sufficient to move their thinking, understanding is sufficient to observe their affairs, talent is sufficient to enact it, words sufficient to meet with trust. If this plan is followed, even Lì Shēng’s subduing of the King of Qí and Lù Jiǎ’s persuasion of Wèi Tuó would be without any distant surpassing.80 In wishing to advance on a distant road, it is not appropriate to set aside thoroughbred steeds. When already seriously ill, it is not appropriate to dismiss Biǎn Què.81 May you examine my humble advice.”



〔三〕　魏名臣奏載中領軍夏侯獻表曰：「公孫淵昔年敢違王命，廢絕計貢者，實挾兩端。既恃阻險，又怙孫權。故敢跋扈，恣睢海外。宿舒親見賊權軍眾府庫，知其弱少不足憑恃，是以決計斬賊之使。又高句麗、濊貊與淵為仇，並為寇鈔。今外失吳援，內有胡寇，心知國家能從陸道，勢不得不懷惶懼之心。因斯之時，宜遣使示以禍福。奉車都尉鬷弘，武皇帝時始奉使命，開通道路。文皇帝即位，欲通使命，遣弘將妻子還歸鄉里，賜其車、牛，絹百匹。弘以受恩，歸死國朝，無有還意，乞留妻子，身奉使命。公孫康遂稱臣妾。以弘奉使稱意，賜爵關內侯。弘性果烈，乃心於國，夙夜拳拳，念自竭效。冠族子孫，少好學問，博通書記，多所關涉，口論速捷，辯而不俗，附依典誥，若出胸臆，加仕本郡，常在人右，彼方士人素所敬服。若當遣使，以為可使弘行。弘乃自舊土，習其國俗，為說利害，辯足以動其意，明足以見其事，才足以行之，辭足以見信。若其計從，雖酈生之降齊王，陸賈之說尉佗，亦無以遠過也。欲進遠路，不宜釋騏驥；將已篤疾，不宜廢扁鵲。願察愚言也。」













[33] Wú shū states: Wèi sent envoys Fù Róng, Niè Kuí to appoint [Gōngsūn] Yuān as Duke of Lèlàng. [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s Calculations Clerk from Luòyáng returned, spoke to [Gōngsūn] Yuān stating: “The envoy is Zuǒ Jùnbó, those sent are all selected for valor and strength, not ordinary men.” [Gōngsūn] Yuān because of this was suspicious and afraid. [Fù] Róng and [Niè] Kuí arrived, stationed inside a school building. [Gōngsūn] Yuān in advance had infantry and cavalry encircle them, and then entered to receive the appointment. [Fù] Róng and [Niè] Kuí were greatly afraid, because of this returned to Luò and reported the situation.



〔四〕　吳書曰：魏遣使者傅容、聶夔拜淵為樂浪公。淵計吏從洛陽還，語淵曰：「使者左駿伯，使皆擇勇力者，非凡人也。」淵由是疑怖。容、夔至，住學館中。淵先以步騎圍之，乃入受拜。容、夔大怖，由是還洛言狀。













[34] Wèi shū states: [Gōngsūn] Yuān knew this change was not only produced by [Guànqiū] Jiǎn, and therefore made preparations. Sent envoy to apologize to Wú, declared himself King of Yān, requested to become an allied state. However he yet ordered his office associates to send up letter to vindicate himself to Wèi stating: “Marshal-in-Chief’s Chief Clerk Your Servant Guō Xīn, Advisor to the Army Your Servant Liǔ Pǔ and others of seven hundred eighty nine men say: Respectfully reciving this year’s Seventh Moon Jǐmǎo [237 Aug 28] Edict letter, in prostration reading with earnest sincerity, spirit and soul were scattered apart, not knowing where our bodies and lives would be thrown and placed. [We, Guō] Xīn and the rest in prostration examine ourselves, crickets and ants and petty things, capacity unworthy to be employed in our time, happened to encouter something out a thousand years, received and enjoyed the glorious and brilliant virtue of Gōngsūn Yuān’s grandfather and father and onward, beneficence soaking through, nourished with glory and splendor, without a cùn or chǐ of achievement, yet accumulated with burdened carriages.82 therefore covered in commendations and rewards, entering name in Heaven’s registers, all as lame horses attached to dragon and entrusted to thoroughbred steed, wound in blue-green and trailing purple, flying and soaring on cloud ladders, moved by gratitude and thinking to repay it, to die without choosing the place. We Your Servants have heard that when an enlightened lord above listens to government and selects advice, servants of men below are able to be without hidden opinions, and therefore we take advantage to present complaints, risking offense to report grievances. [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s grandfather [Gōngsūn] Dù first came to oversee the prefecture, inheriting and receiving desolation and ruin, opened the light of sun and moon, established strategy of divine warfare, assembled people of a crow gathering, swept ground as his enterprise,83 his authority shaking and dazzling those of different customs, virtue and beneficence covering the crowds of living. That Liáo’s lands are not destroyed, truly was by depending on [Gōngsūn] Dù. Kǒng-zǐ said: ‘Without Guǎn Zhòng, I would have loose hair and left lapels.’84 Supposing if we had not encountered [Gōngsūn] Dù, then the prefecture would long ago have become graves and ruins, and the people bound in caitiff courts. When [Gōngsūn] Dù had died, the clerks and people in gratitude and admiration, happily supported his son [Gōngsūn] Kāng, honoring and serving him. [Gōngsūn] Kāng ascended and united the vast threads, able to strengthen the illustrious plans,85 civil shining and martial intense, striding virtue nad planting benevolence, devoting heart to capital, cautious in reverent respect, assisting the state and pacifying chaos, providing merits numerous and complex, achievements grand and services great, accomplishments recorded in the Royal Archives. [Gōngsūn] Dù and [Gōngsūn] Kāng happened upon the coincidence of Wǔ Huángdì’s glorious and brilliance, joined plans to register names, supporting and assisting the Hàn House, humbling self and pleding hostages, lowering themselves and serving Wèi. It was not being small and repressed by the large or submitting out of fear, rather it was admiration and trust in high winds, embracing and looking up to flourishing virtue. Wǔ Huángdì also with open heart welcomed and accepted, treating them without sequencing, achievements whether massive or minute, every time was not forgotten. Also his mandate to them said: ‘The lands north of the sea, are assigned to entrust to you, generation to generation your descendants truly will obtain and possess them.’ August Heaven and Lordly Earth, truly heard the virtuous sound. Ministers and commoners small and large, have long been downwind, serving in all around, not daring to fail or neglect. [Gōngsūn] Yuān from birth had the qualities of orchid and stone, in youth embodied teachings of friendliness and fraternity, equipped with the civil and equipped with the martial, loyal and kind and moreover upright, the living people admire and look up, none are not filled with love. [Gōngsūn] Yuān gathered the weapons of his grandfather and father, lord overseeing myriad peoples, acted for the state with courtesy, gently influence flowing and enacted, alone saw before seeing, gathered and bound distant regions, the righteousness of diligently serving King, he viewed the rugged as if flat, for generations conveying loyalty and integrity, not failing his name. Sūn Quán admired his righteousness, not thinking ten thousand lǐ as distant, for continuous years sent envoys, wishing to bind him to be his own assistance, and although he met with cutting off and killing, he did not remember old resentments, but continuously went back and forth, seeking to achieve friendship. [Gōngsūn] Yuān held to integrity increasingly firm, was not swayed by profits, his maintaining of will was not merely stone, indeed it was even hard. Yet fearing his red heart was not yet proven and clear, thus he in humble language and generous gifts, enticed and attracted [Sūn] Quán’s envoys, cut off heads and presented the trophies,86 to show he was without duplicity. Although Wú is distant, the water routes are easy to cross, raising sails then one arrives, without any separation or limits. [Gōngsūn] Yuān did not regard the deepness of the enmity, but remembered to preserve the integrity of a servant of men, severing the friendship of a strong Wú, to clearly show his heart to serve Wèi. Spirits and deities clearly reflect on it, everywhere Heaven all hears of it. Your Majesty commends and praises vast achievements, admires these martial achievements, accordingly bestows glorious mandates, favor second after Qí and Lǔ,87 below reaching to the accomapanying ministers, everywhere receiving the great fortunes. Truly with the grave of Heaven’s cover, it should have lasted to the end from the beginning, allowing him to exhaust legs and arms, foreover maintain salary and position, but unexpectedly one morning, unreasonably it was cruelly ruined. Considering the generosity of the nurture, remembering the accmuluated services, grieving the thoughts did not materialize, pained to be met with abandonment, the entire state called aloud, beating breast and weeping blood. Those that the Three Armies attack are the Mán Yí Róng Dí, arrogant and not reverent, thereupon it attracts warfare, it is unheard of for a righteous state to instead receive punishment and suppression. By the Regulations of the Sagely Kings, for the area of the Five Regions,88 if there are those that do not provide duties, then cultivate by civil virtue, and if again it does not arrive, only afterward campaign and attack. [Gōngsūn] Yuān is careful and cautious, respectful in position, diligently serves his superior, and can be said to have made effort. Utterly loyal and exhaustive in integrity, in return he suffers misfortune and disaster. The composition of Xiǎo Biàn, the rise of Lí Sāo, both were because of this.89 Even if the flatterers and evil with deceptive words sound sweet, yet there should be pure examination, to reject and know goodness. Skillful slander resembles the upright, confusing and disordering Sagely Listening, but still one would expect written announcement, to allow understanding of the reason. If truly there is a crime, there should be bequeathing of the three pardons. If he does not change and reform, on account of his achievements reducing punishment, there should be the Eight Discussions.90 But a secret army suddenly surprise attacked, the main army abruptly arrived, brandishing spears and rushing ahead, charging and striking Liáo territory. Dogs and horses hate death, all the more for human beings! The clerks and civilians risked death to obstruct and disgrace the Royal Brigades. Although [Gōngsūn] Yuān was unjustly accused, right when facing the danger, yet he trusted in sagely grace, sorrowfully again rushing, hoping it must be a traitor minister forging Regulations to recklessly abuse authority and cruelty, and so spoke with We Your Servants stating:”In Hàn Emperor Ān’s Jiànguāng Inaugural Year, Liáodōng Dependent State Commandant Páng Fèn received the Third Moon Yǐwèi [121 Apr 19] Edict letting stating: ‘Arrest Yōu Province Inspector Féng Huàn, Xuántù Administrator Yáo Guāng.’ Investigating the case, there was no Yǐwèi Edict letter, sent Attendant Censor to Yōu Province to arrest and investigate the traitor minister who forged Regulations. Now is the Inspector perhaps is mistakenly obeying a forged Regulation?” We Your Servants discussed, believing: “The Inspector raising troops, shaking and disturbing Heaven’s Under, probably is not a forged Regulation, it certainly is an Edict mandate.” [Gōngsūn] Yuān then looked down and looked up and sighed, himself pained that he was without crime. Deeply pondering that the land is what nurtures the people, privately admiring Gǔ-gōng leaned on staff to go to Qí,91 thus he wished to throw away cap and undo sash, and depart into the woods and foothills. We Your Servants restrained him, swearing to the death, to garrison and defend the office gates, and not allow what he proposed. But the seven camps of Tiger Servicemen, five departments of Mán Yí,92 each having their own supplies, had not planned to be alike in heart, exerted arms and greatly shouted, pushing open the gates and rushing out, the nearby suburb farmers released their hoes and spades, cut firewood to make clubs, turned tables into shields, to rush and gallop to face the troubles, an army on the road formed, even treading boiling water and fire, dying without regard for life. Although [Gōngsūn] Yuān met with abandonment, his resentment did not become rage, repeatedly he sent orders to the army, to not transgress and offend, reaching to hand-written letters of announcements, earnest and sorrowful in utmost sincerity. But the clerks and servicemen were fierce and courageous, and could not be disbanded, determined to devote lives, throw into death without regret. [Gōngsūn] Yuān feared the clerks and servicemen would not follow instructions and orders, and so personally galloped, personally going to resolve it, and only barely then stopped them. The kindness of a single meal, a common man would die for, all the more for [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s accmuluated generations of faith and bonds with the Hundred Surnames, grace proven in the people’s hearts. From since the Former Emperor first rose, reaching to Your Majesty, the glory on [Gōngsūn] Yuān accumulated through generations, abundant achievements and exemplary virtue, registered name commended and praised, discussed clearly in Court and Temple. From since they could wear clothes and put on shoes, they recited and sang the brilliant records, to fill their mouths. To bury and yet dig up is what the ancient people found shameful.93 Xiǎobái and Chóng’ěr were vassal lords of a declining age,94 yet admired proven faith, to expand the hegemon’s enterprise. The Shī praises King Wén establishing faith with myriad countries, the Lúnyǔ praises Zhòngní leaving food to maintain faith. Faith as a virtue assuredly is very great. Now Wú and Shǔ each have Emperors, legs of a tripod standing, Heaven’s Under is shaken and disturbed, not yet united, We Your Servants always for Your Majesty fear these dangerous hearts. [Gōngsūn] Yuān occupies the firmness of metal cities, wields harmonious people, the state prosperous and troops strong, and capable of rampaging. Registering name and entrusting hostages, maintaining to death the good Way, loyalty utmost and righteousness exhaustive, a model for the Nine Provinces. Right now the two enemies watch for openings, it is still unknown who will settle it, to not be warned of this, and instead for [Gōngsūn] Yuān to be harmed, is eating the soft and spitting out the hard, not the Way of a King. Although We Your Servants are lowly, truly we are humbly ashamed of it. If there is no Heaven, Your Servant’s one prefecture’s good or bad fortune cannot yet be known. If it is said there is a Heaven, then also what would be feared? We Your Servants have heard that in serving a house, in two generations then treat them as master, in three generations then treat them as lord. We Your Servants were born in desolate frontier lands, came out through a jade tablet hole, without great assistance from Wèi, for generations served the Gōngsūn clan, repaying the lives they bestowed is in exerting to the death. In the past Kuǎi Tōng spoke directly, Hàn Zǔ pardoned him from execution. Zhèng Zhān spoke of compliance, Jìn Wén forgave him from death. We Your Servants are obstinate and foolish, do not understand great integrity, but hold to one matter, exposing our liver and guts, words offending dragon scales, the crime deserving ten thousand deaths. May Your Majesty restore and esteem succor and nurture, understand this appeal, to allow your estranged and distant Servants to forever have protection and preservation.”



〔五〕　魏書曰：淵知此變非獨出儉，遂為備。遣使謝吳，自稱燕王，求為與國。然猶令官屬上書自直于魏曰：「大司馬長史臣郭昕、參軍臣柳浦等七百八十九人言：奉被今年七月己卯詔書，伏讀懇切，精魄散越，不知身命所當投措！昕等伏自惟省，螻蟻小醜，器非時用，遭值千載，被受公孫淵祖考以來光明之德，惠澤沾渥，滋潤榮華，無寸尺之功，有負乘之累；遂蒙褒獎，登名天府，並以駑蹇附龍託驥，紆青拖紫，飛騰雲梯，感恩惟報，死不擇地。臣等聞明君在上，聽政采言，人臣在下，得無隱情，是以因緣訴讓，冒犯愬冤。郡在藩表，密邇不羈，平昔三州，轉輸費調，以供賞賜，歲用累億，虛耗中國。然猶跋扈，虔劉邊陲，烽火相望，羽檄相逮，城門晝閉，路無行人，州郡兵戈，奔散覆沒。淵祖父度初來臨郡，承受荒殘，開日月之光，建神武之略，聚烏合之民，掃地為業，威震燿于殊俗，德澤被于群生。遼土之不壞，實度是賴。孔子曰：『微管仲，吾其被髮左衽。』向不遭度，則郡早為丘墟，而民係於虜廷矣。遺風餘愛，永存不朽。度既薨殂，吏民感慕，欣戴子康，尊而奉之。康踐統洪緒，克壯徽猷，文昭武烈，邁德種仁；乃心京輦，翼翼虔恭，佐國平亂，效績紛紜，功隆事大，勳藏王府。度、康當值武皇帝休明之會，合策名之計，夾輔漢室，降身委質，卑己事魏。匪處小厭大，畏而服焉，乃慕託高風，懷仰盛懿也。武皇帝亦虛心接納，待以不次，功無巨細，每不見忘。又命之曰：『海北土地，割以付君，世世子孫，實得有之。』皇天后土，實聞德音。臣庶小大，豫在下風，奉以周旋，不敢失墜。淵生有蘭石之姿，少含愷悌之訓，允文允武，忠惠且直；生民欽仰，莫弗懷愛。淵纂戎祖考，君臨萬民，為國以禮，淑化流行，獨見先睹，羅結遐方，勤王之義，視險如夷，世載忠亮，不隕厥名。孫權慕義，不遠萬里，連年遣使，欲自結援，雖見絕殺，不念舊怨，纖纖往來，求成恩好。淵執節彌固，不為利迴，守志匪石，確乎彌堅。猶懼丹心未見保明，乃卑辭厚幣，誘致權使，梟截獻馘，以示無二。吳雖在遠，水道通利，舉帆便至，無所隔限。淵不顧敵讎之深，念存人臣之節，絕彊吳之歡，昭事魏之心，靈祇明鑒，普天咸聞。陛下嘉美洪烈，懿茲武功，誕錫休命，寵亞齊、魯，下及陪臣，普受介福。誠以天覆之恩，當卒終始，得竭股肱，永保祿位，不虞一旦，橫被殘酷。惟育養之厚，念積累之效，悲思不遂，痛切見棄，舉國號咷，拊膺泣血。夫三軍所伐，蠻夷戎狄，驕逸不虔，於是致武，不聞義國反受誅討。蓋聖王之制，五服之域，有不供職，則脩文德，而又不至，然後征伐。淵小心翼翼，恪恭于位，勤事奉上，可謂勉矣。盡忠竭節，還被患禍。小弁之作，離騷之興，皆由此也。就或佞邪，盜言孔甘，猶當清覽，憎而知善；讒巧似直，惑亂聖聽，尚望文告，使知所由。若信有罪，當垂三宥；若不改寤，計功減降，當在八議。而潛軍伺襲，大兵奄至，舞戈長驅，衝擊遼土。犬馬惡死，況於人類！吏民昧死，挫辱王師。淵雖冤枉，方臨危殆，猶恃聖恩，悵然重奔，冀必姦臣矯制，妄肆威虐，乃謂臣等曰：『漢安帝建光元年，遼東屬國都尉龐奮，受三月乙未詔書，曰收幽州刺史馮煥、玄菟太守姚光。推案無乙未詔書，遣侍御史幽州（牧）〔收〕考姦臣矯制者。今刺史或儻謬承矯制乎？』臣等議：以為刺史興兵，搖動天下，殆非矯制，必是詔命。淵乃俛仰歎息，自傷無罪。深惟土地所以養人，竊慕古公杖策之岐，乃欲投冠釋紱，逝歸林麓。臣等維持，誓之以死，屯守府門，不聽所執。而七營虎士，五部蠻夷，各懷素飽，不謀同心，奮臂大呼，排門遁出。近郊農民，釋其耨鎛，伐薪制梃，改案為櫓，奔馳赴難，軍旅行成，雖蹈湯火，死不顧生。淵雖見孤棄，怨而不怒，比遣敕軍，勿得干犯，及手書告語，懇惻至誠。而吏士凶悍，不可解散，期於畢命，投死無悔。淵懼吏士不從教令，乃躬馳騖，自往化解，僅乃止之。一飯之惠，匹夫所死，況淵累葉信結百姓，恩著民心。自先帝初興，爰暨陛下，榮淵累葉，豐功懿德，策名褒揚，辯著廊廟，勝衣舉履，誦詠明文，以為口實。埋而掘之，古人所恥。小白、重耳，衰世諸侯，猶慕著信，以隆霸業。詩美文王作孚萬邦，論語稱仲尼去食存信；信之為德，固亦大矣。今吳、蜀共帝，鼎足而居，天下搖蕩，無所統一，臣等每為陛下懼此危心。淵據金城之固，仗和睦之民，國殷兵彊，可以橫行。策名委質，守死善道，忠至義盡，為九州表。方今二敵闚〈門俞〉，未知孰定，是之不戒，而淵是害。茹柔吐剛，非王者之道也。臣等雖鄙，誠竊恥之。若無天乎，臣一郡吉凶，尚未可知；若云有天，亦何懼焉！臣等聞仕於家者，二世則主之，三世則君之。臣等生於荒裔之土，出於圭竇之中，無大援於魏，世隸於公孫氏，報生與賜，在於死力。昔蒯通言直，漢祖赦其誅；鄭詹辭順，晉文原其死。臣等頑愚，不達大節，苟執一介，披露肝膽，言逆龍鱗，罪當萬死。惟陛下恢崇撫育，亮其控告，使疏遠之臣，永有保持。」













[35] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Gōngsūn Yuān established himself, declaring Shàohàn Inaugural Year.95 Hearing the Wèi men was about to suppress, he again declared himself servant to Wú, begging for troops to attack north to rescue him. The Wú men wished to kill his envoys, Yáng Chén said: “It cannot be. It is to indulge in an ordinary fellow’s anger and abandon the planning of Hegemons and Kings. It is not as good as taking advantage to be generous to them, send surprise troops to secretly go to intercept the successes. If Wèi attacks [Gōngsūn] Yuān and is not successful, but our army comes from afar, it is our grace bonding with distant Yí, righteousness covering ten thousand lǐ. If the troops are continuously not resolved, head and tail separated apart, then we will capture their nearby prefectures, charging to raid and then return, also sufficient to deliver the punishments of Heaven, and avenge and clear the former matter.” [Sūn] Quán said: “Excellent.” Thus organized troops to greatly set out. He spoke with [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s envoy stating: “Please await later news, there will be following letters. I certainly will with my younger brother share in glory and sorrow, together in survival or destruction, even if I fall in the central plains, I would be willing in heart.” He also said: “Where Sīmǎ Yì advances none withstands, I am extremely worried for my younger brother.”



〔六〕　漢晉春秋曰：公孫淵自立，稱紹漢元年。聞魏人將討，復稱臣於吳，乞兵北伐以自救。吳人欲戮其使，羊茞曰：「不可，是肆匹夫之怒而捐霸王之計也。不如因而厚之，遣奇兵潛往以要其成。若魏伐淵不克，而我軍遠赴，是恩結遐夷，義蓋萬里，若兵連不解，首尾離隔，則我虜其傍郡，驅略而歸，亦足以致天之罰，報雪曩事矣。」權曰：「善」。乃勒兵大出。謂淵使曰：「請俟後問，當從簡書，必與弟同休戚，共存亡，雖隕于中原，吾所甘心也。」又曰：「司馬懿所向無前，深為弟憂也。」







Previously, [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s house repeatedly had strangeness. A dog in cap and headcloth and purple-read robe went up a room, while cooking there was a small child steamed to death inside a cauldron. In Xiāngpíng’s north market appeared flesh, length and circumference each several chǐ, having head and eyes and mouth and snout, without hands and feat but yet moving and swaying. Divination said: “It has form but is incomplete, has body but no voice, this is the state’s destruction.” Beginning from [Gōngsūn] Dù in Zhōngpíng Sixth Year occupying Liáodōng reaching to [Gōngsūn] Yuān as the third generation was altogether fifty years and then destruction. [36]



初，淵家數有怪，犬冠幘絳衣上屋，炊有小兒蒸死甑中。襄平北巿生肉，長圍各數尺，有頭目口喙，無手足而動搖。占曰：「有形不成，有體無聲，其國滅亡。」始度以中平六年據遼東，至淵三世，凡五十年而滅。〔一〕










[36] Wèi lüè states: Formerly [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s elder brother [Gōngsūn] Huǎng was [Gōngsūn] Gōng’s hostage son at Luò, heard that [Gōngsūn] Yuān had seized away [Gōngsūn] Gōng’s position, said [Gōngsūn] Yuān in the end could not be guaranteed, and repeatedly himself memorialized news, wishing to have the country suppress [Gōngsūn] Yuān. The Emperor because [Gōngsūn] Yuān already held power therefore accomodated and succored him. Reaching to [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s rebellion, therefore by the state’s laws arrested [Gōngsūn] Huǎng. Although [Gōngsūn] Huǎng had previously spoken out and hoped to not be connected, however inwardly because they were bone and flesh, he knew when [Gōngsūn] Yuān was destroyed then he himself would follow. When [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s head arrived, [Gōngsūn] Huǎng himself judged he would certainly die, with his children facing each other and weeping. At the time the Superior also wished to spare him, but the relevant managers believed it not permissible, therefore killed him.



〔一〕　魏略曰：始淵兄晃為恭任子，在洛，聞淵劫奪恭位，謂淵終不可保，數自表聞，欲令國家討淵。帝以淵已秉權，故因而撫之。及淵叛，遂以國法繫晃。晃雖有前言，冀不坐，然內以骨肉，知淵破則己從及。淵首到，晃自審必死，與其子相對啼哭。時上亦欲活之，而有司以為不可，遂殺之。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Zhāng Yàn


Zhāng Yàn was a Chángshān Zhēndìng man, originally surnamed Chǔ. When the Huángjīn rose up, [Chǔ] Yàn united and assembled youths into a crowd of robbers, among the mountains and marshes turning and attacking, returning to Zhēndìng, the multitudes over ten thousand people. Bólíng’s Zhāng Niújiǎo96 also raised multitudes, declared himself Commanding Troops Following Official, with [Chǔ] Yàn uniting. [Chǔ] Yàn nominated [Zhāng] Niújiǎo as the commander, together they attacked Yíngtáo.97 [Zhāng] Niújiǎo was by a stray arrow hit, was wounded and about to die, ordered the multitudes to serve [Chǔ] Yàn, the announcement stating: “You must take Yàn as commander.” Niújiǎo died, the multitudes served Yàn, therefore he changed his surname to Zhāng. [Zhāng] Yàn was fierce and bold, nimble and fast surpassing other men, therefore inside the army they called him Fēiyàn.98 From then afterward the men and multitudes gradually spread, Chángshān’s, Zhào prefecture’s, Zhōngshān’s, Shàngdǎng’s, Hénèi’s various mountain valleys were all interconnected, the smaller commanders Sūn Qīng and Wáng Dāng and others each with their division multitudes followed [Zhāng] Yàn, the multitudes reached a million, called as Hēishān.99 Emperor Líng was unable to campaign against them, north of the Hé the various prefectures suffered the harm. [Zhāng] Yàn sent someone to the capital city to ask to surrender, appointed [Zhāng] Yàn as Pacifying Troubles Central Cadet General. [37] From then afterward, Dǒng Zhuó moved Heaven’s Son to Cháng’ān, Under Heaven troops repeatedly rose, [Zhāng] Yàn therefore with his multitudes joined together with towering heroes. Yuán Shào with Gōngsūn Zàn contested Jì Province, [Zhāng] Yàn sent his officer Dù Zhǎng and others to assist [Gōngsūn] Zàn, with [Yuán] Shào battled, was by [Yuán] Shào defeated, the men and multitudes gradually scattered. When Tàizǔ was about to settle Jì Province, [Zhāng] Yàn sent envoy to request to assist the Royal Brigades, appointed Pacifying North General. He led his multitudes to visit Yè, enfeoffed Marquess of Ānguó precinct, estate of five hundred households. [Zhāng] Yàn died, his son [Zhāng] Fāng succeeded. [Zhāng] Fāng died, his son [Zhāng] Róng succeeded. [38]



張燕，常山真定人也，本姓褚。黃巾起，燕合聚少年為群盜，在山澤閒轉攻，還真定，眾萬餘人。博陵張牛角亦起眾，自號將兵從事，與燕合。燕推牛角為帥，俱攻廮陶。牛角為飛矢所中。被創且死，令眾奉燕，告曰：「必以燕為帥。」牛角死，眾奉燕，故改姓張。燕剽捍捷速過人，故軍中號曰飛燕。其後人眾寢廣，常山、趙郡、中山、上黨、河內諸山谷皆相通，其小帥孫輕、王當等，各以部眾從燕，眾至百萬，號曰黑山。靈帝不能征，河北諸郡被其害。燕遣人至京都乞降，拜燕平難中郎將。〔一〕是後，董卓遷天子於長安，天下兵數起，燕遂以其眾與豪傑相結。袁紹與公孫瓚爭冀州，燕遣將杜長等助瓚，與紹戰，為紹所敗，人眾稍散，太祖將定冀州，燕遣使求佐王師，拜平北將軍；率眾詣鄴，封安國亭侯，邑五百戶。燕薨，子方嗣。方薨，子融嗣。〔二〕










[37] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: In Zhāng Jué’s rebellion, Hēishān, Báibō, Huánglóng, Zuǒ Jiào, Niújiǎo, Wǔlù, Dīgēn, Kǔqiú, Liú Shí, Píng Hàn, Dà Hóng, Sīlì, Yuánchéng, Luóshì, Léigōng, Fúyún, Fēiyàn, Bái Jué, Yáng Fèng, Yú Dú and others each raised troops, the large twenty to thirty thousand, the small not less than several thousand. Emperor Líng was unable to suppress them, and so sent envoys to appoint Yáng Fèng as Black Mountain Colonel, managing the various mountain bandits, able to nominate Filial-Incorruptible and Calculation Clerks. Later they then all the more spread, and could not be further counted.
Diǎnlüè states: The Hēishān and Huángjīn various commanders originally were not capped and canopied, and themselves gave each other sobriquets and appellations,100 calling the one riding the white horse as Zhāng Báiqí,101 calling the light and nimble one as Zhāng Fēiyàn102 calling the one with loud voice as Zhāng Léigōng,103 the one with abundant beard then declared himself Yú Dīgēn,104 the one with big eyes declared himself Lǐ Dàmù.105
Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì says: Also there was Zuǒ Jiào,106 Guō Dàxián,107 Zuǒ Zīzhàngbā108 three divisions.



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：張角之反也，黑山、白波、黃龍、左校、牛角、五鹿、羝根、苦蝤、劉石、平漢、大洪、司隸、緣城、羅市、雷公、浮雲、飛燕、白爵、楊鳳、于毒等各起兵，大者二三萬，小者不減數千。靈帝不能討，乃遣使拜楊鳳為黑山校尉，領諸山賊，得舉孝廉計吏。後遂彌漫，不可復數。典略曰：黑山、黃巾諸帥，本非冠蓋，自相號字，謂騎白馬者為張白騎，謂輕捷者為張飛燕，謂聲大者為張雷公，其饒鬚者則自稱于羝根，其眼大者自稱李大目。張璠漢紀云：又有左校、郭大賢、左髭丈八三部也。













[38] Lú Jī’s Jìn Huìdì Qǐjū zhù states: Below the Gates Communicating Affairs Director Scribe Zhāng Lín was [Zhāng] Yàn’s great-grandson. [Zhāng] Lín with the King of Zhào [Sīmǎ] Lún made chaos, in not reaching a full year, his position reached Secretariat Writers Director, Guard General, enfeoffed Duke of a prefecture. Soon afterward he was killed by [Sīmǎ] Lún.



〔二〕　陸機晉惠帝起居注曰：門下通事令史張林，飛燕之曾孫。林與趙王倫為亂，未及周年，位至尚書令、衛將軍，封郡公。尋為倫所殺。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Zhāng Xiù


Zhāng Xiù was a Wǔwēi Zǔlì man, Agile Cavalry General [Zhāng] Jì’s clan’s son.109 Biān Zhāng and Hán Suì made chaos in Liáng Province, Jīnchéng’s Qū Shèng surprise attacked and killed the Zǔlì Chief Liú Juàn. [Zhāng] Xiù was a county clerk, watched for an opening and killed [Qū] Shèng, inside the prefecture regarded it righteous. Therefore he recruited and united youths, becoming a towering hero within the city. When Dǒng Zhuó was destroyed, [Zhāng] Jì with Lǐ Jué and the rest struck Lǚ Bù, for [Dǒng] Zhuó taking revenge. The story is in [Dǒng] Zhuó’s biography. [Zhāng] Xiù accompanied [Zhāng] Jì, for army achievements gradually promoted to reach Establishing Loyalty General, enfeoffed Marquess of Xuānwēi.110 [Zhāng] Jì garrisoned Hóngnóng, the soldiers were starving, to the south he attacked Ráng, was hit by a stray arrow and died. [Zhāng] Xiù took over the multitudes, garrisoned Yuān,111 with Liú Biǎo joining. Tàizǔ campaigned south, the army stationed the Yù river, [Zhāng] Xiù and the rest led the multitudes to surrender. Tàizǔ accepted as concubine [Zhāng] Jì’s wife, [Zhāng] Xiù resented this. Tàizǔ heard of his displeasure, secretly had a plan to kill [Zhāng] Xiù. The plan leaked, [Zhāng] Xiù surprise attacked Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ’s army was defeated, two sons lost. [Zhāng] Xiù returned to protect Ráng, [39] Tàizǔ for successive years attacked him, not successful. Tàizǔ resisted Yuán Shào at Guāndù, [Zhāng] Xiù followed Jiǎ Xǔ’s plan, again with his multitudes surrendered. The story is in [Jiǎ] Xǔ’s biography. [Zhāng] Xiù arrived, Tàizǔ grasped his hand, with him celebrated and feasted, for his son [Cáo] Jūn obtained [Zhāng] Xiù’s daughter, appointed Raising Warfare General. In the Guāndù campaign, [Zhāng] Xiù fought hard and had achievements, promoted to Breaking Qiāng General. Accompanied in defeating Yuán Tán at Nánpí, further increased his estate altogether to two thousand households. At the time Heaven’s Under’s registered population was reduced and depleted, out of ten only one remained, the varioius officers’ enfeoffments had never yet had any as many as thousand households, but yet [Zhāng] Xiù’s was especially many. Accompanied the campaign against the Wūhuán to Liǔchéng, had not yet arrived, died, posthumous name called Dìng-hóu. [40] His son [Zhāng] Quán succeeded, in connection to Wèi Fěng’s plot to rebel was executed, state abolished.



張繡，武威祖厲人，驃騎將軍濟族子也。邊章、韓遂為亂涼州，金城麴勝襲殺祖厲長劉雋。繡為縣吏，閒伺殺勝，郡內義之。遂招合少年，為邑中豪傑。董卓敗，濟與李傕等擊呂布，為卓報仇。語在卓傳。繡隨濟，以軍功稍遷至建忠將軍，封宣威侯。濟屯弘農，士卒飢餓，南攻穰，為流矢所中死。繡領其眾，屯宛，與劉表合。太祖南征，軍淯水，繡等舉眾降。太祖納濟妻，繡恨之。太祖聞其不悅，密有殺繡之計。計漏，繡掩襲太祖。太祖軍敗，二子沒。繡還保穰，〔一〕太祖比年攻之，不克。太祖拒袁紹於官渡，繡從賈詡計，復以眾降。語在詡傳。繡至，太祖執其手，與歡宴，為子均取繡女，拜揚武將軍。官渡之役，繡力戰有功，遷破羌將軍。從破袁譚於南皮，復增邑凡二千戶。是時天下戶口減耗，十裁一在，諸將封未有滿千戶者，而繡特多。從征烏丸于柳城，未至，薨，諡曰定侯。〔二〕子泉嗣，坐與魏諷謀反誅，國除。










[39] Fù-zǐ states: [Zhāng] Xiù had an intimate Hú Chē’ér, bravery highest in the army. Tàizǔ favored his valor and vigor, with his own hand giving him gold. [Zhāng] Xiù heard and suspected Tàizǔ wished to use his Left and Right assassinate him, and therefore rebelled.
Wú shū states: [Zhāng] Xiù surrendered, employed Jiǎ Xǔ’s plan, requested to relocate his army on a high road, the road went through Tàizǔ’s garrison. [Zhāng] Xiù also said: “The carriages are few but heavy, I request to have the soldiers each wear armor.” Tàizǔ trusted [Zhāng] Xiù, and all permitted it. [Zhāng] Xiù then readied troops and entered the garrison, surpise attacked Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ was not prepared, and therefore defeated.



〔一〕　傅子曰：繡有所親胡車兒，勇冠其軍。太祖愛其驍健，手以金與之。繡聞而疑太祖欲因左右刺之，遂反。吳書曰：繡降，（凌統）用賈詡計，乞徙軍就高道，道由太祖屯中。繡又曰：「車少而重，乞得使兵各被甲。」太祖信繡，皆聽之。繡乃嚴兵入屯，掩太祖。太祖不備，故敗。













[40] Wèilüè states: The Five Office General [Cáo Pī] repeatedly took advantage to invite him to gatherings, expressed anger stating: “You killed my elder brother, how dare you show your face to others?” [Zhāng] Xiù in his heart could not be at ease with himself, and so killed himself.



〔二〕　魏略曰：五官將數因請會，發怒曰：「君殺吾兄，何忍持面視人邪！」繡心不自安，乃自殺。
crumbs: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Zhāng Lǔ


Zhāng Lǔ appellation Gōngqí was a Pèi state Fēng man. His grandfather [Zhāng] Líng was a guest in Shǔ, studied the Dào in the Húmíng mountains, composed Dào books to confuse the Hundred Surnames, those that received the Dào from him contributed five dǒu of rice, therefore the era called them the Rice Bandits. [Zhāng] Líng died, his son [Zhāng] Héng enacted his Dào. [Zhāng] Héng died, [Zhāng] Lǔ further enacted it. Yì Province Governor Liú Yān appointed [Zhāng] Lǔ as Supervising Righteousness Major, with Separate Division Major Zhāng Xiū leading troops to strike Hànzhōng Administrator Sū Gù, [Zhāng] Lǔ therefore surprise attacked [Zhāng] Xiū and killed him, seized his multitudes. [Liú] Yān died, his son [Liú] Zhāng succeeded the position, as [Zhāng] Lǔ was not obedient, completely killed [Zhāng] Lǔ’s mother and family household. [Zhāng] Lǔ therefore occupied Hànzhōng, instructed the people with Ghost Dào, titled himself “Preceptor Lord.” Those that came to study the Dào first all were named “Ghost Soldiers” Those that received the basic Dào and were already trusted were titled “Libationers,” each managed a division of multitudes, those with many were “Governing Head Libationers.” All taught to be honest and faithful and not to deceive and cheat, those will illness self confessed their transgressions, overall with the Huángjīn resembling one another. The various Libationers all made Charity Lodges, like the present’s Precinct Relays. Also installed charity rice and meat, hanging in the Charity Lodges, travelers judged their hunger and took enough. If they took excessively much, the Ghost Dào at once made them ill. Violators of law had three pardons, and afterward then enacted execution. They did not install Chief Clerks, all used the Libationers for governance, the civilians and Yí were convenienced and happy with them. He dominated and occupied Bā and Hàn reaching to thirty years. [41] At Hàn’s end, his strength could not be campaigned against, and therefore instead favored [Zhāng] Lǔ as Defending the People Central Cadet General, designate Hànníng Administrator, to provide tribute and nothing more. Among the civlians someone inside the ground found a jade seal, the various subordinates wished to honor [Zhāng] Lǔ as King of Hànníng. [Zhāng] Lǔ’s Merit Officer Bāxī’s Yán Pǔ remonstrated [Zhāng] Lǔ stating: “The civilians of Hànchuān, the households exceed a hundred thousand, resources abundant and soil fertile, four sides rugged and firm. Best is to rectify Heaven’s Son, which then is to become Huán and Wén. Next is to reach Dòu Róng, to not lose riches ahd honor.112 Now you Uphold Regulations to install officials, powerful sufficient to behead and decide, without the bother of being a King. May you for now not declare title, to not precede disaster.” [Zhāng] Lǔ followed this. In the chaos of Hán Suì and Mǎ Chāo, the civilians west of the passes that followed Zǐwǔ valley to flee to him were several tens of thousands of families.



張魯字公祺，沛國豐人也。祖父陵，客蜀，學道鵠鳴山中，造作道書以惑百姓，從受道者出五斗米，故世號米賊。陵死，子衡行其道。衡死，魯復行之。益州牧劉焉以魯為督義司馬，與別部司馬張脩將兵擊漢中太守蘇固，魯遂襲脩殺之，奪其眾。焉死，子璋代立，以魯不順，盡殺魯母家室。魯遂據漢中，以鬼道教民，自號「師君」。其來學道者，初皆名「鬼卒」。受本道已信，號「祭酒」。各領部眾，多者為治頭大祭酒。皆教以誠信不欺詐，有病自首其過，大都與黃巾相似。諸祭酒皆作義舍，如今之亭傳。又置義米肉，縣於義舍，行路者量腹取足；若過多，鬼道輒病之。犯法者，三原，然後乃行刑。不置長吏，皆以祭酒為治，民夷便樂之。雄據巴、漢垂三十年。〔一〕漢末，力不能征，遂就寵魯為鎮民中郎將，領漢寧太守，通貢獻而已。民有地中得玉印者，群下欲尊魯為漢寧王。魯功曹巴西閻圃諫魯曰：「漢川之民，戶出十萬，財富土沃，四面險固；上匡天子，則為桓、文，次及竇融，不失富貴。今承制署置，勢足斬斷，不煩於王。願且不稱，勿為禍先。」魯從之。韓遂、馬超之亂，關西民從子午谷奔之者數萬家。










[41] Diǎnlüè states: During Xīpíng [172 - 178] witch rebels greatly rose up,113 The Three Adjuncts had Luò Yào. During Guānghé [178 - 184], the east had Zhāng Jué, Hànzhōng had Zhāng Xiū. Luò Yào taught people the Miǎn Nì Fǎ,114 [Zhāng] Jué made the Tàipíng115 Dào, [Zhāng] Xiū made the Five Dǒu of Rice Dào. In the Tàipíng Dào, the Preceptor held a nine joint cane for charms and prayer, instructed sick people to knock head116 and think on their transgressions, and then give charmed water to them to drink. For the ill that perhaps in days grew less serious and then recovered, then they said this person believed in the Dào. For those that perhaps did not recover, then they did not believe in the Dào. [Zhāng] Xiū’s ways were roughly the same with [Zhāng] Jué, but added the use of quiet rooms, having the sick reside inside to think on their transgressions. Also employed people as Treachery Corrector Libationers. Libationers managed with the Lāo-zǐ’s five thousand words. Those sent to supervise studies were titled as Treachery Correctors. Those that were Ghost clerks managed making prayers for the sick. The method of making prayers was to write the sick person’s family name and personal name, state the intention to admit guilt, make three copies, one up to Heaven by placing atop a mountain, one buried in the ground, one submerged in a river, called as the Three Offices Hand Writings. Had the sick’s family contribute rice of five dǒu as the standard, therefore they were called the Five Dǒu of Rice Preceptors. In fact it was without benefit to treating illness, it was only excessive absurdity, however the petty men were ignorant and foolish, and competed together to serve it. Later [Zhāng] Jué was executed, [Zhāng] Xiū also died. Reaching to when [Zhāng] Lǔ was at Hànzhōng, he took advantage of its people believing and enacting [Zhāng] Xiū’s enterprise, and therefore augmented and embellished it. He instructed to have them make Charity Lodges, with rice and meat installed inside for staying travelers. Also instructed them in self examination.117 Those that had small transgressions, were to repair roads for a hundred bù,118 then the crime was expunged. Also complied with Monthly Ordinances,119 spring and summer prohibited killing, also prohibited alcohol. Those in exile that moved and entrusted themselves to the land did not dare not observe the practices.
Your Servant Sōngzhī says Zhāng Xiū should be Zhāng Héng. If it is not Diǎnlüè’s mistake, then it is a transmission copyist error.



〔一〕　典略曰：熹平中，妖賊大起，三輔有駱曜。光和中，東方有張角，漢中有張脩。駱曜教民緬匿法，角為太平道，脩為五斗米道。太平道者，師持九節杖為符祝，教病人叩頭思過，因以符水飲之，得病或日淺而愈者，則云此人信道，其或不愈，則為不信道。脩法略與角同，加施靜室，使病者處其中思過。又使人為姦令祭酒，祭酒主以老子五千文，使都習，號為姦令。為鬼吏，主為病者請禱。請禱之法，書病人姓名，說服罪之意。作三通，其一上之天，著山上，其一埋之地，其一沉之水，謂之三官手書。使病者家出米五斗以為常，故號曰五斗米師。實無益于治病，但為淫妄，然小人昏愚，競共事之。後角被誅，脩亦亡。及魯在漢中，因其民信行脩業，遂增飾之。教使作義舍，以米肉置其中以止行人；又教使自隱，有小過者，當治道百步，則罪除；又依月令，春夏禁殺；又禁酒。流移寄在其地者，不敢不奉。臣松之謂張脩應是張衡，非典略之失，則傳寫之誤。







Jiàn’ān Twentieth Year [215], Tàizǔ then from Sǎn Pass set out Wǔdū to campaign against him, reached Yángpíng Pass. [Zhāng] Lǔ wished to lead Hànzhōng to surrender, his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi did not agree, led multitudes of several tens of thousands of men to resist at the pass and firmly defend. Tàizǔ attacked and defeated them, and therefore entered Shǔ. [42] [Zhāng] Lǔ heard Yángpíng had already fallen, was about to bow forehead and submit to surrender, [Yán] Pǔ again said: “Now as you are forced to go, your achievement will certainly be light. It is not as good as depending on Dù Huò and going to Piáo Hú to resist together, and only afterward pledging hostages, your achievements will certainly be many.” Thereupon he then fled to the southern mountains and entered Bāzhōng. The Left and Right wished to completely burn all the treasures and goods and granaries and storehouses, [Zhāng] Lǔ said: “I originally wished to submit to the mandate of the country, but my intentions were not conveyed. Now to flee is to avoid a sharp advance, not to have malicious intentions. The treasures and goods and granaries and storehouses are the country’s possession.” Therefore he sealed the storages and left. Tàizǔ entered Nánzhèng, extremely commended this. Also as [Zhāng] Lǔ originally had good intentions, sent someone to reassure and explain. [Zhāng] Lǔ completely led his family to go out, Tàizǔ faced and appointed [Zhāng] Lǔ as Defending South General, treated with the rituals for a guest, enfeoffed as Marquess of Làngzhōng,120 estate ten thousand households. Enfeoffed five of [Zhāng] Lǔ’s sons with [Yán] Pǔ and others all as Ranked Marquesses. [43] For his son Péngzǔ obtained [Zhāng] Lǔ’s daughter.121 [Zhāng] Lǔ died, posthumous name on him called Yuán-hóu. His son [Zhāng] Fù succeeded. [44]



建安二十年，太祖乃自散關出武都征之，至陽平關。魯欲舉漢中降，其弟衛不肯，率眾數萬人拒關堅守。太祖攻破之，遂入蜀。〔一〕魯聞陽平已陷，將稽顙〔歸降〕，圃又曰：「今以迫往，功必輕；不如依（杜灌）〔杜濩〕赴朴胡相拒，然後委質，功必多。」於是乃奔南山入巴中。左右欲悉燒寶貨倉庫，魯曰：「本欲歸命國家，而意未達。今之走，避銳鋒，非有惡意。寶貨倉庫，國家之有。」遂封藏而去。太祖入南鄭，甚嘉之。又以魯本有善意，遣人慰喻。魯盡將家出，太祖逆拜魯鎮南將軍，待以客禮，封閬中侯，邑萬戶。封魯五子及閻圃等皆為列侯。〔二〕為子彭祖取魯女。魯薨，諡之曰原侯。子富嗣。〔三〕










[42] Wèi Míng Chén Zòu records Dǒng Zhāo’s memorial stating: “Wǔ Huángdì received reports from the Liáng Province Following Official and Wǔdū surrendered men, saying that Zhāng Lǔ was easy to attack, that below Yángpíng city walls the southern and northern mountains were far apart, and could not be defended, and believed it as correct. When he went and saw and walked it, it was not as he heard, thus he sighed and said: ‘Other people’s assessments are rarely like one’s thinking.’ Attacked the various garrisons atop Yángpíng’s mountains, they could not be timely captured, and the wounded soldiers were many. Wǔ Huángdì’s thoughts were frustrated, so he wished to evacuate the army to cut across the mountains and return, sending former General-in-Chief Xiàhóu Dūn and General Xǔ Chǔ to call the troops atop the mountains to return. It happened that the front army had not yet returned, in the night got lost, mistakenly entered the rebel camp, the rebels then retreated and scattered. Attendant Centrals Xīn Pí and Liú Yè and others were to the troops’ rear, spoke to [Xiàhóu] Dūn and [Xǔ] Chǔ saying: ‘The government troops have already occupied and taken the rebel’s critical garrison, the rebels are already scattered and fleeing.’ They did not yet believe it. [Xiàhóu] Dūn advanced to personally see, and then returned to report to Wǔ Huángdì. Advanced troops to settle them, by good fortune succeeding in capturing. This is a resent event, what the clerks and servicemen know.” Also Yáng Jì’s memorial states: “When Wǔ Huángdì first campaigned against Zhāng Lǔ, he had multitudes of a hundred thousand, personally oversaw and walked, directing and instructing the overall strategy, taking advantage of civilian wheat for army provisions. Zhāng Wèi’s defense overall is not worth discussing. The land is rugged and defense easy, even with elite troops and tiger officers, their strength cannot be used. Facing troops for three days, he wished to pull out the army and return, saying: ‘I have been in the army for thirty years, in one morning to hand it over to another, how can it be?’ This plan was already settled, Heaven blessed Great Wèi, [Zhāng] Lǔ’s defense on its own broke, and we took advantage to settle it.”
Shìyǔ states: [Zhāng] Lǔ sent his Five Office Assistant to surrender, his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi across the mountains built Yángpíng city to resist, the Royal Brigades could not advance. [Zhāng] Lǔ fled to Bāzhōng. The army’s provisions were exhausted, Tàizǔ was about to return. West Department Assistant Dōng prefecture’s Guō Chén said: “It cannot be. [Zhāng] Lǔ has already surrendered, the remaining envoy has not yet returned, and even if [Zhāng] Wèi is in disagreement, he is without support and can be attacked. For a hanging army deeply penetrated, to advance is to certainly succeed, to retreat is to certainly not escape.” Tàizǔ doubted this. In the night there were wild deer of several thousand charging and breaking [Zhāng] Wèi’s camp, the army was greatly alarmed. In the night Gāo Zuò and others mistakenly encountered [Zhāng] Wèi’s multitudes, [Gāo] Zuò and the rest sounded many drums and horns to gather their multitudes. [Zhāng] wèi was afraid, believed the main army was surprise attacking, and therefore surrendered.



〔一〕　魏名臣奏載董昭表曰：「武皇帝承涼州從事及武都降人之辭，說張魯易攻，陽平城下南北山相遠，不可守也，信以為然。及往臨履，不如所聞，乃歎曰：『他人商度，少如人意。』攻陽平山上諸屯，既不時拔，士卒傷夷者多。武皇帝意沮，便欲拔軍截山而還，遣故大將軍夏侯惇、將軍許褚呼山上兵還。會前軍未還，夜迷惑，誤入賊營，賊便退散。侍中辛毗、劉曄等在兵後，語惇、褚，言『官兵已據得賊要屯，賊已散走』。猶不信之。惇前自見，乃還白武皇帝，進兵定之，幸而克獲。此近事，吏士所知。」又楊暨表曰：「武皇帝始征張魯，以十萬之眾，身親臨履，指授方略，因就民麥以為軍糧。張衛之守，蓋不足言。地險守易，雖有精兵虎將，勢不能施。對兵三日，欲抽軍還，言『作軍三十年，一朝持與人，如何』。此計已定，天祚大魏，魯守自壞，因以定之。」世語曰：魯遣五官掾降，弟衛橫山築陽平城以拒，王師不得進。魯走巴中。軍糧盡，太祖將還。西曹掾東郡郭諶曰：「不可。魯已降，留使既未反，衛雖不同，偏攜可攻。縣軍深入，以進必克，退必不免。」太祖疑之。夜有野麋數千突壞衛營，軍大驚。夜，高祚等誤與衛眾遇，祚等多鳴鼓角會眾。衛懼，以為大軍見掩，遂降。













[43] Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Although Zhāng Lǔ had a good heart, he was forced by defeat and afterward surrendered, now then to be favored with ten thousand households, five sons all enfeoffed as Marquesses, it is excessive.
Xí Zuòchǐ states: [Zhāng] Lǔ wished to declare himself King, but Yán Pvu remonstrated and stopped him, now [Yán] Pǔ is enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess. Rewards and punishments are in order to punish the bad and encourage the good. If they can be used to make clear standards and instructments to the people, there is no regard to far or near or obscurity or depth. Now Yán Pǔ remonstrated [Zhāng] Lǔ to not be a King, and so Tàizǔ in recollection enfeoffed him, of the people of the future who will not think of obedience? Blocking the original source and the later flow on its own stops, this is what it is speaking of. If instead one does not understand this and only values the achievements of scorched ruin, abundant nobility and generous rewards stopping at servicemen of death battles, then the people will seek profit in having chaos, customs will be to compete in killing and attacking, relying on trops and wielding strength, shields and spears wll not be put away. Tàizǔ in this enfeoffment, can be said to understand the root of reward and punishment, even if Tāng and Wǔ122 had been in this position, they could not have added to it.
Wèilüè states: During Huángchū [220 - 226], augmented [Yán] Pǔ’s noble title and estate, among those given Ritual Invitations.123 Later in over ten years he died of illness.
Jìn shū says: Western Róng Major Yán Zuǎn was [Yán] Pǔ’s grandson.



〔二〕　臣松之以為張魯雖有善心，要為敗而後降，今乃寵以萬戶，五子皆封侯，過矣。習鑿齒曰：魯欲稱王，而閻圃諫止之，今封圃為列侯。夫賞罰者，所以懲惡勸善也，苟其可以明軌訓於物，無遠近幽深矣。今閻圃諫魯勿王，而太祖追封之，將來之人孰不思順！塞其本源而末流自止，其此之謂與！若乃不明於此而重燋爛之功，豐爵厚賞止於死戰之士，則民利於有亂，俗競於殺伐，阻兵仗力，干戈不戢矣。太祖之此封，可謂知賞罰之本，雖湯武居之，無以加也。魏略曰：黃初中，增圃爵邑，在禮請中。後十餘歲病死。晉書云：西戎司馬閻纘，圃孫也。













[44] Wèi lüè states: Liú Xióngmíng was a Lántián man. In youth he used collecting herbs and shooting and hunting as his work, always residing below Fùchē mountain. Every morning and night, he went out walking in clouds and mist, using his knowledge of the roads to not get lost, but the people of the time therefore said he was able to become cloud and mist. In the chaos of Guō [Sì] and Lǐ [Jué], many people joined him. During Jiàn’ān he submitted himself to the province and prefecture, the province and prefecture recommended him as a minor officer. When Mǎ Chāo and the rest rebelled, he would not agree to follow them, [Mǎ] Chāo attacked him. Later he visited Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ grasped his hand and spoke to him stating: “When I was about to enter the passes, I dreamed of obtaining one divine man, was it you?” Thus generously treated him, memorializing to appoint him a General, sent to command and welcome his division group. The division group did not wish to surrender, therefore seized him to rebel, various fugitives all went to depend on him, he had multitudes of several thousand men, occupying Wǔ Pass’s road mouth. Tàizǔ sent Xiàhóu Yuān to suppress and defeated him, [Liú] Xióngmíng fled south to Hànzhōng. When Hànzhōng was defeated, destitute with nowhere to go, he thus again submitted to surrender. Tàizǔ grabbed his beard and said: “Old bandit, I truly got you!” Restored his office, transferred to Bóhǎi. At the time also there were Chéng Yín, Hóu Xuǎn, Lǐ Kān, all Hédōng men. In the chaos of Xīngpíng [194 - 195], each had multitudees of over a thousand families. Jiàn’ān Sixtheenth Year [211], they all united with Mǎ Chāo. [Mǎ] Chāo was defeated and fled, [Lǐ] Kān facing the battle lines died. [Chéng] Yín and [Hóu] Xuǎn went south to enter Hànzhōng. When Hànzhōng was defeated, they visited Tàizǔ to surrender, all restored offices and noble titles.



〔三〕　魏略曰：劉雄鳴者，藍田人也。少以采藥射獵為事，常居覆車山下，每晨夜，出行雲霧中，以識道不迷，而時人因謂之能為雲霧。郭、李之亂，人多就之。建安中，附屬州郡，州郡表薦為小將。馬超等反，不肯從，超破之。後詣太祖，太祖執其手謂之曰：「孤方入關，夢得一神人，即卿邪！」乃厚禮之，表拜為將軍，遣令迎其部黨。部黨不欲降，遂劫以反，諸亡命皆往依之，有眾數千人，據武關道口。太祖遣夏侯淵討破之，雄鳴南奔漢中。漢中破，窮無所之，乃復歸降。太祖捉其鬚曰：「老賊，真得汝矣！」復其官，徙勃海。時又有程銀、侯選、李堪，皆河東人也，興平之亂，各有眾千餘家。建安十六年，並與馬超合。超破走，堪臨陳死。銀、選南入漢中，漢中破，詣太祖降，皆復官爵。

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Appraisal


Appraisal states: Gōngsūn Zàn protected a citadel, sitting and waiting to be exterminated. [Gōngsūn] Dù was cruel and violent and without restraint, [Gōngsūn] Yuān continued the enterprise to accumulate viciousness, only sufficient to overturn their clan. Táo Qiān was ignorant and chaotic and so in distress died, Zhāng Yáng gave up his head by his own subordinates, both embraced and occupied province and prefectures, but did not compare even to common fellows, assuredly not worthy of discussion. [Zhāng] Yàn, [Zhāng] Xiù, [Zhāng] Lǔ gave up crowds of robbers, ranked as accomplished ministers, left danger and destruction, protecting ancestral sacrifices, then in comparison to the others they were better.



評曰：公孫瓚保京，坐待夷滅。度殘暴而不節，淵仍業以載凶，秪足覆其族也。陶謙昏亂而憂死，張楊授首於臣下，皆擁據州郡，曾匹夫之不若，固無可論者也。燕、繡、魯舍群盜，列功臣，去危亡，保宗祀，則於彼為愈焉。

title: 8  Biographies of Two Gōngsūn, Táo Qiān, Four Zhāng
text:
Below the Gates (ménxià) refer to the administrative office staff under an official. Writing aide (shūzuǒ) refers to a low-ranking clerical post.↩︎
Filial-Incorruptbile (xiàolián) was a type of candidate nomination for office. The most common path for a government career was to be nominated Filial-Incorruptible, then serve a probationary period as a Cadet (lǎng) serving in the capital.↩︎
A Dependent State (shǔguó) was a formerly foreign tribal group that submitted to the Empire but was permitted to retain a local government subordinate to a nearby prefecture, rather than be directly ruled by the prefecture.↩︎
Magistrate (lìng) was the head of a county.↩︎
Jì county was in Guǎngyáng prefecture↩︎
Wūhuán were a nomadic people in the northeast.↩︎
Minister of the Imperial Clan (zōngzhèng) was one of the Nine Ministers, responsible for keeping track of members of the extended male-line Imperial family.↩︎
Xiāngbēn county was in Dōnghǎi prefecture.↩︎
Prefectures that also served as a fief state were led by a Chancellor (xiàng) instead of an Administrator (tàishǒu), as a holdover from when fief states were actually ruled by their respective King or Marquess with their own courts headed by a Chancellor.↩︎
Minister of Staff (guānglùxūn) was one of the Nine Ministers, in charge of the grandees and cadets in the service of the Palace. The name guānglùxūn is believed to have derived from the name of a building in the Palace complex.↩︎
Bópíng county was in Dōng prefecture.↩︎
Minister of the Guard (wèiwèi) was one of the Nine Ministers, responsible for the Imperial Guard.↩︎
To undertake authority (chéngzhì) was to claim delegated authority from the Emperor to make enfeoffments and appointments. Claiming this authority would have allowed Liú Yú to legitimize the titles claimed by Yuán Shào and the rest.↩︎
Xiào-Líng is the full posthumous name of Emperor Líng. All Hàn Emperors except the two founding Emperors Gāo and Guāng-Wǔ formally have Xiào as one of their posthumous names. The shared character is sometimes dropped for convenience.↩︎
After the death of the founding Hàn Emperor Gāo, his widow the Empress Lǚ controlled the government first through her weak son the Emperor Huī and then through two alleged sons of Emperor Huī, greatly empowering her Lǚ clan in the process. After her death, the Marquess of Jiàng Zhōu Bó and Guàn Yīng led a coup that destroyed the Lǚ clan. They deposed and executed the Later Young Emperor, claiming he was not a true biological son of Emperor Huī, and then welcomed Emperor Gāo’s son Liú Héng, the King of Dài, to become Emperor. Liú Héng is known by his posthumous name Emperor Wén.↩︎
In the chaos of the Former Hàn-Xīn-Later Hàn transition, one of the first claimant restorations of Hàn was led by Liú Xuán, who became known by his title and Year Name Gēngshǐ ”Another Beginning.” He ultimately failed to restore order and was killed. Liú Xiù successively led another attempted restoration, founding Later Hàn, and is known by his posthumous name Emperor Guāng-Wǔ.↩︎
Yú Wéi Tiān Zǐ. The word for Exepctation (yú) is the same character for Liú Yú’s personal name, allowing for the prophetic interpretation “Liú Yú as Heaven’s Son.”↩︎
The word for replacing (dài), as in replacing the current Emperor, is also the name of Dài prefecture.↩︎
Yuán Shù had memorialized Sūn Jiān as Inspector of Yù Province. Yuán Shào then memorialized Zhōu Áng as a rival claimant to that office and sent him to take over the province from Sūn Jiān.↩︎
The Pán river was in Pán county in Píngyuán prefecture.↩︎
Guǎngchuān county was in Qīnghé prefecture.↩︎
Suí Huáng and Fú Xī were two of the earliest claimed rulers of high antiquity.↩︎
At the end of Former Hàn, the powerful regent Wáng Mǎng gradually accrued temporary powers, even becoming ‘Temporary Emperor,’ until he finally accepted title as the true Emperor, founding the Xīn empire.↩︎
Jūyōng county was in Shànggǔ prefecture.↩︎
Yì county was in Héjiān prefecture.↩︎
Lù county was in Shàngdǎng prefecture.↩︎
Bó is the term for an oldest brother, Zhòng the second, Shū the third, Jì the fourth.↩︎
Bó Yí and Shū Qí were famous brothers who lived during the Shāng-Zhōu transition era.↩︎
Qí and Jìn were powerful states during the Spring and Autumn era. Duke Huán of Qí and Duke Wén of Jìn were two of the celebrated Five Hegemons who held true power but used it to support the legitimate but weak Zhōu dynasty.↩︎
In formal government official dress, the seal of office was worn by tying the ribbon or cord attached to the seal to the wearer’s belt.↩︎
According to Hú Sānshěng’s commentary to the Zīzhì Tōngjiàn, the river and battle site were on the border between Píngyuán and Bóhǎi.↩︎
Mèngmíng was a Sprign and Autumn era Qín officer who famously achieved a great victory to avenge a previous humiliating defeat.↩︎
Breaking head (suìshǒu) is a reference to bowing to knock one’s head against the ground, the most extreme level display of submission and begging.↩︎
Specially Advanced (tèjìn) is a special additional honor placing someone’s ceremonial rank and position as just after the Three Excellencies.↩︎
This refers to Cáo Pī, who is often referred to anachronstically by his office as Five Office General (wǔguānjiāng).↩︎
Abundant Talent (màocái) was a level of nomination for government office made at the provincial level, above the Filial-Incorruptible (xiàolián) nominations at the prefecture level.↩︎
Lú county was in Jǐběi prefecture.↩︎
Lìyáng county was in Dānyáng prefecture.↩︎
This Cáo Hóng 宏 should not be confused with the more famous Cáo Hóng 洪.↩︎
Yúyáo county was in Kuàijī prefecture.↩︎
Gōng is almost certainly an honorific (Gān-gōng) meaning something like “elder” rather than a personal name, but for convenience of flow we will not translate it here.↩︎
Shū county was in Lújiāng prefecture.↩︎
Presumably there was some sort of implicit social etiquette involved in the dance that is now no longer known for sure.↩︎
